Coll. of Trop. Agr., 1921.

COLLETT, J. W., M.R.C.P., M.R.C.S.—Med. offr., S. Nigeria, 1901; author of "Text Book of Physiology and Hygiene."

COLLIER, C. W. H.—B. 1892; ed. Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana; cler. astt., immigrn. dept., Br. Guiana, 1909; sec. to various col. comtes, and gradually promoted to 1st cls. offr., 1920; immigrn. agt., 1926; sec. (colonization (500 family scheme) comtes, 1927; senr. immigrn. agt. and immigrn. agt., Demerara county, 1928; ag. immigrn. agt., 1929; senr. clk., col. sec.'s office, 1930; prin. clk. and clk., exec. and leg. couns. 1932; astt. col. sec., 1934.

COLLIER, HON. PHILIP.—B. 1873; M.L.A. for Boulder, W. Australia, since 1905; min. for mines and rly. in Scaddan govt., 1911-14, and of mines and water supply, 1914-16; leader, parly. labour party, May, 1917; premier, W. Australia, Apr., 1924 to Apr., 1930.

COLLIER, REGINALD.—B. 1880; stock inspr.; Basutoland, 1910; sub-inspr., Basutoland Mounted Pol., 1910; inspr., 1924; Zulu Rebellion, 1906; Great War, 1917-19.

COLLINS, CHARLES HENRY, B.A., Lond.—B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1910; attd. Karunegala kachli, Dec., 1910; office astt., Kandy Kachheri, July, 1913; astt. land settm. offr., May, 1915; astt. land settm. offr., Sept., 1915; addtl. astt. govt. agt., ditto, Sept., 1916; office astt. to govt. agt., W. Prov., Oct., 1916; 2nd astt. col. sec., Oct., 1917; 3rd astt. col. sec., Sept., 1920; 2nd astt. col. sec., Jan., 1922; prin. astt. col. sec., Feb., 1924; addtl. astt. col. sec., Oct., 1925; dep. collr., cust., Dec., 1925; ag. dep. ch. sec., Dec., 1932; govt. agt., Sabaragamuwa, Feb., 1933; dep. finan. secy., Feb., 1934; offr. cls. I., grade I., 1935.

COLLINS, JOHN VICTOR, M.A., Sc.M. (Dublin), F.I.C.—B. 1897; astt. govt. analyst, Ceylon, Jan., 1925; dep. do., Oct., 1927; govt. analyst, May, 1934.

COLLINS, W. H., Ph. D., F.R.S.C.—B. 1878; ed. Univ. of Toronto, 1904; Heidelberg Univ., 1907; Chicago Univ., 1909; Univ. of Wisconsin, 1911; astt. geologist, govt. surv. of Can., 1906; jun. geol., 1912; geol., 1914; fellow, Royal Soc. of Can., 1918; dir., geol. surv. of Can., 1920; ex-offf. mem., Can. Inst. Min. Met.; mem., Geol. Soc. of America, 1920; has pub. numerous papers and memoirs on pre-cambrian geol. and petrology.

COLLISSON, PERCIVAL LORIMER, O.B.E. (Mil.), 1919.—B. 1883; ed. at Warminster and King's Coll., London; examr., E. and A. dept., 1901; col. aud. branch, Sept., 1906; examr. of acota, O.R.C., Jan., 1906; rejoined col. aud. branch, Jan., 1908; astt. auditor, N. Nigeria, Sept., 1908; 2nd cls. clk., col. audit., 1914; mil. audit., E. Africa Exped. Force, 1916 (twice ment. in des.), senr. astt. auditor, E.A.P., Apr., 1919; ag. audr., E.A.P., 1920; audr., Fiji and W. Pacific, 1922; audr., N. Rhodesia, Aug., 1924; audr., Uganda, Sept., 1927; audr., Hong Kong, Aug., 1930; J.P., 1932.

COLLYMORE, ERNEST ALLAN, M.A. (Oxon.), K.C. (1933)—B. 1893; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and Merton Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. hons. final schl. of jurisprudence, 1914; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1920; serv. in E. Lancs. Regt., 1914-19; capt., Oct., 1915; capt., Barbados Vols. and O.C., cadet corps of the island, 1921-26; sen. mag., Bridgetown and dist. A, June, 1925; recvr. of wrecks, Aug., 1925; ag. judge, astt. ot. of appeal
in 1925 and 1926; stip. and circuit mag., Bahamas and coroner for New Providence, July, 1927; ag. atty.-gen., in 1927 and 1928; atty.-gen., Barbados, June, 1928.

COMBE, SIR RALPH MOLYNEUX, K.T. BACH (1920).—Ed. at Haileybury Coll. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1894; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1897; Crown advocate, E. Africa Prot., 4th Aug., 1905; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., 1907; atty.-gen. E.A.P., 1912; atty.-gen., Nigeria, 1913; ch. just., Nigeria, 1918; ret. Mar., 1929.

COMMISSION, TERENCE BERTRAND.—B. 1893; 3rd clk., col. sec.'s office, Grenada, Apr., 1909; 2nd clk., gov.'s office, June, 1915; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s office, Dec., 1919; ag. ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, clk. of couns., med. regis., and man. govt. printing sub-dept., Feb.-Sept., 1920; seconded for active serv., Sept., 1915 to Oct., 1919; awarded meritorious serv. med. in German E. African campaign, June, 1916; appdtd. J.P., Grenada, in recog. of war serv., July, 1919; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, clk. to exec. coun., med.regis. and man., govt. printing dept., May, 1921; asst. col. sec., Grenada, Jan., 1928.

CONIBEAR, JAMES HANFORD.—Reg. army, 1897-1919; sub-inspr., pol. and keeper, prisons, St. Lucia, Nov., 1920; ag. ch., pol. and inspr., prisons, 1922; prison supt., Gold Coast, Jan., 1924; lieut., G.C. Volunteers, Oct., 1924; ag. adjt., 1924-25; capt., G.C. Defence Force, Mar., 1933; supt., grade I, Sept., 1934; senr. prison supt., Jan., 1935; ag.dir., prisons, June-Sept., 1935.

CONNELL, W. K., M.B., Ch.B. (Glas.), F.R.C.S. (Eng.), D.T.M. & H. (Lond.).—B. 1893; mily. serv., R.A.M.C., 1916-20; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1924; junr. surg. specialist, 1934.

CONNOLLY, HON. SIR JAMES DANIEL, K.T. BACH, (1920).—B. 1870; ed. Warwick Publ. Schl. and Catholic Schl.; M.L.C., Western Australia, 1902; col. sec. and min. of com. and lab., 1906; col. sec. and min. of pub. health, 1910; leader of leg. coun. from 1906 to 1911; M.L.A. for Perth, 1914; agt. genl. in London for Western Australia, 1917-23; agt. genl. in London for Malta, 1930.

CONRADIE, DAVID GIDEON, B.A., LL.D.—B. 1879; ed. Prince Alfred Hamlet and Ceres Schls., Stellenbosch and Trinity Coll., Dublin; sen. mod. and gold medal, LL.D., 1906; advoc., Cape Town and Bloemfontein, 1907-09; sec., educn. dept., O.F.S., 1909-15; atty., Reitz and Bloemfontein, 1915-33; mem., prov. and prov. exec., 1920-26; M.P., Bethlehem and Lindley, 1926-33; admstr., S.W. Africa, 1933.

CONRADIE, JOHANNES HENDRIK.—B. 1872; ed. Calitzdorp, Robertson, pvt. study, later Stellenbosch; schmaster., Christiana, 1889; Boshof, 1890-95 and Grey Coll. Schl., 1896-1900; admitted as atty.-at-law, 1905; finan. sec., Dutch Reformed Ch., Cape Prov., 1905-12; supt., Kakamas lab. sol., 1912-1920; organising secy., Nationalist Party, Cape Prov., 1921-29; mem., leg. assem. for Gordonia, 1924-29; admstr., Cape Prov., Sept., 1929.

CONSTANT, CHARLES FREDERICK, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—B. 1888; radiologist, F.M.S., Apr., 1924; do., col. hosp., Port-of-Spain, Trinidad, Jan., 1934.

CONWAY, WILLIAM EWAN.—B. 1893; ed. High Schl., Dundee; govt. travelling schl. master, 10th Dec., 1913; 2nd clk., C.S.O., Mar., 1916; ag. clk. and priv. sec. to gov't of Falkland Is., June, 1916 to Apr., 1917 and Sept., 1917 to Apr., 1920; collr., cust., G. Coast, Oct., 1920; senr. collr., cust., June, 1928.

COOK, MAJOR DUDLEY STAFFORD.—B. 1890; ed. Elston Schl., Bedford; solr., June, 1913; asst. dist. offr., Nigeria, Apr., 1914; served in Cameroons, 1914; G.E.A., 1917-18; major, 1918; ag. commnr., lands, Nigeria, 1924-25; dist. offr., 1924; asst. commnr., lands, S. Prova., 1927-30; dep. rea., 1933; ag. commnr., Colony, 1934-35.

COOK, RT. HON. SIR JOSEPH, P.C. (1914); G.C.M.G. (1918).—B. 1860; mem. of H. of R., Commonwealth of Australia, since 1901; postm.-gen., N.S. Wales, 1894-1998; min. for mines and agric., 1898-9; min. of defence, C. of A., June, 1909; prime minister, C. of A., June, 1913-Sept., 1914; min. for the Navy, 1917; ditto, from 10th Jan., 1918; high commnr. in London for C. of A., Nov., 1921; ret., 1927.

COOKE, ELEANOR MARGARET.—B. 1891; matron, Achimota Coll., Gold Coast, May, 1928.

COOKE, S. V.—Asst. dist. commnr., E.A.P., Jan., 1917; accompanied S. Aulitian (Somali) patrol, 1917-18; polit. offr., Turkana, 1921; A.G.S. med. and clasp.; dist. commnr., Kenya, 1928; dist. offr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1931.

COOKE, WILLIAM ERNEST, M.A., F.R.A.S.—Cadet, Adelaide observatory, 1878; B.A. Adel. Univ., 1883; ast. astronomer, Adel. obser., 1884; M.A. Adel. Univ., 1889; govt. astronomer, W.A., 1896; govt. astronomer, New South Wales, 1912-26; prof. of astronomy at Sydney Univ.

COOLS-LARTIGUE, ALEXANDER RAPHAEL—B. 1899; ed. at St. Mary's Coll., St. Lucia, and Dominica Grammar Schl.; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1924; admitted to bar, Leeward Is., 1924; practised at bar, 1924-35; ag. crown atty. and mag. dist. "F," and mem. exec. and leg. couns., Dominica, Oct. 1931 to Jan. 1932; ag. crownatty., Dominica, and mem. exec. and leg. couns., Aug., 1933 to Feb., 1934, and from July, 1934 to Jan., 1935; visiting just. of prisons and J.P., 1934; crown atty., and mag., dist. "E," and mem. exec. and leg. couns., Dominica, Jan., 1936; commnr., sup. ct., Leeward Is., June, 1936.

COOLS-LARTIGUE, LOUIS.—B. 1905; ed. Dominica Grammar Schl.; ast. mast., Dominica Grammar Schl., Mar., 1923-1948; 2nd clk., admnr.'s office, Dec., 1924; junr. clk., do., Aug., 1927; senr. clk., regist'r's office, Apr., 1929; prin., admnr.'s office as ch. clk. and clk. of couns., etc., June, 1932.

COOLS-LARTIGUE, THEODORE.—B. 1867; ed. at Mount Saint Mary's Coll., Derbyshire; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1889; admitted to the bar, St. Lucia, 1889; ditto, Leeward Is., 1894; ag. regist'r., St. Lucia, 1891; ag. mag. in 1903-4-5; ag. regist'r., St. Lucia, 1906-7; ag. mag., 1911; elective mem., Castries town bd., 1903-1912; regist'r. and prov. marshal, Dominica, and also supplementary mag., Roseau, Dominica, Feb., 1912; offi. mem. leg. coun., Dominica, visiting just. of Dominica prison and J.P., 1912; govt. mem., Roseau town bd., 1914; valuation commnr. for assessing of taxes, 1916; ag. crown atty. and mem. exec. coun., 1916-19; crownatty. and regist'r., sup. ct., Oct., 1919; ret., 1929; re-apptd. ag. addnl. mag., dist. E, 1930.

COOMARASWAMY, CHINNAPPAN.—B. 1887; ed. Hindu Coll., Jaffna, and Royal Coll., Colombo; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. serv., April, 1910; extra office astt. to govt. ast., Batticaloa, Apl., 1910; pol. mag., Matara, May, 1913; pol. mag. and office astt. to govt. ast., Puttalam, June, 1913; pol. mag., Chilaw, Feb., 1914; pol. mag., Point Pedro, June, 1915; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Feb., 1918; ditto, Chilaw and Puttalam, Mar., 1920; addnl. astt. govt. ast., Chilaw and Puttalam, in
addn., Aug., 1920; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, May, 1922; dep. comsnr., stamps, May, 1925; dist. judge, Kalutara, Apr., 1926; dep. comsnr., stamps, May, 1926; registr., motor cars, Jan., 1928; ag. registr.-gen., Sept., 1931; dist. judge, Kurunegala, June, 1932; do., Jaffna, Oct., 1933.

COOMARASWAMY, VALUPPILLAI.—B. 1892; Cadet, local division, Ceylon civ. serv., Mar., 1913; attached to Puttalam Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; Anuradhapura Kach., June, 1913; ag. addtnl. office asst., Anuradhapura Kach., Nov., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Puttalam, Feb., 1914; extra offic. asst. to asst. govt. agent, Puttalam and Chilaw, in addition to his own duties, Mar., 1914; pol. mag., Negombo, July, 1917; ditto, Dandangamuwa, July, 1918; office asst. to govt. agt., S. Prov., Feb., 1919; pol. mag., Panadura, Oct., 1920; dist. judge, Kegalla, June, 1924; asst. govt. agt., Hambantota, July, 1927; asst. govt. agt., Puttalam and Chilaw, Jan., 1931; clk., state coun. and sec., bd. of ministers, July, 1932; ag. govt. agt., E. Prov., June, 1933; offr., cls. I. grade II., 1935.

COOMBES, H. P.—B. 1894; clk., govt. sec's. office, Nyasaland, May, 1917; senr. clk., Aug., 1923; ag. asst. sec. and clk., exec. and leg. couns., Dec., 1926 to Mar., 1927; ag. senr. asst. sec. and clk., exec. and leg. couns., Apr. to Dec., 1927; ag. office supt., secretariat and clk., exec. and leg. couns., in 1929 and 1930; office supt., secretariat, Apr., 1931; clk., exec. and leg. couns., Apr., 1931 to Dec., 1933.

COOPE, ARTHUR EGERTON.—B. 1888; ed. Fonthill Schi., St. Edward's Schi., and Keble Coll., Oxford; B.A. Oxon.; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; passed cadet, June, 1913; offr., cls. V., Dec., 1914; asst. dist. offr., May, 1915; offr., cls. IV., Jan., 1919; asst. dist. offr., Apr., 1919; dist. offr., Mar., 1921; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1923; offr. asst. advr., lands, Redah, May, 1924; town planning admr. and state valuer, Ipoh, Oct., 1928; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1928; ag. asst. dist. offr., Ipoh, in addn., Apr. to May, 1929; ag. mag., Seremban, Sept., 1929; ag. chmn., sany, bd. in addn., ass. adviser, Muar, Johore, Mar., 1930; mag., K. Lumpur, July, 1931; offr., cls. B., Nov., 1931; ag. legal advr. and judl. comsnr., Kelantan, Mar., 1933; comsnr., trade and cust., Johore, Dec., 1934; finan. comsnr. and audr.-gen., do., Feb., 1935.

COOPER, BERTRAND, M.N.Z.I.S.—B. 1882; mounted infy., S. Africa, 1901-02; licensed survr., N.Z., 1906-07; survr., Pahang, Apr., 1921; asst. supt., rev. surveys, F.M.S., Jan., 1926; asst. supt. (field), Kinta, Aug., 1929; ag. asst. supt., rev. surveys, Kinta, June, 1930 to Feb., 1931; asst. supt., surveys, Malacca, May, 1933; do., Kedah, Mar., 1934; seconded as ass. contr. rubber, June, 1934.

COOPER, EVANS GUSTAVUS.—B. 1875; asst. clk. of courts, Jamaica, 1893; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1912; clerk of cts., Hanover, Dec., 1912; J.P., 1913; ag. res. mag. on various occasions; supernw. rev. mag., June, 1923; res. mag., June, 1924.

COOPER, COMDR. GUY EDWARD, R.N. (ret.),—B. 1891; ed. R.N.; Great War, ment. in desps.; called to bar, Inner Temple, 1923; legal adviser, Seychelles, Apr., 1928; ag. ch. just., May to Nov., 1928 and Nov., 1930 to May, 1932; pol. mag., Gold Coast, Nov., 1932.

COOPER, WILLIAM GERALD GROVES, Ph.D. (Lond.), B.Sc. (Lond.), A.R.C.Sc., F.G.S., A.Inst. M.M.—B. 1890; ed. Queen Elizabeth's Grammar Schi., Crediton, Devon, Battersea Polytechnic Inst. and Imp. Coll. of Sc. and Technology, 1911-14; res. engr., on location and constrn. of Canadian Northern Ontario Rly., 1911-14; war serv., 1914-18; geologist, Gold Coast geol. survey, Nov., 1919.

COORAY, EDMUND JOSEPH, B.A., LL.B. (Lond.), Barrister-at-Law, Lincoln's Inn.—B. 1907; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Oct., 1931; attd. Colombo kach., Nov., 1931; office assst., Ratnapura kach., Mar., 1934.

CORBETT, ALAN FREDERICK.—B. 1878; ed. K.H.S., Coventry, and St. John's Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1902; barrister-at-law (Inner Temple), 1903; advoc., sup. ct., Cape Colony, 1904; sup. ct. (T.P.D.) Union of S.A., 1919; clk., res. mag., Worcester, July, 1903; clk., mast. sup. ct., Cape, Jan., 1905; clk., res. mag., Beaufort West, Dec., 1905; clk., civil comsnr., Kimberley, May, 1906; clk., inland rev. dept., Apr., 1911; ag. recr. of rev., Germiston, Oct., 1915; senr. clk., inland rev. dept., Nov., 1916; prin. clk., inland rev. dept., Jan., 1921; asst. comsnr. for inland rev., Apr., 1929; comsnr. for inland rev., Sept., 1929.

CORBETT, GEORGE HAMBLIN, B.Sc., F.R.E.S.—B. 1887; ed. King Edwards Schi., Bath, and Edin., Cornell and Harvard Univ.; gov't. entomologist, F.M.S., Apr., 1920; deleg. of F.M.S. and S.S. gov'ts. at 2nd Imp. Entomological Confce., London, June, 1925; constg. entomologist, Inst. Med. Resch., and Rubber Resch. Inst., in addn., June, 1930-Aug., 1932.

CORDEAUX, MAJOR SR HARRY EDWARD SPILLER, K.C.M.G. (1921), C.B. (1904), C.M.G. (1902).—Ed. at Cheltenham Coll., and St. John's Coll., Camb.; minor scholarship, 1889; class. tripods, 1892; passed in Hindustani and Persian, 1895; Somali, 1899; B.A., 1892; entd. Indian Army, 1894; probationer, Bombay polit. dept., as 4th asst. polit. res., Aden, Apr., 1898; asst. res., Berbera, July, 1898; vice-consul, Berbera, Oct., 1898; consul, Nov., 1902; admstd. gov't. of Somaliland Prot., in 1900, 1902, 1903 and 1904; served in operations against the Somali Mullah 1902-04, as polit. offr. (ment. in desps., medal and 3 clasps); dep. comsnr., Somaliland Prot., 1904; admstd. gov't., June, 1905; comsnr. and comdr-in-chief, 15th May, 1906; gov', Uganda, 1st Feb., 1910; gov', St. Helena, 22nd Nov., 1911; assumed gov't., 21st Feb., 1912; gov', Bahamas, 1920.

CORDOUAN, JEAN ALBERT.—B. 1887; clk., cust., Durban, 1904; Pretoria, 1911; 1st grade clk., 1916; senr. clk., 1919; prin. clk., 1921; acct., 1922; ch. clk., cust. and excise, Pretoria, 1930; ch. insp., cust. and excise, 1933; dep. comsnr., 1933.

COREA, CARLTON VICTOR DEMETRIUS SENKWIRATNE.—B. 1903; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Feb., 1927; attd. Matara kach., Mar. 1927; ag. office asst., Kegalle kach., Nov., 1928; pol. mag., Pt. Pedro, Mar., 1930; office asst., Galle kach., Nov., 1931; asst. govt. agt., Badulla, June, 1933; asst. settlm. offr., Dec., 1934.

CORNELL, CHARLES ALBERT.—Called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1928; asst. dist. comsnr., Kenya, Feb., 1921; ag. dist. comsnr., 1925; dist. comsnr., 1927.

CORNEY, LEONARD GEORGE.—B. 1886; B.A. Cantab., class. exhibtnr. St. John's Coll., Camb.; class. tripods, 1908; examr., col. audit branch of R. and A. Dept., Feb., 1910; asst. audr., Gold Coast, Aug., 1910; ag. audr., July, 1913, July to
Dec., 1914, and Apl. to Oct., 1916; ag. ast. col. sec., Dec., 1916 to Jan., 1917; seconded to G. Coast Regt., Apl., 1917 to Jan., 1918; senr. audr., Jan., 1919; ag. audr., Jan. to Oct., 1919; dep. audr., Jan., 1920; ast. dir. cent. office (Col. Audit Dept.), Feb., 1930; dep. audr., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1931; ag. audr., S.S. and F.M.S., Apr., 1932; audr., do., 1936.

CORNISH, HENRY HAVELOCK, K.C., M.A. (double 1st cls., hon.), LL.M.—B. 1887; ed. Kaitangata Schol., Otago Boys' High Schl., Otago Univ. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; pvt. legal practice many years; pres., Wellington dist. law socty., 1926; mem., N.Z. law socty.; coun. of law reporting, rules comte., etc.; prof., English and N.Z. law, Victoria Univ. Coll., 1930-34; solr.-gen., N.Z., 1934.

CORNWALLIS, COL. SIR K., K.B.E. (1929), C.M.G. (1926), C.B.E., Mily. (1919), D.S.O. (1917), Commander of the Order of King George I. of Greece, Order of Nahdah (2nd cls.), Order of the Nile (3rd cls.), Order of Majidie (4th cls.), three times mentioned in desps.—Sudan civ. serv., 1906-14; Egyptian civ. serv., 1914; dir. Arab Bureau, Cairo, 1916-19; dep. ch. polit. offr., Egyptian Expedy. Force, 1918; ast. ch. polit. offr., ditto, 1919; addt. to Amir Faisal in London, 1919; addt. to F.O., 1920-21; accompanied Amir Faisal to 'Iraq and seconded to 'Iraq govt. for two years, June, 1921; adviser to min. of interior, 'Iraq, September, 1921.

CORRIE, OWEN CECIL KIRKPATRICK, M.C.—B. 1882; ed. Monckton Combe Schol. and Trinity Coll., Cambridge (maths. exhibr.); on active serv. in France, Belgium and Palestine with N. Somerset Yeomanry and R.F.A. (T.F.), 1915-19; M.C. and ment. in desps.; judl. offr., Nablus, O.E.T.A. (S.), Mar., 1919; vice-pres., ct. of appeal, O.E.T.A. (S.), Oct., 1919; vice-pres., ct. of appeal, Palestine, July, 1920; senr. Br. judge, sup. ct., Sept., 1924; ag. ch. just., Oct., 1922 to Jan., 1923 and from Oct., 1924 to Jan., 1925.

CORSEK, LIEUT. E. E.—Ed. Shrewsbury; 2nd lieut., 4th Batt. King's Shropshire Light Infantry (T.), Aug., 1914; lieut., June, 1916; served in France, 1917-18; ast. dist. commr., G. Coast, 3rd Dec., 1919.

CORSON, JAMES FREDERICK, O.B.E. (1935), M.B.E., M.D., Ch.B. (Manch.), D.P.H., D.T.M. & H. (Cantab.).—B. 1878; W.A.M.S. (Gold Coast), Jan., 1913; pathologist, Dec., 1920; Nigeria, May, 1923; Tanganika Territory, 1925.

COSGRAVE, ALEXANDER KIRKPATRICK, M.C.—B. 1885; ed. Shrewsbury and Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O., 1909, D.P.H., 1918; L.M., Rot. Hosp., 1920; grad. with dist., L.S.T.M., 1920; D.T.M. & H. Lon., 1920; col. med. serv., 1910; med. offr., Ulu Selangor, 1911; on active serv., 1914-19; B.E.F. with 34th div., 1916; D.A.D.M.S., 16th (Irish) div., 1917-18; demob. with hon. rank of maj.; med. offr., Klang, ag. H.O., Coast and in charge, quarantine camp, Port Swettenham, 1920; H.O., Negri Sembilan, 1921; sen. med. offr., Selangor, 1922; S.M.O., Selangor, Jan., 1926; offl. mem., advisory coun. to L. of N. eastern health bureau, Singapore, Jan., 1927; senr. health offr., Selangor and Pahang, and ag. ch. health offr., F.M.S. in addn., Feb. to Oct., 1927 and Nov., 1927 to Mar., 1928; ag. ch. health offr., F.M.S., Nov., 1928 and Sept., 1931; major, M.S.V.R., Feb., 1930; state med. and health offr., Pahang, Oct., 1932; do., Perak, Sept., 1934.

COSTAR, NORMAN EDGAR.—B. 1909; ed. Battersea Grammar Schol. and Jesus Coll., Cam-

bridge; hist. schol., 1928-32; cls. I divn. 1, hist. tripes, pts. I and II; B.A., 1931; Kellen prize-man, 1931; apptd. after compet. exam., astt. prin., C.O., Apr., 1932; pvte. sec. to permitt. under sec., D.O. (Sir Ed. Harding), 21st Oct., 1935.

COTCHING, HOUGHTON ALDGATE, A.M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1887; serv. in mech. dept., N.E. Ry. Coy., 1903-15; on mil. serv., 1915; seconded for duty with R.E. (inland waterways and docks), 1917; major, D.A.D.R.T. and sent to Chemin de Fer du Hedjaz as loco. supt., 1919; ch. mech. engr., Palestine rlya., 1920.

COULSON, NORMAN.—B. 1891; ed. Charterhouse and Pembroke Coll., Camb.; (M.A., hons. in cls. and mod. hist.); 2nd lieut., 10th Res. Regt., Cav., Sept., 1914; attd. 8th (K.R.I.) Hussars, Sept., 1915; (France and army of occupation); cadet F.M.S., Apr., 1920; passed cadet, June, 1922; attd. to treas., Penang on sp. duty, Sept., 1922; dist. offr., Dindings, Apr., 1923; dist. offr., Raub, Feb., 1925; seconded for serv. in Kelantan, Aug., 1926; offr., cls. III., Feb., 1928, supt., lands, Kelantan, Apr., 1928; mag., Seremban, Mar., 1930; sg. sec. to res., Selangor; June, 1931; offr., cls. II, Feb., 1933; astt. treas., Penang, Apr., 1934.

COURT, PHILIP FRANCIS SHELSEY, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—B. 1900; med. offr., med. dept., Hong Kong; med. offr. in ch., Kowloon and New Territories, Oct., 1930; ditto, Victoria Hosp., Mar., 1932; astt. med. offr., Victoria Hosp., May, 1932; med. offr. in ch., Kowloon Hosp., Mar., 1933.

COUTTS, JAMES MAGNUS.—B.1896; ed. Heriot's Schol., Schol. of Medicine and Univ., Edinburgh; L.D.S., R.C.S. (Edin.), 1924; served great war with Cameron Highlanders, 1915-19; M.M., 1916; dental surg., Falkland Is., Oct., 1925; ag. loco. audr., Apr., 1926-Apr., 1927; lieut., Falkland Is. Def. Force, 1927; capt., ag. O.C., May to Nov., 1928; 2nd in commd., 1927-31; dental offr., Straits Settlements, Aug., 1931; dent. offr., S.S. and dent. surg., S'pore, Jan., 1934; sec., dent. I.d., S.S. in addn., Feb., 1934.

COWAN, JOHN ARCHER, M.B., B.S. (Lond.), D.T.M. (L'pool).—B. 1890; bacteriologist, S. Stiltsm., Apr., 1925; pathologist, S'pore, Aug., 1926.

COWAP, JOHN CHESTER, B.Sc. (Vic.), F.I.C.—B. 1884; chem. astt. govt. lab'y., London, Sept., 1904; astt. govt. analyst, S'pore, Apr., 1909; dep. govt. analyst, Penang, Oct., 1909; govt. analyst, S.S., June, 1924; ditto and astt. supt., govt. monopolies, S'pore, Jan., 1929.

COWELL, HUBERT RUSSELL, B.A., C.M.G. (1928).—B. 1877; ed. Malvern and Cambridge; scholar of Clare, 1896-9; apptd., after compet. exam., clk., sec.'s dept., inland revenue, Oct., 1901; 2nd cl. clk., C.O., 27th Mar., 1902; sec. to inter-dept.mtl. comte. on oil fields of W. Indies, 1904; sec. to Roy. Coman. on trade relations between Canada and W. Indies, 1909-1910; priv. sec. to Sir J. Anderson, G.C.M.G., 26th June, 1911; priv. sec. to Lord Emmott, 9th Nov., 1912; priv. sec. to Lord Islington, 8th Aug., 1914; ag. 1st cls. clk., 12th Oct., 1914; 1st cls. clk., 10th Mar., 1916; ag. prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1920; astt. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

COWGILL, JOHN VINCENT.—B. 1888; ed. Durham Schol. and All Souls Coll., Oxford (bible-clerk, 1907-11), 3rd cls. mods., 3rd cls. lit. hum., B.A., 1911; cadet, F.M.S., 1911; studied Chinese, 1912-14; on mil'y. serv., 1915-19; M.C., 1917
ment. in desps., 1919; dist. offr., Dec., 1919; asst. advr., Trengganu, Nov., 1923; town planning admstr. and state valuer, Ipoh, June, 1926; collr., land rev., K. Lumpur and registr., titles, Selangor, Nov., 1927; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1928; ag. dist. offr., Kinta and dist. supt., prisons, July, 1930; mem., Perak coun. of state, Jan., 1932; ag. sec. to res., Perak, Mar., 1932; offr., cls. I.B., 1934; chmn., sauy. bd., K. Lumpur, Feb., 1934.

COWPER, HERBERT WELLESLEY.—B. 1883; ed. at St. Paul's School, London, Hertford Coll.; Oxford, and in Germany, France and Italy, asst. res., N. Nigeria, Nov., 1910; ag. res., 1916; 2nd cls. dist. offr., Dec., 1918.

COX, ARTHUR HENRY.—B. 1888; ed. Felsted and Corpus Christi Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1910; asst. dist. comantr., Uganda, Nov., 1911; A.D.C. to gov., 1918-19; 1st gr. admstrive. offr., Jan., 1922; dep. prov. comantr., Dec., 1928; ag. prov. comantr., July, 1929 and June, 1932; asst. ch. sec., Uganda, Mar., 1930; ag. dep. ch. sec., Mar., 1930 to Oct., 1931; prov. comantr., Dec., 1932.

COX, CHARLES EDWARD LANGLETON.—B. 1889; entd. civ. serv., B. Guiana, 1907; 2nd cls. clk., col. sec.'s office; called to the bar, 1918; stip. mag. for the colony; revising barrister, 1919; served in France as lieut., R.G.A. (S.R.); injured at Loos, Sept., 1916; invalided out of army, Nov., 1917; served under Admiralty as A.T.S.O., mining depot, Grangemouth, Mar. to Dec., 1918; extra A.D.C. to Sir W. Egerton, K.C.M.G., 1913-15; lieut., artillery coy., B. Guiana Militia, 1908; capt., 1919; pol. mag., St. Vincent, 1920-23; ag. atty.-gen. and ch. just., St. Vincent; crown atty. and registr., sup. ct., Dominica, 1923-25; mem., exec. coun., income tax comntr., offl. recr., visiting just., prison, Dominica; pres., dist. ct., Cyprus, 1925; ag. puisne judge, sup. ct., July, Oct. and Nov., 1929, and June-Oct., 1932.

COX, Lieut.-Col. C. H. F., C.M.G. (1927), D.S.O. (1917).—Ed. Rugby and R. Mily. Acad., Woolwich; comsmd. R.H. and R.F.A., 6th Jan., 1900; served S. African War; served in India, 1905-08; seconded Sudan civ. serv., 1913-15; served in Great War, 1915-18; four times ment. in desps., D.S.O., 1917, bar, 1918; brevet lieut.-col., 1st Jan., 1919; asst. admstrive. offr., Palestine, Apr., 1919; mil. gov., Nabulus, May, 1920; ditto, Galilee, Aug., 1920; dist. gov., Samaria, July, 1922; retd. from Army with rank of lieut.-col., Jan., 1923; ch. Br. res. Trans-Jordan, Apr., 1924.

COX, HERBERT CHARLES FAHIE.—Br. Guiana pol., 1913-19; called to bar, 1915; on war serv., France, 1917-19; asst. to atty.-gen., Br. Guiana, 1919; ag. mag. on various occasions; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1925; M.L.C., 1926; ag. ch. just., May-Sept., 1926, Mar.-Oct., 1927 and from June to Sept., 1929; chmn., bd. of health, 1926-27; chmn., water and sewage bd., 1928-29; dep. gov., Mar., 1929; dep. adminstr., June and July, 1929; atty.-gen., Gibraltar, Dec., 1929; solr.-gen., Nigeria, 1933; ag. atty.-gen., Mar.-Aug., 1934; atty.-gen., 1935.

COX, Major-Gen. Sir Percy Zacharian, G.C.M.G. (1922), G.C.I.E. (1917), K.C.S.I. (1915), K.C.M.G. (1920), K.C.I.E. (1911), C.S.I. (1909), C.I.E. (1902), F.R.G.S., F.Z.S.—B. 1864; ed. Harrow and Sandhurst; joined army 1884; served with 2nd batt. Cameronians till 1889; joined Indian Staff Corps 1889; Indian polit. dep., 1890; vice-consul, Zaila, Somali Coast, 1893; Berbera, 1894-95; consul and polit. agt., Muscat, 1899-1904; consul-gen., Bushire, 1904; polit. res., Persian Gulf, 1909; sec., foreign dept. govt. of India, 1914; ch. polit. offr., Indian Expedy. Force "D," 1914; ment. in desps., 1916; ag. British min. to Persia, 1919-20; high comantr., Mesopotamia, 1920, ret., 1923.

CRABB, RICHARD BRUCE—B.1891; ed. Cranleigh Sch.; asst dist. comantr., Gold Coast, 1915; served European War, East Surrey Regt., 1916-18; dist. comantr., 1922; asst. col. sec., 1923; called to bar, Inner Temple, 1926; ag. clk., couns. in 1927 and 1928; ag. prin. asst. col. sec., Apr. to Sept., 1932; senr. asst. col. sec., Sept., 1932.

CRAGG, WILLIAM GILLIAT, D.S.O. (1918). Major, R. of O. Loyal Regt.—B. 1883; ed. Shrewsbury and R.M.C., Sandhurst; asst. dist. offr., N. Nigeria, Aug., 1920.

CRAIG, ERNEST DUNCAN, M.A., B.Sc., F.Z.S.—B. 1888; ed. Aberdeen Univ. and at Exeter Coll., Oxford; supt., educn. dept., N. Provs., Nigeria, Jan., 1920.

CRAIG, JOHN.—B. 1884; ed. at Aberdeen Univ.; M.A., lst cl. hons., Classics; univ. prize in Latin, 1906; and at Christ Church, Oxford; B.A., 2nd cls. hons., lit. hum., 1908; after exam., examnr., E. and A. dept., Jan., 1909; asst. auditor, S. Nigeria, May, 1909; temporarily transfd. to N. Nigeria, Aug., 1909; joined col. audit dept., Jan., 1910; auditor, Br. Honduras, Nov., 1912; priv. sec. to gov., Sir W. Collett, K.C.M.G., Nov., 1914; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to ag. gov. R. Walter, C.M.G., gov. W.Hart-Bennett, C.M.G., and gov. Eyre-Hutson, C.M.G., 1915-19; lieut., B. Honduras Territorial Force; audr., Mauritius, Apr., 1920; col. audit dept., 1st Apr., 1924; dep. audr., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1926; ag. audr., Mar.-Nov., 1927; treas., Fiji, Apr., 1930; chmn., economy comte., 1931; chmn., tariff revision comte., 1932.

CRAIG, MAJOR JOHN CORBACOCK, D.S.O. (1918). M.Inst.C.E., M.E.I.C.—Res. engnr., P.W.D., Straits Settlements, 1905-13; asst. P.G.E. Rly., Vancouver, Br. Columbia, 1914; lieut., Can. Engrns., 1914; seconded to 1st Can. Pioneers for serv. in France, Oct., 1915; promoted major, July, 1916; ch. engrnr. and 2nd in commd., 9th Can. Rly. Troops, Dec., 1916; asst. constrn. (ag. it. col.) G.H.Q., France, Sept., 1918; demob., Canada, Apr., 1919; R. of O. desps. 3 times; engrnr.-in-ch., soundings and borings, Vancouver harbour, 1919; asst. ch. engrnr., Gold Coast harbrs., 1921; ch. engrnr., 1924; D.P.W., Br. Guiana, 1927; mem., exec. and leg. couns.

CRAIG, RUPERT BERCHMANS, A.M.Inst.C.E., M.R.San.I.—B. 1897; apprentice, P.W.D., Br. Guiana, 1913; served with H.M. Forces, 1915-19; ment. in desps.; ag. asst. engrnr. and ch. draughtsmn., Oct., 1921-July, 1922; asst. draughtsman, P.W.D., Jan., 1924; seconded to consultants, Georgetown improvement schemes, June-July, 1923; seconded to harbr. bd. as engrnr.-in-ch., Berbice River training wks., Jan. to Oct., 1925; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., 1926; dist. engrnr., P.W.D., 1929.

CRAIGIE-HALKETT, MONTAGU C., O.B.E. (1934).—Ag. priv. sec. to gov. Falkland Islds., 1897; writer, col. sec.'s off., Apr., 1897; priv. sec. to admntr., Apr., 1897; clk., col. sec.'s off., Oct., 1897; treasy. clk., 1899; J.P., Nov., 1909; postmtr., man., savings bank, registr.gen., and registr. of sup. ct., and offl. admstr., 1911, temp. mem., leg. coun., 1911 and 1914; supt. census, 1911 and 1921; local audr., 1916-26; registr.-gen.and mag., 1926; temp. mem., exec. coun., 1923; treas. and collr., cust., Aug.,
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

1926; has acted as mag. and regis., sup. ct., and as col. postmr. on various occasions; ag. col. sec., May-July, 1933 and Feb.-Sept., 1934; ag. gov., July, 1933 to Feb., 1934; dep. gov. in 1932, 1933, 1934 and 1935; ag. gov., Sept., 1934 to Feb., 1935; col. sec., Jan., 1935.

CRAN, CAPT. PETER MCELLENN, O.B.E., B.Sc., M.Inst.C.E.—B. 1886; ed. George Watson's Coll., Edin. and Edin. Univ.; 2nd lieut. R.E. (S.R.), 1911; asst. engrnr., govt. ryls., N. Nigeria, 1911; dist. engrnr., P.W.D., Gold Coast, 1912; asst. div. offr., R.E., Forth and Clyde Defences, Scottish Comd., Mar., 1914; div. offr., do., Oct., 1914; asst. to comdg. royal engrnr., do., Nov., 1916; ment. in desps., Feb., 1917 and Aug., 1919; exec. engrnr., P.W.D., Sierra Leone, 1928; temp. asst. engrnr., P.W.D., Cyprus, Jan., 1931; divnl. engrnr., Mar., 1931.

CRANE, ALFRED VICTOR, LL.B. (Lond.), Hons.—B. 1892; solr., sup. ct., just., Eng. and Br. Guiana; el. mem. Br. Guiana legislature, 1926-33; dep. mayor, Georgetown, 1923; mem. several select and other govt. comtes; mem. Georgetown sewage and water bd.; mem. bd. of govrn., Queen's Coll.; senr. mag., Br. Guiana, Nov., 1933; called to bar (Inner Temple) 1935; author of "Law of Unlawful Possession."

CRANSTON, T. D.—M.A. (Glasgow); asst. mast., training instit., for teachers, Accra, G. Coast, Apr., 1912; asst. censor, in addn., Mar., 1915 to Jan., 1916; ag. qrtmtr., Gold Coast Volunteers, Nov., 1916; lieut., ditto, Apr., 1917; ag. prin., Accra Training Coll. on several occasions between 1917 and 1929; ag. prov. inspr., schls., Apr., 1926; asst. dir., educn., Nov., 1926; ag. dir., educn., in 1930, 1932, 1933 and 1934.

CRAKEY, WILLIAM RAYMOND DUNSTAN, B.Sc. (Eng.), A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1900; ed. Graham's Schl., Holt and London Univ.; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., Zanzibar, Apr., 1926; ag. dist. engrnr., in 1930, 1931, 1933 and 1934; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., Nigeria, 1935.

CRAWFORD, JOHN GERALD.—B. 1894; ed. King's Schl., Chester and Merton Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1920; lieut., Cheshire regt., T.F., Nov., 1915; capt., June, 1916; cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; attd. to dist. office, K. Selangor, Apr., 1921; attd. to office of conserv., forests, Jan., 1922; passed cadet, Feb., 1923; supernvy. offr., cls. V, Feb., 1922; asst. dist. offr., B. Padang, Nov., 1923; ditto, Kroh, Mar., 1924; offr., cls. IV, Feb., 1926; dist. offr., Ulu Langat, June, 1927; attd. to co-op. socs. dept., Oct., 1931; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1931; asst. dir., co-opern. (North), Apr., 1932.

CRAWFORD, MATTHEW, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1901; asst. vety. surg., Ceylon, 1924; attended Imp. Agrl. Research Confce., as Ceylon del., 1927; govt. vety. surg., Nov., 1931.

CRAWSHAW, EDWARD DANIEL WESTON.—B. 1903; ed. St. Bees and Selwyn Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1926; admitted, solr., Mar., 1930; N. Rhodesia, 1930; asst. adminstr. gen., Tanganyika Territory, 1933.

CREAN, B.—Barrister-at-law; dep. regnr. of titles, Kenya, Oct., 1929; res. mag., Apr., 1921; puisne judge, sup. ct., Cyprus, Apr., 1930; ag. pres., dist. ct., June to Sept., 1930; ag. ch. just.; ch. just., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1934.

CREASY, GERALD HALLEN.—B. 1897; ed. Rugby; schol., King's Coll., Camb., 1915; served with R.G.A., 1916-19; asst. prin., C.O., 26th July, 1920; pvt. sec. to parl. under sec. for Dominion affrs., 1925-27; dep. sec., C.O. confce., 1927; prin., 1927; accomp. parly. U.S. of S. for the Cols. (Mr. Ormsby-Gore) to Ceylon, Malaya and Java, 1928; sec., Col. Agrl. Coun., 1929-31, and of confce. of dirs. of agr., 1931; accomp. parly. U.S. of S. for the Cols. (Lord Plymouth) to W. Africa, 1936.

CREED, HENRY.—B. 1871; apptd., after exam., 3rd class messenger in C.O., July, 1900; 2nd class, 1st Feb., 1904; King's mess., 30th Jan., 1911; office keeper, 1924; med., Order of Br. Empire, 1931.

CREMER, ARTHUR STANLEY.—B. 1886; ed. Durham schl.; col. audit dept., 23rd Jan., 1911; asst. audr., G. Coast, 1911-13; asst. audr., Nyasaland, 1913-16; asst. audr., Uganda, 1916-18; asst. audr., provisional admtn., G.E.A., 1918-19; senr. asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1919; audr., Mauritius, July, 1924; audr., Gold Coast, Jan., 1933.

CREMER, JOHN AWDRY.—B. 1881; B.A. (Oxon.), 1903; clk., col. audit branch, E. and A.D., 1903; asst. auditor, Lagos, 1905; asst. auditor, Nyasaland, 1908; 2nd cls. clk., cent. office, 1913; auditor, Nyasaland, 1914; audr., Cyprus, Aug., 1925.

CRERAR, HON. THOMAS ALEXANDER—Ed., pub. schls. and Collegiate, Portage la Prairie, Manitoba; teacher, farmer, grain elevator operator; invited to enter Union govt., 1917; P.C., Canada, 1917; min. of agr., 1917-19; M.P., Marquette, Manitoba, 1917-25; leader, progressive party, 1921-22; M.P., Brandon, 1930; min. of ryls. and canals, 1929-30; defeated, g.e. 1930; re-ele., g.e. 1935 as M.P. for Churchill; min. of mines, min. of immigrn. and colonization, min. of interior, and supt. gen., Indian affrs. in Mackenzie King cabinet, Oct., 1935.

CRESSALL, PAUL EWART FRANCIS, M.C.—B. 1893; ed. Cranleigh Schl.; ent. civ. serv., B. Guiana, 1911; cler. asst., secretariat and sub-inpr., B. Guiana pol., 1912; ag. dist. inapr., 1914-15; 2nd lieut., B. Guiana Militia Infy., 1914; served in B.W.I. Regt. as capt., E. Africa and Palestine, 1915-19; dist. inapr., B. Guiana pol., 1920; J.P. and coroner, 1920; ag. county inapr., 1920; passed final law exam., 1921; capt., B. Guiana local forces, 1922; ag. staff offr., B. Guiana local forces, 1922; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1923; county inapr., pol., 1923; consnr., for oaths and revising barrister, 1924; stip. mag., Apr., 1924; ag. stip. mag., Georgetown, Aug., 1924 to Dec., 1924 and July to Dec., 1926; chmn., comsh. of enquiry into Underneeming indus. schl., Sept., 1925; ag. chmn., soldiers' pensions bd., 1925; chmn., ditto, Nov., 1926; senr. stip. mag., Nov., 1930; senr. Br. mag., Palestine, June, 1931; ag. pres., Nablus dist. ct., May, 1933; do., Jerusalem dist. ct., June, 1933; chmn., legal bd., June, 1933; relieving pres., dist. cts., Aug., 1934.

CRESWELL, COL. THE HON. FREDERIC HUGH PAGE, D.S.O.—B. 1866; ed. Bruce Castle, Derby Schl., and R. Schl. of Mines (grad. cls.), arrived in S. Africa, May, 1893; mining in Rhodesia, 1893-94; man., Durban Roodepoort Deep Mine, 1895-99; served in Imp. Light Horse during Anglo-Boer war; man., Village Main Reef, 1902-03; supported agitation for expulsion of Chinese labour; elec. to first Union parl., 1910, and led Labour Party; 2nd in commd., Rand Rifles, S. W. Africa, 1914; 2nd in commd., subsequently commdgr., 8th S. A. Infy Brig., German E. Africa campaign; mem. for Denver; min. of defence and labour, 1st and 2nd Hertzog miny., June, 1924 to Mar., 1933; M.P. for Bellville, May, 1933.
CREWE, 1ST MARQUESS OF (cr. 1911); ROBERT OFFLEY ASHBURTON CREWE-MILNES, K.G., P.C., M.A., F.S.A.—B. 1858; Baron Houghton of Great Houghton in the county of York, 1863; Earl of Crewe (cr. 1895); Earl of Madeley (cr. 1911); ed. at Harrow and Trin. Coll., Camb.; ast. priv. sec. to sec. for foreign affairs (Earl Granville), 1883-84; lord-in-waiting to Queen Victoria, 1886; lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1892-95; lord pres. of the coun., 1905-08; S. of S. for the Colonies, Apr., 1908; Lord Privy Seal (in conjunction with Secretaryship of State), 1908; S. of S. for India, 1910-15; accompanied H.M. King George V. on the occasion of the Royal visit to India, 1911; lord pres. of the coun., 1915.

CRICHLLOW, NATHANIEL.—M.B., Ch.B.; med. offr., Solomon Islands, Oct., 1914; ag. surr. med. offr. on several occasions; travelling med. offr., July, 1927.

CRITTIEN, ATTILIO, O.B.E. (1927), M.B.E. (1919), M.A., M.D., Malta Univ., D.P.H., D.T.M. (Liverpool), 1906.—B. 1872; demonstr., schl. of anatomy, 1899 to 1901; civil surgeon attclh. R.A.M.C., 1901 to 1904; med. offr. of hth., Malta, 1906 to 1917; chf. gov't. med. offr. and supt. of pub. hth., with seat in exec. coun. and coun. of govt., 1917-21.

CROCKER, WILLIAM HENRY.—B. 1890; served in R.A.S.C. (M.T.) in Mesopotamia, Persia and India; ast. gov't. printer, Gold Coast, 1921; ag. gov't. printer, 1925, 1927, 1928, 1930 and 1932; supl., gov't. press, 1928.

CROCKETT, HON. OSWALD SMITH, LL.D.—B. 1868; ed. pub. and high schls., Fredericton, N.B., Canada, and Univ. of New Brunswick; B.A., 1886; atty.-sup. ct., N.B., 1891; called to bar, 1892; M.P. (Can.) for York County, N.B., 1904-11; judge, king's bench div., sup. ct., N.B., 1913; judge, sup. ct., Canada, 1932.

CRONEEN, BRIAN.—Ed. Dulwich Coll.; served B.S.A. pol. and Bechuanaland Prot. pol., 1911; 2nd grade clk., 1921; ag. sub-instr., 1922; ag. ast. res. mag., 1926; passed 2nd grade Seowana exam., 1923; ag. res. mag., 1927; 1st grade clk., Apr., 1928; sub-instr., Bechuanaland Prot. pol., 1929.

CROOK, WALTER VERNON.—B. 1900; ed. Marlborough Coll., and R. Milly. Coll., Sandhurst; comand, Reg. Army, East Surrey Regt., Dec., 1918; served N. Russia, 1919; seconded under C.O., Mar., 1926; cadet, Uganda, 1926; ast. dist. offr., Uganda, June, 1928, and placed on Reg. Army, R. of O.

CROSBIE, HON. SIR JOHN C., K.B.E. (1919).—M.H.A., Bay de Verde dist., Newfoundland, 1908; M.E.C., 1909; mem. defence comtee., 1915; chrmn., tonnage comtee., 1917; min. of militia, 1917; min. of shipping, 1918.

CROSBIE, ROBERT EDWARD HAROLD, O.B.E. (1927).—B. 1886; ed. Cheltenham and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge (schol.); B.A. (class. tripods, hon. cls., II), 1908; Egyptian civ. serv., 1910-19; seconded for milly. serv. with E.E.F., 1915; apptd. to O.E.T.A. (S.), 1918; dep. mily. gov., Brisban, 1919; dep. mily. gov., Tiberias, 1920; dep. dist. gov., Jenin, 1920; ast. gov. (continuing as ast. dist. comsrr.), S. dist., 1922; passed advanced Arabic exam., 1924; dist. comsrr., Southern dist., 1931.

CROSS, MATTHEW ARNOLD.—B. 1881; clk., deeds, Transvaal, Mar., 1902; examr., deeds, July, 1904; 2nd grade examr., deeds, Pretoria, Oct., 1919; 1st gr. ditto, Nov., 1919; ch. examr., July, 1922; ast. regis., deeds, Bloemfontein, Nov., 1927; ditto, Pretoria, Oct., 1928; regis., deeds, Bloemfontein., Apr., 1933; do., Pretoria., Feb., 1934.

CROSSE-CROSSE, WILLIAM WICKHAM REDER.—B. 1899; ed. Blundells schl.; 2nd lieut., Welsh Guards, 1918; lt., 1920; served with 1st and 2nd K.A.R., in Tanganyika Territory, 1922-24; R. of O., (Welsh Guards), 1924; cadet, Uganda Prot., 1924; ast. dist. offr., 1926; ag. lab. comsrr., 1929; temp. ast. prin., C.O., 1930.

CROUCHER, HERBERT HARRY, B.Sc. (Lond.), A.I.C.—B. 1904; ed. Reading Univ.; lect. in chem., and soil sci., Impl. Coll. of Trop. Agr., Trinidad, 1926; agrl. chemist, Jamaica, 1931.

CRUICKSHANK, ARTHUR HOWARD, M.I.Mar. E.—B.1888; jnr. mech. engrn. and river survr., P.W.D., Gold Coast, Jan., 1920; ag. ch. mech. engrn., 1921; transfd. as engrn., transport offr. to motor transport dept., Aug., 1922; ag. ch. mech. transport offr., 1924; ag. ch. transport offr. for various periods, 1926-34.

CRUIKSHANK, JOHN MERRILL, M.D., C.M., McGill Univ. Canada 1925, Licentiate Med. Coun. of Canada, 1925.—Med. dir., Alexander sanatorium (mental diseases) San Francisco, 1927-28; med. offr., Bahamas, 1928; res. surg., 1929; ag. dir., med. services in 1930; ch. med. offr. and res. surg., 1931.

CRUTCHLEY, ERNEST TRISTRAM, C.B. (1935), C.M.G. (1932), C.B.E. (civ.), 1926, O.B.E. (mily.), 1918.—B. 1878; lieut.-col., R. E. T. F. Res.; ast. survr., G.P.O., 1908; dep. dir., Army Postal serv. (T.F.), 1914-19; staff offr., grade I, miny. of transport, 1919; ag. prtn., ch. sec.'s office, Dublin, 1921; Irish office and mem., Irish grants comtee., 1922; C.O., 1923; ag. finance offr., overseas settlement dept., 1925; Br. gov't. rep. for migrn. in the C'wealth. of Australia, 1928; rep. in the C'wealth. of Australia of H.M.'s Gov't. in the U.K., 1931.

CRUX, RICHARD MILLET.—B. 1880; ed. in India; dept. of Transvaal prisons, dir., prisons office, Jan., 1904; ast. warden, Houtpoort Reformatory, Apr., 1916; prison supt., 1923; ast., prisons, Pretoria commd., 1934; war serv., Anglo-Boer War, 1900-02; Great War, G.E.A., 1916-17.

CUBITT, MAJOR-GEN. SIR THOMAS ASTLEY, K.C.B. (1931), C.B. (1919), C.M.G. (1916), D.S.O. (1903)—B. 1871; ed. Haileybury and R.M.C., Woolwich; ent. army, 1891; capt., 1900; served W. Africa, 1898 (med. and clasp); staff offr., W. Africa (desp., brevet-major, med. with clasp) 1901; W. Africa, (desp., clasp), 1902; Kanokokoto campaign, 1903 (desp., clasp, D.S.O.); European war in commd., troops, Somaliland, 1914-15; in commd., divn., France, with rank of major-gen., 1918; G.O.C., Presidency and Assam dist., 1920-24; 53rd Welsh Divn., T.A., Shrewsbury, 1927; G.O.C., 2nd Divn., 1928; gov. and commd. in-ch., Bermuda, 1931.

CUFF, CYRIL CHARLES HEIKERT, O.B.E. (1938), M.B., B.S. (Durham), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Edin.).—B. 1888; ed. Guy's and Durham; lieut., R.N.V.R., 1914; passed Bd. of Trade exam. for master, 1916; transfd. to R.A.M.C., 1918; house surg. and bacteriologist, St. Lucia, 1921-23; resigned; re-ent. col. serv. and apptd. to Seychelles as sen. ast. med. offr., res. surg. and visiting mag., outlying islds., 1924; ag. ch. med. offr., June to Nov.,
1924; dist. med. offr., Cyprus, Apr., 1926; surg. specialist, Dec., 1928; ag. dir., health on various occasions in 1928 and 1932-33; ag. senr. med. offr., 1934.

CULLEN, JAMES REYNOLDS, M.A. (Oxon).—B. 1901; ed. Tonbridge and Balliol Coll., Oxford; Hertford schol., 1919; 1st hons. mods., 1920; 2nd lit. hum., 1922; dir., educn., Cyprus, Sept., 1930.

CULLEN, HON. SIR WM. PORTUS, K.C.M.G. (1912), KT. BACH. (1911), K.C., M.A., LL.D.—Barrister-at-law; M.L.A., New South Wales, July, 1891; M.L.C., Aug., 1895; fellow of Senate of Sydney Univ. since 1896; vice-chancellor, 1908; resigned from legia, coun. and apptd. chief just. of N.S.W., Jan., 1910; lieut. gov., N.S.W., 30th Mar., 1910; ret., 1925; chancellor of Sydney Univ. from Sept. 1914.

CUMARASWAMY, SUBRAMANIAN DAVIDS.—B. 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., 1929; attd., Badulla kach., Feb., 1929; attd. Batticaloa kach., Jan., 1930; office asst. to asst. gov't. Matala, Mar., 1930; attd., Kandy kach., Sept., 1933; office asst., Kandy kach., Feb., 1934.

CUNLIFFE-LISTER, RT. HON. SIR PHILIP, G.B.E. (1929), K.B.E. (1920), P.C. (1922), M.C. M.P. (Hendon).—B. 1884; ed. Winchester and Univ. Coll., Oxford; called to bar, 1908; served in army, 1914-17; joint sec. of Miny. of National Serv., 1917-18; chmn., perm. lab. comtce. of War Cabinet was priorities comtce., 1918; mem., select comtce. on nat. expend. and select comtce. on high prices and profits, 1919; party. sec. to B. of T., 1920-21; sec., D.O.T., 1921-22; chmn., Imp. Economic Confce., 1923; pres., B. of T., 1922-23, 1924-29 and Aug.-Nov., 1931; S. of S. for the Cols., 9th Nov., 1931; S. of S. for Air, 14th June, 1935.

CURLEWIS, JOHN STEPHEN, B.A., LL.B. (Cape).—Cape civ. serv., 1883-1888; advoc., sup. ct., Cape Colony, 12th Oct., 1887; advoc., high ct. (late S.A.R.), May, 1888; counsel for Imp. govt. in arbitn. with late S.A.R. re Asiatic question, 1895; ag. judge, high ct. (late S.A.R.), Apr., 1899 to Jan., 1900; pres. crim. ct. for Witwatersrand, Nov., 1899 to Jan., 1900; puisne judge, sup. ct., Transvaal, Sept., 1903; puisne judge, sup. ct., S. Africa (Transvaal Provl. Div.), May, 1910; judge pres., July, 1912; judge of appeal, 1927; O.A.G., Union of S. Africa during absence of Lord Clarendon, 1933.

CURMI, CAPT. HENRY C.—B. 1890; ed. Malta Lyceum, Univ. and pvt. tuition; matric. (Italian, French and Spanish), 1904; 1st place Malta civ. serv. exam., 1908; served in cust., lieut. gov'ts., treas., educn. and charitable institutions depts.; 2nd lieut., K.O. Malta Regt., 1910; mobilised 1914 and transfd. to R. Malta Arty., 1915; with Med. Expedy. Force at Mudros and Anzac from Sept., 1915 to evacuation; ment. in desps., Egyptian Expedy. Force, 1916-19; demob., Apr., 1920; served shipping office, cust., sec., charitable institutions comtce., 1920; sec. to min. for posts and agr. and in charge of lab. bureau, 1921; sec., emigr. comtce., 1922; sec. and offr.-in-charge, tourist comtce., 1923-28; comsnr. for lab., Apr., 1928; comsnr. for Malta in Australia, Jan., 1929.

CURRY, H. D.—B. 1893; ed. Dulwich coll.; served in Fiji, 1911-15; ag. 2nd cls. clk., C.S.O., 1915; cadet, Solomon Islands, 1915; ag. dist. offr., Gizo, 1915; on mily. serv., 1917-19; 2nd lieut., 1919; priv. sec. to gov. of R. Honduras, 1919; resumed duty Solomon Is., 1920; ag. dist. offr., Shortlands, 1920; ag. sec., 1920; adminis. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Feb., 1923; seconded as lab. offr., 1926-31; offr. in ch., lab. affrs., N. prov., 1932; ag. dist. offr., 1935.

CURRY, WILLIAM CLIVE, M.C.—B. 1895; ed. City of London Schl.; mily. serv., 1916-18; M.C., 1917; called to bar, Middle Temple, May, 1922; asst. land offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1927; asst. admstr.-gen., 1928; Br. mag., Palestine, 1932.

CURTIS, ECKO VIVIAN.—B. 1903; Welsh Guards, 1920-23; Br. Palestine gendarmerie, 1923; Tanganyika Territory pol., 1926; staff offr., July, 1934-Jan., 1935; supt., pol., Zanzibar, May, 1935.

CURTIS, RICHARD JOHN FROUDE.—B. 1897; ed. Blundell's Schl. and R. Mily. Acad., Woolwich; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., 1917; lieut., 1920; R. of O., 1920; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1920; offr., cls. V, Nov., 1923; dist. offr., N. Tebal, Dec., 1925; offr., cls. IV, Nov., 1927; Br. res., Brunei, Dec., 1928; res., Labuan, Aug., 1929; A.D.C. to O.A.G., Apr., 1931; A.D.C. to gov., June, 1931; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1932; priv. sec. to gov., Dec., 1932; 2nd mag., Spore, Aug., 1933; 3rd mag., Sept., 1933; mag., Seremban, Nov., 1934; collr., land rev., Penang, Apr., 1935.

CUSACK, CAPT. HENRY VERNON (Res. of Offrs.), F.R.G.S.—B. 1895; ed. Aravon Schl. and Royal Coll. of Sci., Ireland; served in European War, Flanders and N. Russia, 1915-19; asst. audr., Sierra Leone, July, 1920; ag. audr., Oct.-Nov., 1921; asst. audr., Nigeria, Oct., 1922; senr. asst. audr., Nyassaland, May, 1928; ag. audr., Oct., 1928 to Oct., 1929 and Apr. Nov., 1932; asst. dir., col. audit dept., July, 1933.

CUSACK, JOHN RALPH.—B. 1902; ed. Royal Schl., Armagh; apptd. to col. audit dept. as asst. audr., Nigeria, June, 1929; audr., Leeward Is., Mar., 1935.

CUSSEN, RICHARD CECIL.—B. 1887; B.A., Dublin; barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn; cadet, F.M.S., 1911; ag. dist. offr. Jelebu, Oct., 1912; passed cadet, June, 1914; offr., cls. V, Dec., 1914; asst. dist. offr., B. Pahang, Feb., 1915; offr., cls. IV, Jan., 1919; mag., Seremban, July, 1920; offr., cls., III., D.P.P., Perak, Nov., 1923; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1928; dep. legal advr., F.M.S., offr., cls. IB, Apr., 1929; ag. legal advr., F.M.S., July, 1934; temp. judge, F.M.S., Feb., 1935.

CUTHBERT, MORTON.—Ed. Edin. Instit. and Glasgow and West of Scot. Tech. Coll.; apprent. engrnr. to Messrs. Dick, Kerr and Co., Ltd., London, 1895; electrtn. with Glasgow corptn. elec. dept., 1899; asst. engrnr. Govan corptn. elec. dept., 1901; chief asst. engrnr., Oban corptn. elec. dept., 1904; electrnl. engrnr., B. Honduras, 1905; exec. and electrnl. engrnr., P.W.D., B. Honduras, 1909; lieut., B.H.T.F., 1917; ag. adjutant, B.H.T.F., Aug., 1917 to Jan., 1918; hon. A.D.C. to gov., B. Honduras, 1919.

CUTTERIDGE, JOSEPH OLIVER, M.B.E. (1932), A.C.P., F.R.G.S.—B. 1887; ed. Borough Road Coll., Isleworth, Loudon, 1906-08; teacher's certf. (with 4 distinctions) Bd. of Educn., Lond.; A.C.T. cert., Bd. of Educn., Lond.; staff-capt., H.M. Forces; inspr. Q.M.G. services; maths. and drawing master, Junr.Tech. Schl., Liverpool, 1919; prin., govt. training coll., Trinidad, Jan., 1921; mem., Inter-Col. Educn. Confce., 1921; mem. bd. indust. training; supt., tech. classes, 1922; ag. senr. inspr. schl., Feb., 1923; senr. inspr. schl., Trinidad, 1st July, 1923; ag. dir., educn., July, 1925 to Mar., 1926; asst. dir., educn. and senr. inspr., schl., June, 1926; asst. dir., educn. and
ch. inspr., schls., Jan., 1928; ag. dir., educn., May to Nov., 1929; dir., educn., 1934; author "West Indian Readers" etc.

CUZEN, ALLAN LECKIE.—Served in R.E., 1901-2; S. African War (medal and five clasps); Cape police, 1902-6; Bech. Prot. police, 1906-14; passed Cape civ. serv. lower law exam., 1914; 2nd clk. to asst. comsnr., N. Dist., Bech. Prot., 1914; ag. asst. res. mag., ditto, 1916; passed 2nd grade Seawana exam., 1916; 1st grade (B), ditto, 1927; ag. res. mag., 1917; ag. asst. res. mag., 1919; res. mag., 1921.

DAUBER, CHARLES J.—B. 1876; on mily. serv., France and Flanders, Sept., 1914 to Mar., 1919; clk., Army pay office, R. Engnas., Mar. to Oct., 1919; clk., Army pay office, command paymr., Overseas Bases, Oct., 1919 to July, 1922; cler. offr., C.O., 10th July, 1922.

DAKERS, COLIN HUGH, M.C.—B. 1897; ed. Manch. Gram. Sch.; war serv., 1915-19; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1920; offr., cls. V., Nov., 1923; inspr., liquor shops, F.M.S., Sept., 1926; 2nd asst. dir., educn. (Chinese), S.S., Apr., 1926; offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1927; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1932; asst. dir., educn., Chinese schls., F.M.S., Dec., 1932; ag. prot., Chinese, Selangor and Pahang, Apr., 1933; do., Penang, Aug., 1934; do., Selangor and Penang, May, 1935.

DALE, WILLIAM LEONARD.—B. 1906; ed. Hymers Coll., Hull; LL.B. Lond.; Holt. schol., Gray's Inn, 1929; called to bar, 1932; N. Eastern circuit, N.R.Y. and E.R.Y. sessions; legal asst., D.O. and C.O., Feb., 1935; author of "Law of the Parish Church," (1933).

DALLARD, BERKELEY LIONEL.—B. 1889; ed. Rangiora High Schl. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. govt. serv., 1907; stamp duties dept., 1907-13; audit office, 1913-18; advisory acctnt., bd. of trade, 1919-23; inspr., pub. serv. comsnr.'s office, 1924-26; contr.-gen., prisons from 1926; also asst. pub. serv. comsnr., 1929-33; and under sec. justice and registr.-gen., births, deaths and marriages, 1933.

DALLEY, JOHN DOUGLAS.—B. 1900; pol. prob., F.M.S., Nov., 1920, probry. a.c.p., Jan., 1922; on depn. to Kedah; a.c.p., Nov., 1923; 1st a.c.p., Selangor, Dec., 1924; c.o.p., Johore S., Apr., 1926; a.c.p., K. Kangsar, June, 1931; a.s.p., S'pore, Sept., 1932; comdt., pol. depot, Nov., 1933; dep. comsnr., pol., F.M.S., Aug., 1934.

DALLIN, THOMAS.—Late lieut. 3rd Batt. Essex Regt.; served in S. African War (medal and two clasps); hon. 2nd lieut. in the army, Oct., 1902; joined col. audt. dept., Feb., 1904; examr., exchequer and audit dept., July, 1906; asst. audr., S. Nigeria, Oct., 1906 to Feb., 1910; reverted to ex. and audt. dept., Feb., 1910; asst. audr., Hong Kong, July, 1910; ag. audr. in 1911, 1912, 1913 and 1914; asst. cable censor, Aug.-Oct., 1914; on mil. serv., Mar., 1915 to July, 1916; ag. audr., Aug., 1916 to Dec., 1917; J.P., 1918; attd. to finan. branch, W.O., Sept., 1918 to Mar., 1919; ag. audr. on various occasions in 1920, 1922 and 1924-30.

DALTON, ALFRED, A.M.Inst.T.—B. 1892; G.S. and W.R., Ireland, 1909; asst. traffic supt., Tanganyika rly., Nov., 1920; trafic supt., 1930.

DALTON, LLWELYN CHISHOLM.—B. 1879; ed. Marlborough and Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1900 (Hist. Tripos); M.A., 1905; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1901; legal asst., land setttn. bd., O.R.C., Oct., 1901; asst. res. mag. and J.P., June, 1902 to Nov., 1910; advoc., sup. ct., 1904; regir., B. Guiana, Nov., 1910; judge advoc., local forces, 1914; ag. puisne judge, Nov., 1912 to Feb., 1913; Nov., 1914 to Jan., 1915; July, 1916, to June, 1917; July to Sept., 1918; Mar. to June, 1919; ag. solr.-gen., May to Aug., 1914; Sept., 1914 to Jan., 1915; ag. atty.-gen., Aug.-Sept., 1914; Feb.-Apr., 1918; ag. chief just., July-Sept., 1917; June-Oct., 1919; puisne judge, B. Guiana, June, 1919; puisne judge, Gold Coast, Feb., 1923; puisne judge, Ceylon, Mar., 1925; compiled and edited "Statutory Rules and Orders (B. Guiana)," to 1914, 2 vols.; editor, B. Guiana Law Reports, 9 vols.; an asst. editor "Burge on Colonial and Foreign Laws," 2nd edit., vol. iv.; compiled Digest of Case Law of British Guiana, 1916-1920; author of "Civil Law of British Guiana."

D'ANDRADE, WILLIAM ALBERT.—B. 1884; cler. asst., surg. genl.'s office, Br. Guiana, 1903; 6th cls. offr., cust., 1903; 5th ditto, 1906; 4th ditto, 1913; 3rd ditto, 1921; 2nd ditto, 1925; ch. clk., cust., 1925; comptlr., cust., 1927.

DANDURAND, HON. SENATOR RAOUl, K.C., LL.D., P.C.—B. 1861; ed. Montreal Coll. and Laval Univ.; LL.B., 1882; LL.D., 1909 and hon. LL.D., McGill, Toronto, and Queen's Univ.; pres., Univ. of Montreal, Feb., 1934; called to Quebec bar, 1883; K.C., 1898; called to senate of Canada by Lord Aberdeen, 1898; speaker of senate, 1905-9; P.C., 1909; min. of state and leader of King govt. in senate, 1921, also in 2nd King govt., 1926, and in 3rd King govt., 1935; leader of lib. party, senate, 1930; served as R. comsnr. on educn., Quebec, 1910; el. pres., 6th assem., L. of N., Geneva, 1925; del. of Canada to coun., L. of N., 1927-30; apptd. by pres. of U.S.A., arbitr. under treaty of peace with Brazil.

DANEEL, JOSEPH, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), F.R.C.S. (Edin.).—B. 1884; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch and Edin. Univ.; admitted F.R.C.S., Edin., 1922; med. supt., Rietfontein hosp., Union of S. Africa, 1927.

DANKS, FRANK SCOBIE, B.So. (Forestry), Dipl. in Agr.—B. 1896; on war serv., 1915-19; asst. conserv., forests, 1st gr., Cyprus, Oct., 1926.

DANIEL, EDWARD WALLEY, B.A., M.R.S.T.—B. 1895; prin., govt. training coll., Trinidad, Sept., 1927; asst. dir., educn. and ch. inspr., schls., Trinidad, Nov., 1934.

DANIEL, FRANCIS DE FOREST.—B.1886; ed. Marlborough Coll.; admitted solr., 1910; asst. acctnt., Lagos rly., July, 1912; transf., cust. dept. May 1913; asst. dist. offr., N. Provs., Nigeria, July, 1914; res., Mar., 1930.

DANIEL, REGINALD YOUNG, M.A. (Oxon).—B.1894; on mily. serv., Sept., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Oct., 1920; attd. to Galle kach., Oct., 1920; ag. office asst. to asst. govt. agt., Matara, Sept., 1921; ag. pol. mag., Galle, Jan., 1922; ag. office asst. to asst. govt. agt., Hambantota, Mar., 1922; ditto to govt. agt., N. Provs., Nov., 1922; dist. judge, Anuradhapura, Dec., 1925; pol. mag., Kalutara, Dec., 1926; pol. mag., Kandy, Apr., 1928; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Aug., 1930; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, Sept., 1930; do., Ratnapura, Oct., 1931; asst. govt. agt., Mannar, Mar., 1933; do., Matale, Oct., 1934.

DANNATT, ROBERT MALCOLM, M.B., B.S. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Edin.).—B. 1891; med. offr., F.M.S., Oct., 1925; surgn., F.M.S., Mar., 1926; do., Selangor, Nov., 1933.

DARLING, JOHN SINGLETON.—B. 1898; ed. Marlborough Coll.; served in Indian Army
DAVIES, EDWARD JOHN.—B. 1898; ed. Llandovery Coll. and Univ. of Wales, B.A., LL.B. (Wales); served with Artists' Rifles and West Yorks. Regt., 1916-18; France, 1917-18; called to bar, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1922; crown coun., Kenya, May, 1927; legal mem. of land bank bd., Dec., 1931-July, 1932; crown coun., Gold Coast, Feb., 1933; ag. solr.-genl. in 1933, 1934 and 1935; solr.-gen., Trinidad, 1936.

DAVIES, GEORGE FREDERICK, M.B.E., M.I.E.E.—B. 1886; Imp. serv., 1908-13; on mily. serv. (R.E.) 1914-19; seconded to Kenya, 1913-19; ch. tel. engr., Tanganyika, 1919; divnl. engr.; Nigeria, 1926; asst. engrn. in ch., 1930; engrn.-in-ch., posts and tels. dept., 1933.

DAVIES, HENRY NOEL, O.B.E. (1933), M.Inst.T.—B. 1881; asst. audr., S. Indian rly., 1900-17; major, Rly. Corps, German E. Africa, 1917-19; twice ment. in desps.; ch. acct., Tanganyika rly., Apr., 1919; ag. gen. man. for various periods, 1929-32; dep. gen. man., July, 1930.

DAVIES, RICHARD MORGAN.—B. 1892; on mily. serv., Dec., 1914; cadet, Ceylon, Sept., 1920; attd. to Puttalam Kachcheri, Oct., 1920; ditto, Colombo Kach., June, 1921; pol. mag., Matale, Feb., 1923; dep. rubber contr., May, 1924; asst. govt. agt., Batticaloa, Sept., 1925; ditto Trincomalee, June, 1926; asst. sttlmt. offr., Dec., 1926; asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Aug., 1927; dist. judge, Anuradhapura, Nov., 1928; asst. govt. agt., Manar, May, 1930; pol. mag., Matale, Nov., 1931; dep. fiscal, Colombo, Mar., 1932; asst. sttlmt. offr., July, 1932; asst. govt. agt., Nuwara Eliya, Jan., 1935.

DAVIES, RUPERT MCBREDDITH, B.Sc., B.Sc. (Agr.).—B. 1899; ed. Bedford Schl.; mil. serv., Lon. Soot. & R.E.s, 1917-19; Aberdeen Univ., 1919-24; Cambridge Univ., 1924, post grad.; supt., agr., Nigeria, 1928; dist. agrl. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1930; senr. agrl. offr., 1935.

DAVIES, THOMAS, WALTON.—B. 1907; ed. Tonbridge and Balliol Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. mod. hist., 1929; apptd. after compet. exam. asst. prin., Miny. of Transport, 1930; transfd. to C.O., 1st Oct., 1931; called to bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1934.

DAVIES, TUDOR THOMAS.—B. 1887; asst. govt. printer, Nyassaland Prot., 1916; ag. govt. printer and compt. stationery, May to July, 1917, July, 1919 to Mar., 1920 and Apr. to Dec., 1923; govt. printer, Dec., 1923.

DAVIES, WILLIAM ALFORD NOEL.—B. 1883; ed. Monmouth Gram. Schl.; admitted solr. of sup. ct., England, Apr., 1906; private practice in England, 1906-1907; private practice in E. Africa, 1907-1908; asst. dist. comnr., Sierra Leone, Dec., 1908; passed lower standard Mendi exam., June, 1911; ag. dist. comnr., Dec., 1911, to June, 1912; ag. pol. mag., June to Dec., 1912; acted as crown prosecutor on several occasions; ag. dist. comnr., 1913-14; master and regisr., sup. ct., S. Leone, July, 1914; curator of intestate estates, Oct., 1914; regisr., prize court, 1914; 2nd lieut., general list, Mar., 1916; mentioned in desps., 1916; attached S. Leone Batt., W.A.F.F., May, 1916; served in S. Leone, 1916-17; transfd. to G. Coast Regt., 1917; served in Port. E. Africa, 1918; staff capt. with Col. Rose's column, Apr. to June, 1918; staff quartermr., 2nd W. African Service Brig., Oct., 1918; demob., Dec., 1918; resumed duties as regisr., sup. ot., Sierra Leone, May, 1919 regisr., sup. ct., S.S., Nov., 1920.
DAVIS, Sir Charles Thomas, G.C.M.G. (1928), K.C.M.G. (1923), C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1873; ed. Christ's Coll.; Brecon, and Oxford; classical scholar, Balliol Coll., 1892-6; 1st class classical mods., 1894; Jenkyns exhibnr., 1896; 1st class lit. hum., 1896; apptd., after compet. exam., 1st cl. clk., acct-gen.'s dept., admiralty, Oct. 5th, 1896; transf. to sec.'s dept., inland rev., Mar., 1897; 2nd cl. clk., col. office, Apr. 15th, 1897; went to Gibraltar as sec. to Rt. Hon. Sir C. R. Thompson on a mission to inquire into the currency question, May and June, 1898; sec. Pacif. cable comttee., 1900; priv. sec., to Sir M. Ommannye, June, 1902; 1st cls. clk., 1st Apr., 1905; principal clk., 4th June, 1916; senr. asst. sec. to Imperial Conference; asst. sec., 1st Apr., 1920; asst. under-sec. of state, Dec., 1921; perm. under-sec. of state for dominion affrs., 9th July, 1925; ret., 1930.

DAVIS, Hon. Henry Hague.—B. 1885; ed. Brockville, Ont., Can.; Collegiate Inst., Toronto Univ. (B.A. 1907, gold medallist in polit. sci., M.A., LL.B.); Law Sch., Osgoode Hall, Toronto, 1911; called to Ontario bar 1911; K.C., 1928; judge, supreme ct., Ont., 1933.

DAVIS, Richard Pritchard, M.I.M. & C.E., M.T.P.I., M.R.S.I.—B. 1888; town planning supt., Selangor, F.M.S., Dec., 1928; town planner, Selangor, July, 1932; do., Perak, Selangor and N. Sembilan, Oct., 1933.

DAVIS, Sir Steuart Spencer, Kt. Bach. (1930), C.M.G. (1919)—B. 1875; rev. off., St. Kitts, 1893; 1st clk., treas. and cust., 1898; lieut., St. Kitts-Nevia def. force, 1898; ag. adjutant, 1899; att. col. audit branch, E. and A. dept., July, 1901; acctn., treasy., G. Coast, 1901; asst. treas., 1902; ch. asst. treas., Nov., 1908; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1915; treas., civil admnstr., German Africa (occupied territory), Nov., 1916; treas., Tanganyika Territory, 1919; ag. sec. to admnstr., June to Aug., 1919; dep. admnstr., Mar.-Apr., 1920; treas., Palestine, May, 1922; chmn., economy comttee., 1922; ag. ch. sec. on various occasions, 1923-25; chmn., currency comttee., 1924; del. for Palestine at Constantinople in connec. with Ottoman pub. debt, Oct. to Nov., 1924; chmn., comn. on finances of Orthodox Patriarchate of Jerusalem, Dec., 1925; chmn., standing comttee. for commerce and industry from 1928; O.A.G. Palestine and ag. high, comntr., Trans-Jordan, July-Sept., 1930; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., St. Helena, 1932.

DAVIS, Thomas Arthur Warren.—B. 1899; ed. Haverfordwest and Keble Coll., Oxford; Indian army, 1917-22; dipl., forestry (Oxon.), 1923; asst. conserv., forests, Br. Guiana, 1925; ag. conserv., forests, July-Dec., 1930 and Feb.-Oct., 1934.

DAVSON, Sir Edward, 1st Baronet (cr. 1927), Kt. Bach (1919)—Ed. Eton; pres., associated West Indian Chambers of Commerce, 1916-26; chmn., Imp. Cocoa Comf., 1924; mem., Imp., Economic Comttee., 1925; chmn., federation of Chambers of Commerce of Br. Empire, 1925-28; chmn., W. Indies Comf., 1929; advr. on col. trade to S. of S. for the Cols., Ottawa Comf., 1932 and World Economic Comf., London, 1933; rep. of cols. on Imp. Communications Advisory Comttee. and Imp. Economic Comttee.; a trustee of Imp. Inst., and gov., Imp. Coll. of Trop. Agric.

DAVSON, George Charles Wolsley, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1889; ed. Cheltenham Coll., and Birmingham Univ.; asst. engnr., Nigeria, July, 1913; asst. engnr., Nigerian Rly., 1915; cadet as S.M.E., Chatham, 1916; lieut., R.E., 1917; ag. capt., 1919; asst. engnr., S.S., June, 1919; ex. engnr., Nov., 1928; senr. ex. engnr., Sept., 1933.

DAWE, Arthur James, O.B.E. (1932).—B. 1891; ed. Berkhamsed Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; scholar, 1910-1914; B.A.; war service, 1914-18; staff, 1917; lieut., R.N.V.R. (R.N.D.); temp. appt. in C.O., Jan., 1918; apptd., under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., June, 1919; asst.prin., 1st Apr., 1920; priv. sec. to Mr. Amery, 18th June, 1920; priv. sec. to Mr. E. F. L. Wood, 1921; prin., 1st Dec., 1921; dep. sec. to Imp. Economic Comf., 1923; visited Sierra Leone as sec. to coman. of enquiry into affrs. of Freetown municipality, 1928; accompa. parly U.S. of S. on visit to Palestine and Cyprus, 1930; sec. to Malta royal comn., 1931; sent on mission to Malta, 1933-34; asst. sec., 6th Mar., 1936.

DAWE, Morley Thomas O.B.K. (1925), F.L.S.—B. 1880; asst. botanist, forestry and scientific dept., Uganda, 1902; head of dept., 1903; dir., agric., Mozambique, 1910; agric., advr. to Colombia, 1915; comand. by C.O. to visit and report on agric. conditions and needs of Gambia, 1920; consultg. agric. expert to Fomento Geral de Angola, 1921; comntr., lands and forests, S. Leone, 1922; comntr. repg. S. Leone at British Empire exhibn., 1924; comntr. repg. S. Leone at Canadian Nat. exhibn., Toronto, 1926; dir. agr., Cyprus, 1928; mem., leg., May, 1928 to Nov., 1931; headed Cyprus trade mission, June-July, 1930; rep. govt., 9th Internat. horticultural cong., London, 1930, comf. on fruit production, London, 1930 and 5th Internat. botanical cong., 1930; dir., agr. and forests, Palestine, 1933; mem., advy. coun., chmn., gen. agric. coun. and mem. standing comttee. for commerce and industry.

DAWSON, Christopher William, Barrister-at-Law (Gray's Inn).—B. 1896; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford (class. schol.); 2nd. lieut., 5th Batt., E. Surrey Regt., Mar., 1915; served India (N. W. Frontier, Mesopotamia); demobilised with rank of capt., 1919; cadet, S.S., Mar., 1920; 3rd mag., S'pore, July, 1920; 2nd mag., S'pore, Oct., 1922; 2nd asst. advr., B. Pahat, Nov., 1923; 1st mag. and regisr., sup. ct., Johore, Mar., 1924; dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Feb., 1925; offr., cls. IV, Mar., 1927; called to bar (Grays Inn), June, 1929; dist. judge, Malacca, Sept., 1929; 2nd asst. sec., S.S., Jan., 1930; 1st asst. sec., S.S., Mar., 1932; ag. legal advr., Kedah, July, 1933.

DAWSON, Ernest Edward.—B. 1886; B.A. (engg.) Cambridge with 2nd cls. hon., A.M.I.C.E.; Canadian N. rlv., 1910; asst. engnr., Tanganyika rly., Jan., 1921; dist. engnr., Nov., 1928.

DAWSON, Percy Lee.—B. 1890; ed. Needham House (Ely), Cambs.; office asst., Nigerian Rly., 1920; asst. traffic supt., 1921; dist. traffic supt., Feb., 1935.

DAY, Sir Albert Cecil, Kt. Bach. (1932), C.M.G. (1925), C.B.E. (1919).—Asst. priv. sec. to gov. of New Zealand, 1910-1912; offl. sec. to gov.-gen. since 1913.

DAY, Edward Victor Grace.—B. 1896; ed. Christ's Coll., Christchurch and Timaru High Schl., New Zealand; cadet, S.S., Sept., 1921; attd., col. sec. office, Nov., 1921; asst. sec., Aluana Borneo Exhibn., Dec., 1921; A.D.C. to O.A.G., June, 1922; sec., sany. bd., A. Star in addn., Feb., 1923; offr., cls. V, Apr., 1924; offr., cls. IV, Apr., 1928; offr., cls. III, Apr., 1933; ag. 1st asst. sec., S.S., Nov., 1933.
D'CRUZ, ALBERT WALTER JOSEPH, L.M.S. (S'pore).—B. 1885; asst. aurg., Tan Tock Seng's Hosp., S'pore., Apr., 1908; ag. health offr. quarantine, June 1910 and Nov., 1918; asst. health offr. port, Aug., 1911, Sept., 1915, Mar., 1919 and Apr., 1921; ag. med. offr., Labuan, Dec., 1920; dep. health offr. port, S'pore., Jan., 1923; do., but sr. Jan., 1930; health offr., port, S'pore., Dec., 1930.

DEAKIN, CHARLES SIDNEY, B.A.—B. 1897; ed. at Orme Schl., Newcastle-on-Tyne, Christ's Hosp. and Queen's Coll., Camb., schol., Hughes Eng. essay prize, 1st cl. mechan. tripods, engng., 1923; research grant, bridge oscillations, 1923-24; junr., engng dept., science and indust. research, bridge stress comm., 1924-25; John Wimbolt prize, engin. research, 1925; R.A.S.C. (M.T.), 1916; Iraq, 1917; addl. polit. dept. as Q.M.S., Native Militia and hd. clk., Zubair, 1919; demob., 1920; asst. mast., Achimota, Gold Coast, 1925.

DEAN, H. E. S.—African constab., 1902-07; asst., fencing dept., E.A.P., May, 1908; transport offr., Nairobi, 1908-11; office supt., P.W.D., B.E.A., 1911-16; acctnt., pub. wks. dept., 1916-21; ch. acctnt., P.W.D., Tanganyika Territory, 1921-25; ch. acctnt., P.W.D., Gold Coast, 1925; treas., Dominica, 1932.

DEANE, SIR GEORGE CAMPBELL, KT. BACH. (1930).—B. 1873; ed. at St. John's Coll., Oxford; M.A., Oxon (honours in jurisprudence); called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1898; practised at the bar. B. Guiana, 1898-1903; ditto, Trinidad, 1903-1910; stip. mag., Arima, Trinidad, Sept., 1910; ag. S.J.P., Port of Spain, Trinidad, May to Dec., 1911, and from May to Oct., 1912; stip. mag., Port of Spain, 1913; ag. puisne judge, on various occasions, 1914-17; twice apptd. comsrr. under ordece, 1919; capt. and adjutant, Trinidad Light Horse; 2nd puisne Judge Apr., 1920; ch. just., Leeward Is., Jan., 1923; puisne judge, S. Stilments, and judl. comsrr., F.M.S., Nov., 1924; ch. just., Gold Coast, 1929; pres., W.A. ct. of appl., 1930; ret., Dec., 1933.

DEANE, Lieut.-COL. ROBERT, O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1879; S.A.War, 1900-02; S.A. constab., 1901; Transvaal pol., 1908; S.A. Permt. Force (Staff), 1912; German S.W.A. (staff capt. and brig. machine gun offr.), 1914; W.F.F. Egypt (brig. machine gun offr.), 1st S.A. Inf. Brigade, 1915; France, 1916; ch. of pol., St. Lucia, 1919; dep. inspr. gen. pol., Mauritius, 1922; inspr.-gen. pol. and supt., prisons, 1926; M.L.C., 1926.

DEAR, EUGENE CLYDE.—B. 1885; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; ent. civ. serv., Barbados, 1902; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1923; clk. to atty.-genl., 1924; ag. sol.-gen. for various periods, 1926-28; registr., 1930; judge, asst. ct. of appl., and regir., of friendly socs., 1931.

De BOER, HENRY SPELDERWINDE, M.C., M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.P.H. (Cantab.), D.T.M. and H. (Lond.).—B.1889; ed. privately and at London Hosp.; served with R.A.M.C., 1915-20 (Gallipoli, Sinai, Palestine and Syria, ment. in desps.); med. offr., Kenya, May, 1920; senr. health offr., E. African med. serv., Jan., 1926; dep. dir., san. services N. Rhodesia, Mar., 1931; do., med. services, 1933; dep. dir., med. services, Uganda, 1933.

DE CARTERET, VALENTINE EDWARD ROSS.—B. 1883; asst. comsrr., pol., Gold Coast, May, 1915; comsrr., Jan., 1922; col. pol. offr.' course, R.I.C., 1915, and senr. pol. offr.' course at New Scotland Yard, 1927; senr. comsrr., pol., 1929.

DE CHAIR, VICE-ADMIRAL SIR DUDLEY RAWSON STRATFORD, K.C.B. (1916), K.C.M.G. (1933), M.V.O. (1908).—B. 1864; mid. of the "Alexandra," at bombardment of Alexandria, 1882; landed with naval brig., naval attache to courts of the Maritime Powers, 1902; and to N. and S. America, 1903-4; A.D.C. to the King, 1911-12; naval sec. to 1st lord of the adm'y., 1912-14; adm'l. of training service, 1914; comdg. tenth cruiser squadron, 1914-16; naval adviser to F.O., 1916; vice-adm'l. comdg. battle squadron, 1917-18; vice-adm'l., 1917; adm'l. comdg. coast guard and reserve, 1919; gov., New S. Wales, Oct., 1923; ret., 1930.

DECK, S. F.—Asst. dist. comsrr. E.A.P., 23rd Aug., 1907; dist. comsrr., May, 1913; offr. in charge, Northern Frontier Dist., 1914-15; prin. inspr. of labour, Dec., 1920; supt., native lab., Kenya and Uganda Rly., Oct., 1925; ag. senr. comsrr., 1928; 1st grade prov. comsrr., 1931.

DE COMARMOND, HENRI MAXIME.—B.1899; ed. R. Coll., Mauritius; called to bar, Middle Temple, June, 1922; ag. dist. and stip. mag. for Mauritius and Rodrigues, Aug., 1925; ag. addnl. subst. procureur and advoc. gen., on various occasions, 1925-28; dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius and Rodrigues, Jan., 1927; 2nd addnl. subst. procureur and advoc. gen., Jan., 1928; subst. procureur and advoc. gen., Dec., 1932; ag. procureur and advoc. gen., May, 1933; mem., exec. coun. and coun. of govt.

DE FREITAS, SIR ANTHONY, KT. BACH. (1927), O.B.E. (1918), B.A. (Clare Coll., Camb.).—B. 1869; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn; ag. chief just., St. Vincent May-Oct., 1904; stip. mag., 1st Dist., St. Lucia, Oct., 1904; ag. atty.-gen., St. Lucia, July, 1906; atty.-gen., St. Lucia, Apr., 1907; chief just., St. Vincent, May, 1915; chief just., St. Lucia, Sept., 1919; ag. administrator., St. Vincent, 1909, 1915, and Mar., 1917, to Dec., 1918; ag. col. sec., St. Lucia, on seven occasions; ag. administrator., St. Lucia, on 15 occasions, including July, 1914, to May, 1915; puisne judge, Jamaica, Aug., 1921; ag. ch. just., Jamaica, July, 1922 to Sept., 1923 and Jan., 1925 to Feb., 1926; ch. just., Br. Guiana, Feb., 1927; ret., 1934.

DE GLANVILLE, R. J. A. P. G.—B. 1885; called to the bar, Bahamas, 1914; notary pub., 1914; priv. sec. to H.E. Wm. Hart Bennett, Esq., C.M.G., adminstr. of Bahamas, 1909; also to H.E. Sir W. Grey-Wilson, K.C.M.G., gov., 1912; ag. coroner for New Providence, 1911 and 1913; confirmed, 1914; 2nd elk., H. of A., 1912; chief elk., 1913; ag. registr., sup. ct. from 1913; ag. stip. and circuit mag. and coroner on various occasions, 1921-31; ag. atty.-gen., advoc. gen. and adm'y. advoc., contr., local clearing office and temp. mem., exec. coun. on various occasions in 1923, 1924 and 1925; registr.-gen., Apr., 1923; ag. atty.-gen. on various occasions, 1922-35.

DE HAVILLAND, THOMAS LYTTON, C.M.G., D.S.O.—B. 1874; ed. Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey and R. Naval Schl., London; Bechuanaland campaign, 1897; Anglo-Boer war, 1899-1902; France and Belgium, 1916-19; serjeant-at-arms, H. of A., Union of S. Africa.

DE HEVENINGHAM, N. W. P.—Ed. King's Coll., London and Worcester Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law (Inner Temple); ent. home civ. serv. (open compet.), 1901; served H.O.L.G. Bd. and miny. of munitions; practised at bar, 1918-24; ch. mag. and legal adviser, Br. Solomon Is.; mem., advisory coun. and a judl. comr. for W. Pacific, 1924; dep. registr., high ct., Tanganyika Territory, 1928; ag. registr., May-Dec., 1931; res., mag., 1932; ag. judge, high ct., 1935.
DE JAGER, SAMUEL JACOBUS, K.C., B.A., LL.B., Camb.—B. 1879; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1902; admitted advocate, O.R.C., 1903; atty.-gen., O.F.S., 1911; ditto, Cape Prov., 1929.

DE KOCK, GILLES VAN DE WALL.—B. 1889; ed. Stellenbosch, Pretoria, Capetown and London; M.R.C.V.S., Lond. (1913); vety. research offr., Onderstepoort, 1914; prof. of anatomy, Univ. of Stellenbosch, 1920; prof. anat., T'vaal Univ. Coll., 1920; sr. vety. research offr., Onderstepoort, 1920; sub-dir., vety. services, Onderstepoort, 1927; D.Sc., Witwatersrand Univ., 1928; dep. dir., divn. of vety. services and animal husbandry, 1931.

DE KOCK, MICHIHEL HENDRIK, B.A. (Cape), M.A. and Ph. D. (Harvard).—B. 1898; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch and Harvard Univ., U.S.A.; sen. lecturer, economics, Univ. of Cape Town, 1923-24; mem., bd. of trade and industries, Union of S. Africa, Oct., 1924-29; mem., diamond control advisory comttee, 1930; S. African Reserve Bank, 1931; dep. gov., S. African Res. Bank, 1932; author of "Finance Of the Union of South Africa," "Government ownership in South Africa," and "Economic History of South Africa."

DE LA HARPE, PETER HENRY, I.S.O. (1935).—B. 1877; apptd. to cls. V., Ceylon civ. serv., June, 1923; extra offr., Galle Kach., June, 1923; ditto to col. sec., Aug., 1928; office asst. to col. sec., Sept., 1929; do. to ch. sec., July, 1931.

DE MEZA, JOHN, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1885; vety. offr., Nyasaland Prot., 1914; vety. bact., 1921; ch. vety. offr., 1935.

DENHAM, SIR EDWARD BRANDIS, G.C.M.G. (1935), K.C.M.G. (1931), K.B.E. (1927), C.M.G. (1923).—B. 1876; ed. at Malvern and Merton Coll., Oxford (exhibtn.) B.A., 1899; cadet, Ceylon, Nov., 1899; asst. govt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1902; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec., May, 1904, Mar., 1905; asst. govt. agt. N. Prov. for pearl fishery work, Mar., 1905; 2nd asst. col. sec. and sec., agric. bd., May, 1906; priv. sec. to Sir A. Ashmore, O.A.G., Sept., 1905; organising sec., agric. bd., Dec., 1905; landing survr., cust., Colombo, June, 1906; dist. judge, Negombo, Sept., 1908; 2nd asst. col. sec., Jan., 1909; and priv. sec. to Sir H. Clifford, O.A.G., June, 1909; seconded as supt. of census, Aug., 1910; priv. sec. to Sir H. Clifford, O.A.G., June, 111; attached to C.O., 1st Jan. to 13th Oct., 1913; prin. asst. col. sec., Ceylon, 25th Apr., 1914; chief oensor, in addition to his own duties, Aug., 1914; capt., administrative section, town guard, Colombo, 1915; ag. govt. agt., E. Prov., Sept., 1915; offr. of cls. I., grade II. on app't. as dir. of educn., Aug., 1916; dir., food production, Mar.-Dec., 1920; col. sec., Mauritius, 14th Dec., 1920; admstl. govt. in 1921, 1922 and 1923; col. sec., Kenya Col. and Prot., Aug., 1923; admstl. govt., Feb. to Oct., 1925 and from Jan. to Aug., 1927; gov., Gambia, 1928; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Br. Guiana, 1930; capt.-gen. and gov.-in-ch., Jamaica, 1934; joint author of "Rubber in the East."

DENMAN, LORD.—3rd Baron (cr. 1834), Rt. Hon. Sir Thomas Denman, P.C. (1907); G.C.M.G. (1911); K.C.V.O. (1909).—B. 1874; ed. at Sandhurst; lieut., reserve of offs.; late lieut., Royal Scots, and major, Middlesex I.Y.; served in S. Africa war (wounded, Queen's medal, 3 clasps); lord-in-waiting in ordinary, 1905-7; capt. Lon. corps of gentlemen-at-arms, 1907-11; J.P., Sussex; gov. gen. and commdr.-in-chief, Commonwealth of Australia, 1911-1914.

DENNIS, OWEN GREGORY.—B. 1894; ent. Army, King's Own Scottish Borderers, 1915; war. serv. in Egypt and France, 1915-18; seconded serv., W.A.F.F., 1919; asst. commnr., pol., Nigeria, 1922; resgd. Army commr., 1923; invalided from col. serv., Nov., 1923; re-apptd. as local commdt., pol. and asst. commr., Cyprus, Mar., 1928; commr. and local commdt., pol., Dec., 1929.

Denny, William Joseph, M.C.—M.P., S. Australia, since 1900; atty.-gen. and min. for Northern Territory, 1910-12; capt., A.I.F., European War, 1915-19; atty.-gen., 1924-27 and since Apr., 1930.

DE NOBRIGA, John.—B. 1884; 3rd clk., P.W.D., Trinidad, Apr., 1901; asst. clk., water and sewerage dept., Aug., 1903; storekeeper and clk., engnr.'s office, Apr., 1905; clk., mines dept., Sept., 1908; ch. clk., ditto, Dec., 1910; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s office, Jan., 1921; ch. clk. and clk., leg. coun., Feb., 1925; 2nd astl. col. sec., Jan., 1930; ag. 1st astl. col. sec., Feb., 1931; ag. dep. col. sec., May-Aug., 1934; 1st astl. col. sec., Mar., 1935; ag. dep. col. sec., Feb.-Apr., 1936.

DE NORMAN, ALBERT WILFRED NOEL.—B. 1891; ed. United Services Coll. and Chateau du Rosey, Switzerland; Canadian Expedy. Force, 1914; lieut., Royal Fusiliers, 1915; West African Forces, 1916-20; survr., Nigeria survey, 1921; asst. survr.gen., 1930; ag. survr.gen., Apr., Sept., 1933; ag. commnr., lands and survr.gen., Mar.-Sept., 1935.

DE PINTO, Cyril Ernest.—B. 1892; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Sept., 1914; addl., Galle Kachcheri, Sept., 1914; office asst., Batticaloa Kach., Nov., 1917; pol. mag., Avissawella, Nov., 1919; office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, July, 1921; pol. mag., Jaffna, Oct., 1921; ag. dist. judge, Badulla, Aug., 1923; pol. mag., Matara, Apr., 1925; ditto, Galle, Mar., 1927; dist. judge, Kegalle, June, 1933; do., Matara, May, 1934.

DE ROME, F. J., B.Sc. (Lond.), M.B.E.—B. 1886; B.Sc. Lond. Univ. 1908; Jena Univ. (Germany), 1908-1909; asst. mast., Queen's Coll. Hong Kong, 1910; asst. postal censor, 1914-19; asst. mast., cls. II., 1919; asst. mast., cls. I., 1920; ag. headmr., Ellis Kadoorie schl., 1923; ag. headmr., Wansai schl., 1923; headmr., Ellis Kadoorie schl., 1925; headmr., Queen's Coll., Mar., 1930.

DEERRIMAN, FRANCIS PHILIP LOUIS.—B. 1901; ed. Ratcliffe Coll.; col. audit dept., Oct., 1924; asst. audtr., Tanganyika Territory, Jan., 1925; do., Nigeria, June, 1934.

DE SANTOS, ERROL LIONEL.—B. 1890; ent. Trinidad civ. serv., Apr., 1912; asst. treas., Jan., 1929; treas. and chinm., agrcl. bank, 1933.

DE SILVA, JOSEPH MARTIN.—B. 1880; apptd. to Ceylon civ. serv., Apr., 1926; extra off. asst., Ratnapura kach., Apr., 1926; ditto, Galle kach., Oct., 1929; ag. office asst., Colombo kach., Feb., 1932.

DE SILVA, WALWIN ARNOLD, B.Sc. (Lond.).—B. 1905; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1927; addl., Kegalle kach., Jan. and Sept., 1928; addl., Jaffna kach., June, 1928; addl., Kegalle kach., Sept., 1928; addl., Matara kach., Nov., 1928; office asst., Galle kach., Oct., 1932; asst. govt. agt., Badulla, Dec., 1934.

DE SOYZA, GUNASENA, B.A. (Lond.).—B. 1902; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Aug., 1926; addl., Matara kach., Sept., 1926; addl. to Jaffna kach., June, 1927; office asst., Kegalle kach., Mar., 1928; 2nd landing survr., cust., Nov., 1928; office asst., Badulla kach., Oct., 1931; asst. gov.
