MACKENZIE, MAJOR WALTER JOHN EASTON, M.C., M.R.C.V.S., D.T.V.M.—B. 1889; ed. Royal (Dick) Vety. Coll. and Edinburgh Univ.; war serv., 1914-19; col. vet. surg., Hong Kong, 1920; J.P., 1926.

MACKENZIE-INGLIS, MAXWELL IAN HECTOR.—B. 1903; ed. Winchester and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; cadet, Gold Coast, Apr., 1928; ast. dist. comsrr., Nov., 1928.

MACKENZIE-KENNEDY, HENRY CHARLES DONALD CLEVELAND, C.M.G. (1932).—B. 1889; ed. Marlborough and Clare Coll., Cambridge, B.A., 1911; probr., dist. admstr., N. Rhodesia, Dec., 1912; ast. nat. comsrr., June, 1915; nat. comsrr., July, 1918; ag. ast. mag., Apr.-June, 1923; seconded to dept. of nat. affrs., Apr., 1925; ast. mag., Apr., 1926; rep. N. Rhodesia at Imp. educn. confce., 1927; prin. ast. ch. sec., Sept., 1927; ag. D.P.W., Apr., to May, 1928; ch. sec., Oct., 1930; mem., exec. and leg. couns.; ag. gov., Aug., 1931 and from Sept. to Nov., 1932; ret., 1933; ch. sec., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1935.

McKERRON, PATRICK ALEXANDER BRUCE.—B. 1896; ed. Fettes Coll., Edin.; 2nd lieut. Gordon Highrs., 1914; capt., 1916; transf., I.A.R.O., 1917; capt., 20th Punjab, 1918; demob., Feb., 1919; cadet, S.S., Feb., 1920; passed cadet, Mar., 1922; offr., cls. V., Mar., 1923; dist. offr., N. Tebal, Dec., 1924; offr., cls. IV., Mar., 1927; Br. res., Brunei, May, 1928; attd., fedl. sect., Oct., 1931; sec., retrenchment comn., F.M.S., Mar., 1932; offr., cls. III., Mar., 1932; supt., convict estabm't., Taiping, Oct., 1933; ag. ast. advr., Kedah, Apr., 1934.

MACKIE, GEORGE DOUGLAS, M.B.E. (1923).—Ag. 2nd clk., offr. office, St. Vincent, Dec., 1890, to Apr., 1891; 2nd clk. and cashier, treas., Apr., 1891, to May, 1892, and from Jan., 1897 to Oct., 1898; clk., crown lands and survey office, May to Dec., 1892; audit clk., Jan., 1893, to Dec., 1896; 2nd. clk. and acctnt., treas., Grenada, Nov., 1898; ch. clk., Jan., 1903; ch. sub-collr. and revenue offr., treasy., St. Lucia, Jan., 1911; ag. treasur. on several occasions in 1911 to 1915; treas., Nov., 1915; ag. col. sec. in 1923, 1924 and 1925; admstd. govt., July to Sept., 1925.

MACKIE, JAMES RICHARD, B.Sc. (Agrio.)—B. 1896; ed. Sexey's Sch., Bruton, Somerset and Univ. Coll., Reading; supt., agr., Nigeria, 1921; dep. ast. dir., agr., Nigeria, 1928; ast. dir., agr., 1929.

MACKIE, JOHN BEVERIDGE, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), D.T.M. (Liv.).—B. 1901; med. offr., med. dept., Hong Kong; ast. med. offr., Victoria hosp., Aug., 1931; med. offr. in ch. offr. families and Lai Chi Kok prisons, Nov., 1932; ast. med. offr., Kowloon hosp., Dec., 1933; med. offr. in ch., New Territories and offr. families and Kowloon mortuary, Feb., 1934.

MCKINNEY, E. H., M.B.E. (1933).—B. 1877; ent. Bahamas civ. ser., 1898; 2nd clk., P.O., 1901; res. just., Exuma, 1904; Out Island comsrr. (2nd div.), 1909; comsrr. (1st div.), 1912; senr. comsrr., 1928; sr. stip. and circuit mag. in 1931, 1932, 1934 and 1935; ag. assl inspr., Nov., 1936.

MACKINNON, WILLIAM LUNAN, M.A. (Aberdeen), 1911.—B. 1888; ast. audr., G. Coast, Nov., 1912; ag. senr. ast. audr., in 1918 and 1919; ag. ast. treas. (in addition to his own duties), May to Sept., 1919; ag. senr. ast. audr., Oct., 1919; ag. dep. audr. on various occasions, 1926-29; ag. audr., May-Oct., 1930; senr. ast. audr., Nigeria, Oct., 1930; prin. do., 1934.

MC.KINSTY, SIDNEY ALEXANDER ROGER.—B. 1901; called to bar (Lincoln's Inn), 1930; supernymy. sub-inspr., pol., Leeward Is., 1920; sub-inspr., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1921; sub-inspr. and offr. instr., local forces, Antigua, 1924; sub-inspr., Montserrat, O.C.L., forces, offr. in ch., pris. and supt., fire brig., 1924; mag. and coroner, regis.-gen., regis., sup. ct., escheator gen., etc., Montserrat, 1928; dep. judge, Leeward Is., 1929; mem., exec. coun., Montserrat, 1928; chmn., prison justices, 1929; admstd. govt. of Montserrat, 1929; dist. comsrr., Belize, Br. Honduras and offr. admstr. and offr. recr., 1930; ag. atty.-gen. in 1930, 1931 and 1932; ag. col. sec. in 1932; ag. ch. jnt. in 1931, 1932 and 1934.

MACKLEY, GABRIEL HERCULES.—B. 1883; ed. pub. schls., N.Z.; entd. N.Z. govt. rlv. dept., 1900; ch. clk., 1928; ast. gen. man., 1931; gen. man., 1933.

MACKLIN, MAJOR RODRICK WILLIAM, M.C., A.M.I.E.E.—B. 1891; serv. European War, 1914-18; with army of occupation, Germany, 1919; major, R.A. (R.O.); travelling comsrr., Gambia, Mar., 1920; do., South Bank prov., 1920; do., Macarthy Is. prov., 1924; comsrr., North Bank prov., 1930.

MACLACHLAN, HON. ALEXANDER JOHN.—B. 1872; ed. Adelaide Univ.; called to bar, 1895; el. C'wealth senator for S. Australia, Nov., 1925; hon. min., Aug., 1926; ag. atty.-gen., 1926-27; plenipotentiary for Australia for signing of Kellogg Pact, 1928; vice-pres., exec. coun., Lyons' ministry, 1932; resigned, 1934; P.M.G., 1934.

MACLACHLAN, JAMES BOYD, M.C., M.Sc., B.E., A. M. I. C. E. Chartered Civil Engrnr.—B. 1886; ed. Queen's Coll., Galway and Royal Univ. of Ireland; on active serv., Canadian F.A., 1915-19; M.C., 1917; mentd. in desp., 1918; ast. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Apr., 1919; exec. engrnr., P.W.D., Apr., 1928; senr. exec. engrnr., pub. wks. serv., Malaya, 1935.

MACLAREN, JOHN SUTHERLAND.—B. 1900; Fettes Coll. and Edin. Univ.; M.A. (hons. class.), 1921; Fettes exhib., Lamfane schol., Ritchie schol., 1st equal Gray Essay Prize, 1922; cadet, Hong Kong, 1923; passed in Cantonese, Dec., 1925; ast. treas. and ast. assessor, 1926; ast. estate duty comsrr., 1927; 2nd astt. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1928; ast. offr., N. and S. dists., New Territories, 1929; ast. treas., 1930; dist. offr., South, 1931; ast. treas. and dep. estate duty comsrr., 1933; senr. ast. treas., July-Sept., 1934; dep. estate duty comsrr., 1935.

MACLAREN, COL. THK. HON. MURRAY, C.A.M.C., C.M.G., L.L.D., M.D., C.M., M.R.C.S.,
F.A.C.S., Commander of Order of St. John of Jerusalem, also of Order of Avis Portugal.—B. 1861; ed. Grammar Sch., St. John, N.B.; univ. of New Brunswick; Edinburgh univ.; Vienna; served overseas, 1914-19; 1st el. to H. of C., Canada, 1921; re-el. at g. e., 1925 and 1926; min. of pensions and national health in Bennett admntr., 1930; lieut. gov., New Brunswick, 1935.

McLAUGHLAN, ALLAN HEARTLEY PHILIP, P.A.S.I., chartered survr.—B. 1903; ed. English schl., Cyprus, and pvt. tuition; tracer, P.W.D., Cyprus, 1920; temp. foreman, P.W.D., 1925; draughtsman and record keeper, P.W.D., 1926; asst. engr., P.W.D., 1929; ag. divnl. engr., P.W.D., on various occasions, 1930-35.

MACLEAN, ADRIAN JOHN.—Ed. at Selwyn Coll., Camb., B.A., 1895; M.A., 1901; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., May, 1901; collr., Apr., 1905; recorder of titles, 1911; senr. comnr., Kenya, May, 1920.

MACLEAN, F. H.—B. 1889; apptd. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div., and assigned to bd. of educn., May, 1908; transf. to C.O., Dec., 1911; on military serv., from 25th Apr., 1917, to 23rd Feb., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 24th Jan., 1922.

MACLEAN, GEORGE, O.B.E. (1934), M.B., Ch.B. (Glas.).—B. 1888; temp. lieut., R.A.M.C., Mar., 1918 to Mar., 1919; temp. capt., Mar., 1919 to June, 1920; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1921; sleeping sickness offr., Apr., 1926; D.D.M.S., 1935.

MACLEAN, SIMON JAMES, M.A., LL.B., Ph.D.—B. 1871; comnr. of the Canadian govt. to report on rly. rate grievances, 1901; advar. to comnr. of govt. to draft Railway Act, 1903; prof. of polit. econ., Toronto Univ., 1906-1908; apptd. a mem. of rly. comnr., Canada, 1908; re-apptd., Nov., 1918; asst. chief comnr., Aug., 1919.

MACLENNAN, FINLAY MALCOLM.—B. 1887; ed., Tarbutt Public Sch.; Sault Ste. Marie, Ont., High Schl.; ent. serv. of dept. of rlys. and canals, Can., as office man, Sault Ste. Marie Canal, Sept., 1910; transferred, Port Nelson on Hudson Bay terminals work, as jnr. engr., 1912; asst. audr., dept., rlys. and canals, Ottawa, 1st Apr., 1915; audr., 1917; ch. audr., 1918; asst. comptlr., 1920; comptr., 1930.

MACLENNAN, IAN MORRISON ROSS.—B. 1909; ed. Hymers Coll., Hull and Worcester Coll., Oxford; schol., 1928; 2nd cls. hon., mods., 1930; 1st cls. philosophy, politics, economics, 1932; Gladstone research student, St. Deiniol's liby., Hawarden, 1932-3; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. prin., C.O., 1933.

MACLENNAN, NORMAN MACPHHRSON.—B. 1895; ed. Waitaki College (N.Z.) and Aberdeen Univ.; M.D., Ch.B., D.P.H., D.T.M. & H. (Eng.); war serv., 1915-18; res. med. offr., City Hosp., Aberdeen, 1922; bacteriologist, James Mackenzie Inst., St. Andrews and M.O.H., St. Andrews, 1923; asst. M.O.H. and tuberculosis offr., Woolwich, 1925; health offr., Kenya, 1927; senr. med. offr., Palestine, 1929; senr. health offr., N. Rhodesia, 1931; tuberculosis expert, Palestine, 1933.

MCLEOD, DAVID WILLIAM, M.A.—B. 1887; ed. Aberdeen Cent. Training Coll. and Aberdeen Univ.; senr. asst., King's Coll., Seychelles, 1910; prin., King's Coll. and inspr., schls., Seychelles, 1913; on active serv., 1914-19; senr. asst., King Edward VII Schl., Taiping, Feb., 1920; prin., Jan., 1922; prin., Free Schl., Penang, Dec., 1930; prin., Raffles Inst., S'pore, Feb., 1932.

MACLEOD, J. R. S.—B. 1887; ed. Scots Coll., Ballarat and Cambridge, B.A., LL.B., F.S.A., Scotland; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1921; lieut., Australian Citizens Forces, 1914; served overseas as 2/lieut., Australian Imp. Forces, 1915; capt., 1918 (wounded, desps. twice); temp. clk., F.O., 1921; asst. comnr., national savings comtee., 1922; after compet. exam. apptd. asst. prin., Oversea Sttlmt. Dept., 1924.

McLUCKIE, WILLIAM HARLEY, M.Inst. C.E.—B. 1895; ed. Greenock High Schl., Royal Tech. Coll., Glasgow; mily. serv., 1915-19; asst. engr., P.W.D., Tanganyika Territory, 1922; exec. engr., 1928; ag. dep. dir., pub. wks. for various periods, 1930-35; ag. dir., pub. wks. in 1933.

MACLUSKIE, HECTOR, C.D.A.—B. 1904; univ. dipl., agr. (Aberdeen); Imp. Col. Trop. Agr., Trinidad, 1929-30; agrl. supt., dept. agr., Br. Guiana, 1930.

McMAHON, CECIL, O.B.E. (1934), M.C.—Ent. S. Rhodesia civ. serv., Nov., 1909; served S. African rebellion and German S.W. African campaign, 1914-15 with 1st Rhodesian regt.; E. Africa campaign with 8th S. African Inf., 1915-18; capt. and adjt., "1914-15" Star and M.C.; asst. polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1918 dist. offr., June, 1926; dep. prov. comnr., 1934; ag. prov. comnr., Aug., 1933-Nov., 1934 and Aug., 1935.

MACMICHAEL, SIR HAROLD, K.C.M.G. (1932), C.M.G. (1927), D.S.O. (1917).—B. 1882; ed. King's Lynn and Bedford Schls. and Magdalene Coll., Cambridge (schol.); joined Sudan polit. serv., 1905; successively inspr. in provs. of Kordofan, Blue Nile and Khartoum; polit. and intell. offr., expedy. force, Darfur reoccupation, 1916 (three times ment. in desps., D.S.O.); sub.-gov., Darfur prov.; asst. civ. sec., Sudan govt.; civ. sec., do., 1926; gov. and cmndr.-in-ch., Tanganyika Territory, 1934; Order of the Nile (2nd cls.), 1930; Burton Memorial Med. of the R. Asiatic Soc'y., 1928; Star of Ethiopia (2nd cls.), 1930; author of "The Tribes of Northern and Central Kordofan" (1912), "A History of the Arabs in the Sudan" (1922), "The Anglo-Egyptian Sudan" (1934).

MACMILLAN, HON. CHARLES EDWARD DE LA BARCA.—B. 1872; ed. Brighton pub. schl. and pvtly.; ent. N.Z. H. of R., 1923; min. of agr. and mines, 1932.

MCMILLAN, L. B.—B. 1873; ed. pub. schls., Charlottetown, Prince Edward Is.; messenger, P.E. Is. govt., 1890; clk., 1893; sec. for pub. wk., P.E. Is., 1900.

MACNAB, ALEXANDER CHRISTY, M.I.MAR.E., M.Liv.E.S.—B. 1884; survr., ships, S.S., May, 1920; ag. survr.-gen., various occasions, 1920, 1931 and 1934.

McNAMARA, GEORGE, C.B.E. (1932).—B. 1881; entd. N.Z. post and tel. dept., 1896; supt. of staff, 1916; 2nd asst. sec., 1920; 1st asst. sec., 1923; sec., 1926; dir.-gen., 1933.

McNAUGHTON, MAJOR GEN. ANDREW GEORGE LATTAN, C.B. (1935), C.M.G. (1919), D.S.O. (1918), Hon. LL.D., McGill Univ. (1920)—B. 1887; ed. Lennoxville, McGill Univ. (B.Sc., M.Sc.), R. Staff Coll., Camberley, Imp. Defence Coll. (Lond.); served European War, 1914-13 in France & Belgium (wounded twice), ment. in desps. three times, '1914-15' Star, two med.; ch., Canadian gen. Staff, 1929-35; pres., nat. research coun. of Canada since 1935.

MACNIE, WILLIAM ALexANDER.—B. 1899; 2nd lieut., Seaforth Highrs., 1918; lieut., 1919-20; served, France, 1918; sub-inspr., pol., B.
Guiana, 1921; dist. inspr., 1925; ag. detective inspr., 1925; ag. pol. inspr., 1926, 1928-31; seconded to col. secretariat as addnl. ass't. col. sec., May, 1931; dist. commr., Jan., 1932.

McNULTY, THOS. SYDNEY.—B. 1870; ed. at Marist Coll., Sydney; clk., aceta. branch, wks. dept., Perth, W. Australia, 1896; ch. corres. clk., ditto, 1897; mem. mun. coun., Claremont, 1901-3; sec. to goldfields water supply admin., 1903; under-sec. for agric. and industries, 1909.

McPHEE, SIR JOHN CAMERON, K.C.M.G. (1934).—B. 1878; premier of Tasmania since 1st June, 1928; ret.

MACPHERSON, BARBARA.—Ed. Durness H.G. Sohl. and Skerry's Coll., Edinburgh; apptd. after compet. exam. typist, Lond. tel. serv., 1912; transf'd, to C.O., May, 1918; shorthand writer, Aug., 1918; cler. off'r., Jan., 1923.

MACPHERSON, COLIN, OF O., K.A.R.—B. 1898; ed. Alleyne's Coll., Dulwich; cadet, Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1926; asst. dist. off'r., Jan., 1929.

MACPHERSON, JOHN STUART.—B. 1898; ed. Watson's Coll. and Edin. Univ. (M.A., 1921); 2nd lieut., A. and S. Highlanders, Jan., 1918; France, Apr., 1918-Jan., 1919; cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; ag. 4th asst. sec. to gov't. F.M.S., Aug., 1921; passed cadet, July, 1922; ag. asst. dist. off'r., K. Salangor, Aug., 1922; ag. dist. off'r., Raub, May, 1923; off'r., cls. V, Mar., 1924; ag. dist. off'r., Bentong, Oct., 1925; off'r. cls. IV, dist. off'r., Bentong, Mar., 1928; relief asst. sec. to gov't. F.M.S., Feb., 1930; off'r., cls. III, Mar., 1933; attchd. C.O., Sept., 1933.

McPHILLIPS, HON. ALBERT EDWARD.—B. 1861; ed. St. Boniface and Manitoba Colls.; barrister; K.C., 1900; elected to leg. assem., B.C., 1898; atty.-gen., 1903; subsequently pres. of coun.; judge, ct. of appeal, B.C., 1913.

McQUADE, JOHN HERRBERT.—B. 1893; highest marks in U.K. in entrance exam. for cust. and excise, Mar., 1913; imp. cust. and excise, July, 1913; war serv., Flanders with R.A., 1917-18; asst., cust., Kenya, July, 1920; collr., cust., Aug., 1924; sec., tariff comte., 1930; dep. compt'r., cust., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1930; census off'r., 1931; sec., econ. advay. bd., 1931-33; compt'r., cust., Nov., 1934.

MACQUARIE, EDMUND JEFFREY.—B. 1883; ed. Queen's Coll., B. Guiana and Caiau Coll., Cambridge; B.A., L.B.B., 1905; called to the bar, Inner Temp., 1906; ag., stip. mag., B. Guiana, June to Nov., 1906; and July, 1907 to Mar., 1914; dormant commr. as stip. mag. and apptd. J.P. and commr. of oaths, Dec., 1907; asst. dist. commr., Gold Coast, 1915; crown counsel, 1916; ag. chief registr., Apr.-May, 1917; az. senr. crown counsel, 1917; ag. pol. mag., Nov., 1917 to Apr., 1918; ag. solr.-gen., Apr. to Dec., 1919; ag. ch. registr., Apr. to Oct., 1920; solr.-gen., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1920; ag. atty.-gen. in 1923, 1924 and 1927; puisne and circuit judge, Sierra Leone, 1931.

MACQUILLAN, CECIL JAMES, M.B., M.B., B.Ch. (T.C.Dublin).—M.O., R.A.F. (res.) served U.K. and Irak, 1924-26; R.M.O., Kent and Canterbury hosp., 1926; medl. off'r., Tanganyika Territory, Nov., 1927.

MACRAE, LACHLAN, M.A. (Aberdeen), M.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1886; dir., educn., Ceylon, Jan., 1922; M.L.C.

McROBERTS, CAPT. R. A.K.—Natal mounted pol., 1903-08; Natal rebellion, 1906; Usutu operations, 1907; inspr., veterinary pol., E.A.P., 1909; asst. inspr., pol., Mar., 1910; asst. supt., Sept., 1911; capt., Gordon Highlanders, Aug., 1915; France, 1916; called to bar, Middle Temple, Jan., 1917; att'd, Highland Light Inf'y., Mesopotamia, Mar., 1917; seconded, polit. dept., dist. mag. and dep. mily. gov., Basrah, 1917-18; mily. mission to Siberian govt., 1919; supt., pol., Kenya Colony, May, 1920; mag., Zanzibar Prot., Jan., 1921; ag. asst. judge, in 1922 and 1924; ag. atty-gen., Feb. to Sept., 1925; pol. mag., Sierra Leone, Apr., 1926.

MAFFEY, SIR JOHN LOADER, G.C.M.G. (1935), K.C.B., (1934), K.C.M.G. (1931), K.C.V.O. (1921), C.S.I. (1920), C.I.E. (1916).—B. 1877; ed. Rugby and Christ Ch., Oxford; ent. I.C.S., 1899; transf'd, polit. dept., 1905; served with Mohmand Field Force, 1908 (med. and clasp); polit. agt., Khyber, 1909-12; dep. commr., Peshawar, 1914-15; dep. sec., foreign and polit. dept., gov't of India, 1915-16; ch. polit. off'r., Afghanistan with N.W. Frontier Field Force, 1919; prte. sec. to viceroy, 1916-20; ch. sec. to Duke of Connaught, 1921; ch. commr., N.W. Frontier prov., India, 1921-24; gov.-gen., Sudan, 1926; perm. under-sec. of state for the cols., Nov., 1933.

MAGILL, CHARLES VICTOR, O.B.E. (1934).—Asst. dir., posts and tels., Somaliland, Nov., 1919; dir., posts and tels., Somaliland, Apr., 1926.

MAGLADERY, THOMAS.—B. 1876; M.L.A. for Temiskaming, Ont., 1914-24; promoted in war serv. to capt.; dir., soldier settl. hd., 1931; dep. min., immigrn. and colonization, 1934.

MAGRATH, CHARLES ALEXANDER.—B. 1860; ed., priv. tuition; irrign. and development work in S. Alberta from 1878; mem. for Lethbridge in N.W.T. assem. for several years, and finally mem. of prov. cabinet; ed. to H.C., Can., 1908, for Medicine Hat; def., 1911; fuel contr., Can., 1917-20; chmn., Internat. Joint Coman., Can. sect., 1921.

MAHABIR, F.—B. 1888; asst. med. supt., lunatic asylum, Trinidad, Apr., 1915.

MAHABIR, JULES.—B. 1891; called to bar, Gray's Inn, July, 1916; mag., St. Patrick, Trinidad, Mar., 1934.

MAHON, WILLIAM GRAVES.—B. 1879; ent. civ. serv., Barbados, 1900; ch. clk., pol. magts., dist. "A", 1919; pol. mag., dist. "E", 1919.

MAINGOT, ELLIOT FRANCIS.—B. 1891; ed. Ushaw Coll., Durham; served articles of clerkship in London and qualified as solnr., 1914; crown solnr., admtr., gen. and off'r. receiver, Trinidad, Dec., 1922; pub. trustee, May, 1931.

MAJOR, ALFRED REGINALD SEYMOUR.—B. 1909; ed. St. John's, Leatherhead; pol. probationer, Hong Kong, Nov., 1929; as-t. supt., pol., Dec., 1931; att'd. Punjab pol., 1933-34.

MALAN, RT. HON. FRANCOIS STEPHANUS, P.C. (1929).—B. 1871; ed. in S. Africa and Camb.; B.A. Science, Cape univ.; LL.B., Camb.; advocate of sup. ct., Cape Colony, 1895; M.L.A. for Malmesbury, 1900; re-elected, Feb., 1904; min. of agric., Cape Colony, 1908; min. of educn., Union of South Africa, 1910; attended Imp. conf., 1911; min. of mines, industries and educn., 1912; min. for agr., 1920; min. of mines and industries, 1921-24; senator, 1927.

MALAN, FRANCOIS STEPHANUS.—B. 1882; ed. Normal Coll., Capetown and Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, B.A.; inspr., schls., Transvaal, 1916; prin., Normal Coll., Ermelo, Transvaal, 1919; sec., Transvaal educn. dept., 1924; inspr., schls., Transvaal, 1935.

MALAN, HENDRICK JACOBUS, B.A. (Cape).—B. 1879; Cape civ. serv., 1900; war serv., capt., Pretoria Rgt., S.W.A., 1914-15; asst. mag.,
Johannesburg, 1918; mag., Britstown, 1919; Ladysmith, 1922; Johannesburg, 1927; Senekal, 1930; Potchefstroom, 1933.

MALAN, WOUTER DE VOS.—B., 1892; ed., Boys High Sch., Huguenot Coll., Wellington, Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch and Teachers' Coll., Columbia Univ., New York; B.A. lit. and phil., 1911; B.A. (hons.) hist., 1916; Ph.D., Col. Univ., 1923; princ., Ceres High Sch., 1924-28; prof., educn., Univ. of Stellenbosch, 1929-30; prof. ast.; supt.-gen., educn., Cape Prov., 1930; supt.-gen., educn., Cape Prov., 1934.

MALCOLM, HAROURT GLADSTONE, C.B.E. (1935), O.B.E. (1918); K.C. (1910).—Priv. sec. to Sir Henry Jackson when admnstr. of Bahamas, 1892, 1893, 1895; ditto to Sir W. F. Haynes-Smith, gov. of Bahamas, 1895; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1899; ditto, Bahamas, July, 1899; mem. of H. of A., Bahamas, 1900; deputy-speaker, 1901; re-elected, 1904 and 1911; ag. atty.-gen., Aug. to Nov., 1905; Sept., 1906 to Feb., 1907; July to Nov., 1910; Apr. to Dec., 1911; May to July, and Aug. to Nov., 1913; ag. chief just., 1913 and 1927; speaker, H. of A., 1913; re-elected, 1913, 1919, 1927 and 1928; thanked by S. of S. for assistance to atty.-gen. in drafting bills; thanked by legis., for obtaining copies of early records; Bahamas del. to Canada-W. Indies conferees at Ottawa, 1920 and 1925; Bahamas rep. during visit of Prince of Wales, and partly, tercentenary celebrations at Bermuda Oct., 1920; Bahamas del. to W. Indian conferees, London, 1926; prepared 1929 revised edition of the laws of Bahamas.

MALHERBE, ERNST GIDEON.—B., 1895; ed., Stellenbosch Univ. and Columbia Univ.; B.A. Hons., M.A. (phil.) (Cape), M.A. and Ph.D. (educn.) Columbia; fellow, Teacher's College, Columbia Univ., 1923-24; teacher, Cape Town Training Coll.; lect., educn. psychology, Univ. of Stellenbosch; senr. lect., educn., Univ. of Cape Town; ch. investigator educn. sec., Carnegie Poor White Commn. of research, 1928-32; dir., National Bureau for Educn. and Social Research, 1929; author publications on educn. subjects.

MALHERBE, JOZUA FRANCOIS.—B., 1880; clk., dept. of just., Transvaal, 1900; clk., commr. of pol., 1902; 1st gce. clk. and A.R.M., dept. of just., 1908; pub. pros., Kimberley, 1912; senr. clk., dep. of just., 1920; mag., Wynberg, 1921; admt. mag., Pretoria, 1925; mem., wage bd., 1926; pub. serv. inspr., 1930; workmen's compensation commr., 1934.

MALLEY, THOMAS.—B., 1891; G.P.O., Glasgow, Dec., 1909-16; R.N.V.R., Dec., 1916-Jan., 1920; G.P.O., London, 1920-23; asst. supt., P.&T., F.M.S., Feb., 1923; sec., Malayan w/less comtee., June, 1926; supt., P. & T. Dept., Oct., 1926; sec., comtee.—teleg. & telep. commun., S.S., F.M.S. & U.M.S., Oct., 1930; dep. acctn.-gen., P. & T., Feb., 1933.

MALONE, DENIS KERON.—B., 1903; ed., Cooper's Company Schl.; cler. offr., C.O., 29th Mar., 1921.

MANDERS, RICHARD HENRY DAVID, B.A. (Cantab.), B., 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1927; attd., secretariat, Feb., 1927; attd., Kandy kach., Oct., 1927; office ast., ditto Feb., 1929; ditto, Kandy kach., May, 1930; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Dec., 1931; asst. ch. sec., Apr., 1932; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Mar., 1933; pol. mag., Galle, Nov., 1933.

MANGAN, WILLIAM EDWARD.—Served in Bechuanaland Prot. pol., 1910-14; clk., 1914; ag. ast. res. mag., 1921; passed 2nd grade Seewana exam., 1917; ag. res. mag., 1922.

MANGIN, THORLEIF RATTRAY ORDE.—B., 1896; ed., Marlborough Coll.; sub-lieut., R.N.V.R. and attd. to Royal Naval Dvn., 1915; qualified, gunnery course, H.M.S. Excellent, 1916; apptd., to H.M.S. Repulse and served with Grand Fleet, 1916-1919; ast. dist. commr., Gold Coast, 1919; dep. prov. commr., 1934.

MANN, SIR FREDERICK WOLLASTON, K.B.E. (1933), M.A., LL.M.—B., 1869; called to bar, 1896; served, Boer War; judge, sup. ct., Victoria, 1919; ag. ch. just., 1933-34; ch. just., Oct., 1935.

MANN, GEORGE ERNEST, M.C., M.A. (Cantab.).—B., 1896; ed., St. Olave's Sch. and Pembroke Coll., Camb.; ast. agrl. inspr., F.M.S., Sept., 1921; agrl. field offr., Nov., 1924; agr. instr., Dec., 1926; vice-prin., schl. of agr., Malay., Apr., 1931.

MANNING, RICHARD JOSEPH.—B., 1883; ed., Clongowes Wood Coll. and Univ. Coll., Dublin; sub-inspr. of police, B. Com., Oct., 1909; dist. inspr., Sept., 1912; ag. stip. mag., W. Coast Demarara, June, 1919; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, June, 1920; mag., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1920; res. mag., Jamaica, July, 1925; pol. mag., Gold Coast, Nov., 1927; ag. ch. regis. on various occasions, 1923-31; ag. circuit judge, Ashanti and N.Territories judiciary, July, 1930; 3rd puisne judge, Trinidad, 1932; higher certif. in Hindi, Mar., 1916; higher certif., Swahili, 1922; lower certif., Ga., 1928; compiler, "Br. Guiana Police Manual," Dec., 1918.

MANNING, WILLIAM.—B., 1892; on active serv., Sept., 1914 to Feb., 1919; inspr., pol., Zanzibar, Mar., 1919; supdt., 1924; ag. ast. commdt., on various occasions, 1925-35.

MANSERGH, N. S., M.B.E.—B., 1889; ed., Wellington Coll.; B.S.A. pol., 1910; Rhodesia Native Regt., 1917; lieut., 1917; demob., 1919; dist. pol. offr., Somaliland, 1919; operns. against Mad Mullah, 1920; ast. commr., pol., Gold Coast, 1921; commr., pol., 1926; commr., pol. orim. investgn. dept., 1927.

MANSON, HENRY HINDLE.—B., 1896; ast. elec. engnr., Tanganyika Territory, 1921; dir., elec. dept., Bahamas, 1934.

MANTON, CYRIL COWAN.—B., 1877; 2nd cls. clk., collectorate, Black River, Jamaica, 1897; 1st cls. treasy. clk., 1903; junr. ast. collr. taxes, 1912; ast. collr., Kingston, 1920; dep. stmp commr., 1920.

MARCH, HARRY THOMAS.—B., 1881; ed., King's Coll., London; 2nd divn. clk., post office, 1900-07; acctnt., post office, Nigeria, Apr., 1907 to Jan., 1912; postm.-gen., Sierra Leone, Feb., 1912.

MARCHANT, W. S.—Ast. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Dec., 1918; ag. dist. commr., Kenya, 1926; dep. prov. commr. and ast. sec., Oct., 1935.

MARCI, HON. CHARLES, LL.D., Ottawa Univ.—B., 1860; elec. to H. of C. of Canada for Bonaventure, 1900; dep. speaker of H. of C., 1905-1908; re-elec. at gen. elec., 1908, 1911, 1917, 1921, 1930 and 1935; speaker of the H. of C., 1909; mem. of P.C. for Canada, 1911.

MARILLIER, ERIC STANLEY, O.B.E. (1935).—B., 1890; clk., cust., N. Rhodesia, Apr., 1912; collr., cust., Apr., 1915; ast. collr., cust., Oct., 1926; contr. cust., Mar., 1928; mem., leg. coun.

MARITZ, G. J.—B., 1890; ed., Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch and Trinity Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1912; pres., sp. income tax
MARSHALL, C. W.—Imp. serv., 1897-98; clk., atty.-gen.'s dept., Cape Town, 1898; examr., accts., 1899; clk., res. mag., King William's Town and distr., stamps, 1900; sec., plague admstr., 1903; 2nd cls. examr., control and audit dept., Cape, 1905; inland rev. dept., 1910; contr. and audr.-gen.'s dept., 1912; senr. clk., 1912; recr., rev., Port Elizabeth, 1916; survr., rev., Pretoria, 1921; Cape Town, 1929; recr., rev., Pretoria, 1930; ditto, Johannesburg, 1932.

MARSHALL, EDWARD FOSTER, B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1888; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1912; addl. Kurunegala kach., Jan., 1913; Badulla kach., Mar., 1913; pol. mag., Matale, May, 1917; asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Sept., 1918; pol. mag., Gampola, May, 1920; asst. govt. agt., Galle, Sept., 1923; pol. mag., Matara, Dec., 1923; dist. judge, Badulla, Apr., 1925; pol. mag., Avisawella, Nov., 1926; dist. judge, Avisawella, Jan., 1928; ditto, Badulla, Feb., 1929; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1930; asst. stintm. offr., Nov., 1931; dep. tea contr. in addn., May, 1933.

MARSHALL, CAPT. REGINALD CHARLES, M.A. (Oxon.), Diploma of Forestry.—B. 1893; exhibr. Queen's Coll., Oxford, 1911; hon. mods. (maths), 2nd cls. hon., 1912; 2nd lieut., Worc. Regt., Aug., 1914; Gallipoli, 1915 (wounded); Mesopotamia, 1916 (wounded); lieut., 9th Batt. Worc. Regt., France, 1917-18 (wounded and prisoner); capt., 1st Batt. Worc. Regt., B.A. (Oxon.), 1919; diploma of forestry (with distinction—placed head of the list), 1920; M.A., 1920; forestry coman., 1920-22; instr., forestry schl., Forest of Dean; asst. comanr., national savings comittee, 1922; dep. conservator, forests, Trinidad and Tobago, 1923; conservator, forests, 1923; mem., bd. of agr., 1923; conserv., forests, Gold Coast, 1934.

MARSHALL, REGINALD HENRY.—B. 1890; ed. Dulwich; active serv., Aug., 1914 to Mar., 1919; aud. audit dept., May, 1919; audr., Seychelles, June, 1919; audr., Br. Honduras, Aug., 1924; C.A.D., Oct., 1927; dep. audr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1930.

MARSLAND, HERBERT, B.Sc. (Ag.)—B. 1899; ed. Ashton-under-Lyne Secondary Sch.; Coll. of Agr., Holmes Chapel, 1917; N.D.A., Harris Inst. Preston, 1921; N.D.D., W. of Scotland Coll. of Dairying, 1921; B.Sc. Univ. of Edinburgh, 1924; Imp. Coll. Trop. Agr., Trinidad, 1924; inspr. agr., Sudan govt., 1925; cotton investigator, Tanganyika Territory, 1928; dist. agrl. offr., 1930.

MARTIN, JOHN MILLER, B.A.—B. 1904; ed. Edinburgh Acad. and Oxford; class. schol., Corpus Christi Coll., 1923-27; 1st cls. class. mods., 1924; B.A., 1927; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. prin., Doms. Office, 2nd Nov., 1927; seconded to Malayan civ. serv., 1st Dec., 1931; pte. sec. to perm. under-sec., D.O. (Sir Edward Harding), 21st Nov., 1934; prin., C.O., 21st Oct., 1935.

MARTIN, KENNETH SEFTON, B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1888; asst. dist. comanr., S. Nigeria, 1911; supervisor, oust., 2nd grade, 1911; 1st grade, 1919; senr. collr., 1929; asst. comptr., 1933; ag. comptr. on various occasions, 1931-35.

MARTIN, LEWIS VERNON.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 17th Mar., 1920; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st Jan., 1935.

MARTINDALE, MILES HAY, Barrister-at-Law (Middle Temple).—B. 1893; asst. dist. offr., 1919; pte. sec. to gov., 1920; asst. sec., S.P. secret., 1923; ag. dist. offr., 1924-27; dist. offr., 1928; ag. crown coun. and ag. ch. regist., 1933; asst. judge, high ct., Prot., 1934.
MARTYN, Eldred Bridgeman, B.A., A.I.C.T.A.—B. 1903; ed. Marlborough Coll., Oriel Coll., Oxford and Imp. Col. Sci. & Tech.; C.O. scholarship courses in mycology, Emmanuel Coll, Cambridge, and Imp. Col. Trop. Agr., Trinidad; botanist mycologist, dept. agr., Br. Guiana, 1928.

MARWICK, Allan Graham, O.B.E. (1925).—B. 1877; served in Natal civ. serv., 1895 to 1899; served Anglo-Boer war, 1899-1901; sub. native comsnr., Mbabane, Swaziland, Jan., 1903 to Mar., 1907; asst. comsnr., ditto, Mar., 1907; asst. comsnr., Hlatikulu, Swaziland, Aug., 1916; mem. Swaziland-Portuguese bndry. comsnr., 1920; asst. comsnr., Mbabane and ag. dep. res. comsnr., Oct., 1932; dep. res. comsnr., 1933; res. comsnr., 1935.

MASON, Gerald Boyell.—Ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; matric., London Univ., 1890; joined London hosp., 1890; passed prelim. scientific, 1892; M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), 1896, certif., London Sch. of Trop. Med., 1909; D.P.H., Cambridge, 1917; med. offr., No. 4 dist., Antigua, 1903; ag. comsnr., Virgin Is., 1904; surg.-lieut., Antigua def. force, 1904; mag. and med. offr., Anguilla and dep. judge of sup. ct., Leeward Is., Jan., 1905 to Sept., 1906; med. offr., No. 6 dist., Nevis, 1906; med. offr., dist. “D”, and mag., dist. “F”, Dominica, 1907; med. offr., St. Vincent, 1909-12; temp. capt., R.A.M.C.; med. offr. in charge of troops, Cambridge, 1916-19; founder and hon. sec., W. Indian Club, 1897-8; founder and hon. sec., West India Red Cross Soc., 1921-1924; dir., med. and health dept., Bermuda, Aug., 1924.

MASSEY, T. H., O.B.E. (1934), M.C., L.R.C.P.—Med. offr., E.A.P., Jan., 1913; senr. med. offr., Kenya, Oct., 1923.

MASSON, Gerald Gustave.—B. 1888; dipl. of agr., Roseworthy Agr. Coll., S. Australia; served in Great War with 9th Australian Light Horse Regt., 1915-19; Gallipoli, Sinai, Palestine and Syria; ment. in desps.; inspr., agr., occupied enemy territory adminstr., 1919; inspr., agr., N. Palestine, 1920; inspr., agr. and forests, 1924; ch. agrl. offr., 1930; sec., comtee. of agronomy, gen. agrl. coun., Palestine.

MASTEN, Hon. Cornelius Arthur.—B. 1857, Quebec; educ. parish dist. schl., La Colle; La Colle Academy; Victoria Univ., Coburg, Ont. (graduated with hon., May, 1879); mathematical master, high schl., Orillia, Ont., 1879-1880; entered law soc. of Upper Canada, Oct., 1880; called to the bar, 1883; K.C. (Ont.), and bencher of the law soc. of Upper Canada, 1908; comsnr. to enquire into the Insurance situation in Ont. with a view to improvements in the law; pres., Alumni Assoc. of Toronto Univ.; chmn., exec. comtee. of the speaker’s patriotic league; author of “Master Company Law in Canada”; justice of the sup. ct. of Ontario, Nov., 1915.

MASTERS, Hon. Robert, M.L.C.—B. 1879; ed. at Brunnerton, N.Z.; mem., N.Z. house of reps., 1919-26; mem. and dep. leader of leg. coun., and mem. of exec. coun. without portfolio, 1930; min. of educn., 1931-34; min. of industries and commerce from 1931; mem., N.Z. delegation to World Economic Confce., 1933.

MASTERTON-SMITH, Sir James Edward, K.C.B. (1919), C.B. (1915).—B. 1878; ed. Harrow (schol.) and Hertford Coll., Oxford (schol.); ent. home civ. serv. (cls. I.), admity., 1901; priv. sec. to 2nd sea lord, 1904-8; priv. sec. to perm. sec., 1908-10; priv. sec. to successive 1st lords of the admly., 1910-17; asst. sec., min. of munitions, Sept., 1917 to Jan., 1919; asst. sec. (addnl.), W.O. and Air Miny., 1919-20; joint perm. sec., miny. of labour, 1920; perm. under-sec. of state for the colonies, 30th Aug., 1921; sec. to the Order of St. Michael and St. George; mem. of the off. side of the National Whitley Coun.; ret., 1925; Offr. of the Belgian Order of the Crown.

MASTERTON-SMITH, Percival Frank, M.C.—B. 1896; ed. Christ’s Hosp. and Wadham Coll., Oxford (hons. mod. hist.); B.A., 1921; R. Fusiliers, 1914-16; 60th Rifles, 1916-19; M.C., 1917; capt., res. of Offrs., 60th Rifles; adminis. offr., Nigeria, 25th Jan., 1922.

MATEER, Edward John.—Ed. Foyle Coll. and Taunton Schl.; asst. treas., Uganda, July 1920; senr. asst. treas., 1931; prin. asst. treas., 1933.

MATHER, Norman Frederick Hugh., B.A., (Oxon).—B. 1890; ed. Merchant Taylor’s Schl., and Hertford Coll., Oxford (schol.); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1913; served in Rifle Brig., Dec., 1915-Sept., 1919; asst. sec. to res., Selangor, Nov., 1919; asst. dist. offr., Mar., 1921; regier., war serv. land grant scheme, S. Feb., 1922; sec. to res., Pahang, Dec., 1923; mag., Seremban, July, 1925; offr. cls. III, Nov., 1925; chmn., sany. bd., Seremban, Aug., 1926; cls. II, Nov., 1930; asst. advr., Segamat, May, 1928; dist. offr., Larut and regier., titles, Perak, Mar., 1932; chmn., govt. rice mill in admn., May, 1933.

MATHERS, Frederick Francis, K.C., LL.B.—B. 1871; ed. schls. in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Dalhousie law schl. and Harvard law schl.; called to the bar, 1892; dep. prov. sec. and clk. of exec. coun., N.S., 1902; also regier. of joint stock companies, 1909; now deputy atty.-gen.

MATHESON, Capt. C. L. T., M.C.—Commissioned in Royal Engineers, 1909; asst. dir. of surv., G. Coast, 1914; Togoland campaign, 1914; Cameroonos, 1914-15; France with Field Coy. R.E., 1916-17; W.O., 1918; dep. dir. topographical surveys, G. Coast, 1920.

MATHEW, Charles.—B. 1903; ed. Downside schl. and Trinity Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Lincoln’s Inn, 1927; cadet, admtn., Nigeria, 1929; asst. dist. offr., 1932; ag. pol. mag., crown coun., and offl. admtr. on various occasions, 1930-33; mag., Uganda, 1933; ag. crown coun. and solr.-gen. on various occasions, 1934 and 1935.

MATHEWS, Arnold Burnet.—B. 1898; ed. Shrewsbury (schl.) and Magdalene Coll., Cambridge (cls. schl.); sub-lieut., R.N.V.R., 1917-19; 2nd cls., Pt. I, classical tripes, 1920; B.A., 1920; 2nd cls., anthropological tripes, 1922; asst. dist. offr., N.P. Nigeria, Jan., 1923; asst. sec., N.P. secretariat, Feb., 1925; asst. sec., Nigerian secretariat, Aug., 1927; clk. to exec. and leg. couns., Apr.-Sept., 1928; attd., C.O., July, 1929; asst. sec., Nigerian secret., Sept., 1929; asst. dist. offr., N. Prov., Aug., 1930; dist. offr. Jan., 1931; sp. duty reorganization pagan admtr., 1933-35; ch. asst. col. sec., Sierra Leone, July, 1935.

MATHIESON, Hon. John Alexander, K.C.—B. 1865; ed. Harrington Gram. Schl., Prince of Wales’ Coll., Taught Schl., Desable Gram. Schl., P.E.I., read law with McLean and Macdonald; called to the P.E.I. bar, 1893; K.C., 1905; ed. legislature for King’s county, 1900; re-el., 1904, 1908 and 1912; leader of the opposition, 1903; premier and atty.-gen., 2nd Dec., 1911; ch. just., P.E.I., 13th June, 1917.
MATHISON, JOSEPH GEORGE, B.L (Glasgow) — B., 1907; asst. admstr.-gen., Zanzibar, 1930; ag. munio. and land offr., Apr., 1934; munio. and land offr., Sept., 1934; ag. admstr.-gen., pub. trustee, regis. docs. in addn., Apr., 1935.

MATTHEWS, ERNEST LEWIS, K.C., C.M.G. (1914).—Called to the bar, Inner Temple; law adviser to Transvaal govt., June, 1902; law adviser to govt. of Union of S. Africa, 31st May, 1910; puisne judge, Natal prov. divn., 1926.

MATTHEWS, LESLIE GARD.—Ed. Plymouth. Oxford Univ., O.T.C., 1915; O.A.S., France, 1916 and 1917, Lanc. Fusiliers; Mesopotamia, 1917-21, attd.; Indian Army and Iraq Levies; Arab rebellion, Iraq, 1920 (med. and clasp); asst. treas., Somaliland, June, 1921; dist. pol. offr., Somaliland, Feb., 1923; asst. commr., pol., Nigeria, 1926.

MAUDE, HENRY EVANS.—B., 1906; ed. Highgate Schl. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1929; M.A., 1933; cadet, Gilbert and Ellice Is., 1929; dep. commr., 1931; ag. native lands commr., 1931; admstr.-offr., 1932; ag. sec. to govt., Mar.-June, 1933; nat. lands commr., Gilbert Is., 1935.

MAULE, JOHN PATRICK.—B., 1906; ed. Berkhamsted schl. and Sidney Sussex coll., Cambridge; M.A., 1932; dipl., agr., 1929; A.I.C.T.A. (Trinidad), 1930; supt., agr., Nigeria, 1930; man., govt. stock farm, Cyprus, 1934.

MAVOR, WILLIAM DAVID.—B., 1881; ed. Heriot Watt Coll. (Edin.), foreman, photo-litho seen., F.M.S., Oct., 1910; mily. serv., Highland F. Amb., Sept., 1915; demob., Mar., 1919; asst. supt., photo-litho seen., Jan., 1921; ch. photo-litho, surv. dept., F.M.S., July, 1923.

MAVROGORDATO, COL. ARTHUR STEPHEN, O.B.E. (1928).—B., 1886; ed. at Oakham Schl., Rutland; clk., pol. headqrs., Cyprus, Nov., 1903; inspr., mil. pol., Cyprus, May, 1905; in ch., pol. detachment, Kyrena, 1907-1909; gov., prison and dep. coroner; in command of Papho dist. several occasions; detailed for sp. duty in Larnaca dist. in connection with Limassol riots, May-June, 1912; asst. commr., pol., Sierra Leone, June, 1913; J.P. and dep. coroner, 1913; ag. commr., pol., also sheriff, prison visiting just., and govt. nominee on city coun. of Freetown, and performing duties of marshal of the Adny. prize ct., on various occasions, 1915-18; ag. harbour and detaining offr., under mil. authorities, in 1916, 1917, 1918 and 1919; ag. dist. commr. in headqrs. dist., S. Leone, Feb.-Mar., 1919; dep. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Palestine, Dec., 1922; ag. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Apr., 1924; commdt., ditto, Apr., 1925; rep. Palestine govt. at internat. pol. confce., Antwerp, Sept., 1930; inspr.-gen., constab., Trinidad, July, 1931; mem., leg. coun.; awarded King’s Pol. med., 1934.

MAXWELL, COL. GROFFREY ARCHIBALD PRENTICE, C.M.G. (1934), D.S.O., M.V.O., M.C., Officer Ordre de Leopold, Officer Legion d’Honneur, Belgian Croix de Guerre, French Croix de Guerre, M.Inst.T.—B., 1885; R.M.A., Woolwich, 1902; R.E., 1904; Nigeria Barokanory, 1908-11; survey, E.A.P., 1912-14; European War, 1914-18 (ment. seven times in desps.); inter-allied commn. of control, rlys., occupied territory, 1919; communications sec., sup. economic coun., 1919-20; gen. man., rlys., Tanganyika territory, 1920.

MAXWELL, Sir WM. GEORGE, K.B.E. (1924), C.M.G. (1915); Royal Humane Society’s med. (1882).—B., 1871; ed. at Clifton Coll.; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp.; jun. offr., Perak, F.M.S., Mar., 1891 asst. mag., Kinta, Apr., 1892; regis. of cts., Kinta, Perak, Feb., 1899; dist. offr., Dindings, Aug., 1905; dep. pub. proc., Singapore, 1906; sol.-gen., S. Sttlmts., Aug., 1906; British adviser to govt. of Kedah, July, 1909; ag. col. sec., S. Sttlmts., 1914; ag. sec. to high commr., Malay States and Brunei, 1915; ag. British res., Perak, Dec., 1916 to May, 1917; ag. sec. to high commr., Malay States and Brunei, June, 1917; vice-chmn., food control comtees., S.S. and F.M.S.; vice-chmn., shipping control comtee., S.S.; pres., rubber comm., 1918; pres., Singapore housing comm.; pres., Singapore centenary comtee.; general adviser to govt., Johore, June, 1918; ag. col. sec., S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1918; Br. res., Perak, Dec., 1919; ch. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Sept., 1920; ret., 1926; publications, “Perak Land Laws (past and present),” “The Laws of Perak, 1877-1903,” “The Laws of the S. Sttlmts., 1827-1907,” “In Malay Forests.”

MAXWELL-ANDERSON, Sir MAXWELL HENDRY—Kt. Bach. (1934), C.B.E. (mil.) (1919); O.B.E. (1918); K.C., Aug., 1919; capt., R.N. (ret.).—Ent. Royal Navy, 1893; ret. at own request, 1912; recd. thanks of Admy. for series of magnetic observations carried out in the Pacific Ocean; inst., R.N. Coll., Portsmouth, 1908-10; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1909; younger brother of Trinity House, 1910; rejoined Navy on outbreak of war; promoted capt., Apl., 1919; govt. mem., central (unemployed) body for London, 1913 to 1919; atty.-gen., Gibraltar, May, 1919; ag. chief just., and col. sec. on several occasions; ch. just., Fiji and judl. commr., W. Pacific, 1929; ag. high commr., W. Pacific, June to Aug., 1930.

MAY, HENRY O’HARA, M.D., B.C.H., B.A.O. (Univ. Dubl.), D.P.H. (Irel.)—B., 1878; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Apr., 1907; med. offr., health, Nov., 1911; junr. sanry. offr., Aug., 1916; dep. dir., sanry. serv., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1922; dep. dir., health serv., Gold Coast, June, 1926.

MAY, THOMAS WILLIAM VIVIAN, A.R.I.B.A., M.I.Struct.E., chrted. archt.—B., 1889; asst. in prin. archt’s dept. of H.M.O.W., 1909-14; war serv., Aug., 1914-Aug., 1919; asst. archt., S’pore, Harbr. Bd., Nov. 1919; asst. archt., P.W.D., May, 1924; ag. govt. archt., S.S., Sept., 1925 and May, 1929; asst. archt., S’pore, July, 1933.

MAYBIN, JOHN ALEXANDER, C.M.G. (1935).—B., 1889; M.A. (Edin.); cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1914; attached to the Badulla kach., Jan., 1914; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., July, 1914, and Jan., 1915; addtl. dist. judge and pol. mag., Badulla in addn. June, 1915; pol. mag., Panadura, Mar., 1916; on mil. duty, 1917; ag. pol. mag., Kandy, July, 1919; 2nd finan. asst. to chmn. mun. coun., Colombo, Mar., 1920; finan. asst., Colombo Municipality, Nov., 1920; addnl. asst. col. sec., Jan., 1922; landing survr., Colombo cust., Mar., 1923; 3rd asst. col. sec., Feb., 1924; 2nd asst. col. sec. and clk., legn. coun., Mar., 1925; asst. registr., co-op. socs., Apr., 1928; dep. registr., co-op. socs., Sept., 1932; ch. sec., Nigeria, 1934; O.A.G., Dec., 1934 and June-Oct., 1935.

MAYHEW, ARTHUR INNES, C.I.E.—B., 1878; ed. at Winchester and New Coll., Oxford (schl.); B.A., 1901; Berlin and Jena Univs.; ent. Indian educn. serv., 1903; educn. advisor, Hyderabad State, 1910; dir. pub. instrn., Cent. Provs., 1913; ag. educn. commr. to govt. of India, 1921; mem., Eton Coll. staff, 1922-29; joint sec. to advisory comtee. on educn. in the C.O., 1929; author of “The Education of India,” “Christianity and the Government of India.”
MAYLE, NORMAN LESLIE.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1917; cler. offr., lat Jan., 1920; promoted to clk. of the 2nd div., Feb., 1920; on mil serv. from Sept., 1917 to Sept., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 7th July, 1923; asst. prin., 16th Nov., 1928; ag. pvt. sec. to parly. U.S. of S. for the Cols., 2nd Feb., 1932; pvt. sec., do., 18th Apr., 1932; ag. prin., 1st Jan., 1936.

MAYNARD, PERCY.—B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 15th Oct., 1920.

MEAD, JOHN PHILLIPS.—B. 1886; dip. forestry (Oxon); ed. Charterhouse Sch., Royal Indian Engrg. Coll. (Coopers Hill) and Exeter Coll., Oxford; asst. cons. forests and ag. dep. cons. forests, Aug., 1907-May, 1916; on mil serv. 1916-19; inspr., forests Kordofan prov., Soudan, Aug., 1918; conserv., forests, Sarawak, 1919; temp. forestry advr. to govt., Fiji, Nov., 1926; asst. cons., forests, F.M.S., Jan., 1928; dep. cons., forests, F.M.S., March, 1928; dr., forestry, F.M.S. and S.S., Jan., 1930.

MEADE, CHARLES RICHARD.—Copyist, treasy. and post office dept., Montserrat, Oct., 1907; 5th clk., Apr., 1912; 4th clk., Nov., 1912; govt. offr., Sandy Point, St. Kitts-Nevis, Nov., 1915; clk., treasy., Virgin Is., May, 1917; clk., exec. council; prin., Apr., 1927; ag. postmr., registr. and provost marshal, Virgin Is. circuit, Mar. to July, 1928; prin., treasy., Dominica, Dec., 1928; ag. treas., mem. exec. and leg. couns. and chmn., commr. of income tax in 1931 and 1932; asst. treas. and postmr., Montserrat, Dec., 1933.

MEADE, CAPT. JOSEPH MICHAEL, B.A. (T.C.D.), Barrister-at-Law (King's Inns, Dublin).—B. 1889; European mast., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1920; asst. mast., King Edward VII schl., Taiping, Feb., 1921; asst. inspr., schls., Perak, Jan., 1923, Sept., 1925 and Apr., 1929; inspr., schls., N. Sembilan, Jan., 1926; asst. inspr., schls., S'pore, Oct., 1930; ag. inspr., schls., Malacca, Jan., 1931; senr. educn. offr. (B), Nov., 1931; ag. supt., educn., Johore, Jan., 1934.

MEADEN, HENRY, M.B.E. (1931).—B. 1882; asst. warden, Tobago, 1919; asst. warden, St. Patrick, 1922; mag. warden, Tobago, 1st Apr., 1926.

MEARNS, JOHN WILLIAM, B.Sc. (Engnr.), Glasgow, A.M.I.Struct.E., A.M.I.C.E.—B.1894; asst. engnr., sea defences, Br. Guiana, 1920; do., pub. wks. dept., 1922; dist. engnr., 1925.

MEDWAY, F. W.—Imp. serv. (acctn.-gen.'s dept., G.P.O.), 1901-2; clk., G.P.O., Bloemfontein, Nov., 1902; clk., treasy., O.F.S., May, 1908; senr. clk., treasy., Union of S. Africa, Apr., 1912; senr. clk., inland rev. dept., Dec., 1916; prin.clk., Apr., 1917; ch.clk., April, 1928; recr., Pietermaritzburg, Apr., 1933.

MEHAN, JOHN FRANCIS.—G.W.R., 1903-14; ent. traffic dept., Gold Coast govt. rly., Mar., 1914; seconded Togoland mily. rly., traffic offr., 1918-19; ast. traffic supt., Tanganyika rlys., Aug., 1920; traffic supt., April, 1928.

MEEK, A. I., L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S., D.P.H. (Edin.), L.R.F.P. & S. (Glas.).—B. 1889; R.A.M.C., Aug., 1918 to May, 1920; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1922; senr. health offr., Apr., 1930.

MEGARRY, THOMAS, B.A.—B. 1898; ed. Royal Academical Inst., Belfast and Trinity Coll., Dublin; B.A. (1st cls. hons., classics and mental and moral philosophy); cadet, Hong Kong, Nov., 1922; passed cadet, Dec., 1924; ast. to sec., Chinese affrs., 1925; ast. head, sany. dept., Mar., 1928; 3rd ast. col. sec., June, 1928; sec., currency comttee, in addn., 1930; mag. and dist. offr., N. district, New Territories, Mar., 1931; head sany. dept. and pres., sany. bd., Jan., 1933; dist. offr., N. dist., New Territories, Jan., 1934.

MEGSON, JOHN.—B. 1895; apptd. after compet. exam. clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv.; temporarily assigned to Board of Agric., July, 1914; Home Office, Aug., 1914; on military service, Nov., 1915 to Mar., 1919; Home Office, Mar.-Apr., 1919; assigned to C.O., Apr., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 9th Jan., 1923; staff offr., 13th Oct., 1930.

MEIGHEN, Rt. Hon. ARTHUR, P.C., K.C.—B. 1874; ed. St. Mary's Coll. Inst. and Toronto Univ.; B.A., 1896; ist el. to H. of C., Canada, g.e., 1908; re-el., 1911, 1913 and 1917; defeated, 1921; el. by-el., 1922; re-el., 1925; solr.-gen., 1913; re-el. accl., 1913; p.c. (Can.), 1915; sec. of state and min. of mines (Can.), 1917; later, same year, min. of interior and supt.gen., Ind. affrs.; prime min. of Canada, 1920; p.c. (Eng.), 1920; prime min., Can., 1926; def., 1927; in m., senate, 1932; min. without portfolio in Bennett cabinet and govt. leader in senate, 1932; leader of oppsn., senate, 1936.

MELLISH, HON. HUMPHREY.—B. 1862; ed. Mount Mellish Schl., Prince of Wales Coll., Charlottetown, 1876-79 (holder of Govt. scholarship for County of Queen's P.E.I., 1876-78; medallist, classics and maths., 1879); Dalhousie Univ. (B.A., 1882, LL.B.); matriculant, Univ. of Lond., hon. div., 1883; called to N.S. bar, 1890; K.C., 1904; practised law, 1891-1918; pres., N.S. Barristers' Soc., 1912-13; agt., Canadian min. of just. in N.S., 1903-04; judge, sup. ct., N.S., 1918, also surrogate, and dep. local judge in adm'y., for N.S. dist., 1920; local judge in adm'y., 1921.

MELVILLE, EUGENE.—B. 1911; ed. Queen's Park Schl., Glasgow and United Coll., St. Andrews; Harkness res. schol., 1929-33; 1st cls. hons. classics, 1933; 1st cls. hons. econs. and moral philosophy, 1935; ast. inspr., taxes, 1935; apptd., after compet. exam., ast. prin., C.O., Jan., 1936.

MENZIES, HON. ROBERT GORDON, K.C., LL.M., M.P.-M.L.C., Victoria, 1928-32; min. without portfolio, 1928-29; M.L.A. for Nunawading, Victoria, 1932-34; atty.-gen., min. for rlys. and dep. premier; el. M.H.R. of C'wealth of Australia for Kooyong (Vic.), 1934; atty.-gen. and min. for industry, Lyons miny., 1934.

MERCIECA, Prof. Sir SIR ARTURO, Kt. Bach. (1926), M.A., LL.D.—B. 1878; matric., Malta Univ., 1894; M.A., 1897; LL.D., 1901; el. for coun. of govt., 1907-10; ast. crown advoc., 1915; prof. of law, 1915; crown advoc., 1919; judge, 1921; ch. just., 1924; ex. in law, 1921.

MEREWETHER, SIR EDWARD MARSH, K.C.M.G.(1916); K.C.V.O.(1907); C.V.O.(1903); C.M.G.(1902).—B.1858; ed. Harrow; cadet, S.S., Oct., 1880; confirmed, Jan., 1883; Malay interp. with H.M.S. "Pegasus" to Tenom in connection with the "Nisero" case, June, 1884; dist. offr., Dindings, 1886; 2nd ast. col. sec., June, 1890; supt. of census, 1891; ag. ast. col. sec., Aug., 1891; coll. of land rev., and in charge of treasy., Malacca, July, 1892; inspr. of prisons, S.S., 1893; ast. col. sec. and clk. of couns., May, 1897; Br. res., Selangor, Dec., 1901; lieut.-gov. and ch. sec. to govt., Malta, Aug., 1902; gov., Sierr Leone, 1911; gov., Leeward Islands, Jan., 1916; ret.

MERRICK, H. F. C.—B. 1889; ed. Battersea Gram. Schl. and London Univ.; ast. audr. S.
Nigeria, 1913; ditto, Sierra Leone, 1914; audr., Malta, 1920–22; clk., col. audit dept., 1922; audr., Gibraltar, May, 1927.

MERRICK, JOHN EDWARD SIGFRID, O.B.E. (1931).—B. 1888; ed. Winchester and Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. 1911; ast. dist. commnr., Uganda Prot., 1912; 3rd ast. sec., 1913; 2nd ast. sec., 1916; senr. ast. sec., E. Africa Prot., Nov., 1919; ast. col. sec. (2nd grade), Kenya, 1926; ag. ast. col. sec. (1st grade) in 1925 and 1926; prin. ast. col. sec., 1927; ag. col. sec. for various periods, 1928–32; dep. ch. sec., Uganda, 1932; ag. ch. sec. in 1933, 1944 and 1935; ch. sec., Dec., 1935.

MESSERVY, E., M.R.C.V.S., D.T.V.M.—ed. Victoria Coll., Jersey and R. Vety. Coll., Lond.; D.T.V.M. (Univ. Edin.), 1932; vety. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Jan. 1929.

MESSERVY, GEORGE FORSHAW.—B. 1889; ed. Minto House Schl., Queen’s Coll., Br. Guiana, and Victoria Coll., Jersey; ag. survr. ast., lands and mines, Br. Guiana, 1910; 5th cls. offr., do., 1911; 4th cls. offr., 1915; land offr. and dist. commissary, taxation, Demerara River, 1916; ag. ch. elk., lands and mines, 1926; supt., lands, 1930; ag. sec. and acctn., do., 1931, 1932, and 1933.

METCALFE, CHARLES CAMPBELL, M.B.E. (1931), M.C.—B. 1880; ed. Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey; elk., W.O., 1901; clk., treas., Nyassaland, 1911; K.A.R., 1914–22; ag. chief transport offr., Nyassaland, Apr., 1922 to Feb., 1923; ch. transport offr., Feb., 1923.

METIVIER, CAPT. HARRY VINCENT MERCER, O.B.E.—Govt. vet. surg. examr. of animals, Trinidad, Dec., 1920.

METZGEN, MONRAD SIGFRID, M.B.E. (1932).—B. 1893; temp. clk. to keeper of prisons, B. Hond., Mar., 1910; transf. to treas. dept., Aug., 1910; temp. ast. keeper of King’s warehouses, Sept., 1910; 3rd grade cust. and excise offr., Aug., 1911; 2nd grade ditto, Jan., 1918; 2nd lieut., B. Hond. Territorial Force, June, 1918; internal rev. offr., Mar., 1920; seconded to income tax dept., June, 1921; prin. offr., income tax, Aug., 1922; offr. of cust., Nov., 1922; sec. to select comte, to enquire into cost of living to civ. servants, Mar., 1923; ag. audr. in 1923 and 1924; ag. dist. commnr., Orange Walk, June-July, 1923; ch. income tax collr., Jan., 1924; dist. commnr., 1935; joint compiler, Br. Hond. Handbook.

MEYER, LEOPOLD DONNELLY.—B. 1889; survey cadet, Queenslands, 1909-11; survey br., state forests dept., May, 1911; lic. land survr., Victoria, Oct., 1913; survr., Kedah, Apr., 1914; mily. serv., 1917-19; demob., 1919; ast. supt., rev. surveys, N. Sembilan, Apr., 1923; do., Pahang, 1924; supt., surveys, Trengganu, Sept., 1927; ag. supt., surveys, Kelantan, May, 1930; senr. ast. supt., surveys, Kinta, contd. as ag. supt., rev. surveys, Aug., 1933; supt., surveys, Malaya, 1935.

MICHAUD, HON. JOSEPH E., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1888; ed. Quebec Seminary, Laval Univ. (B.A. 1910), St. Dunstan Univ., Charlottetown, P.E.I., Dalhousie Law Schl. (LL.B. 1913); major of Edmundson, N.B., 1919, 1932, 1934; el. to legis. of N.B., 1917, re-el. 1920, 1925, 1930; min. without portfolio in Foster govt., 1921; Veniot admin., 1923-25; el. to H. of C., 1933; re-el., 1935; min. of fisheries in govt. of Mackenzie King, 1935.

MIDDLEBROOK, STANLEY MUSGRAVE.—B. 1898; ed. Bradford Gram. Schl. and St. Catharine’s Coll., Camb. (open exhibnr., mod. history); war surv., 1917-19; cadet, S.S. Apr., 1921; offr., cls. V, Apr., 1924; ast. prot., Chinese, Nov., 1924; attd., govt. monops. dept., S’pore, Nov., 1927; offr., cls. IV, Apr., 1928; ast. prot., Chinese, Selangor and Pahang; do., Muar, Apr., 1931; ast. to sec. for Chinese affrs., F.M.S., July, 1932; sec., uniform licences and fees comte. (road and rail transport, Malaya), Aug., 1932; offr. cls. III, Apr., 1933, ast. prot., Chinese, S’pore; ast. dir., educn., Chinese schls., F.M.S. Aug., 1934.

MIDDLETON, I. C., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), D.T.M., D.T.H. (Liv.)—B. 1899; mily. serv., 1917-18; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1929.

MIDDLETON, SIR JOHN, K.C.M.G. (1931), K.B.E. (1924), C.M.G. (1916)—B. 1870; ed. Sedbergh and Univ. of Edin.; M.A.; ast. dist. commnr., S. Nigeria, 1901; ag. dist. commnr., Warril, 1901; ast. sec., 1902; sen. ast. sec., 1904; officiated as sec. to govt. and divisional commnr., 1904-5; dist. commnr., 2nd grade, 1906; ag. ch. ast. col. sec. and ast. prov. commnr., 1906-7; senr. ast. col. sec., 1907; ast. col. sec., Mauritius, 1908; ag. col. sec., 1908-9-10-11-12-13; col. sec., 1913; admstn. govt., 1914, 1916 and 1919; gov., Falkland Is., 1920; gov., Gambia, 1927; gov., Newfoundland, Sept., 1928; ret., 1932.

MIDDLETON, HON. WM. EDWARD.—B. 1860; ed. Toronto Coll. Inst. and Toronto Univ.; admitted solr., 1884; called to the bar, 1815; K.C., 1908; judge of high ct., Ontario, 1910.

MIPSUD, EDWARD R., C.M.G. (1932), O.B.E. (1927), M.B.E. (1925).—B. 1875; clk., Malta civ. serv. after compet. exam., 1892; clk., audit office, 1892; secretariat, 1901; ch. clk., lieut. gov.’s office, 1913; dep. ast. sec. to govt. and clk. of coun., 1920; clk. of exec., nominated, and privy couns. and private sec. to gov., Oct., 1921; sec., Maltese Imp. Govt., June, 1927; sec. to gov., 1932.

MIPSUD, HON. SIR UGO P., KT. BACH. (1927), LL.D. (1910), B. Litt. (1906), M.L.A.—B. 1889; matric., Malta Univ., 1903; called to bar, 1910; el. to rep. first dist. in Maltese parlmt., Oct., 1921, in June, 1924 and Aug., 1927; min. of industry and commerce, 28th Oct., 1921; prime min., Aug., 1924; leader of House, 1921-23 and from 1924-27; leader of opposition and head of national party, Aug., 1927 and June 1932; prime min., 1932-1933.

MILES, ARCHIBALD CLARENCE.—B. 1887; ent. Gold Coast serv., Feb., 1909; left, May, 1919; visited W. Indies to study cocoa cultivation, 1914; rejoined Gold Coast serv., as prov. supt. of agr., July, 1921; del., Imp. agrl. confce., Oct., 1927; dep. dir., agr., Nov., 1933.

MILLAR, WILLIAM, B.E. (Irel.), A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; mily. serv., 1916-19 (ment. in desps.), Gold Coast, 1920; irrign. engr., Iraq, 1922; anti-malarial engr., Tanganyika Territory, 1932.

MILLARD, ALFRED SUTTON, B.Sc., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.); D.P.H.—Med. offr., S. Sttlmts., May, 1907; ag. sen. med. offr., Singapore, 23rd Jan. to 17th June, 1909; med. offr., grade II., F.M.S., 6th July, 1909; health offr., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1912; temp. med. offr., Quilting, Basutoland, Sept., 1916; med. offr. of health, Cyprus, Mar., 1921; ag. dist. med. offr., June to Oct., 1921; ag. ch. med. offr., May to Sept., 1927; title altered to ast. dir. of health, May, 1928; ag. dir. health, June to Sept. and in Oct., 1929.

MILLER, ALBERT EDWARD, M.C.—B.1892; H.M. Forces, Aug., 1914; serv. in Malta, Sept., 1914 to Jan., 1915 and France, 1915-19; 2nd lieut., 1917; wounded, Feb., 1918; inspr., live-stock, Gold Coast, May, 1921.
MILLER, GEORGE LAWN.—B. 1889; asst. acctnt., F.M.S. Ryks., Dec., 1919; asst. sec., finance, bd. and estabmt., various periods, 1920, 1921, 1924 1927 and 1929; sec. to P. Sham. advay. bd., Jan., 1929; ag. sec. to gen. man., Dec., 1930; sec. to gen. man., Jan., 1932.

MILLER, JAMES INNES, M.A. (Edin.), F.R.S.S.—B. 1892; ed. Fettes Coll. (schol.) and Edin. Univ.(exhbr.); James Welsh Bursar, 1911; 1st cls. hons., class., 1914; 1st cls. hons. hist., 1915; 2nd lieut., R.F.A., June, 1915; on serv. Suvla Bay and Mesopotamia, 1915-18; cadet, Malayan civ. serv. (S.S.), Oct., 1919; dep. coll. and regiar. of deeds, Penang, Dec., 1919; mag., May, 1920; agt., food contr., Penang, Oct., 1920; secy. to food contr., Singapore, Feb., 1921; attd. col. secy.'s office in addn., June, 1921; passed cadet, May, 1922; mag. and 2nd asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, 1923; els. IV, May, 1924; dist. offr., Bukit Merlajam, Sept., 1924; sec., rubber restrn., Johore, 1924; recr., Alsagoff concession in addn., Dec., 1924; mag. and asst. regiar., Johore in addn., 1924; inspr., prisons, Johore, in addn., 1926; 3rd mag., S'pore, Apr., 1929; cls. III, May, 1929; 2nd mag., S'pore, May, 1929; ag. regiar.-gen., statists S.S. and F.M.S., July, 1929; on sp. duty, N.E.I., Oct.-Nov., 1931; mem. and sec., S.S. trade comm., 1933-34; supt., rubber control, S'pore and Penang and regiar., textile quotas S.S. and F.M.S. in addn.; offr. cls. II, May, 1934.

MILLER, JOHN EATON.—B. 1896; ed. Berkhamsted Schol. and Sheffield Univ.; asst. dist. commr., Gold Coast, Jan., 1922; dist. commr., 1925.

MILLER, RALPH W. R., B.A.(Camb.), A.I.C., Dip. Agrie. Camb.—B. 1892; ed. Darlington and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; 2nd lieut., S. Lancashire Regt., 1915; sp brig., R.E., 1917-18; asst. analyst, Kenya, 1919; chem. offr., Kenya, 1923; senr. agrl. offr., Tanganyika, 1920; dir., agr., Barbados, 1929.

MILLINGTON, EDWARD TURNER.—B. 1881; ed. Victoria Univ., Manchester (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1904; extra offr., asst. to govt. agt., N. Prov. and asst. collr. of cust., Jaffna, Jan., 1906; pol. mag., Avissawella, Apr., 1906; off. asst. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Nov., 1906; Cent. Prov., Aug., 1908; ag. dist. judge, etc., Nuwara Eliya-Hatton, Jan., 1910; asst. govt. agt., Hambantota, Feb., 1913; ditto, Matale, Dec., 1917; ag. dist. judge, Kurunegala, Apr., 1921; asst. govt. agt., Kalutara, Aug., 1922; ag. regiar.-gen., July, 1923; addnl. asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Nov., 1924; ag. govt. agt., S. Prov., Dec., 1924; ag. govt. agt., Uva, Feb., 1926; dist. judge, Jaffna, Nov., 1923; govt. agt., Sabaragamuwa, Mar., 1926; addnl. govt. agt., W. Prov., Nov., 1928; ag. govt. agt., Jan., 1929; govt. agt. Prov. of Uva, June, 1929.

MILLS, ERIC, C.B.E. (1934), O.B.E. (Mily.) 1919, B.A. (Cantab.), F.S.S.—B. 1892; schol. of Corpus Christi Coll., Cambridge, 1910; Cowell schol., 1913-14; 1st cls. maths, tripes, pt. I., 1912; 2nd cls. maths, tripes, pt. II., 1913; 2nd lieut., Bedford Regt., 1914; gas poisoned, 1915; transferred to Egypt, 1916; staff capt., gen. list, 1918; served in occupied enemy territory admstn.; ment. in desps., 1918; major, mily. gov., Gaza, 1919; asst. gov., Samaria dist., Palestine civil admstn., July, 1920; lent to C.O. by Palestine govt., and ag. prn., Nov., 1921; 1st asst. sec. to Palestine govt., Oct., 1925; asst. ch. sec., Nov., 1926 and Jan., 1933; seconded as supt. census, May, 1931 to Dec., 1932; ag. ch. sec. on many occasions; comsnr., migrn. and stats., 1934.

MILLS, FREDERICK LEIGHTON VICTOR, A.M.I.C.E., M.C.—B. 1893; asst. engnr., P.W.D., Nigeria, 1922; ag. senr. exec. engnr., 1929-34; ag. asst. dir., 1934 and 1935; senr. exec. engnr., 1934.

MILLS, HENRY ARTHUR.—B. 1888; ed. East London Coll.; 4th cls. clk., C.A.'s office, 1907; on mily. serv., 1914-19; 3rd cls. clk., 1918; exec. offr., 1920; seconded for duty in Hong Kong, Aug., 1924; acct., post office, Hong Kong, Oct., 1926; senr. clerical and acctg. staff, 1927; attd., sup. ct. for sp. duty, 1927; acct., treasy., 1930; ch. acct., post office, 1933.

MILLS, JOHN VIVIAN GOTTLIER, B.A. Oxon., (Merton Coll.), Mods. and Lit. Hum., Barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1919.—B.1887; cadet, F.M.S., Oct., 1911; sec. to Chinese Riots Comsnr., 1912; passed cadet, May, 1914; on sp. duty at Chinese emigr. camp, Port Swettenham, Aug. to Sept., 1914; offr., cl. V., Nov., 1914; asst. prot., Chinese, Selangor and N. Sembilan, Feb., 1915; tempy. attd. office, commr., trade and cust., Aug., 1918; offr., cl. IV., Jan., 1919; agt. to food contrlr., F.M.S., in addn., Jan., 1919; offtg. dist. offr., K. Solangor, Nov., 1919; offr., cls. III., Oct., 1923; regiar., sup. ct., Penang, Dec., 1924; asst. offr., assignee, Penang, in addn., Apr. to July and Oct. to Nov., 1925; cls. I.B., Apr., 1928; solr.-genl., S.S., Apr., 1928; temp. puisane judge, Sept. to Nov., 1930 and Jan to Feb., 1931; ag. atty.-gen., Apr., 1932; puisane judge, S.S., Jan., 1933; judge, Johore, Oct., 1934.

MILNE, GEOFFREY, M.Sc. (Leeds), F.I.C.—B. 1898; ed. Hymers Coll., Hull and Leeds Univ.; mily. serv., 1917-19; asst., later lecturer, Leeds Univ., Sept., 1923; soil chemist, E. African agrl. research stn., Amani, Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1928.

MILNE, T. M.—B. 1890; dep. regiar. gen. and dep. regiar. and dep. marshal, sup. ct. and regiar., friendly societies, Trinidad, Sept., 1931; asst. crown solic., 1932.

MILSTEAD, HERBERT ERNEST GEORGE.—B. 1886; temp. asst. acctt., P.W.D., Uganda, May-July, 1921; asst. treas., Kenya, July, 1921; visiting just., Nairobi prison, 1922; sec., cent. tender bd., 1923 and 1927; ag. senr. asst. treas., in 1924 and 1927; seconded to secretariat as estab. offr., June, 1927 to Apr., 1926; ag. acctt., treasy., May to July, 1927; asst. currency offr., July, 1927; ch. storekeeper, P.W.D., Nov., 1929.

MILSUM, JOHN NOEL, F.L.S.—B. 1890; asst. supt., govt. plantn., F.M.S., Oct., 1913; asst. agrl., Aug., 1920; on sp. duty in Sumatra, May, 1921; ag. agrl., various occasions, 1924-33; deleg. to 4th Pac. Sc. Cong., Java, May, 1929; on sp. duty in Java & Sumatra, Apr.-May, 1934.

MILTON, SIR W. H., K.C.M.G. (1903), K.C.V.O. (1910), C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1854; clk., col. sec.'s office, Cape, Apr., 1878; 3rd class clk., 1st Jan., 1879; 2nd class clk., Jan., 1881; 1st class clk., Apr., 1883; sec. to the tender bd., 1881; clk. to exec. coun., 1886; ch. clk. and acctnt., col. sec.'s office, 1891; sec. to prime min., Mar., 1894; detached for serv. in Rhodesia as ch. sec. and sec. serv., Oct., 1897; ag. admr. Rhod., July, 1897, to Nov., 1898; apptd. admnstr. Mashonaland and senr. admnstr. S. Rhodesia, Dec., 1898; admnstr. S. Rhodesia, 20th Dec., 1902; resig., 1914.

MINTER, K. S.—B. 1894; apptd. after compet. exam. asst. clk., and assigned to G.P.O., Sept., 1912; apptd. after compet. exam. clk. of
the 2nd div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to H.M. stationery office, Aug., 1914; to C.O., Oct., 1914; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st Apr., 1922.

MITCHELL, CHARLES EDWARD SAWERS, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.)—B. 1876; med. ser., B. Guiana, 1903; G.M.O., pub. hosp., ag. res. surg., pub. hosp., Berbice, 1910; ag. med. supt., lun. asylum, 1912; J.P., 1919; ag. asst. res. surg., pub. hosp., Georgetown, 1920; med. supt., lun. asylum, 1921; ag. res. surg., pub. hosp., Georgetown, April-Nov., 1924.

MITCHELL, EDWARD THOMAS.—B. 1900; on mily. ser., May, 1918 to Jan., 1919; temp. elk., W.O., Feb., 1919 to Aug., 1926; apptd. to C.O. as cler. offr. after compet. exam. (Southborough), Aug., 1926.

MITCHELL, HUBERT MANIFOLD.—B. 1895; joined army, 1914; served in France, Belgium, Egypt, Palestine, 1915-20; wounded; ment. in desps., M.C.; demob., 1920; apptd. min. of lab. (Irish branch), 1920; asst. commr., pol., Gold Coast, Sept., 1921; ag. staff offr., Apr. to Oct., 1924; commr., pol., Sept., 1927.

MITCHELL, HON. SIR JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1921), C.M.G. (1917); M.L.A., W. Australia.—B. 1866; entd. ser. of W. Aust. Bank; 16 years man. of Northam branch; entd. parlmt., 1905; hon. min. and mem. of exec. coun., 1906; min. of agric., 1907; min. for lands in addition to agric., 1909, and again in 1916; premier, 1919-24 and since Apr., 1930.

MITCHELL, PHILIP EURN, C.M.G. (1933), M.C.—Ed. St. Paul's Schl. and Trinity Coll., Oxford; asst. res., Nyassaland, 1912; lieut., K.A.R., 1915; capt., 1917; adjt., 1917-18; men., in desps., A.D.C. and pte. sec. to ag. gov't., Nyassaland, 1918-19; asst. polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1919; asst. sec., native affrs., 1926; prov. commnr., 1928; sec. for native affrs., 1928; ch. secy., 1934; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Uganda, 1935.

MOFFAT, JAMES.—B. 1876; exam. offr., Bloemfontein, 1903; inspr., cust., Pretoria, 1912; ch. inspr., Johannesburg, 1917; cust. investigating offr., N. York, 1923; do., London, 1926; collr., cust., Johannesburg, 1933; do., Cape Town, 1934.

MOIR, WILLIAM JOHN, M.B., Ch.B. (Aberdeen), D.P.H. (Lond.), D.T.M. and H. (Eng.)—B. 1893; health offr., F.M.S., Nov., 1920; ditto, Kinta, Nov., 1925; ag. sr. health offr., N. Sembilan, Mar., 1928; sr. health offr., Johore, June, 1929; ag. state med. and health offr., N. Sembilan, July, 1934.

MOLLOY, PAUL AUGUSTUS, A.M.I.C.E., chtd. civ. engrn.—B. 1887; ed. MOLTENO, HON. SIR JAMES TENNANT, KT. BACH. (1911), B.A., LL.B., M.L.A.—B. 1865; ed. at Diocesan Coll., Rondebosch, and Trin. for native aff., Aug., 1896; transf. to Rhod. MONSON, WILLIAM BONNAR LESLIE, B.A.—B. 1912; ed. Edinburgh Acad. and Hertford Coll., Oxford (hist. schol.), 1930-34); 2nd cls. class. mods., 1932; 1st cls. hist. schls., 1934; B.A., 1934; apptd., after compet. exam., asst. prin., D.O., Oct., 1935.

MONTAGNAC, LOUIS IVAN DE.—B. 1880; called to bar, Middle Temple, Jan., 1911; clk. of cts., parish of St. Andrew, Jamaica, May, 1921; ag. res. mag., St. Thomas, 1st Aug., 1922; ag. regisr., sup. ct., Oct., 1924; regisr., sup. ct., July, 1926.

MONTAGU, JAMES DROGO.—B. 1878; served, Cape Mounted Pol., 1903; Johannesburg Mounted Pol., 1903-8; B.S.A. pol., 1908-9; S. Br. del. of Evcaf, July-Sept., 1930; comnr., 1934.

MONTAGUE, CYRIL JOHN.—B. 1893; asst. audr., Nigeria, July, 1919; senr. asst. audr., Nov., 1932.

MONTGOMERY, H. R., C.M.G. (1936).—Asst. dist. comnr., E.A.P., May, 1908; dist. comnr., Apr. 1914; ag. senr. comnr., Kenya, 1926; senr. comnr., 2nd grade, 1929; 1st prov. comnr., 1932.

MOOD, H. L.—Asst. dist. comnr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; res. 2nd grade, Nyassaland, Nov., 1925; res. 1st grade, Mar., 1926; dist. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1928.

MOODY, SYDNEY, O.B.E. (1932).—B. 1889; ed. King's Schl., Pontefract, Leeds Univ. and Lincoln Coll., Oxford (Hist. Schol.), 2nd cls. hist. finals, 1914; pte., Pub. Schls. Batt., R. Fusiliers, 1914; 2nd lieut., E. York Regt., France, 1915; lieut., King's Liverpool Regt., Egypt, 1916; lieut., Herefordshire Regt., Palestine, 1917-1918; held various appts. in O.E.T.A. (S.) MOONESINGHE, NALIN, B.A. (Oxon.)—Cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1924; attd., Anuradhapura kach., June, 1924; do., Batticaloa kach., Jan., 1925; do., Badulla kach., June, 1925; pol. mag., Pt. Pedro, Nov., 1926; ditto, Puttalam, May, 1927; ditto, Jaffna, Aug., 1929; office asst., Galle kach., Nov., 1930; pol. mag., Pt. Pedro, Nov., 1931; pol. mag., Jaffna, July, 1933.

MOOR, HERBERT WILLIAM.—B. 1891; obtained higher standard certif. in Forestry at Imperial Research Inst. and Coll., Dehra-Dun, India, 1914, with medals for forest engineering and sylviculture; probationer, Indian provincial forest service, 1914; passed exams. in Indian land revenue systems, forest law and accounts, and Hindustani by the higher standard, 1915; permanent extra asst. conserv., forests, Jan., 1918; asst. conserv., forests, Gold Coast, Jan., 1923; prin. forest offr., Apr., 1926.

MOOR, RICHARD, M.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1898; ed. Ermysted's Schl., Skipton and Hertford Col., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple; cadet, S.S., July, 1921; asst. supt., govt. monops., Spore, Mar., 1924; offr., cls. V, July, 1924; offr., cls. III, July, 1933.

MOORE, ERNEST STANLEY.—B. 1890; Imp. post office, 1909; war surv., Aug., 1914 to Mar., 1919; asst. surv., posts and tels., Nigeria, Sept., 1919; surv., do., 1926; divnl. surv., do., 1933.

MOORE, SIR HENRY MONCK-MASON, K.C.M.G. (1935), C.M.G. MOORE, HON. SIR NEWTON JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1910), C.M.G. (1908).—B. 1870; mayor of Bunbury, W. Aust., for some years, M.L.A. for Bunbury, 1904; min. of lands and agric., W. MOORE, WILFRED HENRY, B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1902; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1925; attd., Kalutara kach., Jan., 1926; ditto, Kandy kach., July, 1926; office asst., N'Eliyi kach. MOORE, WM. BROWNLOW ASH, O.B.E. (1936), L.R.C.P.I., L.R.C.S.I., L.M. (Rotunda), 1912, D.T.M. & H. (Eng.), 1927.—House surg. to Meath hosp. and co., Dublin infirmary, Dublin, 1903; asst. MOORES-WEDON, W. C.—B. 1880; ed. Dulwich and Trin. Coll., Dublin; cadet, B.N. Borneo, 1905; asst. dist. offr., 1906; offr. in-charge Tenom-Tawau expedn., 1906; dist. offr., 1908; ag. P.M.G. and supt. of telegraphs, 1917; ag. offr.-in-charge, West Coast residency, 1917; examr. in Malay, 1917; on special service in Ceylon and F.M.S., 1918; postmnr.-gen. and supt. of telegraphs, B.N. Borneo, 1918; ag. res., interior, B.N. Borneo, 1920; ag. food contr., 1920; res., Kudat, 1921; sessions, 1922; ag. res., Sandakan and mem., leg. coun., 1922; res., East Coast, 1923.

MOORMAN, ALEXANDER WILLIAM GEORGE.—B. 1887; nine yrs. MOREAU, REGINALD ERNEST, C.M.Z.S., M.B.O.U.—B. 1897; 2nd. div. o.l., W.O., 1914; exec. offr. gr. II, army audit office, H.Q., B.T.E., Cairo, 1920; sec. & librarian, E. African agrl. research station, Amani, Tanganyika Territory, 1928 also in ch. ornithological research.

MORETON, JAMES REGINALD.—B. 1905; ed. Northwich Grammar Schl. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; cadet, Hong Kong, Feb., 1928.

Wales circuit, 1924-26; lieut., the Welch Regt., Regular Army R. of O.; war serv. with Machine Gun Corps, India; crown coun., Gold Coast, Oct., 1926; asst. atty.-gen., Nyassaland Prot., Mar., 1932; ag. atty.-gen. in 1932, 1933 and 1934; ag. judge, Oct.-Nov., 1933.

MORGAN, LEONARD GROFFET, B.Sc. (Lond.), M.A. (Lond.), Dip. Ed.—B. 1908; asst. mast., educn. dept., Hong Kong, Sept., 1926.

MORLEY, ARTHUR HABOLD, M.B., Ch.B. (Leeds), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (London), D.T.M., D.T.H. (Liverpool), D.P.H.—B. 1900; ed. Leeds Gen. Infirmary; house surg., Leeds Gen. Infirmary, 1926; ditto, Northampton Gen. Infirmary, 1927; med. offr., Somaliland, 1928.

MORRIS, JAMES PATRICK ANDREW, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1892; ed. St. Ignatius Coll., Galway, Blackrock Coll. and Royal Vet. Coll., Dublin; capt., R.A.V.C.; vety. offr., N. Rhodesia, Dec., 1920; dep. dir., animal health, Jan., 1930; ag. dir., do., Dec., 1932; dir., do., 1933.

MORT, ERIC LAIDLFT, O.B.E. (1935), B.A.—Ed. Tonbridge Schl. and University Coll., Oxford; jur. supt., educn. dept., N. Nigeria, Aug., 1914; attched. Nigeria Regt., 1916, and 1917-18; supt., educn., Nigeria, Jan., 1920; ag. ch. inspr., N. Provs., 1935.

MOSELEY, FRANCIS ARNOLD.—B. 1883; ed. Perth, W. Australia and Brasenose Coll., Oxon.; B.A. 1904; called to bar, Middle Temp., May, 1905; judge's associate and clk. of arraigns, W. MOSELEY, HENRY DOYLE.—B. 1884; junior clk., sup. ct., W. Aust., Oct., 1900; judges' assoc. and clk. of arraigns, Aug., 1903.

MOTTISTONE, 1st Baron (cir. 1933), MAJOR-GEN. RT. HON. JOHN EDWARD BERNARD SEELY, P.C. (1909), C.B. (1916), C.M.G. (1918), D.S.O. MOUBRAY, GEORGE ALEXANDER DE CHAZAL DE.—B. 1888; ed. Loretto Schl., Manchester Univ. (civ. engnr.), Zurich Polytechnikun and Univ. (pure science); cadet, F.M.S., 1912; offr. cls. Guiana, 1906; 3rd cls. offr. and survr., B. Guiana, 1908; warden, mining dist. and J.P., 1910; 1st cls. clk., dept. of lands and mines, 1911; ag. chief clk., 1911-12, 1913-14; 1st lieut., B. Guiana local forces, 1915; capt., 1918; seconded to govt. secretariat as conf. clk., 1916; chmn., canals polder, 1917-25; ch. clk., lands and mines dept., 1918; ch. clk. and ag. ast. D.P.W., 1919-20; ast. commr., lands and mines, 1922; mem. and sec., bd. of colonisation and development, 1926; ag. commr., lands and mines, chmn., local govt. bd. and mem., town council on various occasions; commr., land and mines, 1927; mem., exec. and leg. couns., 1929.

MULOCK, Rt. Hon. Sir WILLIAM, P.C. (1925) K.C.M.G. (1902), K.C., LL.D., M.A.—B. 1843 graduated at Toronto Univ., 1863; gold medal in modern languages; called to the Ontario bar, 1868; vice-chanc. of Toronto Univ. in 1881; sat in parlmt. 1882 to 1905, representing N. York; postmr.-gen. in Sir W. Laurier's govt., June, 1896; ch. just., exchequer div., high ct. of just., Ontario, 1905; ch. just., Ontario, 1923.

MUNRO, THOMAS AMBROSE VESPER.—B. 1883; harbour, Bahamas, 1st Sept., 1913; ag. marshal, admry. side, sup. ct., 1919.

MURDOCH, JAMES WILSON, M.B., Ch.B. (Aberdeen).—B. 1900; 2nd ast. med. asst., ment. hosp., T. Rambutan, F.M.S., Jan., 1928; med. supt., do., July, 1931.

MURISON, Sir JAMES WILLIAM, KT. BACH. (1919), B.A., LL.B., K.C.—B. 1872; ed. privately and at Trin. Hall, Camb.; senr. class. scholar, 1891; 1st div., 2nd cls. class. tripes, 1894; 3rd cls. law tripes, Part II., 1895; Latham English prize, 1895; B.A., LL.B., 1895; called to Bar, Middle Temple, Apr., 1896; devilled and practised at the Chancery Bar, 1896-1902; registr., E.A.P., Oct., 1902; town mag., Mombasa, Jan., 1904; 2nd ast. judge, H.B.M. ct. for Zanzibar, Apr., 1904; sen. ast. judge, Mar., 1905; ch. judge, Zanzibar, 20th Sept., 1914; mem., of ct. of appl. for Eastern Africa, 1905-1910, and from 1914 upon transfer of Zanzibar to C.O.; judge, sup. ct. of H.H. Sultan of Zanzibar from 1908; arbitrator in dispute between Zanzibar and E.A.P. govts. as to H.H. mainland properties, 1911; recd. thanks of S. of S. for conversion of applied Indian Acts into Zanzibar Decrees, 1917; judge prize ot. Zanzibar from 1914; passed govt. exam. in Hindustani, 1903, and in Swahili, 1904; exam. in Swahili to the Zanzibar Govt.; joint ed., Zanzibar Law Repts., 1868-1918; atty.-gen., S. Sttlmts., 1919; ag. col. sec., June, 1920 to May, 1921; ch. just., S. Sttlmts., July, 1925; ret., 1933; commr. to Palestine to inquire into Jewish-Arab riots, 1934; edited the Revised Laws of the S. Sttlmts., 1926; author of "Swahili Translations," 1911.

MURPHY, Hon. DENIS, B.A.—B. 1870; ed. Ottawa Univ.; B.A. 1892; called to the bar, 1896; elec. to provincial legis. British Columbia, 1900; judge of sup. ct., B. Columbia, 1909.

MURPHY, JOHN HOWARD BLACKWOOD.—B. 1895; Schl. of Physic, Trinity Coll., Dublin, 1913; R.A.M.C., Jan., 1915; India Office, Apr., 1919; A.D.C., Jubaland, Dec., 1919; dist. commr., Gosha, 1920; ditto, Choreh, 1922; ditto, Kitul, Ukambani, 1923; resigned, private affairs, 1926; re-apptd., commr., Somaliland, 1927; admin. offr., Kenya, 1930.

MURPHY, JOSEPH.—B. 1892; ed. Stokane Schl., Sligo; R.L.C., 1913-22; Jamaica constab., Apr., 1922; sub-inspr., Apr., 1926; 3rd cls. inspr., Apr., 1931; King's pol. med., 1926.

MURPHY, PHILIP PAIN, B.A., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O. (Dublin)—B. 1910; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; Royal City of Dublin Hosp.; med. offr., Somaliland, Jan., 1935.

MURPHY, Hon. THOMAS GEROW, P.C. (Can.).—B. 1883; ed. at pub. and high schls. of Ont.; grad. of Man. Coll. Pharmacy; 1st cl. to H. of C., Canada, g. e., Oct., 1925; re-elec., g. e., 1930; min. of interior in Bennett admnstr., Aug. 1st, 1930; re-elec. by accl. after assuming office Aug., 1930.

MURPHY, TIMOTHY.—B. 1882; joined Hong Kong pol., Dec., 1903; passed final exam. in
Cantonese, 1912; inspr., Aug., 1922; King's pol. med., 1924 C.D.I., Nov., 1926; asst. supt., pol., July, 1931.

MURPHY, WILLIAM LINDSAY.—B.A., Trin. Coll., Dublin; B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1910; addl., Kandy kach., Dec., 1910; addtl. pol. mag., Colombo, Aug., 1911; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Jan., 1912; office asst. to govt., Prov. of Uva, May, 1913; asst. land settlmt. offr., July, 1913; ag. asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Feb., 1915; addtl. pol. mag. and addtl. mun. mag., Colombo, Apr., 1915; ag. asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Oct., 1915; ditto, Hambantota, Nov., 1917; ditto, Matare, Oct., 1920; addnl. dist. judge, Galle, Jan., 1921; ag. asst. govt. agt., Kegalla, May, 1921; asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Sept., 1922; asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, Apr., 1923; temp. employed, C.O., 1926; addnl. asst. col. sec., Jan., 1927; 2nd asst. col. sec. and clk., leg. coun., Feb., 1927; prin. asst. col. sec. and clk., exec. coun., May, 1928; comptlr., lab., Sept., 1931; chmn., munic. coun. and mayor, Colombo, Mar., 1932.

MURRAY, ARTHUR EVELYN FRANCIS, B.A. (Oxon.), Barrister.—B. 1888; ed. Marlborough and Exeter Coll., Oxford; asst. dis. comsrs., S. Nigeria, 1912; cls. I, grade I, admstv. serv., 1928; sec. to comsn. of inquiry into disturbances in S.E. Provs., 1930; ag. sec. for native affrs., 1930.

MURRAY, HON. SIR GEORGE JOHN ROBERT, K.C.M.G. (1917), B.A., LL.M.—B. 1863; judge of sup. ct., S. Australia, 1912; chief just., Jan., 1916 and lieut.-gov., Apr., 1916.

MURRAY, SIR J. H. P., K.C.M.G. (1925), C.M.G. (1914).—M.A., Oxon.; ed. at Sydney gram. schl. and won Knox prize, Fairfax prize, senr. univ. prize, and John West medal; went to Brighton Coll., Germany, and Univ. Coll., London; entd. Oxford Univ. and gained foundation scholarship to Magdalen Coll., 1880; 1st cls. class. mods., 1882; 1st cls. Lit., Hum., 1884; M.A., 1885; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1886; practised as a barrister in Australia until apptd. crown prosecutor, N.S. Wales; acted as dist. ct. judge on several occasions; commanded N.S.W. Irish Rifles, 1898; served in S. African war, 1900-1901; recd. comsn. of major in Impl. army in recognition of his services, 1902; chief judicial offr. and mem. of exec. and legis. couns., Papua, Sept., 1904; ag. administr., 8th Apr., 1907; and lieut.-gov., in addition to duties of judge, 1908.

MURRAY, MENZIES.—B. 1890; ed. Stellenbosch and Trinity Coll., Dublin; B.A. (hons. Stellenbosch), 1920; B.A., LL.B. (T.C.D.), 1914; LL.B. (S.A.), 1920; war serv., 1914-19; capt., R.W. Fus., M.C.; advoc., 1921; ch. clk., patent office, Univ. of S. Africa, Jan., 1930; regsr., patents and regsr., companies, June 1932.

MURRAY, ROBERT EVERITT KING.—B. 1902; clk., grade II, Basutoland, 1924; sub.-inspr., Basutoland mounted pol., 1930.

MURRAY-JARDINE, ROBERT WILLIAM GORDON.—Ed. Marlborough Coll. and Clare Coll., Camb.; asst. dist. comsrs., Uganda, 1912; sec. commdr., 4th Batt. K.A.R., 1917-18; called to the bar (Inner Temple), 1919; dist. mag., Tanganyika Territory, 1919; ret. without taking up appt., 1920; dist. mag., Entebbe, Uganda, 1921; senr. mag., 1930.

MURTLAND, CHARLES CAMPBELL.—B. 1884; ed. Harrogate, York and Dublin; sub.-inspr. of police, B. Guiana, 1908; dist.-inspr., 1912; ag. county inspr., 1910-1911, 1914-1916; capt., B. Guiana militia, 1915; county inspr., 1920; detective inspr., 1927; ag. dep. inspr.-gen., pol., Sept., 1928 to May, 1929 and Apr.-Nov., 1930.

MYCOCK, CHARLES.—B. 1890; asst. mast., educn. dept., Hong Kong, Jan., 1915; asst. cable censor, 1914-16; on mily. serv., 1917-19; headmr. Ellis Kadoorie schl., 1919; do., Yaumati schl., 1928-30 and 1932-34; 2nd mastr., Queen's Coll., 1930.

MYERS, Rt. Hon. Sir MICHAEL, P.C (1931), K.C.M.G. (1930), K.C. (1922), LL.B. (1897).—B. 1873; ed. Thornton schl., Wellington Coll. and Canterbury Univ. Coll. (N.Z.); in legal practice many years; ch. just., N.Z., 1929.

NAIRAC, GEORGE EDOUARD, K.C.—B. 1876; ed. R. Coll., Mauritius; called to bar, 1898; ag. addnl. subst. procureur and advoc.-gen., 1903-06; mem. for Port Louis in coun. of govt., 1911-25; nominated mem., 1926; K.C., 1926; procureur and advoc.-gen., July, 1927; mem., exec. coun. and coun. of govt.; ag. col. sec., July, 1928 to Mar., 1929; ag. ch. just., Oct., 1929 to Oct., 1930; ch. judge, 1930; edr., Mauritius Law Repts. since 1906 and of the Law Repts. Digest, 1902-26.

NAISH, RICHARD BRYANT.—B. 1891; B.A. (Oxon.), M.R. San. I.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1914; attached to Galle kach., Dec., 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Galle in addn., Apr., 1915; extra office asst. to govt. agt., N. Prov., Oct., 1916; pol. mag., Gampola, Dec., 1918; asst. contr. of estate supplies, May, 1919; office asst. to govt. agt., C. Prov., Feb., 1920; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo and Avissawella, Sept., 1920; asst. finan. asst. to chmn., mun. coun., Colombo, Jan., 1921; pol. mag., Pt.
