PIENAAR, MAJOR FILIPPUS FOURIE, D.T.D., O.B.E.—Civ. serv., S. A. Republic; dep.-ohmn., miner's phthisis bd., Witwatersrand; accredited rep. of Union of S. Africa to League of Nations; cons-gen. for Union of S. Africa, Laurencio Marques, 1934.

PIERS, FRANCIS A.—B. 1882; sub-inspr., Basutoland mounted pol., 1910; inspr., 1923.

PIERS, HAROLD HENRY ROSS.—Cler. aast., Peddie, Cape Prov., 1895; clk., col. sec.'s office, 1895; R.M. clk., Peddie, 1898; on active serv., served Boer War, 1899-1900; sur. clk., comsnr., Kimberley, 1902; first clk., Calvinia, 1903; Albany, 1907; aast. mag., Albany, 1907; 3rd grade mag., Keiskama Hoek, 1914; ditto, Hopefield, 1919; 2nd grade mag., Molteno, 1920; 1st grade mag., Greytown, 1927; senr. grade mag., Windhoek, S.W.A., June, 1929; sp. "B" mag., E. London, Mar., 1933; sp. "A" mag., Pretoria, 1935.

PIGGOTT, SIR FRANCIS TAYLOR, KT. BACH. (1905).—Barrister-at-law; employed by F.O. on
special service in 1887; legal adv. to prim. min., Japan, Nov., 1887; sec. to att.-gen. Sir C. Russell (afterwards Lord Russell of Killowen) during Behring Sea arbitrn., 1893-4; proc.-gen., Mauritius, 1894; ag. ch. just., 1895 to 1897; ch. just., Hong Kong, Apr., 1906; ret., 1912; recd. thanks of coun. of govt. for ser. in connection with planters' loans, 1902; author of "Nationality and Naturalization," "Exterritoriality," "Extradition," "Foreign Judgments and Jurisdiction," "Law of Torts" and "Imperial Statutes applicable to the Colonies."

PILBEAM, S. A.—B. 1899; entd. C.O., Jan., 1915; passed astt. clk.'s exam., July, 1916; on military service from 18th July, 1917, to 10th May, 1919; assigned to C.O. as astt. clk., Apr., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; ag. cler. offr., higher grade, 10th Oct., 1925.

PILKINGTON, CHARLES WILLIAM McDONALD.—B. 1877; clk., cust., Cape Town, 1895; ch. clk., Port Elizabeth, 1930; do., Pretoria, 1933; collr., cust., Johannesburg, 1934.

PILLING, HENRY GUY, C.M.G. (1932).—B. 1886; ed. King's Schl., Ely, and Keble Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1911; cadet, Fiji, 1907; passed cadet, 1910; 2nd grade dist. comsnr., 1914; mem., Indian Franchise Comsn., 1920; ag. astt. col. sec., 1920; astt. col. sec., Jan., 1921; ag. sec., W. Pacific high comsn., Mar., 1924; sec., W. Pacific high comsn., 1926; astt. to high comsnr., W. Pacific, 1929; col. sec., Br. Honduras, Dec., 1929; ag. gov. in 1930 and 1931; dep. col. sec., Kenya, 1933.

PINDER, RICHARD FRANCIS, (R. of O.).—B. 1898; ed. St. Bees, Cumberland; served, European War, Flanders, Germany, 1916-19; astt. audr., Sierra Leone, May, 1920; ag. audr., Nov.-Dec., 1920; astt. audr., Gold Coast, Nov., 1929; ag. audr., Feb. May, 1930; sen. astt. audr., Uganda, Aug., 1931; ag. audr., July-Dec., 1932; audr., Fiji, Solomon Is., Prot., Gilbert and Ellice Is., Col., Aug., 1934.

PINKERTON, WILLIAM JAMES DUNLOP, A.M.I.C.E., Chartered Civil Engrnr.—B. 1890; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Apr., 1914; exec. engrnr., Ulu Selangor, July, 1923; sr. exec. engrnr., in addn., Jan., 1930; offtd. as sr. exec. engrnr., Kinta, in addn., Nov.-Dec., 1930; senr. drainage and irrign. engrnr. Malay States, Jan., 1932; irrign. engrnr., Kelantan, Jan., 1932.

PINNEY, CAPT. CHAS. ROBERT, M.C. (1917).—B. 1883; ed. Essendon Grammar Schl.; draughtsman, lands dept., Papua, 1906; on war serv., A.I.F., 1914-20; wounded; transf'd. R. of O., C.M.F., 1920; ch. draughtsman, Papua, 1920; staff survr. in addn., 1924; ag. oomsnr., lands, etc., 1927; comsnr., lands, dir., mines, dir., agr., dep. chmn., land bd., mem., exec. and leg. couns., July, 1930; adminr., Norfolk Is., July, 1932.

PIRIE, D. A.—B. 1886; clk. Burgher camps, Transvaal, 1903; treas'y., 1903; prin. clk. treas'y., Union of S. Africa, 1920; sec. milly. pensions bd., treas'y., 1920; ch. clk., grade II, 1928; ch. clk., grade I, 1932.

PIROW, HANS, D.Sc., M.Inst.M.M., D.I.C., vice-pres., Geol. Soc. of S.A.; mem., coun., Chem. Met. and Min. Soc., and S.A. Assoc. for the Adv. of Science.—B. 1892; ed. S. Africa and on continent; grad., S.A. and London; various offl. capacities on Witwatersrand gold mines, 1911-1919; govt. research schol., 1919-20; astt. inspr., mines, 1920; dominion sci. schol., London, 1924; G.M.E., Dec., 1926; is also mem., mining leases bd. and elec. control bd., assessor mem., research grant bd. and statistical coun.; ag. sec., mines and industries, 1927.

PIROW, OSWALD.—B. 1890; ed. South Africa, Germany and England; admitted barrister, 1913; K.C., 1924; ent. parl., of the Union of S. Africa, 1924; min. of justice, June, 1929; min., rly. and harb's and min. defence, Mar., 1933; World Econ. Conf., London, 1933.

PITBLADO, DAVID BRUCE.—B. 1912; ed. Strand Schl. and Cambridge; schol. of Emmanuel Coll., 1930-34; hist. triplos part 1 and law triplos part 2, cls. 2 divn. 1; hist. triplos part 2, cls. 2; B.A., 1933; supervisor in hist., Emmanuel Coll., 1934-35; apptd. after compet. exam., astt. prin., D.O., Oct., 1935.

PITCAIRN, ANDREW.—B. 1894; ed. Edinburgh Coll. of Agr.; on war serv., 1915-19 (France, Mesopotamia and Palestine); lieut., R.F.A.; ment. in desps.; dist. agr. offr., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1921; astt. dir., agr., Cyprus, Mar., 1929; ag. dir., agr., on various occasions, 1930-35; ag. dir., animal husbandry, June to Sept., 1930, and June-Sept., 1932.

PITMAN, CHARLES ROBERT SENHOUSE, D.S.O. (1917), M.C. (1916).—B. 1890; ed. Royal Naval Schl., Blundell's and R.M.C., Sandhurst; att'd. R. Warwickshire Regt.; 27th Punjabis; capt., 1915; war serv., Egypt, 1914-15; France, 1915; Mesopotamia, 1916-18 (wounded, des't twice, M.C., D.S.O.); Palestine, 1918-21; gen. staff, 1919-21; game warden, Uganda, 1925; seconded to N. Rhodesia for sp. duty, 1931-33.

PITT, WALTER JAMES, B.A.—B. 1875; ed. Downing Coll., Cambridge (modern and medieval language triplos); ent. Middle Temple, Jan., 1919; passed Bar final exam., Dec., 1920; headm'r., Cape Coast Govt. Schl., 1910; inspr. of schl., 1912; prov. inspr. of schl., 1914; att'd. to polit. serv., Gold Coast, Aug., 1914; astt. dist. comsnr., July, 1917; dist. comsnr., Jan., 1921; ag. prov. comsnr., W. Prov., Ashanti, Feb.-Nov., 1920.

PITTMAN, WILLIAM B.—1878; ed. S. African Coll. and Wadham Coll., Oxon; B.A. (Univ. S.A.), M.A. (Oxon); called to bar, Middle Temple, 1903; admitted to Cape (1904) and Transvaal (1905) bars; dean of faculty of law, Univ. S.A., 1918-25; K.C., 1924; judge, sup. ct., S. Africa eastern dists. local divn., 1925; mem., delimitation coman., July, 1927 and Mar., 1932.

PLACE, ALAN WHITLEY.—B. 1888; native affrs. dept., S. Rhodesia, 1910-19; milly. serv., 2nd Rhodesia Regt., 1915-16, 4th K. A. R., 1916-24; cadet, Uganda, 1924; astt. sec., 1927; temp. serving in D.O. and C.O., 1928-29; senr. astt. sec., Uganda, 1934.

PLANT, GEORGE FRDERIC, C.B.E. (1927).—B. 1877; ed. Manchester Gram. Schl. and Brasenose Coll. (scholar, 1896); 1st cl. class. mods., 1898; B.A., 1900; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., 1910; off. astt., Kurunagala, 1902; off. astt., Galle, 1904; pol. mag., Avissawella, 1905; dist. judge, Ratnapura, Apr., 1906; ditto, Matara, Dec., 1906; astt. gov't. agt., Kalutara, May, 1909; temporarily employed in C.O. London, May, 1915, to Dec., 1918; sec., oversea settlement contect., Jan., 1919; permanently transferred to Home civ. serv., Sept., 1919; mem., oversea settlement deleg't. to Canada, 1924; astt. sec., D.O., 11th Nov., 1935.

PLATT'S, SHELLEY ABDEN.—B. 1899; ed. Bedford Schl.; passed army entrance exam.; "King's India cadetship," 1917; gazetted 2/9th Gurka Rifles; 3rd Afghan War, 1919; att'd. 2/11th
Gurka Rifles and 4/70th Burma Rifles, Burma, 1921; cadet, admive. service, Tanganyika Territory, May, 1926; a.st dist. offr., July, 1928.

PLOWMAN, CLIFFORD HENRY FITZHERBERT, O.B.E (1928) — B. 1889; ed. at King's Schl., Ely and Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A. (class. tripes); asst. dist. comsnr., E. Africa Prot., Mar., 1912; pol. offr., Turkana Expedn., 1915 (A.G.S. Med. with clas); ag. offr. in charge, Northern Frontier Dist., 1919-20; seconded to F.O. as H.B.M. Vice-Consul, Harar, Abyssinia, 1920; H.B.M. Consul on transfer Harar Consulate to C.O., 1922; transfd., Somaliland, 1922; H.B.M. chargé d'affaires, Addis Ababa, Dec., 1925 to Jan., 1926; mem., mission to Abyssinia for coronation of Emperor, 1930; 2nd cls., Star of Ethiopia; asst. comsnr. and pol. offr., Br. Somaliland; Ethiopia bndy. comsnr., 1931-33; sec., govt. of Somaliland, 1933; ag. comsnr., May-Oct., 1934; has passed E. Africa Prot. law exam. and in Swahili, Boran Galla and Amharic languages.

PLUNKETT, JOHN OLIVER, M.I.C.E., Chtd. Civ. Engr.—B. 1888; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Dec., 1914; demob. with rank of capt., Sept. 1919; asst. engr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Apr., 1920; do., S.S., Sept., 1922; exec. engr., Nov., 1929; exec. engr., F.M.S., Oct., 1933.

PLYMOUTH, 2nd Earl of (cr. 1905) and 15th Baron Windsor (cr. 1529) IVOR MILTON WINDSOR-CLIVE.—B. 1889; ed. Eton and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; D.L., Worcestershire; lord-lieut., Glamorganshire, 1923; capt., hon. corps of gentlemen-at-arms, 1925; M.P., Ludlow divn., Shropshire, 1922-23; parly. under-sec. of state for Dominion affrs., Jan., 1929; kt. of grace of St. John of Jerusalem; parly. sec., min. of transport, Sept., 1931; parly. under-sec. of state for the cols., 30th Sept., 1932.

POLE-EVANS, ILLIOTT BULLER, C.M.G. (1921), M.A. (Cantab.), D.Sc. (Wales), F.L.S.—B. 1879; ed. Cowbridge Gram. Schl. and Univs. of Wales and Cambridge; mycologist, Transvaal, 1905; rep. Transvaal govt. at 4th Internat. Botanical Congress, Brussels, 1910; ch., divn. of mycology and plant pathology, 1911; ch., divn. of botany and plant pathology, 1912; sp. mission to P. E. Africa, coconut palm disease, 1913; dir., botanical survey of S. Africa, 1918; pres., S. African Assocn. for Advancement of Science, 1920; ch., divn. of botany, horticulture and entomology, 1927; ch., divn. of plant industry, 1929; author of many scientific papers.

POLLARD, ARNOLD.—B. 1893; ed. Hele Schl., Exeter; active serv., R.N.A.S. and R.N.R., 1915-19; col. audit dept., Feb., 1920; asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1920; asst. audr., Kenya, May, 1924; ag. senr. asst. audr. on several occasions in Tanganyika and Kenya; audr., Windward Is., Jan., 1926; senr. asst. audr., Uganda, Jan., 1929; ag. audr., Apr., 1929; audr., Trinidad, June, 1931; audr., N. Rhodesia, 1935.

POLLOCK, CAPT. JAMES HURY HAMIL (R. of O.).—B. 1893; ed. Royal Schl., Armagh; war serv., 1914-20; Gallipoli, Macedonia, Egypt and Palestine; men, in desps.; staff capt., O.E.T.A.; inspr., grade 3, Palestine, July, 1920; dep. gov., grade 3, Ramallah, Oct., 1920; admive. offr., Nigeria, Sept., 1923; asst. sec., secr., Lagos, Dec., 1927; admive. offr., Palestine, Jan., 1930; asst. dist. comsnr., 1932.

POOLEY, CHARLES EDWARD.—B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 22nd Oct., 1920; cler. offr., higher grade, Aug., 1933.

POPE, GEORGE WILLIAM, L.L.M.R.C.P., and S.I. (Ireland), D.P.H., R.C.P. and S.I.—B. 1891; med. offr., Kenya, 1920; 2nd health offr., port med. dept., Hong Kong, 1924; ag. asst. bacteriologist, 1924; asst. health offr., 1925; health offr., 1926.

POPE, LAWRENCE HENRY.—B. 1896; ed. Uppingham; served European War, 1915-19 (France and N. Russia); asst. P.S. to govr., S. Australia, Sir W. E. E. A. Weigall, K.C.M.G., 1920; P.S. to govr., Tasmania, Sir W. L. Allardyce, G.C.M.G., 1921; col. audit dept., 1923; asst. audr., Fiji, 1923; ag. audr., 1924-28; asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory, 1928; do. Nigeria, Apr., 1934.

POPE, STEAD.—Br. post office, Feb., 1903; dist. survr., post and tels., Gold Coast, Dec., 1913; on active serv., Togoland Field Force, Aug., 1914; and later in charge posts and tels., Togo-land to May, 1915; imp. army serv., Sept., 1915-19; lieut., R.E. and R.A.F.; dist. survr., Gold Coast, June, 1919; div. survr., Jan., 1927; P.M.G., Nyasaland, Mar., 1930.

POPHAM, HENRY BRADSHAW, C.M.G. (1935), M.B.E. (1918).—B. 1881; ed. Tonbridge Schl.; comsnr., 13th Light Infy., 1900; served, S. African War (2 med.); seconded, G.Costregt., W.A.F.F., 1906; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to ag. govr., G. Coast, Mar. to Aug., 1909; col. sec.'s office, Jan., 1910; priv. sec. to ag. govr., Feb. to June, 1911; ag. ch. asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., July to Aug., 1913; ag. senr. asst. col. sec., Oct., 1913; dist. comsnr., Jan., 1914; seconded to Togoland polit. admtn., Nov., 1914; senr. asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., Jan., 1920; ag. ch. asst. col. sec., Sept., 1920 to Feb., 1921; dep. prov. comsnr. and ag. comsnr., W.Prov., Feb., 1921; prov. comsnr., Apr., 1922; ret'd. (invalided) May, 1923; comsnr., Cyprus, Oct., 1925; admstr., Dominica, 1933; mem., exec. coun., Leeward Is., 1933.

POPLEWELL, GEOFFREY DOUGLAS, B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1904; cadet, provincial adminstr., Tanganyika Territory, April, 1927; asst. dist. offr., May, 1929; ag. dist. offr., 1931-32.

PORTELLY, JOHN, M.D., D.P.H., D.T.M. and H. (Eng.), Certif. Lond. Schl. of Hygiene and T.M.—B. 1889; ed. govt. secondary schl. and Univ., Malta; med. offr., gen. hosp., Penang, S.S., Mar., 1922; med. offr., S. Kedah, and asst. supt., prisons, inaddn., Jan., 1925; med. offr., in ch. gen. hosp., J. Bahru, Apr., 1927; port health offr., S'pore, Feb., 1929; ag. senr. health offr., Penang, Apr., 1929; offr. rep. on L. of N. Interchange Tour for port health offrs. in the East, June, 1930; ag. senr. health offr., Johore, Sept., 1932; registr.-gen., births and deaths, Johore, Oct., 1932; ag. state med. and health offr., N. Sembilan, June, 1933; do. Perak, Oct., 1934.

PORTER, HENRY ARTHUR, F.R.I.R.A. — B. 1884; senr. archt., P.W.D., Nigeria, 1925.

POSTMUS, JOHANNES.—B. 1877; ed in S. Africa and at Sneek, Holland; gen. man., Netherlands Bank of S.A., 1920-26; dep. govr., S. African Reserve Bank, 1927-31; govr., S. African Reserve Bank, Jan., 1932; World Econ. Conf., London, 1933.

POTTER, JOHN WAGNER.—B. 1873; ed. at Uppingham Schl. (class. schol.); called to bar, Middle Temple, 1910; ent. Crown Agents office, Oct., 1896; asst. registr., inscribed stock, Mar., 1905; asst. head, gen. stores dept., Jan., 1913; ditto, gen. dept., Jan., 1920; ditto, pay dept., Jan., 1924; dep. head, pay dept., Feb., 1930.

POTTINGER, JOSEPH HECTOR, M.B., Ch.B., D.P.H., D.T.M. & H. (L'pool).—B. 1898; on war
serv., 1915-18; med. offr., health, W. African med. staff, Gold Coast, 1928; asst. govt. med. offr. of health, Br. Guiana, 1932; senr. med. offr., Palestine, 1935.

POTTS, HUGH CUTHBERT MILLER.—B.1907; ed. Durham Schl. and Lincoln Coll., Oxford; B.A. Law.; cadet, Tanganyika Territory, July, 1930; asst. dist. offr., 1932.

POTTS, JOHN WILFRED.—Served in Bechuanaland Prot., pol., 1912-16; clk., 1915; ag. asst. res. mag., 1920; ag. res. mag., 1920 and 1922-23; passed civ. ser. lower law exam., 1919; passed 2nd grade Seswana exam., 1922; sub. inspr., Bech. Prot. pol., 1924; inspr., Mar., 1927; res. mag., Apr., 1929.

POUGNET, EDUARD DESBARRIERES, A.C.G.I., A.M.I.C.E.—Pub. wks. dept., Mauritius, Jan., 1888; asst. water authority, Mch., 1898; inspr. of water wks., July, 1903; govt. survr., Mch., 1911; supt. of pub. wks. and survr. of roads, St. Kitts, Apr., 1914; in service of French govt., in France during the war.

POULIER, REGINALD SYDNEY VERNON.—B. 1894; B.A. Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Aug., 1919; att. Galle Kach., Aug., 1919; pol. mag., Matale, Feb., 1922; addtl. dist. judge, Mannar and Mullaitivu, Oct., 1924; addtl. asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Dec., 1925; comsnr., requests, Kandy, Oct., 1927; asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Nov., 1928; asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Oct., 1931; do., Mannar, Oct., 1934.

POULTON, ARTHUR STANLEY.—B. 1900; ed. R. Mily. Acad., Woolwich; R.A., 1918; Iraq campaign, 1920; Somaliland Camel Corps (K.A.R.), 1927; comsnr., 3rd grade, Br. Somaliland, 1931; asst. dist. offr., 1932.

POULTON, WILFRED FRANK, C.B.E. (1935).—B. 1888; ed. Bishop's Stafford Coll. and Royal Vety. Coll., London; vety. offr., Uganda, Jan., 1914; war serv. in E. Africa, 1914-17; dir., vety. services, Uganda, Feb., 1925.

POUSSETTE, HENRY RIVINGTON.—B. 1872; ed. Sarnia Pub. Sch., Upper Can. Coll., Royal Mily. Coll., Kingston, and Sch. of Prac. Science, Toronto; capt., S. African Constab., 1901, and thereafter in same corps throughout S. African war; dist. comdr., and pub. pros., S. Africa; ent. serv. dept. of trade and commerce, Can., as trade comsnr., Durban, S. Africa, 1909; trade comsnr., Buenos Aires, 1910; enlisted for activeserv., 1914; returned Can., 1919; inspr., trade comsnr. serv.; sp. trade comsnr., India, 1919; dir., comm. intelligence serv., Ottawa, 1921; trade comsnr., Trinidad, 1924.

POWELL, BASIL WELSTEAD BARNARD.—B. 1881; ed. George Watson's Coll., Edin. and Highfield Coll.; senr. engrnr., P. and T. dept., S.S. and F.M.S., Penang, Mar., 1913; ditto, K. Lumpur, July, 1928; ditto, N. Sembilan, Dec., 1928.

POWELL, HARRY CREWELL, A.M.Inst.T.—B. 1881; mily. serv., France, 1916-19; traffic supt., Jamaica govt. rly., Jan., 1921; dir., do., Oct., 1930.

POWER, HON. CHARLES GAVAN, K.C., B.A., LL.B. (Quebec South).—B. 1888; ed. in Loyola Coll., Montreal; grad., 1907; B.A., LL.B., Laval Univ.; called to bar, 1910; enlisted Jan., 1915; served overseas, twice wounded, invalided from serv., 1918; capt. and ag. major, M.C.; el. to H. of C., Canada, Dec., 1917; re-el., g.e., 1921, 1925, 1926, 1930 and 1935; min. of pensions and nat. health, MacKenzie King's cabinet, Oct., 1935.

POWER, FRANCIS WILLIAM.—Ed. Stonyhurst Coll.; Indian Army, 1917; seconded, I.C.S. as polit. res., Perim Is., 1922-23; col. audit dept., Apr., 1924; asst. audr., Gold Coast, June, 1924; ag. dep. audr., July, 1928; audr., Windward Is., Feb., 1929; senr. asst. audr., N. Rhodesia, 1936.

POWER, G., B.A.—B. 1891; ed. Denstone Coll. and Queen's Coll., Oxford; supt., educn., N. Nigeria, Jan., 1914; asst. dir., educn., Gold Coast, May, 1929; dir., ditto, Feb., 1933.

POWERS, HON. SIR CHARLES, K.C.M.G. (1929).—Justice of the high ct. of Australia, 1913; ret.

POYNTON, ARTHUR HILTON.—B. 1905; schol. of Marlborough Coll. (1918-23) and Brasenose Coll., Oxford (1923-7); lst cls. hona., moda., 1925; 2nd cls. hona., lit. hum., 1927; M.A., 1933; apptd. asst. prin., dept. of scientific and industrial research after compet. exam., 31st Oct., 1927; transf. to C.O., 1st Oct., 1929; joint sec., Col. Development Advisory Comtee, 1st Apr. to 30th Sept., 1930; sec., do., 1st April, 1932; pte. sec. to partly. under sec. for cols.(Sir R. Hamilton), 18th April, 1932 and to (Lord Plymouth), 30th Sept., 1932; seconded to Sierra Leone admtn., Apr., 1933-35; ag. prin., D.O., 9th Sept., 1935; do., C.O., 4th Nov., 1935.

POYSER, KENNETH ELLISTON, D.S.O., K.C. (Barbados).—B. 1882; ed. Shrewsbury and Merton Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Inner Temple, 1906; served, European War, 1914-20, Yorks. L.I., and Loyal N. Lanc. Regt. (depts. thrie., D.S.O., 1917); puisne judge, Leeward Island, Sept., 1920; atty.-gen., Barbados, June, 1926; atty.-gen., Uganda, 1928; puisne just., Ceylon, 1933.

PRAIN, LT.-COL. SIR DAVID, KT. BACH. (1912); C.M.G. (1912); C.I.E. (1906); M.A., M.II., L.L.D., F.R.S E., F.L.S., F.R.S.—B. 1857; ed. Aberdeen gram.schl. and Univ. of Aberdeen and Edinburgh; demonstrator of anatomy, coll. of surgeons, Edin., 1882-3, and univ. of Aberdeen, 1883-1884; entd. Indian med. serv., 1884; curator, Calcutta herbarium, 1887-1894; prof. of botany, med. coll., Calcutta, 1895-1905; director, botanical survey of India, and aspt. of royal botanic garden, Calcutta, 1898-1905; trustee of the Indian Museum, 1898-1904; sec. bd. of scientific advice for India, 1903-1904; mem. of coun. of various scientific societies; director of royal botanic gardens, Kew, 1905; ret., 1922.

PRANKERD, HORACE ARTHUR, B.A.(Cantab.).—B. 1883; ed. at Ipswich and Queen's Coll., Cambridge (scholar, 2nd class, tripods), B.A., 1905; baccalaureat(B.L. 1st part) Lyons Univ., France, 1908; asst. sec., N. Nigeria, Oct., 1910; asst. res., 1911; ag. supt., schla., July, 1912 to Apr., 1913; called to bar, Gray's Inn, Apr., 1921; promoted cls. I, grade I, admstve serv., Feb., 1928.

PRASAD, MURARI, U.B.—B. 1888; Cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1912; attached to Galle Kachcheri, Jan., 1913; addtl. office ast. to govt. agt., N.C. Prov., Aug., 1914; addtl. dist. judge, Anuradhapura, Aug., 1915; office ast. to govt. agt., N.C. Prov., Dec., 1915; pol. mag., Chilaw, Apr., 1917; ditto, Panadure, Apr., 1919; office ast. to govt. agt., N. Prov., Mar., 1920; dist. judge, Anuradhapura, May, 1921; pol. mag.; Kalutara, May, 1922; ditto, Gampola, Mar., 1923; dist. judge, Tangalla, Oct., 1924; dep. fiscal, Colombo, Feb., 1926; dist. judge, Matara, June, 1927; comsnr., stamps, July, 1932; dist. judge, Kurunegala, Oct., 1933.

PRENDERGAST, HON. JAMES EMILE PIERRE.—Ed. at Seminary of Quebec and Laval Univ., Quebec; B.A., 1878; LL.B., 1881; returned for
La Verandrye, Manitoba, Aug., 1886; again Dec., 1886; on formation of cabinet by Hon. Thomas Greenway, Jan., 1888, was given portfolio of prov. sec.; re-elected in said constituency; elected for Woodlands, 1888; judge of sup. ct., N.W.T., 1902; ditto, Saskatchewan, 1907; puisne judge, court of King's Bench of Manitoba, 1910; ch. just., Dec., 1929.

PRESCO'TT, ARTHUR STANLEY.—App'd. after compet. exam., supplementary clk., supreme ct., Gibraltar, 1895; 3rd cls. clk., 1899; asst. regis. and deputy clk. of arraigns, 1911.

PRETHEROE, EDWARD OWEN, M.C., B.A.; LL.B.—B. 1896; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1921; admnstr. offr., 1922; asst. commr., lands, 1924; ag. commr., lands, 1924; asst. sec., S. Prova., 1924; pol. mag., 1928; ag. ch. regis., sup. ct. on various occasions; crown coun., 1930; ag. solr.-gen. on various occasions.

PRETORIUS, JAN LODEWKYK.—B. 1878; ed. at Grey Coll., Bloemfontein; joined O.F.S. repub. civ. serv., Mar., 1887; asst. mag., Edenburg, 1902; Vrede, 1904; Lindley, 1908; dist. asst. mag., Dewetsdorp, Feb., 1910 to Oct., 1913; Reitz, Nov., 1913; mag., Reitz, 1918; Houtenad, Feb., 1919; Boshof, Oct., 1919; Frankfort, Oct., 1923; Senekal, June, 1929; Vereeniging, Feb., 1930; Lichtenburg, Mar., 1933; Port Elizabeth, Feb., 1934.

PRETTY, ERIC ERNEST FALK.—B. 1891; ed. Harrow, and Demy of Magdalen Coll., Oxford; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1914; passed cadet, June, 1917; ag. collr. of land revenue, Johore Bahru, Sept., 1917; offr., cls. V., S.S., Dec., 1917; 2nd lieut. and asst. adjt., J.V.R., May, 1918; supernum. offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1921; Br. res., Brunei, Mar., 1923; offr., Cls. III., Nov., 1926; dist. offr., Krian, June, 1928; ag. sec., high commr., July, 1931; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1931.

PRICE, CHARLES ROY.—B. 1893; ed. Wellington Schl., Somerset University Coll., London; B.A. (war), 1919; unattached list, Territorial Force, Jan. to Aug., 1915; Royal Garrison Arty., Sept., 1915 to Dec., 1918; served in France, June, 1916 to Sept., 1918; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, asst. prin., C.O., 1st Mar., 1921; pvte. sec. to perm. under sec. for dom. affrs., 6th July, 1927 (ag. from 6th June, 1927); temp. ag. prin., D.O., 22nd July, 1927; pvte. sec. to parly. under sec. for dom. affrs., Jan., 1928; asst. sec., Imp. wireless and cable confce., Jan., July, 1928; ag. prin., D.O., 15th Sept., 1928; U.K. delegn. to L. of N. assembly, 1928 and 1932; U.K. delegn. to London naval confce., 1930; attd. to sec., Imp. confce., 1930; U.K. delegn., disarmament confce., Geneva, Feb.-Dec., 1932.

PRICE, HENRY HENRY, M.B.E. (1936).—2nd clk. to asst. commr., Northern Div., Bech. Prot., 1910; 2nd clk., res. commr.'s office, 1st May, 1912; passed Cape civ. ser. lower law exam., 1910; ag. asst. res. mag., 1911-12; regis. of brands, 1913; ch. clk. and regis., 1921; passed 3rd grade Seswana exam., 1927; asst. govt. sec., Apr., 1935.

PRICE-JONES, CAPT. WILLIAM.—Served during Great War in France; awarded M.C., 1917; asst. dist. commr., Gold Coast, Aug., 1919; dist. commr., Apr., 1924; called to bar, Gray's Inn, Nov., 1926; pol. mag., 1928; ag. puisne judge, sup. ct., Sept., 1935.

PRICHARD, HERBERT WILLIAM, K.C. (1923), B.A. (Oxon.)—B. 1873; ed. at Keble Coll., Oxford (open class. schol., 1892); called to the bar, Gray's Inn, Jan., 1902; practised in London, 1902-1910; stip. mag. Trinidad, Aug., 1910; puisne judge, Mauritius, Feb., 1915; 1st puisne judge, Oct., 1916; ag. proc. and advoc.-gen., Oct., 1916 to July, 1917; chmn. of oman. on Royal College, 1916-1917; chmn., sugar sales comte., Sept., 1918 to Aug., 1919; ag. col. sec., Sept. to Dec., 1920 and Feb. to Apr., 1921; ag. proc. and advoc. gen., April, 1921; confirmed in appt., Jan., 1922; ag. col. sec. from Aug., 1924 to Feb., 1925; puisne judge, S. Sttlmts., and judge, F.M.S., June, 1927; ag. sr. puisne judge, S.S., in 1928 and 1932.

PRIESTMAN, HAROLD EDDEY, B.A. (Dublin).—B. 1888; mil. serv., 1914-19; temp. admin. offr., min. of lab., 1919; asst. dist. offr., Nigeria, 1921; attbd. to C.O., 1930; seconded as ag. col. sec. and senr. asst. col. sec., Gambia, 1931; resumed duties, C.O., 1932; resumed substantive appt., Nigeria, 1933; admin. sec. to high commr. for Basutoland, Bech. Prot. and Swaziland, 1935.

PRING, HARRY.—B. 1883; ed. Watford Schl. and King's Coll., London; Imp. serv., 1898-1903; col. sec.'s office, Capetown, 1903; dept. of interior, Pretoria, 1910; ch. clk., 1925; under sec., 1927; pub. serv. commr., 1931.

PRINGLE, LEONARD DUNGAN, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—B. 1906; med. offr., F.M.S., 1931; Hong Kong, 1932; ag. radiologist, Jan.-Aug., 1933; M.O. in ch. of officers' families, Victoria Gaol, infant dist. hosp., Victoria mortuary and remand house, 1934.

PRIOR, A. C. VINCENT.—B. 1881; ed. King's Coll., Cambridge; M.A., LL.B.; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1905; atty.-gen., St. Vincent, Jan., 1915; ag. ch. just., Jan. to June, 1915; atty.-gen., Leeward Is., 1918; solr.-gen., Sierra Leone, Sept., 1920; ag. atty.-gen. on several occasions; solr.-gen., Gold Coast, 1926; ag. atty.-gen., May to Nov., 1926; atty.-gen., Sierra Leone, 1927; ag. ch. just., June to July, 1928 and June to Oct., 1929; atty.-gen., Nigeria, Oct., 1929.

PRITCHARD, NEIL.—B. 1911; ed. Liverpool Coll. and Worcester Coll., Oxford (hist. schol., 1929-32); hist. schol., 1st cls.; B.A., 1932; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. prin., D.O., Oct., 1933.

PROBYN, SIR LESLIE, K.C.M.G. (1909); C.M.G. (1903).—Ed. at Charterhouse, and in France and Germany, called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1884; joint author of "The Jurisdiction and Practice of the Mayor's Court," and other law books; atty.-gen., Br. Honduras, 1893; atty.-gen. of Grenada, May, 1896; also ag. col. sec. in 1897-8; ag. admstr. on several occasions; gov. secretary, S. Nigeria, Apr., 1901; gov., Sierra Leone, July, 1904; gov., Barbados, Nov., 1910; gov., Jamaica, May, 1918; ret., 1924.

PROPSTING, HON. W. B., C.M.G. (1918).—M.L.C., Tasmania; atty.-gen. and min. for rly.s., Apr., 1916; pres., leg. coun., 1926.

PROUT, SIR WILLIAM THOMAS, K.C.M.G. (1928), KT. BACH. (1924), C.M.G. (1905), O.B.E., M.B., C.M. (Edin.)—Asst. poor law med. offr., Mauritius, 1886; surg. supt., immigrant ship "Dundee," 1887; asst. col. surg., Gold Coast, 1888; dist. commr., Gold Coast, 1890; col. surg., Gambia, 1893; ag. chief surg., Gambia, 1893; med. offr. in charge of base hosp. during campaign against Foday Sila; col. surg., S. Leone, 1896; title altered to prin. med. offr., 1901; retired, 1906; fellow of roy. med. soc., Edin., and corrpdg. mem. of the epidemiological soc. of Lond.; lect. schl. of trop. med., Univ. of Liverpool; med. adviser to C.O.; mem. of advisory. med. and
sanitary comttee. for Tropical Africa, C.O.; senr. med. adviser to C.O., 1924; author of article "Yaws" in "Diseases of Warm Climates" (Davidson); Fil. Volucolous (Archives de Parasitologie, May, 1901); "Filariasis in S. Leone" (Brit. Med. Journal, 1902); and other papers.

PRYER, JOHN HAWKES.—B. 1894; ed. Bedford Harpur Trust; mech. transport, B.E.F., France, 1918-19; cadet pilot, R.A.F.; asst. storekeeper, Gold Coast rly., Sept., 1920; asst. ch., do., Aug., 1929; ch., do., Mar., 1932.

PUCKERIN, MERVYN ALLEYNE.—B. 1891; entd. civ. serv., Barbados, 1909; war serv., 1916-19; supt., govt. indust. schls., 1924; tov., Glendairy prison, 1932.

PUCKRIDGE, GEOFFREY MARTIN.—B. 1895; ed. Exeter Schl.; 2nd lieut., Devon Regt., T.F., Dec., 1913; capt., Dec., 1914; served in France with 5th West Yorks regt.; seconded to Royal Flying Corps, July, 1917; seconded to Inter Allied Aeronautical Comn. of Control, Germany, 1920; resigned comn., Sept., 1921; asst. dist. comntr., Gold Coast, 1921; dist. comntr., 1925; asst. col. sec., 1928.

PUDSEY, FAWCETT.—B. 1882; Assoc. M.I.M.E.; Assoc. M.I.C.E.; ed. Hymer's Coll., Hull, and Repton Schl.; apprentice with Messrs. Rose, Downs and Thompson, Ltd., Hull, 1900-1905; engineering asst., dock engnr.'s staff, N.E. Rly., 1905-1911; engaged on survey work, Catalonia, Spain, for the Pearson Engineering Corporation, New York, 1911; in charge of opening of the Hessle quarry and crushing plant of the British Portland Cement Manufacturers, Ltd., 1912-1914; asst. D.P.W., B. Guiana, 1914; ag. D.P.W., Feb., 1916; D.P.W., Palestine, Dec., 1927.

PUGHIE, S. R., M.B.E. (1926).—B. 1877; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil ser., and assigned to the C.O., Aug., 1897; promoted, with gratuity, Aug., 1904; confl. clk., Dec., 1907; minor staff clerk, 1911; staff clk., 1st grade, 1st Mar., 1916; staff offr., 1st Apl., 1922; on service in Sierra Leone, Oct., 1926 to Feb., 1927; sec., Discovery comttee., Jan.-June, 1928.

PULLICINO, Sir PHILIP, KT. BACH (1934) B.Litt., LL.D.—B. 1886; ed. St. Ignatius' Coll., Malta; matric., Malta Univ., 1900; B.Litt., 1903; LL.D., 1907; advoc. for poor, 1918; judge, 1928; pub. pros. and treasy. coun., 1929.

PULLON, BERTRAM.—B. 1882; asst. printer, N. Rhodesia, 1921; ag. govt. printer, 1924-25; asst. govt. printer, 1925; ag. govt. printer for various periods during 1927-29, 1931 and 1932; govt. printer, 1932.

PURCELL, HUBERT KENNEDY.—B. 1884; ent. Crown Agents office, Oct., 1901; asst. cashier, July, 1914; head of pay dept., Dec., 1920; dep. head of pay and checking dept., Nov., 1921; dep. head, pay dept., 1924; dep. head, gen. dept. and dep. ch. clk., 1930; dep. head, gen. stores dept., Jan., 1933; head, pay dept., May, 1933; head, gen. dept. and ch. clk., Nov., 1933.

PURCELL, VICTOR WILLIAM WILLIAMS SAUNDERS.—B. 1896; ed. Bancroft's Schl. and Trinity Coll., Camb.; B.E.F., France, 1915-18; cadet, F.M.S., Apr., 1921; attd., Chinese prot., K. Lumpur; passed cadet, July, 1924; offr., cls. V, July, 1923; inspr., Chinese schls., S.S. and asst. dir., educn., June, 1924; asst. prot., Chinese, Penang, July, 1925; dep. registr. sup. ct., Sept., 1926; offr., cls. IV, July, 1927, dep. registr. and asst. offr. assignee; 2nd asst. dir., educn. (Chinese), S.S., Aug., 1930; offr., cls. III, July, 1932; mag., Seremban, July, 1934.

PURLL, FREDERICK JOHN.—B. 1891; conf. shorthand writer, B. of T., Aug., 1909; conf. clk. to gen. man., lab. exchange dept., B. of T., Oct., 1909; conf. shorthand writer to S. of S., H.O., Jan., 1911; cler. offr., 21st Jan., 1925; accompanied the Rt. Hon. L. S. Amery, M.P. (S. of S. for Dominion Affairs) on his tour of the Dominions July, 1927-Feb., 1928; transferred to C.O., June, 1928; accompanied Br. economic mission to Australia, Aug., 1928-Feb., 1929; seconded for serv. with Newfoundland R. Comsn., Mar.-Oct., 1933.

PURVES, ALEXANDER BRUCE, M.I.C.E.—B. 1890; ed. Kirkcaldy and George Watson's Coll., Edin.; survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1914; asst. engrnr., Tytam Tuk scheme, 1915; asst. water engrnr., 1916; engrnr., Shing Mun Valley scheme, in addn., 1923-29; dep. water engrnr., 1925; exec. engrnr. in ch. waterworks, 1930.

PUTTICK, LEONARD JAMES.—B. 1885; ed. at High Schl. and Huguenot Coll., Wellington and S. African Coll., Cape Town; served Anglo-Boer war, 1900-01; draughtsman, Swaziland, 1910; clk. of lands, 1916; ch. clk., 1919; ag. reglar. and mast., sp. ct. and sheriff, 1919; sec., Swaziland—Portuguese bndry. comsn., 1922; sec., undeveloped minerals comsn., 1927; ag. dept. asst. comntr., 1925 and 1930; beacon inspr., 1927; ag. govt. sec. in 1927 and 1928; asst. govt. sec., 1928; reglar. and mast., sp. ct., sheriff, reglar. births, marriages and deaths and comntr., protocols, 1932; ag. govt. sec. and finan. sec., Mar.-Sept., 1935.

QUIGLEY, EUGENE PARTRICK, M.C.—B. 1889; served six years R.I.C.; joined army, 1914; 2nd lieut., R. Dublin Fusiliers, 1915; served in France, Egypt and Palestine; organised pol., C.I.D., Palestine, 1919; D.C.P., grade I, 1921; dist. supt., pol., Apr., 1926; dep. comdt., C.I.D., 1930.

RAE, Sir JAMES STANLEY, KT. Bach (1933)—B. 1881; articled and conf. clk. to Sir W. R. Davies, Kt., when atty.-gen., Bahamas; called to the bar, Bahamas, Apr., 1904; called to the bar, Middle Temple, Jan., 1919; ag. coroner for the Is. of New Providence from 1904, confirmed in 1911; J.P., 1910; ag. atty.-gen., Jan., 1910; ag. stip. and circ. mag., 1910-11, and on other occasions; dist. comntr., Belize, B. Honduras, 1914; offr. recr. in bankruptcy, offr. admstr. and J.P. for the col., 1914; registr.-gen., Nov., 1915, in conjunction with duties as dist. comntr.; dir. of P.O.G. fund, 1916; custodian of enemy property, Sept., 1916; press censor during war; pvt., B. Hond. Territorial Force; attd. to staff as mily. censor; atty.-gen., St. Vincent, Apl., 1919; cross of Chevalier of the Order of the Crown, Belgium, for relief services during war, May, 1919; ag. ch. just., St. Vincent, June to Oct., 1919; atty.-gen., St. Lucia, Sept., 1920; ag. ch. just., June, 1921 to Feb., 1922 and from Sept., 1922 to June, 1923; ch. just., St. Vincent, June, 1923; ag. admstr., June, 1926 to Feb., 1927; ch. just., Grenada, 1927; revised and consolidated laws, 1926; ch. just., Leeward Is., Apr., 1931.

RAE, NORMAN.—B. 1892; entd. Crown Agent's office, May, 1911; asst. head of dept., May, 1919; dep. head, stores dept., Oct., 1932; dep. ch. clk., July, 1935.

RAEBURN, COLIN, O.B.E. (1934), D.Sc., F.G.S.—B. 1894; ed. Hamilton Acad. and Glasgow Univ.; lieut., Cameron Highlanders, 1915-19; Salonika, 1915-18; geologist, Scottish Spitzbergen syndicate, 1919; geologist, geol. survey, Nigeria, 1920-29; asst. dir., 1929; author of "Alluvial Prospecting."
RAFFLES, MAJOR STAMFORD CECIL, O.B.E. (Mily.), 1919.—B. 1888; ed. All Saints Schl., Bloxham, Royal Naval Academy, Gosport, and in Germany; 2nd lieut., 4th Suffolk regt., 1903; lieut., 1903; transfd., K.S.L.I., 1906; resig. comrn., 1908; supt., chandu monopoly, Perak, 1913; seconded for mily. serv., Jan., 1915; lieut., 3rd R.W.F., Mar., 1915; capt., Sept., 1915; staff offr., 3rd cls., R.F.C., 1917; staff offr., 2nd cls., R.A.F., 1918; tempy. major, 1918; transfd. unemployed list, R.A.F., Apr., 1919; resumed duty as supt., chandu monopoly, Perak, and supvr. cust., Kinta, Dec., 1919; supvr. cust., Selangor, Dec., 1920; dep. comnr., trade and cust., F.M.S., Jan., 1921; dep. comnr., excise, F.M.S. in addn., Apr. July, 1929; dep. comnr., trade and cust., Selangor and Pahang, June, 1931; dep. comnr., trade and cust., F.M.S., Apr., 1932; ag. comnr., do., in addn., Dec., 1932; senr. dep. comnr., cust. and excise, F.M.S., July, 1932.

RAIKES, H. R.—Ed. Tonbridge Schl., Dulwich Coll. and Balliol Coll., Oxford (William exhib.), Abbot Schol., 1911, final hon. schl. of nat. science (chem.), class I, 1914; B.A., 1914; M.A., 1919; served European War, 1st Batt. The Buffs, R.F.C. and R.A.F., 1914-1919 (A.F.C.); fellow, Exeter Coll., Oxford, 1919-27; sub sector, 1924-27; demonstr. and treas., Balliol and Trinity Coll. laboratory, 1920-27; ch. instr., Oxford Univ. Air Squadron, 1925-27; wing commander, R.A.F.O. since 1926; prin., Univ. of Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, 1928; publs.—papers in Jnl. of Chem. Socv. and Faraday Socv.

RAINSFORD, HUME FRDERICK.—B. 1902; ed. Dublin Univ.; B.A. and hons. B.A.I., civ. engnr., 1925; staff survr., Tanganyika Territory, 1927.

RAJA MUSA, BIN RAJA HAJI BOT, Barrister-at-law (Inner Temple).—B. 1897; Malay probr., Oct., 1910; Malay astt., grade III, July, 1914; do., grade II, July, 1917; Malay offr., grade I, July, 1920; astt. dist. offr., U. Langat, Nov., 1921; offr. cls. V, Jan., 1924; offr. cls. IV, Jan., 1928; offr. cls. III, Jan., 1933; ag. reg., sup. ct., K. Lumpur, Apr., 1933.

RAJA UDA, BIN RAJA MUHAMAD.—B.1894; Malay probr., Oct., 1910; Malay astt., C.S.O., grade III, Sept., 1913; do., grade II, July, 1917; Malay offr., grade I, July, 1920; offr. cls. V, astt. dist. offr., Kuantan, Jan., 1924; offr. cls. IV, Jan., 1928; dep. chmn., sany. bd., K. Lumpur, Sept., 1930; offr. cls. III, Jan., 1933; dist. offr., K. Selangor, Mar., 1933.

RAJENDRA, MURUGESYEN, B.A. (hons.) Lond.—B. 1911; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv. and attd., Hambantota kach., Dec., 1934.

RAKE, EUSTACE OLPHERTS.—B. 1886; ed. Bradfield and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge, B.A.; astt. dist. comnr., Gold Coast, Jan., 1914; prov. comnr., 1930.

RALSTON, JAMES.—B. 1890; M.A. (Glas.), 1911; ast. mast., educ. dept., Hong Kong, 1914; seconded for mil. serv., 1918-19; headmast., Indian Schl., Hong Kong, 1925; 2nd mast., King's Coll., 1928; headmast., Ellis Kadoorie Schl., 1929 and 1933; ditto, Wanteai Schl., 1930; external examr. in method, Hong Kong Univ., 1930; ag. inspr., schl., 1931 and 1935; offr., J.P., 1932; headmr., Cent. Br. Schl., 1934.

RAMAGE, RICHARD OGILVY.—B. 1896; ed. Edinburgh Acad.; R.E. 1914-19 (capt. T.A. R. of O.); admstve. offr., cls. IV, 1920; polit. offr., anti-teaute duties, 1926; astt. sec., Nigerian secretariat, 1929; clk. to exec. and leg. couns., 1930-32; pvte. sec. to O.A.G., and to gov., 1931; ag. prin. astt. sec., Nigerian secretariat, 1932 and 1933; ag. prin. astt. sec., S. Prov., do., 1933-34; ag. sec., S. Prov., 1934-35; admstve. serv., cls. II, 1934; personal astt. to lieut.-gov., Malta, 1936.

RAMBAUT, ARTHUR EDMUND, B.A.—B.1886; ed. Magd. Coll. Schl. and B.N.C., Oxford; 2nd cls. math. mods., 1905; 4th cls. bot., 1908; dipl. forestry, 1909; astt. con., forests, F.M.S., Nov., 1909; do. mil. duty; 2nd lieut. North Fus. (T.F.), 1915; lieut., 1916; temp. capt. 1916; served in France; intel. corps., 1917 (France, Belgium, Germany); rtnd. to F.M.S., Aug., 1919; dep. consrvr., forests, Perak, South, Nov., 1926; ag. per. astt. to consrvr., forests, Dec., 1927 and Aug., 1928; consrvr., forests, Jan., 1930.

RANASINHA, ARTHUR GODWIN, B.A. (Lond.)—B. 1898; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1921; attd. to Kegalla Kach., Mar., 1921; attd., Jaffna kach., Oct., 1922; pol. mag. Pt. Pedro, Mar., 1923; ditto, Balapitiya, Nov., 1923; ditto, Jaffna, June, 1926; dist. judge, Avisawella, Apr., 1928; ditto, Badulla, Jan., 1930; sec. to min. for agr. and lands, June, 1933.

RANKINE, SIR RICHARD SIMS DONKIN, K.C.M.G. (1932), C.M.G. (1919).—B. 1875; clk. treasury, Fiji, Feb., 1894; priv. sec. to Sir George O'Brien, Sept., 1897 to 1901; acted clk. to ex. coun. Sept., 1899 to Mar., 1900; apptd. acct. native taxes, treas., 1901; priv. sec. to Sir Henry Jackson, July, 1902; priv. sec. to Sir E. im Thurn, Oct., 1904; conf. sec., Jan., 1906; sec. to consul-gen. for W. Pacific; clk. of exec. coun.; ag. sec., W. Pacific high comnr., June, 1905 to June, 1906, and from Nov., 1907 to Dec., 1908; astt. col. sec. and astt. recvr.-gen. Jan., 1909; recvr.-gen. and comnr. of stamps, pres. of marine bd., mem. exec. and legis. couns., 1910; ag. col. sec., Nov., 1913 to Nov., 1914; govr.'s dep., in June, 1914; comnr. of currency, Dec., 1914; ag. agt. gen. of immigrn. (conjoint), Mar., 1915; ag. col. sec., Aug., 1915 to May, 1916; govr.'s deputy, Aug., Oct., Dec., 1915; ag. col. sec. on various occasions, 1917-19; on sp. mission to India as personal rep. of the govr. in connection with emigrn. of Indians to Fiji, Oct., 1919 to June, 1920; ch. sec., Nyassaland Prot., July, 1920; ag. govr., on various occasions, 1921-24 and in 1926; ch. sec., Uganda, Aug., 1927; admstve. govt., June to Oct., 1928; Br. res., Zanzibar, 1929.

RANSOM, HON. SIR ETHELBERT ALFRED, K.C.M.G. (1935).—B. 1868; ed. lower Hutt state schl., N.Z.; mem., N.Z. H. of R. since 1922; min. of pub. wks., 1928-30; min. of lands and comnr., state forests, 1930; min., same offices, coalition min'y., 1931.

RANSOM, HERBERT CHARLES, O.B.E. (1923), M.B.E. (1920).—B. 1881; entd. crown agt.'s off., May, 1901; astt. cashier, Mar., 1914; ag. head of appts. dept. and astt. sec., Jan., 1917; head of miscellaneous dept., Apr., 1919; dep. head, gen. dept., 14th Nov., 1921; sec., Dead Sea mineral reses. comte., 1923; sec., Palestine currency bd., 1926-30; ch. clk. and head, gen. dept., Feb., 1930; head, finance dept., Nov., 1933.

READ, ALEXANDER LLEWELLYN.—B. 1877; ent. pub. serv., S. Australia, 1891; ch. sec.'s office, 1920; under sec., sec. to premier and elk., exec. coun., June, 1931.

READ, SIR HERBERT JAMES, G.C.M.G. (1935), K.C.M.G. (1918), C.B. (1914), C.M.G. (1907).—B. 1863; M.A., Brasenose Coll., Oxford; 1st class math. mods., and 1st class math. finals; elk., higher div., W.O., Feb., 1887; 2nd class clk., C.O., Jan., 1889; astt. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, Sept., 1896; priv. sec. to Mr. (afterwards Sir E.) Wingfield, Feb., 1898; 1st cls. elk., Oct., 1898; principal elk., Apr., 1905; British delegate at African liquor confce. at Brussels, 1899; one of the Brit. delegates on boundy. comm. at Berlin for the settm. of Anglo-German frontier in E. Africa, 1906; one of the Brit. plenipotentaries at African liquor confce. at Brussels, 1906; mem. of hon. man. comte. of sleeping sickness bureau, 1908; chmn. of doptmtl. comte., to inquire into W. African med. staff, 1909; visited E. Africa, 1911-12; sen. mem., C.O. delegation at Paris Peace Confce., 1919; astt. under-sec. of state, March, 1916; regar. of the Order of Saint Michael and Saint George; gov., Mauritius, 1924 to 1930; hon. mem., managing comte., Imp. Inst. of Entomology, 1931; hon. mem., managing comte., Imp. Mycological Inst., 1932.

REAKES, CHARLES JOHN, C.B.E. (1919), M.R.C.V.S., Eng., Doctor of Vet. Defence Forces with rank of lieut.-col. (since col.), 1909; dir.-gen., agr. dept., 1918.

REAY, CAPT. GEORGE HENRY NOEL, A.M.I.E.E., D.F.H.—B. 1889; astt. teleg. engnr., F.M.S., Jan., 1914; war serv., 1915-19; elec. inspr., F.M.S., Nov., 1920; elec. engnr., P.W.D., Singapore, July, 1922.

REDELINGHUYS, JOHANNES NICOLAAS.—Cape post and tel. serv., 1899; sec.'s office, Cape Town, 1909; senr. elk., 1920; ch. elk., 1924; astt. under sec., 1926; under sec. and astt. P.M.G., 1927.

REDFEARN, PERCY WILLIAM.—B. 1890; loco. acctnt., F.M.S. rly., Dec., 1919; astt. acctnt., Jan., 1925; fincl. offr., July, 1928; offotg. sr. astt. acctnt., F.M.S. rly., Aug., 1933.

REDMAN, ROBERT CARNE.—B. 1904; ed. Bromsgrove; admitted as solr., 1927; astt. admstr-genl., Tanganyika Territory, 1930; ag. admstr-genl., offl. recr., pub. trustee, regar. companies, trade marks, patents, designs, trade unions, regar. genl., births, deaths, marriages, house tax and estate duty commr., 1935.

REECE, C. MANSEL.—B. 1894; ed. Roseall and Magdalene Coll., Cambridge; war serv., 1914-18 (ment. in despa.); called to bar, Inner Temple, 1921; prte. practice, Shanghai, 1921-26; mag., Zanzibar, 1927; ag. puisne judge, Apr.-July, 1929; crown coun., Uganda, 1930; ag. solr.-gen. in 1930, 1931, 1932 and 1933; atty.-gen., Grenada, Nov., 1933; K.C., 1934; regar., sup. ct., Gibraltar, 1935; comsrr. to revise laws of Grenada.

REECE, COURTENAY, WALTON, B.A.—B. 1899; ed. Harrison Coll. and Codrington Coll., Barbados and Jesus Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1926; pol. mag., dist. "D", Barbados, 1926; do., dist. "B", 1930; reg., 1931; ag. judge, astt. ot. of appl., various periods, 1927-34.

REECE, GERALD.—B.1897; ed. Rugby Schl.; served in France with Sherwood Foresters, 1915-18; solr., sup. ct., England, 1921; admstve. cadet, Kenya, 1925; dist. offr., 1927; ag. consul for S. Abyssinia, 1932; consul, do., June, 1934.

REED, CLINTON AUSTIN, O.B.E. (1930).—B. 1876; ent., civ. serv., Barbados, 1898; war serv., 1916-19; inspr., pol. and astt. supt., fire brig., 1919; ag. inspr.-gen., pol., various periods 1920-23; gov., Glendalough prison, 1923; comprtr., cust., 1932; ag. col. sec., various periods, 1934-35.

REED, E. A.—B. 1894; on mily. serv., Aug., 1914-Jan., 1918; temp. paper keeper, C.O. lib., 22nd Nov., 1920-15th Aug., 1924; estab. paper keeper (library attendant) after qual. exam., 16th Aug., 1924; cler. offr., 31st Oct., 1928.

REED, EDWARD BOYS, P.A.S.I., F.R.G.S.—B. 1881; ed. S. Savior's, Eastbourne, Hurst and County Tech. Coll., Sussex; land survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1906; 1st grade survr., 1913; on mily. serv., capt. REED, HON. JOHN RANKEN, C.B.E. (1919).—B. 1864; ed. Gram. Schl., Auckland, N.Z., Victoria Coll., Jersey, and Clare Coll., Cambridge; judge, N.Z. sup. ct., 1921; pres., prisons bd., 1928; judge advoc.-gen., N.Z. Defence Forces, with rank of colonel, 1911-33.

REED, THOMAS BOUCHER.—B. 1892; ed. St. Stanislaus Coll. and Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana; joined lands and mines dept., Br. REES-DAVIES, SIR WM., KT. BACH. (1913).—B. 1863; ed. Eton and Trin. Hall, Camb.; B.A., 1885; called to bar (Inner Temp.), 1887; went South Wales circuit; J.P. and dep. lieut. Harcourt when chancellor of exchequer, 1893-5, and afterwards from 1895-8; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1897; administered the govt., 1901; ag. ch. just., 1902; King's advocate, Cyprus, Oct., 1902; atty.-gen., Hong Kong, 1906; K.C., 1908; ag. ch. just., 1909-10; ch. just., Hong Kong, 1912; chmn. of gen. mily. serv. tribunal, 1918; chmn., pub. serv. comen., Hong Kong, 1919; chmn., exec. comte. on the visit of H.R.H. The Prince of Wales, 1922; ret., 1924.

REEVE, GEORGE WALKER, B.A. (Alta., Canada).—B. 1887; on mil. serv., 1914-19; admstve. branch, A.I.P., Air Miny., 1918-22; astt. mast. educn. dept., Hong Kong, Mar., 1922; lectr.,
Hong Kong Univ., 1925-33; 2nd mast., Queen's Coll., 1931 and 1933; headmr., Wantai schl., 1934.

REEVES, CHARLES JAMES.—B. 1875; entd. office consulting engns. to W. African govt. rly., 1895; apptd. to Crown Agents office, 1911; ast. head, appts. dept., 1919; dep. head, do., 1933.

REID, C. B. B., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.).—Capt., R.A.M.C., 1917-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Feb., 1919.

REID, HAROLD WALLACE, B.Sc.—B. 1897; dep. inspr., mines, Trinidad, Sept., 1927.

REID, JAMES STUART WELLBURY, M.A. (Edin.).—B. 1899; ed. George Watson's Coll. and Edin. Univ.; cadet, F.M.S., Oct., 1921; attchd. land office, Kajang, Nov., 1921; dist. office, L. REIDY, CAPT. MISCELL JOHN, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1888; ed. Royal Veterinary Coll., Dublin; Fiji, 1922; ast. col. vet. surg., Hong Kong, 1924.

REILLY, BERNARD JOSEPH.—B. 1898; forestry and colonists' dipls., Edin. Univ.; Imp. REILLY, SIR BERNARD RAWDON, K.C.M.G. (1934), C.I.E. (1926), O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1882; ed. Bedford; joined Indian Army, 1902; ent. Indian polit. dept., 1908; served in India and Aden in various appts.; officiated as polit. res., Aden, 1925 and 1926, and as res. and commdr.-in-ch., Aden, 1930 and 1931; res. and commdr.-in-ch., Mar., 1931; ch. comntr., Aden, Apr., 1932.

REILLY, ROBERT O'MALLEY, C.B.E. (1935).—Sub-inspr., Bechuanaaland Prot. police, 1904; passed Cape civ. ser. lower law exam., 1909; ag. ast. res. mag., 1912; inspr., Apr., 1914; ag. res. mag., 1914; res. mag., 1921; passed 3rd grade Secwana exam., 1922; ast. res. comntr., Oct., 1931; ag. res. comntr., April to Oct., 1932 and Mar.-Sept., 1935.

REIMERS, EDMUND., M.B.R. (1934).—B. 1881; archivist and librarian, Ceylon, Oct., 1921.

REINECKE, THEODORE GERALD WELLERBY, M.So. Agr.—B. 1888; lect. in chem., Schl. of Agr., Potchefstroom, 1910; prin. Schl. of Agr., Elsenburg, 1918; do., Potchefstroom, 1920; dir., Stellenbosch-Elsenburg Coll. of Agr., 1926; prin. Schl. of Agr., Glen, O.F.S., 1929; dir., native agr., Union native affrs. dept., Pretoria, 1934.

REITZ, HON. DENNY.—B. 1882; M.P. for Bloemfontein, 1920; M.P. for Port Elizabeth, 1920-27; M.P. for Barberton, 1929; min. of lands, Smuts cabinet, 1921-24; min. of lands, coalition cab., 1933; min., agr., irrig., and forestry, 1936.

REJAS, FELIX.—B. 1886; entd. civ. ser., Trinidad, Feb., 1887; warden, July, 1912.

RENDEK, HILARY CAMERON RUSSEL.—B. 1899; ed. Christ Coll., N. Zealand, Cantby Coll., Univ. of N.Z. and New Coll., Oxford; cadet F.M.S., Nov., 1921; passed cadet, July, 1923; offr., cls. RENNIE, ALFRED BAILEY, LL.B.—B. 1896; ed. King's Coll., Lond.; lieut., B.W.I.R.; war serv., 1916-19; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1922; clk. of cts., Jamaica, May, 1929; res. mag., Jan., 1933; ag. judge, Kingston ct., Jan.-Dec., 1933.

RENNIE, GILBERT McCALL, M.C., M.A. (Glass).—B. 1895; on mily. serv., July, 1915; cadet, Ceylon, Apr., 1920; attd. to Anuradhapura kachcheri, June, 1920; attd. to N'Eliya kachcheri, Nov., 1920; office ast. to govt. agt. REX, MARCUS.—B. 1886; ed. Highgate and Trin. Coll., Camb. (exhbr.); B.A., 1908; cadet, F.M.S., 1910; ast. sec. to res., Perak, 1912 and 1915; ast. dist. offr., K. Kangsar, 1913; supt., chandu monopoly, Sel., N.S. and Pahang, 1917; dist. offr., Raub, 1919; mag., K. Lumpur, June, 1921, sec., retrenchment comn., in addn., Feb., 1922; dep. contr. of rubber expts., in addn., Oct., 1922; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1922; offr., cls. REY, CHARLES FERNAND, C.M.G. (1932)—B. 1877; W. Africa, 1900; joined B. of T. 1900; sec. to China Tariff coman., 1902; to Imp. Inst. Advisory Comtee. and Imp. Inst. Trustees, 1903; to All Red Route Comtees., 1904; Roumanian Treaty Negotiations, 1905; mission to Constantipole and Sofia, 1905; Swiss Treaty negotiations, 1906; gen. man., lab. exchange and unemployment insurance, 1909; ast. gen. sec., miny. of munitions 1916; dir., employment dept., B. of T., 1917; dir.-gen., national lab. supply, miny. of national service, 1918; chmn. and Br. rep., Inter-Allied coman., Rotterdam, for food supply to Germany; seconded for serv. in Abyssinia, 1919; further journeys to Abyssinia, 1922-3, 1925-6.
1926-7; unemployment grants comte., 1920-29; asst. res. commr., Bechuanaland Prot., Oct., 1929; res. commr., June, 1930; F.R.G.S., commdr., Order of the Star of Ethiopia; author of "Unconquered Abyssinia as it is to-day," 1923; "In the country of the Blue Nile," 1927; "The Romance of the Portuguese in Abyssinia," 1929; "The Lady or the Leopard," 1929; contributions to the Royal Geographical Jnl. and the Jnl. of the African Society.

REYNOLDS, A. E.—B. 1881; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Aug., 1900; conf. clk., 1st Jan., 1918.

RHODES, ALEC LEOPOLD.—B. 1884; gen. foreman, govt. printing and stationery dept., Trinidad 1921; typography instr., bd. of indus. training, 1922; mem., bd. indus. training, 1923; govt. printer, 1925.

RHODES, HON. E. N., P.C. (Can.), K.C., B.A., LL.B., D.C.L.—B. 1877; ed. Amherst Acad., Acadia Univ. and Dalhousie Univ.; apptd. K.C., Nova Scotia, May, 1916; 1st el. to H. of C. RHODES, BRIG.-GEN. SIR GODFREY DEAN, Kt. Bach. (1934). C.B.E., D.S.O., R.E.(ret.), M.E.I.C., M.Inst.T., A.M.I.C.E.—Ch. engnr., Kenya and Uganda rly., 1920; gen. manager, 1923.

RHODES, HON. SIR ROBERT HEATON, K.C.V.O. (1927), K.B.E. (1920).—B. 1861; B.A. Oxford; entd. New Zealand parlmt., 1899; served in S. African war (Queen's medal and 4 clasps); lt.-col., 1st Regt., Canterbury Rifles Yeomanry Cavalry; postm-r-gen., min. of telegraphs, min. of pub. health, 1912-1915; min. of defence, 1920-26; commr., state forests, 1922-26; leader of leg. coun. and mem., exec. coun. without portfolio, 1926; dep. leader, leg. coun., 1927; ret. from office, 1928 and from leg. coun., 1932; re-apptd., M.L.C., 1934.

RHODES, WILLIAM FREDERICK, B.A. (Cantab), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.P.H. (Oxon.).—B. 1884; ed. Bromsgrove Schi., Cambridge Univ. and St. Thomas' Hosp.; sen. govt. pathologist, and offr.-in-charge, govt. vaccine inst., Cape Town.

RICE, HARRY PATRICK, O.B.E. (1934).—B. 1886; S.A. constabl., 1906-15; K.A.R., 1916-19; asst. supt., pol., Kenya, Nov., 1919; supt., 1926; dep. commdt., pol. (C.I.D.), Palestine, 1932; dep. inspr.-gen., 1936.

RICE, J. A., B.A., LL.B., (T.C.D.)—B. 1904; ed. Clongowes; admitted solr., sup. ct., I.F.S.; asst. commr., lands, lands dept., Gold Coast, 1927; ag. commr., lands, Apr., 1935.

RICH, HON. SIR GEO. EDWARD, K.C.M.G. (1932).—Senr. puisane just. of the high court of Australia, Apr., 1913.

RICHARDS, ARTHUR COURTNEY.—B. 1896; 2nd asst. govt. printer, Ceylon, Sept., 1920; asst. govt. printer, Apr., 1923; govt. printer, Apr., 1932.

RICHARDS, SIR ARTHUR FREDERICK, K.C.M.G. (1935), C.M.G. (1933), B.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1885; ed. Clifton Coll. and Christ Ch., Oxford; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1908; offr., cls. V., May, 1913; mag., cent. ct., Kota Bharu, and state audr., Aug., 1915; adviser, land office, Kedah, and ag. supt. of mines, June, 1916; offr., cls. IV., Jan., 1918; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1920; 1st asst. col. sec., S. Sttlmts., and ag. clk. of couns. in addn., Apr., 1921; gen. sec., S.S. retrenchment comte., in addn., Jan., 1922; on sp. duty, London, May, 1923; sec., opium comte., Br. Malaya in addn., Nov., 1923; chmn., exec. comte., Br. Malaya, Br. Empire Exhibtn., in addn., 1924; offr. cls. Borneo, Mar., 1930; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Gambia, Nov., 1933; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Fiji, and high commr., W. Pacific, 1936.

RICHARDS, DAVID MORGAN, B.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1892; ed. Christ Ch. Cathedral Schl., Oxford, St. David's Coll. Schl., Lampeter, S. Wales and non-collegiate, Oxford; war. serv., 1917-19; mast., educn. dept., F.M.S., Apr., 1921; ditto, Hong Kong, Dec., 1921; ag. head mast., Central Br. Schl., 1922 and 1933; asst. mast., Queen's Coll., 1934.

RICHARDS, EDMUND CHARLES.—B. 1889; agr. dept., E.A.P., 1909; secr., Nyasaland, 1912; asst. polit. offr., G.E.A., provl. admstrn., 1917; dist. polit. offr., T.T., 1922; dep. prov. commr., 1928; prov. commr., 1931; dep. ch. sec., 1934; res. commr., Basutoland, May, 1935.

RICHARDS, FRANCIS OTHIENI.—B. 1882; vol. 6th cls. clk., postal dept., Br. Guiana, 1905; cler. asst., genl. reg. office, 1907; 6th cls. offr., cust., 1910; 6th cls., 1911; 4th cls., 1916; 3rd cls., 1924; 2nd cls., 1925; 1st cls., 1926; ch. clk., cust., 1927.

RICHARDSON, ALEXANDER STEWART, B.Sc. (Agr.).—B. 1897; ed. Burgh and County High Schl., Peebles; mily. serv., R. Arty., 1916-19; B.Sc., Edinburgh Univ., 1923; dist. agrl. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1924; senr. agrl. offr., 1930.

RICHARDSON, CECILY.—B. 1889; ed. The Laurels, Rugby and Royal Holloway Coll.; B.A., London, 1912; asst. mistress, govt. girls' schl., Penang, 1914; asst. mistress, Raffles girls' schl., Singapore, 1915; ag. prin., 1920 and 1924; prin., St. George's girls' schl., Penang, Sept., 1928.

RICHARDSON, BRIG.-GEN. SIR GEORGE SPAFFORD, K.B.E. (1925), C.B. (1917), C.M.G. (1915), C.B.E. (1919).—B. 1867; enlisted in Royal Artillery, Aug., 1886; attached to N.Z. Forces as instructor in gunnery with rank of master gunner, Aug., 1891; capt., N.Z. militia and dir. of artillery services (N.Z.), Apr., 1907; transf. to N.Z. staff corps, Jan., 1911; major, 1912; lieut.-col., 1915; col., 1919, and brig.-gen. with seniority as from Dec., 1915; N.Z. representative at War Office, London, and attached Impl. gen. staff, Dec., 1913; attached to Admty. staff, Aug., 1914; attached Royal Naval Divn. as asst. adjutant and qtrmr., Nov., 1914; active service at Antwerp with Royal Naval Divn.; subsequently served as A.A. and Q.M.G. on Gallipoli; selected as D.A. and Q.M.G. of an Army Corps at Salonika with temporary rank of brig.-gen.; comdt., N.Z.E.F. in U.K., Mar., 1916; G.O. in charge admtn., N.Z. Forces, May, 1919; admstr., W. Samoa, 1923-28; also admstr., Tokelau Is., 1926-28; rep. N.Z. before mandates committee, L. of N., 1928; Legion of Honour

(Croix de Chevalier) conferred by Pres. of the French Republic, 1916; ment. in despatches (3).

Lancing Coll. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; B.A.; 2nd cls. juris-prudence, 1923; called to bar, Inner Temple, Jan., 1927; cadet, Tanganyika Territory admntrn., May, 1924; asst. sec. Dec., 1924; attd. as asst. prin., C.O., Feb. to Aug., 1927; ag. crown coun. in 1929 and 1932; ag. asst. admstr. gen. and registr., companies, 1929; ag. res. mag., 1934; ag. sec., dept., lands and mines, 1935; sec., Tanganyika soil erosion and gold mining industry comtees.

RICHES, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1885; on mily. serv., Jan., 1915 to Mar., 1919; 2nd lieut., London Scottish, Sept., 1917; apptd. to army audit staff, Eastern command, 1921; cler. offr., C.O., 17th July, 1922.

RICHMOND, ERNEST TATHAM, F.R.I.B.A.—B. 1874; ed. High Croft Schl., Clifton Coll., Bristol, Architectural Schl., Westminster and R. Acad. Architectural Schl.; archt. to pub. wks. miny., Egypt, 1900; subsequently dir.-gen. state bldgs. dept.; attd., dept. of fortifns. and wks., W.O., Dec., 1914—Oct., 1916; in ch. grenade sec., trench warfare dept., miny. of munitions, Mar., 1917; lieut. R.N.V.R., Mar., 1917; archt. attd. to war graves serv., France, 1918-19; asst. civ. sec., Palestine, 1920; dir., antiquities, 1927.

RIDDELL, WALTER ALEXANDER, M.A., PH.D.—Supt., trades and lab. dept. of pub. wks., Ontario govt., 1916; dep. min. of lab., Ontario, 1919; ch. of agril. serv., Internat. Lab. Office, L. of N. Jan., 1920; Dominion of Canada advisory offr. to L. of N., Geneva, 1925.

RIDDELL, HON. WILLIAM RENWICK.—B. 1852; ed. Cobourg, Ont., Coll. Inst. and Victoria Univ., Toronto; lecturer in maths, Normal Schl., Ottawa, 4 years; called to bar, 1883; Q.C., 1897; bencher, Law Soc., Upper Can., since 1892; judge, high ct., Ont., King's Bench dvn., 1906; judge, appellate dvn. (second divi. ct.), 1913; hon. mem., American Bar Assc., and of Bar Assocs. of several states; R.F. Hist. Soc., England; F.R.S.C., Can.; LL.D., Toronto, Yale, McMaster, Lafayette, Rochester, Wesleyan, North Western Univs.; L.H.D., Syracuse Univ.; J.U.D., Trinity Coll., (Toronto); author of several legal and hist. works; has contrib. extensively to hist., scientific and literary jnl.

RIDGEWAY, THE RT. HON. SIR J. WEST, G.C.B. (1906), G.C.M.G. (1900), K.C.S.I., P.C. (Ireland).—B. 1841; ret. from the army with the rank of col., 1889; under-secr., foreign dept., India, 1881-5; commr. for delimitation of Afghan frontier, 1885-7; under-secr. to lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1887; lieut.-gov. of the Isle of Man, 1893; gov. of Ceylon, Dec., 1895-1903; chmn. of commn. sent to S. Africa on Transvaal constitution, 1906; mem. of hon. man. comttee. of sleeping sickness bureau, 1908; chmn., et. of dirs., H. R. N. Borneo Co., 1910.

RIDGWAY, T. R. J.—Asst. supt., pol., Kenya, Dec., 1923; supt., pol., 1935.

RIGBY, WILLIAM EDWARD, M.C.—B. 1897; ed. Bury Gram. Schl.; served in France, Aug., 1916-Mar., 1918 and June, 1918-Nov., 1919; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1920; attchd., Chinese Prot., Penang, Dec., 1920; passed cadet, Nov., 1923; offr., cls. V, Nov., 1923; asst. supt. govt. monops., S'pore and asst. contrlr., rubber, Mar., 1926; offr., cls. IV, Nov., 1927; 3rd mag., S'pore, June, 1930; inspr., prisons, in addn., Sept., 1931; relief asst. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Nov., 1932, offr., cls. III; asst. Malayan estabmt. offr., Sept., 1933.

RIGNELL, JOHN HERBERT.—B. 1886; Scots Guards, 1904-25; mily. prov., staff corps, 1911; warrant offr., cl. I., 1920-25; physical training instr., Trinity Coll., Kandy, Ceylon, 1915-19; physical training instr., Achimota Coll., Gold Coast, Sept., 1925.

RIMINGTON, CAPT. G.B.—Asst. dist. commr., Kenya, May, 1920.

RINFRET, HON. FERNAND, B.A., M.P.—B. 1883; ed. St. Mary's Coll., Quebec (B.A.); ed. St. James divn., Montreal bye-el., 1919; re-el. 1921, 1925, 1926 and 1930; sec. of state, Sept., 1926; re-el. by accl., Nov., 1926; mayor, Montreal, 1932-34; re-el., H. of C., 1933; sec. of state, Oct., 1935.

RINFRET, HON. THIBAUDEAU.—B. 1879; ed. St. Mary's Coll. (B.A., 1897), McGill Univ. (B.C.L., 1900); called to Quebec bar, 1901; K.C., 1912; min. of roads in Quebec Govt., 1910-22; prof., munic. law and law of public utilities, McGill Univ.; judge, sup. ct., Canada, Sept., 1924.

RING, JULIUS, B.Sc. (Eng.) (Birm.), F.S.I., Chart. Surveyor, A.M.I.Struc.E.—B. 1892; engnr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1925; asst. assessor, rates, 1928; 1st asst. do., 1933.

RIPPON, STEWART ROSS, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1895; lieut. R.A.V.C., Jan., 1917; serv. in Salonica, Macedonia, and with Army of Black Sea; capt., Jan., 1918; demob., Jan., 1921; vety. offr., Gold Coast, May, 1921.

RISLEY, SIR JOHN SHUCKBURGH, K.C.M.G. (1922), K.C. (1921), C.B. (1912)—B. 1867; ed. at Marlborough and Magd. Coll., Oxford (classical exhibitioner); 2nd class classical mods., 1888; 2nd class jurisprudence, 1890; open studentship, Inns of Court, 1892; called to the bar, 1893; M.A. and B.C.L., 1894; author of "The Founding of St. Stephen's Golf Club," 1893; "The Law of War," 1897; "Notes and Echoes," 1902; editor of Dale's "Clergyman's Legal Handbook," 7th edition; joint editor of Waterlow's "Companies Acts Manual," 11th and 12th editions; legal assistant, C.O., March, 1901; legal adviser, 19th May, 1911.

RITCHIE, CAPT. A. T. A., O.B.E. (1936), M.C., B.A. (Oxon)—Game warden, Kenya, 1923.

RITCHIE, J. D.—Ck., agril. dept., Kenya, Aug., 1912; head ck. and acct., cust. dept., Sept., 1922.

RITCHIE, T. M.—B. 1895; foreman of wks., P.W.D., Gold Coast, 1925; inspr. of wks., 1928; mast., Accra Tech. Schl., 1930.

ROBERTS, ANTHUR HALLAM, B.A. (Cantab).—B. 1888; ed. Aldenham schl. and Jesus Coll., Camb.; called to bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1914; cadet, Fiji, Jan., 1915; priv. sec. to gov., Mar., 1915; ag. 1st cls. clk., col. sec's office and clk. to exec. and leg. coun., Jan., 1916; passed cadet, June, 1916; priv. sec., Oct., 1916; 2nd grade dist. commr., Oct., 1916; ag. crown solr., July, 1917; assigned dist. of Sava Savu, Aug., 1917; act. serv., June, 1918; dist. commr., Navua, Dec., 1919; resigned, Oct., 1920; el. mem., leg. coun., 1923-26; registr., sup. ct., taxing master, curator, pub. trustee and offr. recr. in bankruptcy, Mar., 1927; ag. atty. gen. in 1931, 1932 and 1935; ch. pol. mag., Aug., 1931.

ROBERTS, GEORGE.—B. 1885; ent. Admty., 1902; seconded as exec. engrnr., Falkland Is., 1925; col. engrnr., 1928; mem., leg. coun., 1929; title of office altered to dir., pub. wks., 1931.

ROBERTS, GEORGE FORSE.—B. 1881; ed. Univ. Coll., London; telegraphist, G.P.O., Sept.,
1897; 2nd div. olk., exchequer and audit dept., treas., Gold Coast, Feb., 1929; capt., G.C. Defence Force.

ROBERTSON, COLIN BROWN.—B. 1893; ed. Leven higher grade; architect, P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1920.

ROBERTSON, IAN DONALD, A.M.I.C.E., Chartered Civil Engrn.—B. 1886; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Jly., 1914; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., irrigation br., Aug., 1916, Aug., 1919 and Nov., 1921; dir., wks., Kelantan, Jan., 1923; exec. engrnr., Jan., 1925; sr. exec. engrnr., P.W.D., S.S. and F.M.S., 1933.

ROBERTSON, THOMAS ROBERT.—B. 1875; ed. Glenalmond, M.E., Ch.B., Edin.; formerly house surgeon and physician, Swansea hosp. and Victoria Park hosp. for chest diseases; civil surg., S. African Field Force, 1901-2 (medal and three clasps); astt. comsnr. and gen. med. offr., Salt Cay, Turks Is., 1905; dist. comsnr. and gen. med. offr., Caicos Is., 1905; gen. med. offr., Grand Turk, 1909.

ROBERTSON, SIR W. C. F., K.C.M.G. (1927), C.M.G. (1919).—Ed. Trin. Coll., Dublin; exhibitioner, 1885 and 1887; classical scholar, 1888; classical moderator, 1889; inspr., schls. G. Coast, 1898; dir. educn., 1899; ag. comprtr., cust., 1899; compiled census rept., 1901; ag. sec., native affairs, June to Nov., 1905; prov. comsnr., Nov., 1905; sec. for native affairs, May, 1907; ag. col. sec., July to Sept., 1908; chief astt. col. sec., Jan., 1909; ag. col. sec., in 1909, 1910, 1911, 1912, 1913; deputy gov., Jan., 1910; dep. gov., Dec., 1912, and April to May, 1913; ag. gov., May to Aug., 1914; dep. gov., Aug. to Sept., 1914; col. sec., Gibraltar, Feb., 1915; liut.-gov. and chief sec. to govt., Malta, May, 1917; offr. admstg. govt., Malta, for various periods, 1920-25; gov.'s dep., in Oct., 1920; liut. gov. by comsnr. under new constitution, Apr., 1921; gov.'s dep., for various periods in 1920 and 1922; hon. L.L.D., Malta Univ., 1925; gov., Barbados, 1926; attended C.O. conferees, 1927 and 1930; ret., 1932.

ROBERTSON, WILLIAM.—B.1875; ed. Palmerston Dist. High Schl., N.Z.; N.Z. dept. of lands and survey, 1892; inspr., 1919; astt. under-sec., 1926; under-sec., 1931.

ROBINSON, CAPT. ARTHUR GORDON, B.Sc. (Eng.), M.Inst.C.E.—B. 1887; ed. St. Asaph gram. schl., N. Wales and Birmingham Univ.; astt. engrnr., pub. works dept., F.M.S., June, 1912; seconded, Kedah, July, 1912; B.E.F., France, Mar., 1917-Jan., 1919; capt., commanding Indian labt., liut., R.E.; ex. engrnr., pub. works dept., F.M.S., June, 1921; sen. ex. engrnr., pub. works dept., F.M.S., July, 1928; ch. hydraulic engrnr., 1930; astt. advr., drainage and irrign., Malay States, Jan., 1932.

ROBINSON, AUBREY CHARLES.—B. 1875; ed. Lancing Coll., and Hertford Coll., Oxford; B.A.; called to the bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1901; practised at the bar, Jamaica, 1901 to 1911; comsnr., and judge of grand ct., Cayman Is., Jan., 1913; compd. revised edition of Laws of Cayman Is. (publcn. deferred during the war); regist.-gen., Bahamas, Jan., 1918; perf. duties of S. and C. mag. in July and Dec., 1918 and from Mar., 1919; regist.-gen., Trinidad, Aug., 1919; ag. regir., supt. et. and marshal, June to Sept., 1920; rec. mag., Jamaica, Sept., 1923; regist., sub. ct. and regist.-gen., Trinidad, Nov., 1928; 2nd puisne judge, Aug., 1931.

ROBINSON, GEORGE GILMOUR—B. 1894; ed. Repton and Trinity Coll., Oxon., B.A., M.A.;
war serv., 1914-19 (France); called to bar, Inner Temple, 1924; practised, 1924-30; res. mag., Kenya, 1930.

ROBINSON, INNES LOVELL.—B. 1904; ed. Marlborough and Jesus Coll., Cambridge (2nd cls. hons. classics); cadet, Tanganyika, 1927; asst. dist. offr., 1929; ag. dist. offr., in 1932-34.

ROBINSON, MONTGOMERY BLAIR.—B. 1878; B.A., Trinity Coll., Dublin, 1901; LL.B., Univ. of Cape of Good Hope, 1909; elk. law dept., Cape, 1903; mag., 1921; ch. clk., dept. of just., 1929; addnl. mag., Pretoria, June, 1931.

ROBINSON, S.—B. 1883; ed. Barnsley Gram. Schl. and Univ. of Sheffield; B.A., 1914; 1st cls. hons. mod. lang.; M.A., 1919; on milly. serv., 1914-19; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, junr. clk., bd. of cust. and excise, Sept., 1919; asst. prin., 1st Jan., 1920; transf. to C.O. as priv. sec. (appts.) to successive secs. of State, 1923-24; asst. pvt. sec. to Lord Passfield, Sept., 1929; prin., 1st Oct., 1930.

ROBINSON, LIEUT.-COL. SIR THOMAS BILBE, K.C.M.G. (1913), KT. BACH (1910), K.B.E. (1918).—B. 1853; formerly major in command of 1st Queenslanders, and senior offr. in Cent. Queensland; man. and dir. of various public companies; J.P., Queensland, 1887; pres. of Rockhampton chamber of commerce; Queensland commnr. for Franco-British exhibn.; agt.-gen. for Queensland, 1910; mem. of comtee. for settm. of ex-serv. men within the Empire, 1917.

ROCK, ALFRED MILTON.—B. 1888; ag. 3rd outdoor offr. and harbour., treasy., Dominica, 1913-15; clk. and interpreter to mag., dist. "E," Mar., 1915; clk., mag., regiar. and provost marshal "A," comsnr. of oaths, dep. coroner, Montserrat, Sept., 1916; clk. to mag., dist. "A" and "B," dep. coroner, Antigua, Nov., 1920; senr.-clk., regiar.'s office, clk., sup. ct. law library, "A" comsnr. of oaths, dep. coroner, Dominica, May, 1927; prin. for duty as regiar. and provost marshal, regiar. of titles, admir. of estates and regiar.-gen. of births, marriages and deaths, Dominica, Apr., 1929.

RODD, A. J.—B. 1886; apptd., after exam., asst. library attendant, C.O., 11th Dec., 1905; library attendant, 18th Feb., 1911; supplementary clk., col. audit dept., Apr., 1914; on mil. serv. from 5th Aug., 1914 to 1919; regiar., 1st Apr., 1928.

RODDA, GEORGE CHARLES, M.B.E. (1919), F.R.A.N.Z., F.L.A.N.Z.—B. 1878; ed. Stafford schl., Hokitika dist. high schl. and Victoria univ. coll., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. govt. insur. dept., 1894; treas., 1902; offr. in ch., war expenses, 1914-19; sec., local govt. loans bd. 1927-30; asst. sec., treasy., 1930; sec., treasy., recvr.-gen., paymr.-gen., 1935; also chmn. local govt. loans bd., finan. advr. to govt., and ex officio dir., reserve bank, 1935; attd. N.Z. deleg., world economic confce., 1933.

RODEN, SIR ROBERT BLAIR, KT. BACH. (1918).—B. 1860; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1902; clk., public library, Antigua, 1880; 2nd clk. to the gov., Leeward Is., 1881; acted on several occasions as ch. clk., and as clk. to the logs., and exec. couns., and as a dist. mag., Antigua; also acted as priv. sec. to different govs., Leeward Is., in 1883, 1890, 1895 and 1896; mag., Nevis, 1890; mem. St. Kitts and Nevis legis. couns., 1891; mem., fed. leg. coun., Leeward Is., 1896-9; mag., Bridgetown, Barbados, 1903; visiting justice, Glendairy prs., 1904; ch. just., St. Vincent, 1912; admnstd. govt. of St. Vincent from Oct., 1912 to Feb., 1913, and for short periods in Apr., Aug., and Dec., 1913; also from Mar. to Nov., 1914; ch. just., Br. Honduras, Feb., 1915; chmn. of food control comtee., Jan., 1918; ret., 1921.

RODGER, ROBERT, A.M.Inst.C.E., A.M.I. Mech.E., A.M.Inst.M. & Cy.E., M.I.Struc.E., F.R.G.S.—B. 1893; ed. Wishaw High Schl., Wishaw Tech. Schl. and Glasgow Tech. Coll. (affiltd.); on active serv. with Lanarkshire Yeo., (Lowld. Mtd. Bde., Soot., T.F.) 1914-20; dist. engrnr., P.W.D., Palestine, 1924; road engrnr., P.W.D., Gold Coast, on "Tarmet" Scheme 1926; road engrnr., P.W.D., Nigeria, on road development schemes, 1930; road engrnr., P.W.D., Cyprus, 1930; ag. asst. dir., pub. wks., in 1931 and 1932.

RODRIGO, EDMUND.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attd. Kurunegala Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; office asst. to govt. agt., W.Prov., May, 1915; mun. mag., Colombo, Oct., 1915; pol. mag., Puttalam, July, 1917; office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuva, Sept., 1918; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Apr., 1920; ditto, Matara, May, 1922; asst. comsnr., excise, Sept., 1924; dep. comsnr., excise, Sept., 1927; contr., finance and supplies, July, 1931; asst. govt. agt., Puttalam, July, 1932; ag. govt. agt., N. Prov., July, 1933.

RODWELL, SIR CECIL HUNTER, G.C.M.G., (1934), K.C.M.G. (1919), C.M.G. (1909).—Ed. Eton and King's Coll., Camb., B.A., 1897; serv. on staff of high comsnr. for S. Africa since Dec., 1900; Imperial sec., Mar., 1904; gov., Fiji, and high comsnr., W. Pacific, 1918; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., B. Guiana, 1925; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Southern Rhodesia, Sept., 1928; ret., Dec., 1934.

ROE, ROBERT JESTIN, M.R.C.V.S. (Williams Memorial Prize), D.V.S.M.—B. 1897; ed. Drogheda and R. Vety. Coll., Ireland; war. serv., 1915-16; vety. surg., Cyprus, June, 1921; passed exam. in mod. Greek, Jan., 1923; del. to Imp. Agric. Research Confce., 1927; ag. dir., animal husbandry, July-Oct., 1928; title changed to ch. vety. offr., Jan., 1930; rep. govt. Internat. Dairy Cong., Copenhagen, 1931.

ROGERS, FRANCIS MERVYN.—B.1890; student, R. Botanic Gardens, Kew, 1915; milly. serv., 1916-19; sub-foreman, Kew, 1919-20; head gardener, Amani, Tanganyika Territory, 1920; supt., plantations, E. African agr. research stn., Amani, 1927.

ROGERS, HON. NORMAN McLEOD.—B. 1894; ed. Amherst pub. and high schls. and Acadia Univ.; served Great War; B.A., Acadia Univ., 1919; cl. to Rhodes scholarship at Oxford; B.A. (hist., polit. sci. and law); prof., hist., Acadia Univ.; admitted to Nova Scotia bar; sec.; Rt. Hon. Mackenzie King in his capacity as pres., P.C., 1927; prof., polit. sci., Queen's Univ., 1929; coun. for govt. of Nova Scotia before R. commn. of econ. enquiry, 1934; el. M.P., Canada, g.e. 1935; min. of lab., Mackenzie King cabinet, 1935.

ROGERS, WALTER ERNEST.—B. 1864; ent. civ. serv., S. Australia, 1882; 2nd clk., audit dept., 1912; audr.-gen., S. Aust., 1923.

ROGERSON, WALTER JOHN LANCASHIRE, B.A., Cantab.—B.1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attd. Kandy kach., Jan., 1913; addtl. office asst., Anuradhapura, June, 1914; office asst. to govt. agt., Badulla, Sept., 1914; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1915; office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, May, 1917; pol. mag., Arissawella, Jan., 1921; ditto, Kandy, Feb., 1921; dist. judge Kegalla, Sept., 1922; pol. mag., Colombo, July,
1923; astt. govt. agt., Colombo, Nov., 1925; addnl. govt. agt., N.W.P., Feb., 1930; astt. govt. agt., Nuwara Eliya, Apr., 1931; addnl. govt. agt., W. Prov., Sept., 1933; govt. agt., S.P., Oct., 1934.

ROLSTON, CECIL MICHELL.—M.D., C.M., Univ. of Manitoba, Canada, 1896; L.R.C.P., Edin., F.R.C.S., Edin.; L.R.F.P. and S., Glasgow, 1898; mem. Coll. of Phys. and Surgeons, 1903; F.R.I.; pub. health, London; late civil surg., attached to R.A.M.C. during S. African war, 1900-1902 (Queen's medal, 2 clasps; King's medal, 2 clasps); apptd. to Leeward Is. med. serv., 1903; med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, and ag. med. offr. of pub. instit., 1903; dist. med. offr. of health, Vancouver, B. Columbia, 1910; med. offr., dist. 8, Nevis, 1914; ag. mag., Nevis, May to June, 1915; med. offr., dist. 6, Nevis, Sept., 1915.

ROOKE, CHARLES EUSTACE, M.Inst.T., F.R.S.S.—B. 1892; ed. Dover Coll.; astt. traffic man., Uganda Rly., Oct., 1914; served with Indian Expdy. Force, 1915-17; 2nd lieut., Indian Army R. of O.; astt. traffic man., F.M.S. Rly., Oct., 1919; gen. man., rly., Cyprus, Oct., 1929; traffic man., Tanganyika Rly., 1935.

ROOTHAM, J. ST. J., M.A.—B. 1910; ed. Tonbridge Schl. and St. John's Coll., Cambridge (class scholarship); 1st cls. class, tripes, Pts. I and II; apptd. after compet. exam. astt. prin. min. of agr. and fisheries, 1933; transf. to C.O., July, 1934.

ROOTS, NEVILLE, M.Inst.C.E.—Ed. Tonbridge Schl. and City and Guilds Engng. Coll., S. Kensington; held various engng. appts. in U.K., 1897-1904; inspgr. engr., P.W.D., Jamaica, 1908; astt. dir., P.W.D., 1914; ag. dir., Apr., 1920 to Sept., 1921; dep. dir., Apr., 1922.

ROPER, WILLIAM JAMES.—B. 1891; entd. C.A. office, 1907; seconded to Falkland Is., Aug., 1912; ag. priv. sec. to admstr. and clk. to couns., Aug., 1913; chf. clk. to col. sec., Jan., 1914; ag. local audr., Nov., 1914; retnd. to C.A. office, 1915; served European war (M.G.C., France), 1916-1919; 1st cls. clk., Nyasaland, Jan., 1920; ag. ch. clk., July to Dec., 1921; edr. Gazette, Oct., 1921 to Dec., 1922; ag. 2nd astt. sec. and clk. to exec. and leg. couns., in 1922, 1925 and 1926; organising sec., Nyasaland Vol. Res., Sept., 1926; ag. ch. transport offr., Dec., 1926 to May, 1927; office supt., secretariat, Apr., 1927; sec., govt. tender bd., Mar., 1928; clk., exec. and leg. couns., Mar., 1928; ag. staff offr., Nyasaland Vol. Res., Apr. to Nov., 1929; ag. senr. astt. sec., May, 1929 to June, 1930 and Nov., 1930 to Mar., 1931; supt., census, 1930; astt. sec., Apr., 1931; ag. astt. ch. sec., Apr. to Aug., 1935.

ROSE, ALAN EDWARD PERCIVAL, M.A., LL.B. (Cantab.).—B. 1899; ed. Aldenham Sch. and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; temp. 2nd lieut., Rifle Brig., B.E.F., 1918-19; 2nd cls. hons., law tripes, Cambridge, 1921; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, Jan., 1923; mem., S.E. circuit; ch. pol. mag., Fiji, July, 1929; ag. atty.-gen., June, 1930 to June, 1931; crown coun., N. Rhodesia, Aug., 1931; ag. solr.-gen., on various occasions, 1931-35; ag. atty.-gen. in 1934 and 1935.

ROSE, FREDERIC GARDINER, B.A., 1907, M.R.C.S., Eng., L.R.C.P. Lond., 1911, M.B., B. Chir., U. Camb., D.M.R. & E., Camb., M.D., Camb., M.R.C.P., Lond.—B. 1885; ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; med. ser., B. Guiana, 1915; govt. bac. and path., 1915; ag. G.M.O.H. and port health offr., 1917; ag. G.M.O.H. and port health offr., 1919; govt. radiologist, 1921-22; hon. con. radiologist, 1923; ag. port health offr., 1924; dep. port health offr., 1925; med. supt., lep. hosp., 1926.

ROSE, HON. HUGH EDWARD.—B. 1869; ed. at Jarvis St. Collegiate Inst., Univ. of Toronto; (B.A., 1891; LL.B., 1892), and Osgoode Hall; mem. of the firm of Fasken, Cowan, Chadwick and Rose; called to the bar, Ontario, 1894; K.C., 1908; judge of the sup. ct., Ontario, Dec., 1916; ch. just., high ct., Ont., 1930; examr. in law for some years for University of Toronto and the Law Society of Upper Canada.

ROSEDALE, JOHN LEWIS, Ph.D. (Bonn), D.Sc. (Aberdeen), F.I.C.—B. 1889; prof. of biochemistry, King Edward VII Medical Coll., Singapore, Apr., 1927; offl. deleg. to 8th cong. of Far Eastern Asso. of Trop. Med., Bangkok, Dec., 1930; offl. deleg. to 9th cong., F.E.A.T.M., Nanking, Sept., 1934.

ROSEDALE, WILLIAM ORIEL PELLY.—B. 1891; astt. dist. offr., Nigeria, Aug., 1914; dist. offr., 1924; astt. sec. and clk., exec. and leg. couns., 1927; ag. prin. astt. sec., 1930-31; admstr. offr., clms. I., Oct., 1930.

ROSENOW, JACOBUS DANIEL MALAN, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1884; ed. Boys' Public Schl., Riverdale and Diocesan Coll., Rondebosch; Cape civ. serv., audit office, Capetown, 1903; astt. gen's. office, Capetown, 1907, various mag. offices for 12 years; clk., office of dir., prisons, 1922; jun. prof. astt. att. gen., Natal, 1923; registr., high ct., S.W. Africa, 1926; sen. prof. astt. atty. gen., Natal, 1927; solr. gen., Grahamstown, Mar., 1933.

ROSENOW, RODERICK EDWARD GERHARD.—B. 1893; ed. Somerset West Pub. Schl., Diocesan Coll., Rondebosch, Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch and Univ. of Cape Town; joined bar, Cape Town, Jan., 1923; transf., Windhoek Bar, Jan., 1925; professional astt. to atty.-gen., Windhoek, Apr., 1932; atty.-gen., S.W. Africa, Mar., 1933.

ROSS, CHARLES CLAYE, M.A. (Oxon).—B. 1901; ed. Charterhouse and Magdalene Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Lincoln's Inn, Jan., 1927; pte. practice, 1927-34; atty.-gen., St. Vincent, Aug., 1934; ag. ch. just., Aug., 1934-Feb., 1935; admstr. govt., Aug., 1935; atty.-gen., Grenada, Nov., 1936.

ROSS, DONALD GILLON.—B. 1903; sub-inspr., pol. Jamaica, 1928; 3rd cls. inspr., Mar., 1932.

ROSS, EDWARD ANDREW, M.C.—B. 1895; ed. Leigh Gram. Schl. and Manchester Univ.; on active serv., 1914-19; relinquished comm., 1921 with rank of capt.; cadet, F.M.S., May, 1920; passed cadet, Dec., 1921; supernum'y offr., cls. V., May, 1923; astt. contrlr., lab., Penang, Mar., 1925; offr., cls. IV, May, 1927; attd. for sp. duty to office of offr. assignee and pub. trustee, regnr. of companies and collr., est. duty, F.M.S., May, 1927; astt. contrlr., rubber and astt. dist. judge, S'pore, Oct., 1927; 2nd astt. advr., B. Pahat and mag., Klang, Jan., 1928; astt. advr., Kukup, Sept., 1928; contrlr., lab., Johore, Jan., 1930; offr., cls. III, May, 1932; ag. dep. contrlr., lab., Malaya, Jan., 1934; do., F.M.S., Dec., 1934.

ROSS, GEORGE ARCHIBALD PARK, M.D., Ch.M. (Edin.), D.P.H. (Edin.); diploma, trop. diseases, Liverpool.—B. 1879; S. African War, Lovat's Scouts, 1900-02; Anglo-Portuguese bdry. comm., Zambesia, 1904-5; native rebellion, Natal, 1906; trop. diseases investig., 1906-10; govt. pathologist, Natal, 1911; astt. health offr., Union of S. Africa, statnd. in Natal, 1918; offr. in ch., sleeping sickness bureau, Durban and sanitation offr. Natal, 1914-18; senr. astt. health offr., Union of S. Africa, Natal, 1918; col., S. A.M.C. and A.D.M.S., No. 3 mily. dist., Union S. Africa.
ROSS, J. G. H.—Asst. dist. commr., E.A.P., Sept., 1919; ag. junr. asst. sec., Kenya, Nov., 1919 to Oct., 1919; ag. clk. of exec. and leg. couns., Dec., 1919 to Mar., 1920; editor, offl. Gazette, Feb., 1920 to Mar., 1920.

ROSS, JAMES SANDFORD.—B. 1884; ed. Merchant Taylors Sch.; mily. serv., 1914-19; N.W. Frontier campaign, 1915; Salonica Field Force, 1916-19; asst. treas., Kenya, 1919.

ROSS, OSWALD F.—Ed. Malvern Coll. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; capt., N. Staffs. Regt., European War; served Dardanelles expdn., 1915; Mesopotamia, 1916; passed A.T.S. course, 1920; asst. dist. commr., Gold Coast, 1920.

ROSS-CLUNIS, ROBERT CHATTAN.—B. 1905; ed. South Africa and Westminster; 2nd lieut., N. Rhodesia pol., 1931; lieut., 1933; local commdt., pol., Cyprus, 1934.

ROUNCE, NORMAN VINCE.—B. 1906; ed. Dulwich Coll., Wye Agr. Coll. (dipl. of agr., 1926) St. John's Coll., Oxford (one year), Imp. Coll. Pol. Agr., Trinidad; dist. agr. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1928.

ROUSE, HAROLD STUART, C.E., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1888; ed.
