Truro Coll. and Christ's Hosp.; survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, Feb., 1912; engnr., drainage wks. office, Dec., 1913; transf. to gen. wks. office, P.W.D., Apr., 1915; offr. in charge, G.W.O., May, 1924; sec., water emergency comte., May to Aug., 1929; exec. engnr., roads office, P.W.D., Nov., 1931; do., drainage office, 1934; O.C., N.V.F., Feb., 1934.

ROWAN, WILLIAM ALFRED.—B. and educ. Graaff Reinet, Cape Prov.; civ. serv., lower, 1903; higher, 1907; LL.B., 1921; Rhodesian pol., 1897; O.R.C. pol., 1900; asst. mag., O.F.S., 1905; addnl. mag., Bloemfontein, 1915; overseas mily. serv., 1916-20; ret. as capt.; ment. in desps.; mag., Senekal, 1920; addnl. mag., Pretoria, 1920; mag., Bethlehem and Kroonstad, 1928; do., Port Elizabeth, 1932; Durban, 1934.

ROWE, CHARLES HAWKSWELL.—B. 1885; asst. acct., constr., F.M.S. Rly., Feb., 1912; divnsl. acct., June, 1913-Jly., 1914; acct. and audr., constr., head office, Kuala Lumpur, Mar., 1920; stores supt., F.M.S. Rly., Nov., 1926.

ROWE, ERIC GEORGE.—B. 1904; ed. Chatham House Sch., Ramsgate and St. Edmund Hall, Oxford; B.A. 1926; cadet, Tanganyika Territory, 1928; asst. dist. offr., 1930.

ROWE, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1878; ent. Crown Agent's office, 1904; asst. head, stores dept., 1917; asst. head, pay dept., 1920; cashier, 1921; dep. head, finance dept., 1927; dep. head, stores dept., 1929; dep. head, finance dept., 1932; head, pay dept., 1933.

ROWELL, THOMAS, B.Sc. (Hon.), Dipl. in Educn., Liverpool Univ.—B. 1896; ed. Douglas Secondary Schi. and Univ. of Liverpool Training Coll.; war serv., 1915-1918; mast. educn., dep., Hong Kong, Mar., 1923.

ROWELL, THOMAS HUBERT.—Clk., loco. dept., I.M.R., Pretoria, Oct., 1900; acctg. brch., ch. loco. supt.'s office, Jan., 1903; acctg. offr., ch. mech. engnr.'s dept., July, 1908; inspr., audit dept., S.A.R. and Harbs., Oct., 1910; inspr., asst. contr. and audr. gen.'s dept., Union of S. Africa, May, 1911; inspr., (rlys. and hbrs.) control and audit dept., July, 1916; senr. inspr., (rlys. and hbrs.) control and audit dept., Oct., 1922; ch. inspr. (rlys. and harbrs.) control and audit dept., Apr., 1933.

ROWEN, F. C. P.—B. 1896; copyist, audit dept., B. Honduras, 1912; 3rd cls. clk., atty.-gen.'s off., 1915; 2nd cls. clk., ditto, 1918; clk. to regiar.-gen., 1919; sec., riot enquiry comm., 1919; ag. regiar.-gen. and cust. enemy ppty. and contr. local clearing office, 1920; sec., yellow fever enquiry comm., 1921; again ag. regiar.-gen., 1921, 1923 and 1925; regiar.-gen., regiar., lands titles, regiar., sup., vice-admry. and bankcy. cts., regiar., companies and patents and regiar., births marriages and deaths, 1927; J.P.; stamp commr., dir., pub. offrs. guarantee fund; commr., income tax, 1927.

ROWNEY, LESLIE CHARLES, M.A. (Oxon), Dip. For. (Oxon).—B. 1896; ed. King Edward's Schi., Birmingham and Worcester Coll., Oxford; on active serv., Salonika and Egypt, 3rd Batt. Middlesex Regt., France, pilot, R.A.F.; asst. constr., forests, Gold Coast, Aug., 1921; utilisation offr., Oct., 1933.

RUDD, VIVIAN HUGH THOMAS HERMAN.—B. 1882; clk., just. dept., Oudtahoon, 1900; snr. clk., Pretoria, Apr., 1912; asst. acct., land dept., Pretoria, Oct., 1919; 2nd gr. ch. clk., Sept., 1929; 1st gr. ch. clk., Aug., 1932; under-sec. for lands, May, 1934.

RUNDLE, GEN. SIR HENRY MACLEOD LESLIE, R.A.—B. 1856; G.C.B. (1911); G.C.M.G. (1914); G.C.V.O. (1911); K.C.B., 1908; K.C.M.G., 1901; D.S.O., 1897; ed. Roy. Mil. Acad., Woolwich; entd. R.A., 1876; maj.-gen., 1896; served in Zulu war, 1879; Boer war, 1881; Egyptian war, 1882; Nile expdn., 1884-5; Soudan Frontier field force, 1885-7; Soudan Frontier, 1889; Dongola expdn. force, 1896; adjt.-gen., Egyptian army; Khartoum expdn., 1898; comdg. S.E. Dist., 1898-9; dep. adjt.-gen. to the forces, 1899-1900; in cmd. of div., Aldershot, 1900; lieut.-gen. on staff in cmd. of 8th Div., S. African field force, 1900, 1902; lieut.-gen. of Nthn. Comd., 1905-7; col.-cmdt., R.A., 1907; gov. and cmdr.-in-chief-Malta, 1909-1915.

RUSHTON, CHARLES BERKELEY, I.S.O. (1931).—Clk., commr. of rlys. dept., W. Aust., Apr., 1896; ch. clk., July, 1896; ag. sec. to commr. of rlys., 23rd Aug., 1901; sec. to ditto, 18th Dec., 1901; sec., W. Australian London Agency, 3rd Nov., 1919.

RUSHTON, HERBERT HARVEY, C.B.E. (1934).—B. 1876; acct., electric light dept., Gibraltar, 1897; asst. sec. and asst. acct., munic. authority, 1902; ch. acct. and asst. sec., 1903; sec. and finan. offr., 1908 (also man., pub. electricity and water supplies, mem., comte., on exchange and currency); asst. ch. acct., Uganda Rly., E. Africa Prot., 1915; lieut., E.A. Forces, 1915; capt., 1916; ag. dep. ch. acct., Uganda Rly., 1916 to June, 919 (also govt. rep., Nairobi munici. coun., 1918, mem., gen. manager's advisory comte., 1919); dep. treas., Kenya Colony, 1920 and 1921; ag. treas., Aug., 1920 to Apr., 1921; mem., exec. and leg. couns. (also chmn., currency and other comtes.); col. treas., Fiji, 1922 (with charge of group of depts., cust., port and marine, transport, posts, telegraphs and telephones, govt. stores, and returned soldiers' dairy stltm.); mem., exec. and leg. couns.; commr. of currency, mem., educn., mining and other bds.; chmn., many comtes.; ag. col. sec., Apr., 1929; gov.'s dep. for four periods; treas., Kenya, Mar., 1930.

RUSSELL, MAJOR-GEN. SIR ANDREW HAMILTON.—K.C.B. (1918); K.C.M.G. (1916).—B. 1868; held comm. as lieut. for 5 yrs. in Imperial Army; vol. offr., New Zealand, 1900; hon. A.D.C. to H.E. the Gov. of N.Z., 1911; brig.-gen., 1914; temp. major-gen., 1915; major-gen. in command of N.Z. Div., 1916.
RUSSELL, LAURENCE ARNOLD.—B. 1883; ed. Rossall Schl. and Hertford Coll., Oxford; proba-
tioner, N. Rhodesia, Sept., 1914; asst. nat. comsnr., 1914; war serv., 1915-19; nat. comsnr.,
1918; asst. mag., 1926; ag. prov. comsnr., for short periods 1929 and 1933; prov. comsnr., 1934.

RUSSELL, WILLIAM, M.C., M.D.—B. 1883; ed. Edin. Univ.; Union of S. Africa mental
hoop. serv., 1913; comsnr., mental hygiene, 1932.

RUSSELLI, SIR WILLIAM ALISON, KT. BACH.
(1928), K.C.—B. 1875; ed. Rugby and Trin.
Coll. Camb.; B.A., LL.B., hons., 1897; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp., 1900; equity
bar, 1900-6; apptd. Crown advoc., pub. proscr., admstr. gen., prin. registr. of docms., regis-
ter of companies, Uganda Prot., May, 1906; Crown
advoc. and pub. proscr., Jan., 1909; ag.
chief sec. to govt., Aug., 1909, to Mar., 1910;
Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Mar. to May,
1910; ag. chief sec. to govt., June, 1910 to May,
1911; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., June, 1911
to June, 1912; King's advoc., Cyprus, July, 1912;
mem. of exec. and legis. couns., 1912; joint
comsnr. under Reprint of Statutes Law, 1913;
edition pubd., Feb., 1914; K.C., Cyprus, 1924;
ch. just., Tanganyika Territory, 1924; ret., 1929;
legal advr. to govt. of Malta, 1934; reptd. on
language and procedure of law cts., recommend-
ations adopted, 1934; chmn., coms. of inquiry
into disturbances, Copperbelt, N. Rhodesia, 1936;
published, "Legislative Drafting and Forms"
(3rd edn., 1931), "Handbook for Magistrates" (2nd
edn., 1928), "Notes and Forms for Enquiries
under the Col. Regs." (2nd edn., 1936).

RUSSELL, WILLIAM HAYWORTH.—B. 1894;
clk., Mankaiana, Swaziland, Apr., 1915; clk.,
treasy., 1920; asst. acct. and asst. collr., inc.
tax, 1922; acct., 1928; ag. finan. sec., Apr. to
Oct., 1931; finan. sec., Bech. Prot., Jan., 1935.

RUSSELL, W. J., A.I.M.M.—Ed. Royal Coll.
of Science, Ireland and Cornwall Cent. Schl. of
Mining; asst. inspr., mines, Nigeria, 1914; inspr.,
mines, 1919; dep. ch. inspr., mines, 1929; ag.
ch. inspr., mines, 1930-33; ch. inspr., mines,
Jan., 1934.

RUTHERFOORD, JOHN WYNNE CORRIE
B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1888; ed. St. Paul's Schl. and
Merton Coll., Oxford; asst. dist. comsnr., S. Ni-
geria, 1911; seconded as asst. recr., 1914; asst.
sec. Nigerian secretariat, Lagos, 1926; clk., exec.
and leg. couns., 1926; cls. I, grade I, admtrv.
serv., 1928.

RUTHERFORD, CAPT. PETER WILLIAM, M.C.
(1916), F.R.G.S.—B. 1894; ed. Brighton Coll.;
2nd lieut., W. Yorks Regt., 1914; lieut., 1915;
seconded, Flying Corps, 1916; capt., 1917; retd.
from army, 1919; asst. dist. comsnr., G. Coast,
Sept., 1921.

RYRIE, MAJ.-GEN. HON. SIR GRANVILLE DE
LAUNE, R.C.M.G. (1919), C.B. (1918), C.M.G.
(1916), V.D.—B. 1865; ed. King's Schl.,
Parramatta; mem., state parl., N.S.W., 3 years,
mem., house of reps., C. of A., 1911-27; asst.
min. for defence, 1919-22; commanded 3rd
Light Horse Regt., N.S.W., for 7 yrs. with rank
of lieut.-col.; served S. Africa, 1900-1 (severely
wounded (Queen's med. 4 clasps); European
War, 1914-18; commanded 2nd Light Horse
Brig., A.I.F., Egypt; commanded Australian
divn., Syria; G.O.C., Australian Forces, Egypt
(wounded twice, five times ment. in desrs.);
maj.-gen. commdg., 1st Cav. Divn., N.S.W.,
1923-27; high comsnr. for Australia, 1927-32.

SABINE, NEVILLE WARDE, B.A.—B. 1910;
ed. Chorlton-cum-Hardy Manchester Gram-
mar Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; col.
audit dept., Feb., 1934; asst. audr., Gold Coast,
Apr., 1934.

SAINT, SYDNEY JOHN, B.Sc., A.I.C.—B. 1897;
ed. Beaumaris Grammar Schl., Reading Univ.;
B.Sc., 1920; served with R.A.F., 1916-19; Salters
research fellow, 1920-22; lect. in agrl. chemistry,
Leeds Univ., 1922-26; agrl. chemist, Barbados, 1927.

ST. JOHNSTON, LIEUT.-COL. SIR REGINALD,
K.C.M.G. (1931), C.M.G. (1923), Barrister-at-law
(Middle Temple); M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond.,
etc.—Ed. Queen Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey and
Cheltenham Coll.; various spots, in home civ.
service; entered Fiji civ. serv., 1907; comsnr. Lau
Islands, 1909; seconded for European war;
D.A.D.M.S., B.E.F., France; subsequently
attached to W.O. (brevet lieut.-col. and recd.
thanks of S. of S.); col. sec., Falkland Is., Dec.,
1918; ag. gov., Falkland Is., from Sept. 1919 to
Apr., 1920; col. sec., Leeward Isds., Dec., 1919;
ag. gov., Leeward Is., eight times; admstr. govt.
of Antigua on many occasions; ag. admstr.,
Dominica, 1925; admstr., St. Kitts-Nevis, 9th May,
1926; assumed duty, 23rd Nov., 1925; gov.,
Leeward Is., Sept., 1929; ret., 1935; author of
"The Lau Islands, Fiji," "The Children of the
Sun," "The Falkland Islands," "The Islanders
of the Pacific," "South Sea Reminiscences,"
"West Indian Tales" and some novels, etc.

SALE, GILBERT NOEL, B.Sc. (Forestry,
Edin.).—B. 1897; ed. King Alfred's Schl., Wan-
tage, Edinburgh Univ. and Imp. Forestry Inst.,
Oxford; army serv., 1916-19; lieut., B.A.
(S.R.); asst. conserv., forests, Cyprus, Mar.,
1922; ag. asst. prin. forest offr., 1924; ag. prin.
forest offr., 1926-28; dir., forests, Mauritius,
Dec., 1928; conserv., forests, July, 1930; do.,
Palestine, 1935.

SALMON, FREDERICK JOHN, M.C., A.C.G.I.,
F.R.G.S., Lieut.-Col., R. of O., R.E.—B. 1882;
ed. Univ. Coll. Schl., Lond., and Cent. Tech.
Coll., S. Kensington; empd. on Transvaal Mines,
1904-1907; assoc., inst., of mining and metallur-
gy; asst. supt., surveys, Ceylon, June, 1908;
supt., surveys, 1914; served with field survey
units in France, 1915-19; thrice ment. in desps.;
lieut.-col., supt., surveys, on staff (appl. surveys),
Ceylon, 1924; ag. asst. survr.-gen. 1928; dir.,
land registn. and surveys, Cyprus, Sept., 1930;
offr. commdg. sp. constab., 1932; dir., surveys,
Palestine, 1933.

SALOMONE, WALTER.—B. 1888; ed. St.
Ignatius Coll. and Malta Univ.; elec. for 6th
divn. in leg. assem., Oct., 1921; re-elec., June,
1924 and Aug., 1927; min. for industry and
commerce, Aug., 1927.

SAMARAKOON, EDWIN RICHARD DE ALWIS.
B. 1877; cls. V. Ceylon civ. serv., Oct., 1927;
extra office asst., Badulla kach., Oct., 1927;
office asst. to contr., rev., Feb., 1928; office asst.
to land comsnr., July, 1931; attd., Ratnapura
kach., Nov., 1933; attd., treasy., Feb., 1934.

SAMPSON, BASIL FEHRSEN, M.C.—B. 1888;
ed. St. Andrew's Coll., Grahamstown; M.B.,
B.S., Lond. Univ. (Guy's Hosp.), 1917; M.R.C.S.
(Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), 1915; temp. surg.,
R.N. (H.M.S. Benbow), 1915; tempy. capt.,
S.A.M.C., France, 1916; M.C., 1918; asst.
bacteriologist, Guy's Hosp.; senr. govt. path.,
Union of S. Africa health dept., Durban, 1931.

SAMUEL, EDWIN HERBERT, B.A. Oxon
(Balliol Coll.).—B. 1898; ed. Westminster; 2nd
lieut., R.F.A., 1917; G. S. I., G.H.Q., Paleo-
stine, 1917-19; dist. offr., Jlem dist., Palestine
civil admtn., Oct., 1920; dist. offr., Ramallah sub-dist., 1925; dist. offr., Jaffa, 1926; sec., wages commn., 1927; asst. sec., Pal. gov't., 1927; ag. priv. sec. to O. A. G., 1929; dist. offr., J'lem dist., 1930; Commonwealth fund serv. fellowship (econ.), Columbia Univ., New York, 1931-2; ag. asst. dist. commn., J'lem dist., 1932; mem., rev. coll. commn., 1933; asst. dist. commn., Galilee divn., 1933-4; dep. commn., mign., 1934.

SAMUEL, T. HON. SIR HERBERT LOUIS, P.C. (1908), G.B.E. (1920), M.A.—B. 1870; ed. University Coll. Schi. and Balliol Coll., Oxford; M.P., Cleveland Divn., N. Riding, Yorks., 1902-18; partly, under sec., home dept., 1905-9; chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster (with a seat in the cabinet), 1909-10 and 1915-16; P.M.G., 1910-14 and 1915-16; pres. of the L.G.B., 1914-15; sec. of state for home affairs, 1916; chmn. of the select comtes. of house of commons on national expenditure, 1917-18; British sp. commn. to Belgium, 1919; grand offr. of the Order of Leopold of Belgium, 1919; high commn., Palestine, 1920-25.

SANDERS, JOHN OWEN, M.I.T., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1892; ed. Elstow Schi. and Manchester Univ.; mil. ser., 1915-20; 2nd lieut., 1917; ag. capt., 1918; asst., Crewe loco. works, L.M.S.R., 1922; works man., F.M.S. Rlys., 1924; run. supt., 1927; traffic man., Nov., 1930; transportation man., 1932; ag. gen. man., F.M.S. rlys., Apr., 1934.

SANDERSON, I., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), D.T.M., D.T.H. (Liv.)—B. 1894; mily. serv., 1914-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1925.

SANDFORD, FOLLIOTT HUGH BLAKELOCK.—B. 1889; ed. Rugby and Magdalen Coll., Oxford, (demy and Sheppard exhib.) M.A.; barrister-at-law; asst. dist. commn., Uganda, 1913; dist. commn., 1923; senr. dist. offr., 1933; prov. commn., 1936.

SANDFORD, GEORGE RITCHIE, O.B.E. (1924), Barrister-at-Law, Inner Temple, 1924.—B. 1892; ed. Christ's Hosp. and Queens' Coll., Camb., B.A. and wrangler, 1914; asst. dist. commn., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; priv. sec. to gov., 1918; junr. asst. sec. and clk. of couns., Sept., 1922; ag. sec. asst. sec., Mar. to Sept., 1923; resig., 1926; clk. to leg. coun., Jan., 1926; dep. treas., 1931; ag. treas., Oct., 1933-Apr., 1934; treas., Tanganyika Territory, 1935.

SANDFORD, THOMAS FREDERICK, C.M.G. (1935), M.B.E., B.A.—B. 1886; ed. Marlborough Coll. and Oriel Coll., Oxford; asst. native commn., N. Rhodesia, Sept., 1910; native commn., Apr., 1913; served in E. African campaign, 1915-19; ag. dist. commn., 1927; ag. prov. commn., in 1929, 1930 and 1931; prov. commn., Aug., 1932; temp. mem., leg. coun., 1932.

SANDYS, MELVILL KEVERNE TRELLAWNY, M.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1890; on mily. serv., Aug., 1914; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1919; attd., Ratnapura kach., Nov., 1919; office astt. to gov't. agt., N.W. Prov., Mar., 1922; dist. judge, Anuradhapura, July, 1925; pol. mag., Kurunegala, Oct., 1926; ag. agt., Hambantota, May, 1927; ag. dist. judge, Tangalla, June, 1927; asst. gov't. agt., Uva, July, 1927; asst. settlmt., officer, Jan., 1929; asst. gov't. agt., Mannar, Nov., 1931; asst. gov't. agt., Trincomalee, Mar., 1933.

SANGER-DAVIES, ARTHUR ELPHINSTONE.—B. 1885; ed. Dover Coll., Coopers Hill and Oxford (Diploma of Forestry, 1907); asst. conservator, forests, grade II., F.M.S. forest dept., 1907; grade I., 1912; dep. conservator, forests, 1919; ag. conserv., forests, S.S. and F.M.S., June, 1923; dep. conserv., forests, Oct., 1923; title of office changed to conserv., forests, Jan., 1930.

SANKERALLI, ESAU JYMSHED, M.B., Ch.B., B.A.O. (Queen's University, Belfast), D.T.M. (Liverpool), L.M. (Dublin), D.P.H. (Belfast).—B. 1898; govt. med. offr., Trinidad, 1923; asst. res. surg., col. hosp., 1929; junr. med. inspr., health, Aug., 1935.

SANSON, CHARLES HENRY.—B. 1886; ed. Plymouth and Munnamed Coll.; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1923; pol. prob., 1905; reg. of criminals, F.M.S. and S.S., 1910; asst. commn. of pol., Ipoh, 1911; adjt., F.M.S. pol., 1913; commn. of pol., Johore, 1921; supt., pol., S'pore but cont. former appt., Nov., 1924; ch. pol. offr., S'pore, Dec., 1929; offg. ch. pol. offr., Perak, Nov., 1930; commn., pol., F.M.S., Oct., 1931.

SARAVANAMUTTU, P.—B. 1894; B.A., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Aug., 1919; attd. to Matale Kach., June, 1920; addnl. dist. judge, Badulla, Mar., 1921; pol. mag., Bandagamuwa, Sept., 1921; ditto, Kurunegala, June, 1922; addnl. asst. gov't. agt., Colombo, Mar., 1923; addnl. asst. dir., educn., Dec., 1925; asst. gov't. agt., Mullaitivu, Dec., 1926; dist. judge, Kegalle, Mar., 1929; dist. judge, Kalutara, Apr., 1932; asst. gov't. agt., Kalutara, Apr., 1933; rubber contr., May, 1934.

SERGEANT, CAPT. R. G., M.B.E. (1928), A.I.N.A., F.R.G.S.—Port. offr., Kenya, Jan., 1917; port capt., 1925.

SAUL, SAUL ISAAC.—B. 1887; ed. privately; shorthand writer, off. of dir.-gen. of educn., Simla, Mar., 1906; ag. confd'l. shorthand writer to the Viceroy, July, 1912; coun. reporter, Imp. leg. coun., Simla, Feb., 1913; on staff of Viceroy, Aug., 1914; coun. reporter Burma and per. astt. to lieut.-gov. of Bengal, June, 1916; European coun. reporter, S.S. & F.M.S., May, 1921; do., S.S., May, 1922.

SAUNDERS, SIR CHARLES JAMES RENAULT, K.C.M.G., 1906, C.M.G., 1896.—B. 1857; held various appts. in Natal civ. serv., 1876-87, when he ratified treaty with Queen of Amatongaland (deeps.); res. mag., Eshowe, and J.P. for Zululand, 1888; defined bndry. between Amatongaland and Zululand, 1889 (deeps.); variously employed under Zululand Gov't., 1888-95 (deeps.), when he was apptd. spec. commn. for Trans-Pongoland territory, carried out final act of annexation of that territory and declared British prot. for Amatongaland; acted as res. commn. and chief mag. of Zululand, 1896; apptd. chief mag. and civ. commn. for prov. of Zululand on its incorporation with Natal, 1897; medal, S. African War, 1899-1902; col. representative on Zululand Lands Delimitation Comsn., 1902, and commn. for native affairs, 1906; ret., 1909.

SAUNDERS, PHILIP HENRY NORMAN.—B. 1890; ed. Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana; successively 6th, 5th, 4th, 3rd and 2nd cls. clk., P.W.D., Br. Guiana, 1911-24; sec., bd. of industrial training, 1930; acctg. clk., P.W.D., 1931; sec., advisory comte., on sea defences, 1932; sec., sea defence bd., 1933.

SAUNDERS-JONES, DAVID WILLOUGHBY.—B. 1899; ed. Christ Coll., Brecon; Indian Army, 1917-23; on service in Waziristan, Egypt and Palestine; wounded in Palestine, 1919; asst. dist. commn., Zanzibar, Feb., 1924; ag. pvt. sec., Br. res. in 1925 and from Aug., 1930-May,
1931; ag. prov. commr., Pemba, June, 1930 and July, 1932-Feb., 1933; asst. sec. and pte. sec. to Sultan, 1935.

SAUVE, HON. ARTHUR, P.C. (Can.).—B. 1875; ed. in Seminary of Ste. Therese and L'Univ. de Montreal; 1st el. to legis. assem., Quebec, g.e., 1908; re-elec., g.e., 1912, 1916, 1919, 1923 and 1927; el. to H. of C., Canada, g.e., 1930; P.M.G., in Bennett Cabinet, 1930; re-elec. by accl. after assuming office, Aug., 1930; mem. senate, 1935.

SAYAGE, GEORGE.—B. 1887; supt. of regis-trn., G.P.O., Singapore, Oct., 1914; supt. of mails, ditto, Jan., 1915; supt. mails, Penang, but cont. ag. senr. supt. mails, July, 1917; supt., grade II., Jan., 1919; supt., grade I., Jan., 1920; supt., posts and teles., Malacca, Sept., 1920; contr., P. and T., S'pore, Oct., 1926; senr. acct., G.P.O., S'pore, contd. to act as contr., P. and T., Jan., 1929; contr., P. and T., F.M.S., Aug., 1929; ag. P.M.G., Sept., 1929; P.M.G., Johore, July, 1930.

SAYARY, JOHN LEWIS HENRY WILLIAM.—B. 1884; col. schol., Trinidad, 1901; Gray's Inn, 1902; prizeman in evidence, procedure and criminal law exam., 1904; barrister-at-law, Nov., 1905; practised at bar, Trinidad, 1906-24; retainer from Trinidad govt. as junr. coun. to atty.-gen., Jan., 1916-Dec., 1923; ag. solr.-gen., in 1921, 1922 and 1923; regis. and marshal and regis- gen. and prin. regis., West Indian ct. of appeal, Jan., 1925; ag. puisne judge in 1925 and 1926; puisne judge, Br. Guiana, 1928; ag. ch. just. in 1932 and 1934.

SAVILE, ARTHUR HUGH, Dip. Agr. (Wye), A.I.C.T.A.—B. 1905; ed. Clifton Coll., Wye Agr. Coll. and C.O. Sch., course Oxford and Trinidad; dist. agrl. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1928.

SAWARD, CAPT. SIDNEY CABMON, M.C. (1916), M.M. (1916).—B. 1889; fellow of surveyors' inst.; served with 509 (1-1) Long Field Coy., R.E., 6th divn.; home serv., Aug. to Dec., 1914; France and Germany, Dec., 1914 to June, 1919; Ireland, June to Aug., 1919; commdg., cadre, 12th Field Co., R.E.; command., Sept., 1915; lieut., June, 1916; capt., Oct., 1918; ag. major, Dec., 1918 to Jan., 1919; ment. in desps., Mar., 1919; survr., Gold Coast, Nov., 1919; field supervisor Apr., 1924; ag. dep. survr.-gen. on various occasions, 1925-32; ag. survr.-gen., Feb.-June, 1927; asst. survr.-gen., Apr., 1929; ag. survr.-gen., Mar.-Aug., 1934.

SAWTELL, WILLIAM GEORGE.—B. 1894; ed. at King Edward VII's Sch., Bath, and H.M.S. "Worcester"; H.M. Transport Serv., 1915-17; Indian govt. tel. ship, 1917-18; Indian Army R. of O., 1918-22; wharf-mast. and pilot, Tanganyika Territory, 1922; marine offr., 1932.

SAXTON, SIDNEY WARING.—Ed. Toulouse (France), and Dean Close Sch., Cheltenham; paymr. cadet, R.N., July, 1905; paymr.-lieut.-comdr., Mar., 1918; 1st cls. French interpreter lent to C.O. and apptd. asst. dist. commr., G. Coast, Sept., 1914, but did not take up apptmt., having resumed duty in H.M. Navy for the period of the war; assumed duties as junr. asst. col. sec., G. Coast, Apr., 1919; ag. asst. col. sec., May, 1919; ag. dist. commr., Accra, and ag. trav. commr. for Accra-Akwapim and Birrim dists., Oct., 1919; invalided, H.M. Navy, 1920; passed Tropical African service course (all subjects, 2nd part); barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1926; promoted pay commdr., ret. list, 1927; dep. prov. commr., 1930.

SAYER, GEOFFREY ROBLEY, B.A.—B. 1887; ed. at Highgate schl. (foundationer) and Queen's Coll., Oxford; open exhibr. in classics and Fitzgerald exhibr.; 2nd cls. class. mods.; 3rd cls. lit. hum. (B.A., 1910); cadet, Hong Kong, Oct., 1910; passed in Cantonese, Nov., 1912; ag. ch. asst. sec. for Chinese affrs. 1914 and 1915, in addn. to other duties; priv. sec. to gov., in addn. 1915; attd. to crown solr.'s off., 1915; passed final exam. in Hakka, July, 1915; ag. chief asst. sec. for Chinese affrs., 1915; on mily. serv., 1915-19; dep. registr. and appraiser, Hong Kong, 1920; head, sany. dept., 1920; passed in Mandarin, May, 1921; attd. to treas-y, 1924; asst. treas. and commr. of estate duties, Apr., 1925; supt., impts. and expts. dept., June, 1927; P.M.G., Apr., 1928; head, sany. dept., Oct., 1928; offr., dis. 1, Aug., 1934.

SAYERS, ELDERD FRANK.—B. 1889; ed. King's Coll. Schl., Wimbledon, St. John's Coll., Cambridge, and Grenoble Univ., B.A., LL.B. (Cantab.); barrister-at-law (Inner Temple), Apr., 1913; passed lower and higher stand. exams. in Temne, and lower stand. exam. in Koranko; war service, E. Africa, 1918; asst. dist. commr., Sierra Leone, Jan., 1915; dist. commr., Aug., 1922.

SAYERS, GERALD FLEMING.—B. 1893; ed. Westminster and Christ Church, Oxford; B.A. (hons.) 1914; asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1916; ag. senr. asst. sec., Nov., 1919 to July, 1920; asst. sec., Tanganyika territory, July, 1920; ag. senr. asst. sec., for various periods 1920-24; clk. to exec. coun., Sept., 1923; attd. to C.O., Aug., 1924 to Sept., 1925 and from July to Sept., 1930; clk., leg. coun., 1926-32; ag. asst. ch. sec., on various occasions, 1927-31; asst. ch. sec., 1932; asst. ch. sec., Nyasaal Prot., 1933; ag. ch. sec., Feb., 1934; dep. ch. sec., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1935; mem. exec. and leg. couns.; ag. ch. sec., May-Nov., 1935; edr., Handbook of Tanganyika Territory, 1930.

SAYLE, LIEUT. COMMDR., ARTHUR REGINALD WILLIS, R.N.R., Barrister-at-Law (Gray's Inn).—Ed. Merchant Taylors Schl. and cadet H.M.S. "Worcester"; Royal Navy, May, 1914; R.I.C., 1920; admtrve. offr., S. Nigeria, May, 1921; station mag., Ibadan, S. Nigeria, Aug., 1928; pol. mag., Oct., 1928; crown coun., 1930; ag. solr. gen. in 1932, 1933 and 1935.

SCADDAN, HON. JOHN, C.M.G. (1924), M.L.A.—B. 1876; leader of Parly. Lab. party in W. Aust. since Aug., 1910; elected for Ivanhoe, June, 1904; premier of W. Australia, 1911-1916, min. for rlys., mines and industry, 1930.

SCAMMELL, ERNEST HENRY.—B. 1873; ed. privately; sec. various business concerns, 1891-1907; visited Australia, engaged in business and journalism in Canada, 1907-1913; organizing sec., Canadian Peace Centenary Association, under the auspices of the govt. of Canada, 1913; asst. cable censor, dept. of militia and defence, Canada, 1915; sec., mil. hosps. commr., Canada, 1915; asst. dep. min. and sec., dept. of soldiers' civil re-estabmt., Canada, 1918; negotiated reciprocal agreements between Canadian, British and United States Govts., regarding treatment and training of Naval and Military Forces resident in these countries, 1919; sec., pensions divn., dept. of pensions and national health, 1931; Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Secretaries (London); Fellow of the Royal Colonial Institute (London); mem. of the Exec. of the Canadian Peace Centenary Assoc.

SCHARFF, JOHN WILLIAM, B.A., M.D., B.A.O., B.Ch., D.P.H. (T.C.D.), D.T.M. & H.
(Lond.)—B. 1895; surgn. sub-lieut., R.N.V.R., July, 1915; health offr., S.S., Nov., 1920; lect. in biology, King Edward VII Coll. of Medicine in addn., May, 1921; hon. sec. for Malaya of the Far Eastn. Assoc. of Trop. Med., Aug., 1921; health offr., Malacca, June, 1925; tr. health offr., Penang, May, 1928; offl. deleg. to 8th cong. of Far Eastn. Assoc. of Trop. Med., Bangkok, Dec., 1930.

SCHMIDT, CARL FRIEDRICH, B.A.—Civ. serv. law clk., law dept., Cape, May, 1893; control and audit office, July, 1893; asst. examnr. of acts., Jan., 1894; examr., May, 1898; ch. examr., July, 1907; inspr. of actsa., Jan., 1909; prin. clk., Apr., 1912; sec. educn. dept., Bloemfontein, 16th Aug., 1915; ag. dir. of educn., O.F.S., July, 1918; dir. of educn., O.F.S., June, 1920; sec. for interior, Sept., 1926; contr. and audr.-gen., 1929; rector, Pretoria univ., 1935.

SCHMITT, LOUIS JOHN, A.I.C.A., F.C.A.A.—B. 1885; ed. Victoria Parade coll., Australia; accnt. for some years; sec., N.Z. bd. of trade price investig. tribunal, 1919; investig. accnt., bd. of trade, 1921; sec. to advay. coun., N.Z. sect., Wembley exhibn., 1924; dep. govt. commnr., Dunedin internat. exhibn., 1925; advay. accnt., industries and commerce dept., 1927; mem. (rep. employers), N.Z. ct. of arbitn., 1928; N.Z. govt. tourist and trade commnr. in Australia, 1930-35; sec. and gen.-man. N.Z. dept. of industries and commerce, tourist and publicity, 1936.

SCHNEIDER, SIR GUALTERUS STEWART, Kt. Bach (1928), K.C.—B. 1864; ag. puisne just., Ceylon, Jan., 1921; commnr. of assize, Nov., 1921; puisne just., Dec., 1921; ag. ch. just., Sept.-Dec., 1926; ret.

SCHNEIDER, GEORGE ALBERT WILHELM.—B. 1884; ed. Pretoria High Schl. and S.African Coll., Cape Town; solr., sup. ct., Transvaal; civ. gen., Transvaal, 1907; ch. clk., dept. of lands, 1931; under-sec. for agr., 1935.

SCHOCK, AUGUST ARNOLD.—B. 1883; ed. Berne, Switzerland; graduated, Leiden, LL.D. and called to bar, Middle Temple, 1910; ent. Union pub. serv., 1911; priv. sec. to min. of justice, 1913-16; professional asst. to atty-gen. (Transvaal), 1916-24; solr.-gen., Cape Eastern Dists., Aug., 1924; law adviser and Dutch draughtsman, dept. of just., Pretoria, Sept., 1925; senr. law adviser, Oct., 1931.

SCHOFIELD, WALTER.—B. 1888; ed. Univ. of Liverpool, M.A.; non-coll. student, Oxford, 1908-1911, M.A.; cadet, Hong Kong, Nov., 1911; attached to secretariat for Chinese affairs, 1914; asst. cable censor, in addition to other duties, 1914 to 1915; passed cadet, Feb., 1915; J.P., 1915; passed law exam., 1916; ag. reg. and appraiser, in addn. to other duties, 1919; ag. chief asst. to sec. for Chinese affrs, in 1919, 1920 and 1921; dist. offr., South, in addn., 1922; dist. offr., South, 1923; mag., Hong Kong, 1926; mag., Kowloon, 1927; asst. supt., impts. and expts., 1929-30; dist. offr., South, 1930; 1st pol. mag., 1931; offr., cl.s., I.1935.

SCHOKMAN, CLIVE CONRADE.—B. 1897; 4th supt., prisons, Ceylon, Jan., 1924; 1st do., Apr., 1928; inspr.-gen., prisons, Mar., 1932.

SCHOLEFIELD, GUY HARDY, D.Sc. (Lond.), O.B.E. (1919).—Ed. Tokomairiro High Schl. and Univ. of N.Z. (Bowen and Macmillan High prizeman) and Univ. of London; ch. librarian, gen. assembly lib. and contrlr., dominion archives, N.Z., 1926.

SCHOLEFIELD, WILLIAM.—Dep. clk., res. mag's. ct., Feb., 1917; asst. commnr. and mag., Turks and Caicos Islands, July, 1919; ag. commnr., ditto, Sept. to Oct., 1920; ag. res. mag., Jamaica, on various occasions, 1922-26.

SCHUMANN, THOROD E. WERNER, B.A., M.Sc., Ph.D.—B. 1896; ed. Stellenbosch, S.A., Gottingen, Germany and Yale, U.S.A.; lect. in physics and math., Rhodes Univ. Coll., Grahamstown, 1918-19; and at Stellenbosch, 1920-21; dir., fuel research inst. of S. Africa, June, 1931, reassg., Feb., 1933; ch. meteorologist, Union of S.A., Sept., 1933

SCICLUNA, HANNIBAL P., M.B.E. (1935), L.P.—B. 1880; ed. St. Ignatius' Coll., Malta; matric., Malta Univ., 1897; ent. Malta civ. serv., 1902; legal procurator, 1905; sec. and regis., Malta Univ., 1913-20; rep. of govt. emigr. dept. in devastated regions, France, 1920; attd., ministry of justice, 1921; esquire, Order of St. John of Jerusalem (Rome), 1910; Officier d'Academie (France), 1921; mem. of the Societe Academique d'Histoire Internationale de Paris, 1923; libr., Malta public library, July, 1923.

SCOTLAND, ERICA ELEANOR.—Ent. C.O. as typist, July, 1913; shorthand writer, Aug., 1918; cler. offr., 9th Mar., 1922.

SCOTT, HENRY HAROLD, M.D., London Univ.; F.R.C.P., London; F.R.S., Edin.; D.P.H.; M.R.C.S., Eng.; D.T.M., & H. (Camb.); Fell. of Royal Soc. of medicine; Fell. of Royal Inst. of preventive medicine; Fell. of Soc. of tropical medicine and hygiene.—Ed. at St. Bart's and St. Thomas's hosps.; Univ. Colls. London and Copenhagen; prosector, 1894; asst. demonstrator in Materia Medica, 1895; asst. house physician, 1897; house physician, 1898, all at St. Thomas's hosp.; res. med. offr., Teignmouth hosp., 1898; serv. in S. African War (Queen's medal with 5 clasps); med. offr. in charge bacteriological and X-Ray depts., mil. hosp., Maritzburg, 1903; M.O. in charge Fort Napier hosp. for women and children, 1904; res. med. offr., Kingsbury and Neasden isolation hosp., 1910; bacteriologist to Willesden Dist. Coun., 1910; govt. bacteriologist and fermentation chemist, Jamaica, 1910; is also pathologist to Kingston gen. hosp.; mem. of med. coun., board of examiners, quarantine board, and cent. board of health, Jamaica; during 1918-1917, seconded for war service; bacteriologist at Command Laboratory, Aldershot, 1915; in charge No. XIII, mobile laboratory, 1916; pathologist and med. specialist, Cambridge hosp., Aldershot, 1916; govt. pathologist, dir., serum inst. Hong Kong, 1919; lect. on path. and med. jurisprudence, Hong Kong Univ., 1919; Milner research fellowship, L.S.H. and T.M., 1925; lect., trop. disease, Westminster hosp. med. schl., 1926; examr., D.M.T. and H. Eng., 1927; med. sec., col. med. research comte, 1928.

SCOTT, HENRY SEPTIMUS, C.M.G. (1935).—B.1873; ed. at Eton and Hertford Coll., Oxford; M.A.; inspr. of schools, Transvaal, 1902; examr., 1908; sec. to educn. dept., Transvaal, 1911; dir. of educn., Transvaal, 1924; dir., educn., Kenya, 1928.

SCOTT, SIR JOHN, K.B.E. (1932), C.M.G. (1923).—B. 1878; ed. Bath Coll. and King's Coll., Cambridge (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1901; prin. astt. col. sec., Apr., 1917; dep. ch. sec. to govt., Nigeria, Feb., 1921; ch. sec., Tanganyika Territory, Jan., 1924; admstd. govt. for various periods, 1924-29; col. sec., S.S., 1929; admstd. govt., Oct., 1929 to Feb., 1930 and from Oct., 1930 to June, 1931.
SCOTT, MARGARET.—Ed. Sherbourne Schl. for Girls; V.A.D. nurse, Brit. R. Cross, 1915-19; housekeeper's dipl., Edin. Sch. of Domestic Econ., 1920; matron, Achimota, 1926.

SCOTT, R. R., M.C., M.B., B.S. (Durham), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.P.H. (Lond.).—R.A.M.C. (S.R.), Aug., 1914; ment. in despatches, 1919; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1919; senr. med. offr. of health, Apr., 1924; dep. dir., sany. serv., 1932.

SCOTT, WALTER RICHARDSON.—B. 1899; ed. Durham, 1922; pol. probationer, Hong Kong, 1922; passed final exam. in Chinese, 1924; asst. supt. pol., 1924; J.P., 1925; attd. Indian pol. and passed in Urdu, 1926; passed Punjabi, 1928; prte. sec. to O.A.G., in addn., 1928; ditto to gov. in addn., Jan. to Mar., 1929; hon. A.D.C. to gov., 1929; ag. dir., comm. intell., 1932-33; supt. pol., 1933; ag. divnl. supt., do., Mar., 1935.

SCRIVENER, RUPERT FREDERICK.—B. 1890; assoc., R. Schl. of Mines, dipl., Imp. Coll. Science, assoc., I.M.M., assoc., Inst. of Mining and Metallurgy; survey work, England and Alaska, 1911-14; command. serv., 1914-20; capt., 1918; served in Gallipoli, Egypt, Mesopotamia, India and Palestine; commanded, 29th Rly. Coy., Sappers and Miners, I.A.; asst. ch. engnr., Palestine rly., 1920; engrnr., ways and wks., Palestina rlys., 1924.

SORVENOR, T. V.—B. 1908; ed. King's Schl., Canterbury and Oriel Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1930; apptd. temp. asst. prin., C.O., Oct., 1930 prior to serv. as an admstr. offr., N. Rhodesia.

SCULLIN, Rt. Hon. JAMES HENRY, P.C.—El. to Commonwealth H. of R., for Corangamite, Victoria, 1910; defeated, gen. el., 1913; M.H.R. for Yarra, Victoria, since 1922; prime min. of the C'wealth of Australia, 1929-31.

SEAGOE, ERNEST GOLDFINCH, M.B.E.—B. 1886; clk. to res. commr., New Hebrides, 1902; inspr. of native labourers, Br. residency, New Hebrides, 1909; ag. asst. to res. commr., 1911-12 and 1915-16; joint ag. native advocate, Oct., 1915, to Dec., 1922; ag. asst. to res., Nov., 1919 to Feb., 1920 and Sept. to Deco., 1921; commt. constab., Aug., 1922; dep. commr., W. Pacific (New Hebrides), Nov., 1922; in ch. of accts., May to Aug., 1923; ag. asst. to res. commr., on various occasions, 1923-33; dist. agt. and lab. inspr., Apr., 1923; agt., Efate dist. and commdt., pol. (Br. divn.) Apr., 1925.

SEDGWICK, RICHARD ROMNEY.—B. 1894; ed. Westminster and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; schol., Trinity Coll., 1912; 1st cls. hist. tripes, pt. I., 1914 and pt. II., 1915; Gladstone prize, 1914; elected fellow of Trinity Coll., 1919; M.A., 1919; apptd. under reconstruction scheme asst. prin., Min. of Labour, 1919; asst. prin., C.O., 1922; prte. sec. to parly. under sec. of State, D.O., 23rd Sept., 1929; prin., D.O., 1st Oct., 1930.

SEED, CHARLES WILLIAM STANLEY.—B. 1898; ed. St. John's (R.C.) Coll., Wonesh, Surrey; Artists' Rifles, 1916; 2nd lieut., 12th London Regt., 1917; served in France, 1918-19; (G.S. and Victory Meds.); col. audt. dept., July, 1921; asst. audr., Nigeria, Sept., 1921; ag. senr. asst. audr., July-Sept., 1926; asst. audr., Nyasaland, Dec., 1926; ag. senr. audr., June, 1927 to July, 1928 and Oct., 1928 to Sept., 1929; audr., Seychelles and Somaliland, July, 1930; also prte. sec. to gov., Seychelles, 1931-33 and to O.A.G., July-Sept., 1933.

SEEL, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1895; ed. Macclesfield Grammar Schl. and Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (schol.); on mily. serv., Cheshire Regt. in Gallipoli, Egypt and Palestine; apptd. to air miny., 29th July, 1919; seconded for serv. in C.O., as asst. prin., 9th Jan., 1922; prte. sec. to parly. under secy. of state for the Cols. (Mr. Wm. Lunn, M.P.), 10th June 1929; prin., 17th Sept., 1929.

SEHEULT, JOSEPH EMMANUEL.—B. 1881; entd. civ. serv., Trinidad, Mar., 1902; ch. clk., dept. of agric., Jan., 1916; asst. censor, 1914; censor, Apr., 1918; man.-sec., agric. bank, Jan., 1928.

SEHEULT, LEO GABRIEL, A.C.G.I.—B. 1886; ast. dist. offr., pub. works, Trinidad, Mar., 1911; 2nd grade dist. offr., Sept., 1916; 1st grade dist. offr., June, 1917; gen. ast. to ast. D.P.W., Jan., 1925.

SELBORNE, 2nd EARL OF (creat. 1882), VISCOUNT WOLMER, BARON SELBORNE (U.K.), K.G., (1909), P.C. (1900), G.C.M.G. (1906), THE RT. HON. WM. WALDGRAVE PALMER.—B. 1859; ed. at Winchester and at Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. (1st cls. hist.), 1882; ast. priv. sec. to Mr. Childers, Chanc. of Excheq., 1882-86; was mem. of parlmt. for E. Hants, 1885-92, and for W. Edinburgh City, 1892-96; succeeded his father, 1896; Under S. of S. for Cols., June, 1896; chmn., Pacific cable comtee., 1896; mem. of Pacific cable comtee., 1899; first lord of the admiralty, Nov., 12th, 1900; high commr. for S. Africa, and gov. and comdr-in-chief of Transvaal and O.R.C., 1905 to 1910; ceased to be gov. of O.R.C. on grant of resp. govt., June, 1907; pres. of bd. of agric. and fisheries, 1915-16.

SELBY, JOHN ALEXANDER ROBERTSON, M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.)—B. 1900; venereal diseases offr., med. dep., Hong Kong, 1930.

SELLS, MARTIN PERONNET O.B.E., A.M.I.M.E., M.I.Loco. E.—B. 1887; ed. Trent Coll. and Univ. Coll., London; junr. ast. loco. supt., Lancs and Yorks Rly.; temp. major R.E., 1917; supt., light rly., France, 1917-1919 (twice ment. in despatches); dist. loco. supt., Tanganyika Terry. rly., 1919; ag. ch. mech. engnr., Tanganyika Terry. rly., 1920; ch. mech. engnr., Gold Coast rly., 1922; ch. mech. engnr., Nigerian Rly., 1926.

SELWYN CLARKE, PERCY SELWYN, M.C., M.D., B.S. (Lond.), M.R.C.F. (Lond.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), D.P.H. (Eng.) with distinc., D.T.M. and H. (Lond.), barrister-at-law.—B. 1893; ed. St. Bartholomew's Hosp. and Lond. Univ.; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Oct., 1919; med. offr., health, W.A.M.S., Gold Coast, Nov., 1919; senr. sany. offr., W.A.M.S., Oct., 1924; awarded Langley Memorial Prize, 1924; dep. dir., sany. serv., May to Aug., 1927; del. for Gold Coast to Yellow Fever confee., Dakar, Senegal, 1928; visited U.S.A. and Canada at invitation of Rockefeller Foundation, 1928; asst. dir., sany. serv., June, 1929; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1929; awarded Médaille d'Argent des Épidémies for work in connection with outbreak of yellow fever in W. Africa, 1929; ch. health offr., F.M.S., 1930; ast. dir., med. serv., Gold Coast, Jan., 1932; dep.-dir., health serv., 1933.

SEMPLE, J. M., B.A., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O., T.C.D., L.M. (Rotunda).—Sandhurst, 1915; lieut., R. Irish Rifles, 1915-18; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1922; med. offr., Zanzibar, Oct., 1924; ag. S.S.O., July, 1925 to Oct., 1926; ag. D.D.S.S., Feb. to Aug., 1928; and Nov., 1928 to Aug., 1929; senr. med. offr., Uganda, 1934.

SENEVIRATNE, DIONYSIUS BARTHOLOMEW, M.M.—B. 1895; on mily. serv., Nov., 1915; cadet, Ceylon, Oct., 1920; attd. to B'calo Kachcheri, Oct., 1920; ditto, Kurunegala Kach., Nov., 1921;
office asst., Batticaloa kach., Dec., 1923; addnl. asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Dec., 1926; asst. govt. agt., Ratnapura and addnl. asst. govt. agt., Kegalle, Jan., 1929; dist. judge, N. Eliya, Jan., 1930; ditto, Anuradhapura, Sept., 1930; do., Ratnapura, Apr., 1931; asst. sttlmt. offr., Oct., 1931; asst. govt. agt., Kurunegala, Apr., 1934; asst. settlmt. offr., May, 1934; addnl. asst. to govt. agt., W. Prov., in addn., Oct., 1934.

SENEVIRATNE, LEOPOLD JAMES DE SILVA, LL.B., Barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn.—B. 1899; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1923; attd., Matara kach., Dec., 1923; ditto, Jaffna kach., July, 1924; ditto, Kegalla kach., Apr., 1925; pol. mag., Puttalam, Mar., 1926; ditto, Pt. Pedro, May, 1927; asst. sttlmt. offr., Apr., 1929.

SENNETT, CEDRIC WILLIAM ARTHUR.—B. 1890; ed. Plymouth Coll., Edinburgh Univ. and non-collegiate, Oxford (B.A.), 1913); cadet, S.S., 1914; asst. regisr., impts. and expts., 1917; asst. supt., govt. monopolies, 1920; asst. dist. offr., 1920; offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1921; asst. sup't., govt. monopolies, Penang, Nov., 1923; dep. regisr., sup. ot. and asst. offr., assignee, Penang, Jan., 1925; dist. offr., Dindings, Mar., 1926 (offr., cls. III.); 2nd mag., asst. dist. judge and coroner, Penang, Nov., 1926; collr., land rev., Penang, Apr., 1927 and Mar., 1930; offr., assignee and asst. regisr., coys., Penang, July, 1929; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1931; dist. offr., L. Perak Apr., 1933; 1st mag., Ipoh, Oct., 1933; asg. dist. offr., Kinta, Apr., 1935.

SERTSIOS, B. D., O.B.E. (1931).—B. 1876; ed., Athens; Ph.D., University of Athens; B.A., Greek College, Serres; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1906; judge, dist. ct., Cyprus, 1909; asst. king's advoo., June, 1924; title changed to asst. atty.-gen., May, 1925; ag. solr.-gen., Apr. to May, 1927; puisne judge, Oct., 1927; ag. ch. just., July-Sept., 1934.

SETON, CLAUD RAMSAY WILMOT, M.C. (1918).—B. 1888; ed. Framlingham Coll., Lealeham, Margate and Univ. Coll., London; admitted solr., sup. ct., England, 1910; on mily. serv., 1914-19; wounded, 1918; twice ment. in desps.; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1928; pres., dist. ct., Jaffa, Palestine, 1919; judl. adviser, Transjordan, Oct., 1926; pres., dist. ct., Haifa, 1931; puisne judge, Jamaica, 1934; puisne judge, Jamaica, 1935; publication "Legislation of Transjordan, 1918-1930."

SEVERN, SIR CLAUS, K.B.E. (1923), C.M.G. (1917), M.A. (Cantab.), LL.D., Hong Kong (1920).—B. 1869; temp. clk. in librarian's dept., Foreign Office, Mar., 1891, to June, 1892; priv. sec. to gov., S. Sttlmts., Feb., 1894; junr. offr., Selangor, Dec., 1895; passed in Malay and law, 1898; asst. dist. offr., Selangor, June, 1897; asst. dist. offr., Serendah, May, 1899; asst. sec. to res.-gen., F.M.S., Aug., 1903; sec. to high commnr., Malay States, Feb., 1911; col. sec., Hong Kong, Feb., 1912; admnstd. govt. on various occasions, 1912-13, 1916-19, 1921-22; ret., 1926.

SEVIGNY, HON. ALBERT, K.C.—B. 1881; ed. Nicolet and Valleyfield (Quebec) Colls. and Laval Univ., B.A., L.L.L.; advoc., city of Quebec; elec. to H. of C., Canada, g.e. 1911; dep. speaker, 1915; speaker, 1916; min. of inland rev., 1917; defeated at g.e., 1917; mem. of the P.C. for Canada; judge, superior ct., Quebec, Mar., 1921.

SEWELL, CHARLES YULE BLACKWOOD.—B. 1888; govt. roads dept., New Zealand, 1906; surv., rev. survey dept., Perak, Oct., 1908; surv., 1st grade, Apr., 1909; asst. supt., surveys, Kedah, Aug., 1917; supt., rev. surveys, N. Sembilan, Jan., 1926; ditto, Selangor, July, 1929; senr. supt., surveys, S'pore, May, 1933.

SEYMOUR, ALFRED WALLACE, C.M.G. (1934).—B. 1881; ed. Warwick Schol. and St. Andrew's Univ.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1906; asst. asst. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Mar., 1906; N.C. Prov., Apl., 1907; W. Prov., Nov., 1908; asst. govt. agt., Mullaittivu, Aug., 1910; ditto, Trincomalee, June, 1911; asst. govt. agt., Mullaittivu, Dec., 1912; ditto, Nuwara Eliya, Jan., 1913; ditto, Matale, Sept., 1915; on mil. duty, June, 1916; dist. judge, Chilaw, Aug., 1919; asst. govt. agt. Kegalla, Mar., 1920; govt. agt., N.C. Prov., May, 1921; regisr. gen., Dec., 1924; col. sec., Fiji, Dec., 1926; O.A.G., Fiji and high commnr., W. Pacific, for various periods, 1927-33; gov.'s dep. for various periods, 1930-35; col. sec., Trinidad, 1935.

SEYMOUR-HALL, CHARLES F.R.S.A., F.R.E.S., M.R.A.S., F.Z.S.—B. 1897; prob. flight offr., R.N.A.S., 1917; flight sub-lieut., R.N., 1917; lieut., R.A.F., 1918; ment. in desp., 1918; capt., H.M.A.Z., 31, 1918; demob., 1919; asst. dist. commnr., Zanzibar, 1921; ag. 2nd asst. sec. and priv. sec. to ag. Br. res., 1923-4; ag. asst. admistr.-gen., 1926-27; ag. asst. sec., pvt. sec. to Br. res., clk. of couns. and edr., offr. gal., 1928; ag. prov. commnr. (with seat on leg. coun.) 1929, 1930, 1931, 1932 and 1934; dist. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1935; assisted in revision of Madan's Swahili Dictionary, 1931.

SHACKLES, DEREK HOLMES.—B. 1900; ed., R.N.C., Osborne and Greshams Schol., Holt; solr.; asst. commnr., landa, Gold Coast, 1929; dep. regisr., high ct., Tanganyika Territory, 1933; ag. regisr., 1933; regisr., high ct., Uganda, 1934.

SHARP, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1888; ed., Univ. Coll. Schol. and King's Coll., London; comprtr. and acct.-gen.'s dept., G.P.O., 1907-12; acct., postal dept., S. Nigeria, 1912-14; acct., posts and tels. dept., N. and S. Provs. of Nigeria, 1914-19; ch. acct., posts and tels., Nigeria, 1920; on mily. serv., London Rifle Brig., 1908-12; Nigerian Land Congt., 1914-18; ch. acct., P. and T., Nigeria, 1920; ag. dep., P.M.G. in 1928-30; ret., Oct., 1930; reappd. col. postmnr., Barbados, July, 1931 and in 1934.

SHARPE, H. B.—Asst. dist. commnr., Kenya Colony, Apl., 1919; ag. dist. commnr., 1926.

SHAW, BARNABAS JAMES DOLD.—B. 1877; elk., cust., Port Elizabeth, 1897; senr. elk., Pretoria, 1915; prin. elk., 1920; ch. elk., Cape Town, 1928; collr., cust. and S.M., E. London, 1932; do., Johannesburg, 1934; do., Port Elizabeth, 1934.

SHAW, FREDERIC LLOYD, B.A. (Hons.) Lond.—B. 1892; ag. headmast., English Coll., Johore Bahru, Feb., 1921; headmast., govt. English Schl., Muar, June, 1922; 1st asst. mast., Sultan Idris Training Coll., Nov., 1925; asst. mast., Raffles Inst., Jan., 1926; inspr., schls., Selangor, Apr., 1926; asst. inspr., schls. Singapore and Labuan, Mar., 1927 and Dec., 1928; headmast., Victoria Inst. K. Lumpur, Aug., 1929.

SHAW, JOHN HENRY DE BURGH, B.L.—B. 1887; ed., Clifton Schol., Dalkey, Dublin and Corrig Schl., Kingston; asst. dist. commnr., Sierra Leone, May, 1921; dist. commnr., May, 1928.

SHAW, JOHN VALENTINE WESTAN.—B. 1894; ed., Reston Schol.; service with M.E., 1914-19; asst. dist. commnr., Gold Coast, 1921; dist. commnr., 1925; asst. col. sec., 1928; seconded for duty at C.O., Mar.-Sept., 1930; asst. sec., grade F, Palestine, 1935.
SHAW, ROBERT PHILLIP, A.R.I.B.A. (Chartered Architect).—B. 1888; ed. Bathgate Acad. and Heriot Watt Coll., Edinburgh; architect, P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1920.

SHAW, SIR WALTER SIDNEY, KT. BACH.(1921).—B. 1863; ed. Brighton Coll. and Trin. Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1888; pol. mag. and ag. chief just., St. Vincent, 1906; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; confirmed as chief just., 1907; ag. chief just., Grenada, Feb., 1908, to June, 1909; revised and consolidated laws of St. Vincent, 1912; admtd. govt. of St. Vincent, June, 1911 to Jan., 1912, and for various shorter periods; chief just., R. Honduras, 1912; puisne justice, Ceylon, Aug., 1914; ag. chief just., June to Oct., 1916; ch. just., S. Stittinta., May, 1921; ret., 1926.

SHEEHAN, JOHN JOSEPH.—B. 1896; ed. Christian Schla., Dublin Univ. and Univ. Coll., Dublin; pte., Artists Rifles, Dec., 1916; 2nd lieut., R.F.A., Sept., 1917; demob., May, 1919; cadet, F.M.S., Mar., 1920; passed cadet, Nov., 1921; sec., rubber restrn., Oct., 1922; supernum. off., cls. V., Mar., 1923; dep. contrlr., rubber expts., Johore, in addn., Aug., 1923; offr., cls. IV., Mar., 1927; dist. offr., Temerloh, Jan., 1930; offr., cls. III., Mar., 1932; dist. offr., K. Pilah, Nov., 1933.

SHELLEY, MALCOLM BOND., C.M.G.(1934).—B. 1879; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Christ's Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1901; cadet, F.M.S., 1902; capt., M.S.V.R., 1915; off. assignee and pub. trustee, 1923; chmn., trade statistics comttee., Aug., 1926; contr., rubber, S.S. and F.M.S., Nov., 1926; treas., S.S., 1929; ag. dir. educn., S.S. and F.M.S. and pres., Raffles Coll., Dec., 1929; Br. res., Perak, June, 1932; ag. ch. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Dec., 1933.

SHELLISH, ALEXANDER JOHN.—B. 1881; jun. clk., postal dept., Cyprus, 1902; asst. island postmtr., 1921; postmtr.-gen., 1934.

SHELSWELL-WHITE, GROFFREY HENRY, Barrister-at-Law.—B. 1897; ed. Whitgift Schl.; comand. with R.F.A. in India, Mesopotamia and Persia, 1916-18; asst. pol. offr., Mesopotamia, 1918-20; personal asst. to Sir Arnold Wilson, ag. civ. comanr., 1918; Iraq rebellion, 1920; A.D.C., Zanzibar, 1921; priv. sec. to res., ag. 1st asst. sec., secretariat, clk. to prot. coun. and edr., off. gaz. at various periods; higher standard Swahili, 1925; pres., Pemba Swahili exam. bd., 1929; dist. registr., Pemba, 1929 and 1930; ag. res. mag., Pemba, 1929 and 1930; called to bar, 1930; pte. sec. to Sultan, 1930; asst. sec., secretariat, 1930; clk., exec. and leg. couns., 1931; edr., Offl. Gaz., 1931-33; trades licensing omsnr., 1934; ag. asst. ch. sec., 1934; ag. asst. ch. sec. and prov. comanr., 1935; author of "A Guide to Zanzibar."

SHELTON, C. F., M.D., B.S., D.T.M. & H., M.R.C.P.—B. 1888; civil surgeon, Serbian red cross, 1913; surgeon lieut., 1914-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1921; junr. med. specialist, 1934.

SHELTON, JAMES, F.I.C.—B. 1886; asst. rech. and analytical chem. in the sc. and tech. dept., Imp. Inst., G. Britain, Mar., 1909; 2nd asst. govt. analyst, Singapore, Feb., 1915; chem., geol. dept., F.M.S., Feb., 1917; in charge, of geol. dept., June, 1917; on sp. duty at Inst. Med. Resch., Jan., 1923; in charge, trade and cust. labv., Mar., 1930 and July, 1933; ag. ch. chem., Inst. Med. Resch., F.M.S., Mar., 1931.

SHELTON, LAWRENCE HUGH, M.A. (Cantab).—B. 1891; ed. St. Michael's Coll., Tenbury, Hereford Schl. and St. John's Coll., Cambridge; asst. dist. offr., S. Nigeria, 1915; cls. I, admstv. serv., 1932; ag. dep. ch. sec., Nigeria, in 1934 and 1935; prin. asst. sec., Jan., 1935.

SHEPPARD, CHARLES HENRY, O.B.E.(1932).—B. 1897; European War, 1914-1918; ment. in desps.; Kurdish gendarmerie, 1919-21; inspecting offr., Iraq pol., 1922-31; Iraq gallantry med., 1932; asst. commdt., pol., Somaliland, 1931.

SHEPSTONE, FRANCIS ALLAN, K.C.—B. 1879; ed. Harrow; rly. constr., Pretoria-Pietersburg, 1898-99; Anglo-Boer war, 1899-1901; barrister, Inner Temple, 1905; Transvaal bar, 1907; Natal, 1908; farming, 1912-22; S.A.H.R., 1918; solvr., 1922-29; Natal bar, 1930; ag. judge, native high ct., 1932; K.C., 1934; judge, native high ct., 1934.

SHERGOLD, F. V.—B. 1900; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Apr., 1918; on mily. serv., 1918 to 1920; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

SHERIDAN, SIR JOSEPH, KT. Bach.(1932).—B. 1882; ed. Castleknock Coll. and Trin. Coll., Dublin; called to bar, Ireland, 1907; went Connaught circuit; judicial clk. (title subsequently changed to asst. to atty.-gen.), Nyasaland Prot., 1908-13; ag. atty.-gen. on different occasions, 1909-13; ag. judge, high ct., Dec., 1909 to Jan., 1910; res. mag., Kenya, 1913-20; ag. puisne judge, Kenya, and mem., ct. of appl. for Eastern Africa, 1919-20; puisne judge, Kenya and mem. ct. of appl. for Eastern Africa, 1920; ag. ch. just., Kenya, 1928-29; ch. just., Tanganyika Territory, 1929; ch. just., Kenya, 1934.

SHERINGHAM, ANTHONY ILEX.—B. 1890; ed. Brighton Coll.; Ceylon pol., 1909-31; on active serv., 1917-18 (lieut., 8th Hussars); comanr., pol., and comanr., prisons, Zanzibar, Apr., 1931.

SHERLOCK, DAVID THOMAS JOSEPH, K.C.(1922), B.A.T.C.D., M.B.E. (Mil.).—B. 1881; judl. comanr. and offl. mem., leg. coun., N. Borneo, Dec., 1920; ch. just., Feb., 1926; ret., Aug., 1935; judge, ct. of appl., Jamaica, 1935.

SHRREWELL, ARNOLD GUY.—B. 1891; ed. St. Edward's Schl. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; M.A. (schl. of jurisprudence, hons. cls. III); called to bar (Inner Temple), 1914; asst. res., Nyasaland, 1914; mily. serv. in Africa, ment. in desps., 1915; practised at bar, 1920-25; dist. judge, Sudan, 1925; asst. advoc. gen. and legal advr. to Sudan govt., rlys. and steamers, 1928; govt. advoc., Palestine, Apr., 1929; relieving pres. of dist. cts., 1930; pres. dist. ct., 1936.

SHIELD, CHARLES GEOFFRY.—B. 1896; on mily. service (France) 1914-18; on staff, 1918-19; priv. secy. to gov., and clk. to couns., Seychelles, 1920.

SHIELS, DR. T. DRUMMOND, M.C., M.P.—B. 1881; ed. Edinburgh Univ. (M.B., Ch. B.); served European War as offr. R. Scots.; in command with rank as capt. one of trench mortar batteries of 9th (Scottish) Divn. (severely wounded); was a mem., Edinburgh town coun.; M.P., East Edinburgh since 1924; mem., sp. comanr., Ceylon constitution, 1927; parly. under sec., India Office, June, 1924; parly. under-sec. for cols., 1929-31.

SHILL, A. T.—B. 1895; on active serv. with Rifle Brig. and Dorset Regt., 1915-17; wounded; Imp. cust. and excise dept., 1919; also dep. supt., mercantile marine, recr. of wreck, regsr. shipping, Lascar transfer offr., etc. asst. recr. gen., Gambie, Aug., 1928; ag. asst. col. sec., Apr. to Oct., 1929 and from July, 1931; contr. food and fuel, May, 1931; supervisor, cust. and exc. dept., Mauritius, Apr., 1932.
SHIPWAY, WALTER ROBERT, M.B.E. (1924).—B. 1879; apptd., after compet. exam., 2nd div. elk., and assigned to C.O., Dec., 1898; minor staff elk., 1911; registr. of col. laws, 1st Apr., 1922; staff offr., promotions, 19th Nov., 1928.

SHIRLEY, EVELYN PHILIP SEWALLIS, O.B.E.—B. 1900; ed. St. Columbus Coll. Rathfarnham, Dublin and R. Mily. Coll., Camberley; joined R. Irish Fusiliers, Dec., 1918; N. Persia and Iraq, 1920; seconded, K.A.R., Jan., 1923; 2/1st K.A.R., Tanganyik and Somaliland Camel Corps; 3rd grade commr., Somaliland, Sept., 1929.

SHREWSBURY, HERBERT SUTCLIFFE, F.I.C., F.C.S.—B. 1878; ed. Newchurch Grammar Schl., Nottingham Univ.; asst. govt. analyst, Trinidad, 1910; priv. asst. govt. analyst, 1912; govt. analyst, 1920; author of various papers on orig. and analytical processes, and on agrl. and forensic chemistry.

SHUCKBURGH, SIR JOHN EVELYN, K.C.M.G. (1922), C.B. (1918).—B. 1877; ed. Eton and King's Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1899; M.A., 1906; apptd. jnr. elk., store dept., I. O., Oct., 1900; transf'd. to judl. and pub. dept., Mar., 1901; joint editor, "India Office List," Oct., 1901; priv. sec. to permitt. under-sec. of state, July, 1902; senr. clk., polit. dept., Mar., 1906; asst. sec., polit. dept., Oct., 1912; sec., polit. dept., Mar., 1917; ag. asst. under sec. of state, C. O., 1st Mar., 1921; asst. under sec. of state, 1st Apr., 1924; dep. under sec. of state, 15th Aug., 1931.

SHUTE, GEOFFREY GAY, B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1892; ed. St. Andrew's Schl., Eastbourne, Uppingham and Clare Coll., Cambridge; asst. dist. offr., Nigeria, 1915; cls. I, admstive serv., 1930; priv. asst. sec., S. Prova., 1931; sec., S. Prova., 1933.

SIDEBOTHAM, JOHN BIDDULPH, B.A. (1914), M.A. (1920).—B. 1891; ed. King's Schl., Canterbury, and Gonville and Caius Coll., Cambridge (Stanhope exhibr., open class exhibr., 1911, schol., 1912); 1st cls., theolog. tripso, pt. I, 1914; 2nd lieut., Home Counties R.E. (T.F.), 1914; lieut., 13th June, 1916; serv. in France, 1914-15; wounded, Apr., 1915; demob., 1919; ent. inland rev., Somerset House, 7th Feb., 1920; transf'd. to C.O. as asst. prin. under reconstruction scheme, Dec., 1922; sec., managing comttee., bureau of hygiene and trop. diseases, 1925; sec., East African guaranteed loan advisory comttee., 1927; pvt. sec. to partly. under-sec. of state for dom. affrs., 15th Sept., 1928; pvt. sec., permitt. under sec. for the cols., 8th July, 1929, priv., 24th Jan., 1930; accomp. permitt. under S. of S. for the Cols. (Sir J. Maffey) to W. Indies, 1936.

SIDLEY, WILLIAM HENRY FRANCIS, B.A. (Trinity Coll., Dublin).—Cadet, R.I.C., Aug., 1908; 3rd cls. dist. inspr., Oct., 1908; 2nd cls., Feb., 1910; 1st cls., Aug., 1919; county inspr., Nov., 1920; served in R.I.C. until disbandment of that force, July, 1922; depot inspr. (1st cls.), Jamaica constab., Dec., 1922; ag. dep. inspr.-gen., Aug., 1923; dep. inspr.-gen., Dec., 1923; ag. inspr.-gen., June to Oct., 1925.

SIKES, HOWARD LECKY, C.B.E. (1936), B.A., B.E. (hons. and extbr.), R.U.I., M.I.C.E., F.G.S.—B. 1881; ed. Botham Schl., York; asst. engrn., P.W.D., E. Africa Prot., 1907; res. engrn. Mombasa water wks., 1911; engrn. in ch., Magadi water wks., constrn., 1913; res. engrn., Magadi rly., 1915; lieut., E.A. Pioneers, 1915; capt., 1916; govt. hydraulic engrn., P.W.D., Kenya, Jan., 1919; dep. dir., pub. wks., Kenya, 1921; D.P.W. and offl. mem., leg. coun., 1923.

SILVESTER, J. M.—Asst. dist. commr., E.A.P., Dec., 1913; ag. dist. commr., Kenya, 1926.

SIMMONS, BENJAMIN ROBERT—Cltk. in conservator of forest's office, E. conservancy, Transkei, 1898; ag. dist. forest offr., Stutterheim, 1902; dist. forest offr., Stutterheim, 1906; ditto, George, 1914; 2nd grade conservator of forests, Transkeian conservancy, 1929; prin. forest offr. (forestry inspr.), Natal and Transkei, 1932; Western inspectorate, 1935.

SIMMONS, GEORGE STANLEY, M.I.Mech.E., Chartered Mech. Engrn.—B. 1892; ed. Battersea Polytechnic; asst. loco. supt., Lancs and Yorks rly.; loco. supt., Togoland Milly. rly., Apr., 1917; asst. loco. supt., Gold Coast rly., May, 1920; dist. loco. supt., do., July, 1925; asst. ch. mech. engrn., do., Dec., 1926; ch. mech. engrn., do., Apr., 1934.

SIMMONS, HON. WM. CHAS.—B. 1865; ed. at Collingwood and Owen Sound High Schls.; B.A., Toronto Univ., 1896; called to the bar, N.W.T., 1900; elec. to legis. assem. of Alberta for Lethbridge dist., 1906; resign., 1908; puisne judge of sup. ct. Alberta, 12th Oct., 1910.

SIMMS, HENRY, O.B.E. (1935), M.V.O. (1917), A.M.I.C.E. (1913).—B. 1881; sany. engrn., Gold Coast, 1908; sany. engrn., Sierra Leone, 1912; D.P.W., Cyprus, 1919; D.P.W., Jamaica, 1925.

SIMPSON, JOHN.—Imp. tel. serv., Jan., 1892; transf'd., post office, Cape of Good Hope, Nov., 1893; survr., posts and tels., Mar., 1920; pub. serv. inspr., Aug., 1921.

SIMS, JAMES HUGH, C.B.E. (1936).—B. 1878; sub-inspr., Basutoland Mounted Pol., 1905; inspr., 1913; asst. commr., 1918.

SINCLAIR, HON. JOHN EWEN.—B. 1879; ed. local common schls.; mem. of swine coman. which visited Europe in 1909; unsucc. cand., legis. ass., P.E.L., 1908; el. to H.C., g.e., 1917; re-el., 1921; min. without portfolio in King admstn., 29th Dec., 1921; senator, June, 1930.

SINCLAIR, HON. SIR J. R., KT. BACH (1918).—B. 1851; ed. Dunedin High Schl., N.Z.; barrister; M.L.C., N.Z., 1907-14 and 1918-32; rep. N.Z. on Dominion Royal Comsn., 1912.

SINCLAIR, ST. CLAIR OVERBECK, M.A., F.I.C., D.Sc.—Cltk., atty.-gen's. office, 1893; clk., col. sec.'s office, 1894; analyst, 1897; transf'd., dept. of agr., 1907; transf'd., dept. of int., 1911; govt. analyst, Cape Town, 1918; transf'd., dept. of agr., Apr., 1923; chief of divn. of chemistry, Mar., 1926.

SINCLAIR-BURGESS, MAJOR-GEN. SIR WILLIAM LIVINGSTONE HATCHWELL, K.B.E. (1935), Kt. Bach (1934), C.B., C.M.G. (1918), D.S.O. (1916)—Lieut., N.Z. Staff Corps, Mar., 1911; adjt., 16th Waikato Regt. and O.C. No. 4 group, Mar., 1911; capt., June, 1913; proceeded as exchange offr. with Australian mil. forces, 1913; brig.-major, 6th mil. dist., 1913-14; left Australia with A.I.F.; O.C., 9th Batt., 1914; major (A.I.F.), 1914; commdr., Australian F.A. Ele., with rank lieut.-col., Feb., 1916; commdr., 4th Australian Divl. Arty. with rank brig.-gen., Aug., 1917-19; major, N.Z. staff corps, 1919; lieut.-col., Aug., 1919; arty. staff offr., cent. commd., Nov., 1919; G.S.O. (I) at G.H.Q., Apr., 1922; dir., mily. training and intell., Jan., 1924; ch. of gen. staff, Apr., 1924 with temp. rank col. on staff; ag. commdt., N.Z. mily. forces, Sep.-Dec., 1925; temp-brig., June, 1928; major-gen. and apptd. commdt. N.Z. mily. forces, Apr., 1931; Croix d'officier of Legion of Honour; awarded American D.S.M.; six times ment. in deeps.

SISNETT, SIR HERBERT KORTRIGHT McDONNELL, KT. BACH (1927)—Ed. at Harrison Coll., Barbados; called to the bar, Inner Tem.,
May, 1896; practised at bar, Barbados, June, 1897, to Feb., 1898; ag. junior pol. mag., Bridgetown, Barbados, Sept. to Nov., 1897; ag. res. mag. for St. Ann's, June to Dec., 1901; ag. priv. sec. to Sir A. Hemming, May to June, 1902, and priv. sec. to Mr. Olivier, the ag. gov't., June to Nov., 1902; clk. of cts., St. James, Jamaica, Apl., 1903; ag. res. mag., St. James and Trelawny, Sept., 1903, do., St. Elizabeth, Mar., 1904, do., Manchester, Apl. to June, 1904, do., St. James and Trelawny in 1904, 1905 and 1906; regiar-gen., Br. Hond., and dist. comsrr. of Belize, Apl., 1907; ag. atty.-gen. and ag. ch. just., Br. Hond., on several occasions; J.P. for Br. Hond., 1907; stip. mag., B. Guiana, Mar., 1913; held inquiry into Rose Hall coolie riots, 1913, and was highly commended by S. of S.; ag. atty.-gen., 1919-20; seconded, puisne judge, Jamaica, 1920; lat puisne judge, 1921; ch. just., Br. Hond., 1922; compiled Br. Hond. sup. ct. rules, 1926; apptd. arbitrator by govt. of U.S.A. and Guatemala in case of P.W. Shufeldt v. the govt. of Guatemala.

SITTAMPALAM, CATHIRAVELU, B.A. (Cantab.), Barrister-at-law (Middle Temple).—B. 1898; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Feb., 1923; attd., Kalutara kach., Mar., 1923; ditto, Kandy kach., Mar., 1925; office asst., Puttalam kach., Aug., 1926; pol. mag., Matara, Apr., 1928; ditto, Puttalam, Oct., 1929; asst. govt. agt., Kurunegala, Nov., 1929; dist. judge, Kegalle, July, 1931; asst. govt. agt., Kurunegala, July, 1932; do., Batticaloa, May, 1934.

SKAN, D. A., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., D.T.M., B.T.H. (Liv.).—B. 1899; war serv., N.R.V.R., 1918-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1926.

SKEETE, CEOL CARRINGTON, B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1900; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; 3rd class hona. nat. sci. tripos pt. I., 1922; dipl. course, Schl. of Agr., Cambridge, 1922-23; asst. dir., agr., Barbados, Sept., 1923; ag. dir., agr., in 1924 and 1925; asst. dir., sci. and agr., Sept., 1925; ag. dir., sci. and agr., on various occasions, 1926-29.

SKELTON, OSCAR DOUGLAS, M.A., Ph.D.—B. 1878; ed. Orangeville and Cornwall High Schls., Queen's Univ. and Univ. of Chicago; counsellor, dept. of external affrs., 15th July, 1924; under-sec. of state for external affrs., 30th Mar., 1925.

SKENE, CHARLES EDWARD.—B. 1889; ed. St. Paul's Schl. and Wren's; asst. dist. comsrr., Gold Coast, Nov., 1912; seconded for serv. in col. sec.'s office, 1912-13; dist. comsrr., G. Coast, Nov., 1912; col. sec.'s office, 1912-15; priv. sec. to ag. gov., 1914; ag. dist. comsrr., Ashanti, 1916-18; dist. comsrr., Oct., 1918; ag. pol. mag., Dec., 1922; dep. prov. comsrr., July, 1927; prov. comsrr., Sept., 1928; ag. sec., native affrs. Apr., June, 1930 and Apr. to Oct., 1932; ag. dep. col. sec., June-Sept., 1930.

SKINNER, ARTHUR DONALD WILLIAM.—B. 1890; ed. Bedford Schl.; 4th clk., col. sec.'s office, Antigua, Aug., 1914; sub-inspr. of schools, St. Kitts-Nevis, Apl., 1915; o/c cadet corps, St. Kitts-Nevis, 1917; ag. inspr. of schl., Leeward Is., Apl., 1918 to Feb., 1920; clk. to comsrr., clk. of couns. and educnl. dist. offr., Montserrat, Feb.-Oct., 1920; lat clk., col. sec.'s office, clk. of couns., Antigua and supt., govt. printing office, Leeward Is., Nov., 1920; ag. asst. col. sec. and ag. clk. of couns. Leeward Is. on various occasions 1921-24; bursar, Achimota Coll., Gold Coast, 1927; ag. prin., Prince of Wales Coll., July to Sept., 1929; asst. col. sec., Sept., 1931; ag. clk., couns., May to June, 1932.

SKINNER, HUGH WELBY.—B. 1894; war serv., 1914-19; served in France, India, Mesopotamia; capt., T.A. res., gen. list, R.A.; apptd. coll. audlt. dept., 1923; asst. audlr., Nyassaland, 1923; asst. audlr., Nigeria, 1926; coll. audlt., 1930; asst. audlr., Gold Coast, 1935.

SKINNER, LESLIE ERNEST.—B.1890; Gloucestershire R.F.A., 1908 to 1910; B.S.A. Pol., 1910 to 1913; E.A.P. pol., Sept., 1913; asst. supt., 1915; staff offr. to inspr.-gen. of pol. and prisons, Kenya Colony and Uganda Prot., 1920 to 1923; supt., pol., Nyassaland, 1922; ag. ch. comsrr., pol. and ch. inspr., prisons, 1923 to 1924; asst. commdt., pol., Zanzibar, 1924; ag. comsrr., pol. and gov., prisons on various occasions, 1925-35.

SKINNER, ROBERT BURNELL, M.B.E. (1933).—B. 1893; ed. Bedford Modern Schl.; held various minor appts., Leeward Is., 1910-20; ch. clk. to admr., and clk., couns., St. Kitts-Nevis, Nov., 1920; ch. clk. to admr. and clk., couns., Dominica, Nov., 1924; sec., loan bd., May, 1926; mem., Roseau town bd., Apr., 1927; comsrr., income tax, May, 1927; pvt. sec. to Sir Eustace Fiennes, Nov., 1927 to June, 1929; ag. treas., Dominica, June to Sept., 1929; offl. mem., exec. and leg. couns., Dominica, June to Sept., 1929; O.A.G., Montserrat, Feb., 1930; ag. treas. and offl. mem., exec. and leg. couns., May to Sept., 1930; treas., Antigua and fedl. treas., Mar., 1931; offl. mem., fedl. exec. coun. and gen. leg. coun.; mem., exec. and leg. coun., Antigua; dep. treas. and comsrr., income tax, Trinidad, Mar., 1934.

SLADE-HAWKINS, W.—Asts. dist. comsrr., E. Africa Prot., Apl., 1919.

SLATER, SIR ALEXANDER RANSFORD, K.C.M.G. (1933), K.C.M.G. (1924); C.M.G. (1916); C.B.E. (1918).—B. 1874; ed. at King Ed. schl., Birmingham, and Emm. Coll., Camb. (scholar); B.A. 1897 (30th wrangler); cadet, Ceylon, Nov., 1898; extra offr. asst. govt. agt., W. P., Aug., 1899; 2nd asst., P.M.G., Mar., 1900; ag. 2nd astt. col. sec., Dec., 1901; on spec. duty at camp for prisoners of war Diyatalawa, July, 1902; ag. 2nd astt. col. sec., Jan., 1903; clk. legis. coun., May, 1904; dist. judge, Badulla, Apl., 1906; additional astt. col. sec. and clk., legis. couns., Apl., 1907; on special deptn. to Straits and F.M.S., Jan., 1908; 2nd astt. col. sec., Feb., 1908; ag. prin. astt. col. sec., Dec., 1909; dep. collr. of cust., Colombo, Sept., 1910; joint comsrr. to report on salaries of pub. serv., Nov., 1911; prin. astt. col. sec., Sept., 1912, and clk. to exec. coun.; col. sec., G. Coast, 18th Aug., 1914; on sp. duty in Togoland, 1st to 28th Sept., 1916; ag. gov'r., G. Coast on several occasions; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Sierra Leone, Apr., 1922; gov. and comdr-in-chief, Gold Coast, 1927; capt.-gen. and gov.-in-ch., Jamaica, 1932; resigned, 1934.

SLEEP, CAPT. ARTHUR, B.Sc. (Manchester).—B. 1894; cadet, F.M.S., Feb., 1920; attd. land office, Kelantan, Feb., 1920; passed cadet, Nov., 1921; asst. supt., lands, Kelantan, Mar., 1923; asst. dist. offr., Mar., 1925; dist. offr., Aug., 1926; offr., cls. III, Mar., 1931; 2nd astt. sec. to govt., F.M.S., May, 1931; ag. astt. treas., F.M.S. and state treas., Selangor, May, 1934.

SLOLEY, SIR HERBERT CECIL, K.C.M.G. (1911); C.M.G. (1905).—Served in C.M.R. in campaigns against Griquas and Moirosi (medal with clasp, 1877-8-9); capt. in native contingent, Basuto war, 1880-1; mentioned in despatches; sub-inspr., Cape police, 1883; ditto, Basutoland, 1884; inspr., 1886; astt. comsrr., Basutoland, 1889; ag. res. comsrr.,
July to Dec., 1895; govt. sec., 1898; ag. res. commnr., Dec., 1900; res. commnr., Sept., 1901; ret., 1926.

SLOMAN, ARTHUR ERIC PENROSE, B.A.—B. 1890; ed. Bradfield Coll., Berks., Queen's Coll., Cambridge, and Univ. of Neuchatel, Switzerland; served in Great War, 1915-19; lieut., R.F.A.; mem., Br. pol. mission to Greece, 1920-27; insp., secondary schls., Cyprus, 1934.

SMALL, ALEXANDER SYM, M.A., B.Sc. (Glas.).—B. 1887; ed. Glasgow Univ.; cadet, F.M.S., Jan., 1911; offr., cls. V, sec. to res., N. Sembilan, Mar., 1914; offr., cls. IV, Jan., 1919; offr., cls. III, Jan., 1923; town planning admstr., K. Lumpur, Dec., 1926; offr., cls. Ia, finan. commnr. and audr.-gen., Johore, June, 1927; offr., cls. Ia, finan. advr. and treas., F.M.S., Dec., 1930; treas., S.S., June, 1932.

SMALL, WILLIAM, M.B.E. (Mily.), ment. in desps.—B. 1885; ed. Univ. of St. Andrews; D.Sc.; botanist, Uganda, 1913; mycologist, 1920; mycologist, Ceylon, 1926; dir. of agr., Nyasaland, 1930.

SMALLEY, JAMES THORNTON, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.).—B. 1882; late clinical asst., asst. house surg., out-pat. offr. and house surg., Guy's hosp.; clinical asst., Evelina hosp., London; R.M.O., Colony hosp., Suva, Fiji; D.M.O., Ra.; D.M.O. and M.O.H., and port med. offr., Levuka; stip. mag., Levuka, 1910-1913; med. offr., Kowloon and New Territories, Hong Kong, med. offr., Kowloon-Canton rly., and med. offr. in charge, pub. mortuary, Kowloon, 1913; lecturer in Pharmacology and Therapeutics, and examr., physiology, Hong Kong Univ.; J.P., 1919; visiting med. offr., Kwong Wah hospital; med. offr. in charge, Lai Chi Kok branch prison; surg. lieut., Hong Kong Volunteer Corps; med. offr. govt. civil hosp., 1929; ag. prin. civ. med. offr., Nov., 1927 to Jan., 1928; ag. dep. dir., med. and sanry. services, Feb., 1928 to Feb., 1929; senr. med. offr. and in ch., Kowloon hosp., Jan., 1931.

SMALLWOOD, MARGARET, M.B., B.S. Grad. L.S.T.M. and Hyg. Trin. Coll., Melbourne Univ.—B. 1898; lady med. offr., inf. wel. centre, Ipoh, May, 1924; do., hosp. Ipoh, Nov., 1927; do., women's hosp., K. Kangsar, Dec., 1933; do., hosp., Ipoh, Sept., 1934.

SMART, CAPT. ARCHIBALD Guelph Holdsworth, M.B.E. (Mil.), M.B., Ch.B., D.P.H., D.T.M. & H.—B. 1882; med. offr., i/c quarantine stn., Singapore, May, 1912; attd., govt. lab., Singapore, Jly., 1913; lent to Kedah for anti-cholera work, Jan.-Apr., 1914; asst. health offr., Singapore, June, 1914; on war serv., R.A.M.C., 1915-18; med. offr., S. Kedah, Oct., 1920; health offr., Kedah, Nov., 1921; sr. health offr., Penang, May, 1927; ditto, Perak, May, 1928; State med. and health offr., Selangor and registr.-gen., births and deaths, F.M.S., Jan., 1932; mem., S.S. and F.M.S. med. coun., Feb., 1932; ret.; senr. med. offr., St. Vincent, 1935.

SMART, HAROLD PHILIP.—B. 1899; ed. Michaelhouse Diocesan Schl., Natal, Glen Schl. of Agr., O.F.S., (Farmers Weekly gold medallist), Transvaal Univ. Coll., Pretoria; (Farmers Weekly schl.), B. Sc. Agr., Balliol Coll., Oxford, Imp. Coll. Trop. Agr., Trinidad, A.I.C.T.A.; served with R.N.A.S. and R.A.F., 1918-20; lecturer in dairy ing. dept. agr., Union of S. Africa., 1926; agr. offr., Br. Honduras, 1928.

SMART, LESLIE MASON, C.B.E. (1936)—B. 1889; asst. supt., Kenya and Uganda Rly., Apr., 1919 to Mar., 1927; dep. traffic man., Tanganyika rly., Mar., 1927; gen. man., Gold Coast rly. and hbr. authority, Takoradi hbr., Oct., 1933.

SMART, V. IRVING.—B. 1875; ed. Upper Canada Coll., Toronto; graduated from Queen's Univ.; engaged on surveys for the Dom. govt., 1897-98; ent. rly. serv. 1900; prot., rly. engnr. and opern., McGill Univ., Montreal, 1907-14; sp. engnr., Canadian National Rlys., 1923-28; gen. supt., trans. Western region, C.N.R., 1928-30; dep. min. of rly. and canals, Dominion of Canada; also govt. dir., Canadian National Rlys., 1930.

SMARTT, FITZPATRICK FORBES PRACY.—Ed. Denstone Coll.; probationer, col. audit dept., July, 1921; asst. audr., Br. Honduras, Oct., 1921; asst. audr., N. Rhodesia, May, 1929; ditto, Tanganyika Territory, 1934.

SMIT, DOUGLAS LAING.—B. 1885; Cape civ. serv., 1903; pub. proscr., 1912; mag., 1927; under sec. for just., Pretoria, 1933; sec., nat. affrs., 1934.

SMIT, HAROLD PRINGLE.—B. 1883; joined Cape civ. serv., Jan., 1901; office of dir. of mil. intell., May-Aug., 1902; Transvaal law dept., Sept., 1902; ch. clk. to atty.-gen., Transvaal, July, 1908; addl. mag., Benoni, Sept., 1914; war stores comm., 1915; mag., Bloemhof dist., Dec., 1915; ch. clk., dept. of just., Dec., 1917; pub. serv. inspr., Feb., 1922; sec. for S.W. Africa, Apr., 1923; dep. admstr., May-Oct., 1924; sec. for lands, Feb., 1934.

SMIT, JACOBS STEPHANUS.—B. 1873; D.T.D. (Dekoratie Trouwe Dienst), Anglo-Boer War; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1905; pte. sec. to Gen. Smuts as col. sec., Transvaal, 1907; to Gen. Botha as premier, Transvaal, 1907 and to Hon. J. de Villiers as atty.-gen. Transvaal, 1908; asst. mag., Transvaal, 1909; asst. mag., Union civ. serv., 1910; resign., 1915; el. mem. for Klipdorp, Union of S. Africa legis. assem., 1920, 1921 and 1924; high commr. for Union of S. Africa, London, 1925; admstr., Transvaal, 1929-34; chmn., diamond control bd., 1934.

SMITH, LIEUT. ARTHUR BERTRAM, F.R.G.S.—B. 1889; ed. R. Masonic Schl., Bushey; sub. lieut., R.N.R., Oct., 1914; ag. lieut., Jan., 1915; served in 8th submarine flotilla, 1914-15; Baltic submarine flotilla, 1915-17; Russian Order of St. Anne, 3rd cls. (with swords), 1915; Russian Order of St. Vladimir, 4th cls. (with swords), 1916; commanded submarine C 14 (N. Sea), Mar. to Nov., 1918, and various surrendered German submarines, Nov., 1918 to Mar., 1919; port offr., Dar-es-Salaam, Mar., 1919; harthr. and supt. of lighthouses, Trinidad, Feb., 1926.

SMITH, ALLAN CHALMERS, B.A., M.C.—B. 1893; ed. Warwick Acad., Bermuda, Rossall Schl. and St. John's Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Gray's Inn, June, 1920; war serv., France and Italy, 1915-18 (three times ment. in desps.); pol.-mag., W. dist., Bermuda, Jan., 1928; M.L.A., 1929; pol. mag., cent. dist. and chmn., licensing authorities, Oct., 1931; pol. mag., Nigeria, Jan., 1935.

SMITH, A. H. W., M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.P.M. (Univ. of Lond.)—Med. supt., St. Ann's lunatic asylum, Trinidad, Nov., 1934.

SMITH, B. O.—Cler. asst., post. dept., Br. Guiana, Aug., 1898; sec., leave and pensions comm., 1920; sec., deptl. salaries comttee, 1921; gradually promoted to 1st cls. clk. and sec. currency comttee, July, 1923; transf'd to col. secretariat, Apr., 1925; acctnt., sup. ct., Oct., 1925; ch. acct., G.P.O., Dec., 1932; ag. P.M.G., 1935.
SMITH, CHARLES JOHNSTON, C.B.E., (1935), M.B., F.R.C.S. (Edin.).—B. 1880; med. offr., F.M.S., Oct., 1911; med. offr., grade III, Aug., 1912; surgn., native hosps., S.S., Aug., 1914; sr. surgn., Singapore, May, 1917.

SMITH, CHARLES ROBERT.—B. 1887; N. Borneo serv., Aug., 1913; astt. dist. offr., May, 1916; mag., 1st cls., Jan., 1918; dist. offr., July, 1919; astt. gov't. sec., Oct., 1926; ag. under sec., July, 1929; ag. res., May, 1930; res., Jan., 1932; ag. gov't. sec., Mar., 1934; addl. sess. judge, May, 1934; ag. judge, high ct., June, 1934.

SMITH, CLIVE ALEXANDER.—B. 1903; ed. Malton Grammar Schl.; R. Navy, 1919; sub. inspr., Jamaica constab., Dec., 1924; 3rd cls. inspr., May, 1930.

SMITH, CUTHBERT, Dip. in Forestry (Oxon.).—B. 1890; astt. conserv., forests, grade II, F.M.S., Nov., 1914; astt. conserv., forests (new scheme), Jan., 1919; dep. conserv., forests, Jan., 1930; ag. conserv., forests, Johore, May, 1930; conserv., forests, Johore, 1934.

SMITH, HON. DAVID STANLEY, LL.M.—B. 1888; ed. Southland Boys' High Schl., Wellington Coll. and Victoria Univ. Coll. (N.Z.); on serv. with N.Z. exped. force, 1917-18; barrister, solic., and notary pub. till apptd. judge, N.Z. sup. ct., 1928; examr. in law, univ. of N.Z., 1920-27; appointee of U.S.A. as non-national mem. perm. comm. to settle disputes between U.S.A. and Peru; chmn., native affrs. comm. (N.Z.), 1934; author of "Adoption of Children in N.Z." in Journal of Comparative Legislation, Oct., 1921.

SMITH, E. A.—B. 1896; ent. E.I.O., Dec., 1911; apptd. after compet. exam., astt. clk., Dec., 1913; on mily. serv., Dec., 1915 to Jan., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

SMITH, EDWARD PAUL.—B. 1884; Cape mounted pol., June, 1901; clk. to regr., deeds, Cape Town, 1903; clk. to high sheriff, C.T., 1907; 2nd gr. clk., pub. ser. comm., 1913; on mily. serv., Great War, 1915-18 (wounded); 1st gr. clk., ditto, 1919; 1st gr. clk., treasry., 1921; senr. clk., P.S.C., 1922; prin. clk., ditto, 1927; ch. clk., ditto, 1930; pub. ser. inspr., 1931.

SMITH, EMILE HAMEL L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S., L.F.P. and S., Glas.—B. 1879; ent. med. serv., Trinidad, Sept., 1909; dist. med. offr., Dec., 1912.

SMITH, ERNEST ALLEN.—B. 1896; war serv., 1914-19; astt. audr., Gold Coast, 1924; audr., Leeward Is., 1927; senr. astt. audr., N. Rhodesia, 1932; ag. audr., 1934; dep. audr., Gold Coast, 1935.

SMITH, ERNEST GARDINER, M.A., LL.B.—Advoc.—prizeman in constit. law and hist.; astt. dist. commr., S. Nigeria, Aug., 1908; astt. pol. mag., Jan., 1911; 2nd grade mag., Nigeria, Jan., 1914; 1st grade mag., Jan., 1914; transf. to legal dept., Sept., 1914; ag. solr. gen., Aug., 1920 to Apr., 1921 and Aug., 1921 to Mar., 1922; circuit judge, Ashanti and N. Territories, G. Coast, Aug., 1922; puism. judge, G. Coast, June, 1925; ch. just., Seychelles, 1935; compiled 1928 edition Laws of Gold Coast, Ashanti, etc.

SMITH, ERNEST JOHN.—B. 1888; ed. E. London Tech. Coll.; mily. serv., Gold Coast Volunteers, 1914-18; astt. acct., constrn., Gold Coast rly., 1920; ch. acct., 1922; dep. ch. constrn. acct., Nigerian rly., 1929; astt. ch. acct., 1930; ch. acct., 1933.

SMITH, FRANCIS EDWARD VINEY, B.Sc. (Hons.)—Ed. Colston's Schl. and Univ., Bristol, 1921; dept. sci. and indust. research, 1921; senr. astt. mycologist, min. of agr. and fisheries, Eng., 1924; govt. microbiologist, Jamaica, 1927; Jamaica del., Impl. Mycological Conf., and Impl. Meteorological Conf., London, 1929; banana industry aid bd, 1932; ag. dir. agr., 1933; sec., W.I. Fruit and Veg. Conf., 1933; mission, Honduras and Florida on citrus industry, 1933.

SMITH, FREDERIC GORDON—B. 1886; ed. Bromsgrove Schl.; solr., Jan., 1909; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, July, 1921; legal dept., N. Rhodesia, 1913; on active serv. in East Africa, with N. R. Police, July, 1915 to July, 1918; held various appts. in legal dept., N. Rhodesia, with B.S.A. Co's adminstr., including registr., high ct. etc., and astt. legal adviser and pub. pros.; astt. atty-gen., Oct., 1924; solr.-gen., Kenya, Sept., 1926; atty.-gen., N. Rhodesia, Apr., 1927; ag. judge, high ct., Sept., 1927 to Mar., 1928 and in 1931; mem., exec. and leg. couns.; atty.-gen., Trinidad, Oct., 1932; puism. judge, S. Stlntms., 1935.

SMITH-FOLLETT, ROBERT REDVERS, B.Sc., A.R.C.S.—B. 1901; ed. Skinners Schl. and Impl. Coll. Sci. and Tech. (B.Sc. hons. chem.); Impl. Coll. Trop. Agr., Trinidad, 1925; research astt. to prof., chem. and soil sci., 1927; chemist-ecologist attd. to col. comtee., Br. Guiana, 1929; chemist-ecologist, dept. agr., Br. Guiana, 1930.

SMITH, SIR GEORGE, K.C.M.G. (1914).—C. M. G. (1911).—B. 1858; entd. war office, Apr., 1873; clk., ch. sec.'s office, Cyprus, Nov., 1879; ch. clk., ditto, 1881; astt. to ch. sec., Dec., 1883; clk., legis. coun., Mar., 1886 to Nov., 1891; commr., Papho, Nov., 1891; regnr.-gen. and offl. mem. of legis. coun., June, 1895; as sec., Col. and Ind. Exhib. comtee., 1886; sec. to Queen's Jubilee Memorial comtee., 1887; pres. mun. comm., Papho, 1892; ag. Br. del. of Evraf, under conven. with Turkey, Mar., to Nov., 1903; ag. prin. forest offr., 1903 and 1907; ag. dir. of agric., 1904 and 1905; Br. del. of Evraf, July, 1905; ag. recr.-gen., and ch. collr. of cust., 1905, 1906, 1907 and 1909; col. sec., Mauritius, June, 1910; administered govt., Apr., to Nov., 1911; gov., Nyasaland, May, 1913; assumed govt., Sept., 1913; ret., Dec., 1923.

SMITH, HARRY ALSTON.—B. 1886; stock inspr., Basutoland, 1913; sub.-inspr. Basutoland mounted pol., 1919; war serv., 1914-18; inspr., 1930.

SMITH, HARRY LESTER, O.B.E. (1933).—B. 1884; clk., G.P.O., O.R.C., May, 1903; clk., col. sec's office, O.R.C., Aug., 1903; clk., gov't. office, O.R.C., 1907; clk., gov'-gen's. office, Union of S.A., May, 1910; prin. clk., July, 1924; ch. clk., Nov., 1926; ag. sec. to gov.-genl., Oct., 1925 to Jan., 1927; ch. clk., off. of high commr. for S.A., Jan., 1928; sec. Swaziland finan. and econ. comm., 1931-32; ditto, Basutoland, 1934-35; astt. admin. sec., 1934.

SMITH, HUGH MIDDLETON BRICE, M.A.—B. 1884; ed. at Pocklington Schl. and Queen's Coll. Cambridge; astt. res., N. Nigeria Jan., 1909; 2nd cls. dist. offr., Oct., 1917; ag. mag. in 1921 and 1922.

SMITH, JAMES.—B. 1882; stock inspr., Basutoland, 1911; sub.-insp., Basutoland mounted pol., 1917; inspr., 1926.

SMITH, JAMES DAVID MAXWELL, M.A. (Aberdeen).—B. 1895; cadet, F.M.S., July, 1920; astt. collr., land rev., Lower Perak, Oct., 1920; passed cadet, July, 1922; offr., cls. V., Sept., 1922; astt. sec. to res., Perak, July, 1925; offr., cls. IV., Sept., 1926; offr., cls. III., Sept., 1931; retrenchment offr., F.M.S., May, 1932; ag. legal advr. and judi. commr., Kelantan, Apr., 1934.
SMITH, JAMES LANDRETH.—B. 1870; draftsman, P.W.D., St. Lucia, July, 1891; draftsman, survey off., Sept., 1893; warden and asst. of water-wks. under St. George's town bd., Apr., 1895 to Aug., 1901; chief overseer of roads and works, Grenada, Aug., 1901; asst. supt. of wks., Apr., 1902; comnr. of crown lands, June, 1904; survr., crown lands, 1904; ag. supt., wks., June, 1906 to Jan., 1907; supervisor, govt. cotton gin- nery, Oct., 1912; ool. engr., Oct., 1918 to Aug., 1920; supt. pub. wks., St. Kitts-Nevis, Sept., 1920.

SMITH, JOHN, O.B.E. (1933).—B. 1883; ed. New Vety Coll., Edinburgh (M.R.C.V.S.), and Liverpool Univ. (D.V.H.); vety. offr., N.
